tldr: This paper introduces the Action Diffusion Transformer (ADT), an anchor-free diffusion transformer that models the multimodal distribution of driving actions for end-to-end autonomous driving, outperforming prior state-of-the-art on the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark with lower latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了动作扩散变换器（ADT），一种无锚点的扩散变换器，用于对端到端自动驾驶中的动作多模态分布进行建模，在闭环 Bench2Drive 基准测试中超越了先前的最先进水平，且延迟更低。

title: RoboDream: Compositional World Models for Scalable Robot Data Synthesis
summary: Scaling robot learning requires large-scale, diverse demonstrations, yet real-world data collection via teleoperation remains prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. While video diffusion models offer a promising avenue for data scaling, existing generative approaches are often limited to superficial visual augmentation, or suffer from embodiment hallucinations that yield physically infeasible motions. We present a generalizable embodiment-centric world model that achieves scalable data generation by synthesizing photorealistic demonstrations with novel objects, in novel scenes, and from novel viewpoints. Our approach anchors generation to rendered robot motion while conditioning on explicit scene and object priors, effectively decoupling trajectory execution from environment synthesis. This formulation has the potential to unlock two powerful data scaling capabilities: (1) retrieval and rebirth, which repurposes existing trajectories into entirely new contexts without new motion data; and (2) prop-free teleoperation, where operators manipulate empty air and the model hallucinates the target objects and scene afterwards, eliminating reset time. We demonstrate with real-world experiments that our generated data consistently improves downstream policy performance and significantly reduces real-world data requirements across diverse manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 缩放机器人学习需要大规模、多样化的示范数据，然而通过遥操作采集真实世界数据仍然成本高昂且耗时。尽管视频扩散模型为数据扩展提供了有前景的途径，但现有生成方法通常局限于表面化的视觉增强，或存在具身幻觉问题，导致生成的运动在实际中不可行。我们提出了一种可泛化的具身中心世界模型，通过合成具有新物体、新场景和新视角的光写实示范数据，实现了可扩展的数据生成。该方法以渲染的机器人运动作为生成锚点，同时基于显式的场景和物体先验进行条件约束，有效解耦了轨迹执行与环境合成。这一框架具有解锁两种强大数据扩展能力的潜力：(1) 检索与重生——无需新增运动数据即可将现有轨迹迁移至全新场景；(2) 无道具遥操作——操作员仅需在空中执行动作，模型后续生成目标物体与场景的幻觉表征，消除了复位时间。通过真实世界实验，我们证明所生成的数据能够持续提升下游策略性能，并在多种操作任务中显著降低对真实世界数据的需求。
tldr: RoboDream proposes an embodiment-centric world model that synthesizes photorealistic robot demonstrations by decoupling trajectory execution from environment synthesis, enabling scalable data generation for manipulation policies without costly real-world data collection.
tldr_zh: RoboDream 提出了一种以具身为中心的世界模型，通过将轨迹执行与环境合成解耦，生成逼真的机器人演示数据，从而在不进行昂贵真实数据采集的情况下实现操作策略的可扩展数据生成。

title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding
summary: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN
summary_zh: 功能可供性理解连接了视觉感知与物理动作，为机器人在开放、非结构化的真实世界环境中的操作提供了可解释的接口。然而，构建一个不仅能理解交互应发生在何处以及如何发生，还能在不同环境、物体和任务间泛化的功能可供性基础模型，仍是一个长期存在的研究挑战。现有方法通常仅解决该挑战的某一部分：要么定位与任务相关的区域但未指定可执行动作，要么预测动作但可扩展性有限。本文提出我们的模型，向实现功能理解的可供性基础模型迈进一步。通过单一RGB-D观测与语言任务描述，该模型可预测任务条件功能掩码（何处交互）和三维接触后运动曲线（如何交互）。为支持开放世界泛化，我们构建了大规模标准化数据管道，将异构的机器人数据、人类数据、仿真数据及真实世界扫描数据转换为统一的可供性模式，包含语言标签、掩码及以物体为中心的三维运动标注。我们从三方面评估模型：在可供性分割方面，模型在来自4个基准测试的8个测试集上大幅超越所有基线，平均gIoU/cIoU提升+23.9/+26.3；在接触点预测方面，模型预测精度显著更高，命中率较最佳基线提升12.7%–61.3%；在三维运动方面，模型在所有三个测试集上均达到最优性能。该模型可直接部署于真实世界机器人操作任务，无需针对机器人本体微调或使用任务特定启发式方法，展示了适应开放世界可供性任务的能力。项目页面：https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN
tldr: This paper presents an affordance foundation model that predicts functional masks and 3D post-contact motion curves from RGB-D and language input, enabling open-world robot manipulation without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可供性基础模型，从RGB-D和语言输入中预测功能掩码和3D接触后运动曲线，实现了无需微调的开放世界机器人操作。

title: Intercepting the Future: Latent-Space Predictive World Model for Dynamic VLA Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across static manipulation but fail when objects move during task execution. They map the current observation to an action and assume the scene is stationary between observation and execution, so at any non-trivial object speed the resulting latency exceeds the time available to grasp. We close this gap with AHEAD (Anticipatory Horizon Extrapolation with Adaptive Dynamics), a predict-then-act wrapper that augments a frozen VLA with a motion-aware latent world model. A small world model trained on manipulation video forecasts future patch tokens in the VLA's feature space, conditioned on per-token velocity and acceleration from optical flow. A language-and-motion saliency mask concentrates prediction on task-relevant patches, and the model rolls forward for an adaptive horizon, halting when prediction uncertainty crosses a threshold. The frozen action decoder then receives the predicted future tokens in place of the current ones. AHEAD adds 4.9M parameters to a frozen 7B OpenVLA and reaches 79 to 97% success across 20 dynamic simulation scenarios where the strongest baseline reaches 31 to 58%. On a physical UFactory xArm 7, AHEAD succeeds on 29/30 to 30/30 on three conveyor and rolling-ball tasks, 23/30 on paddle interception, and 19/30 on projectile catching where every baseline scores 0/30.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在静态操作场景中具有良好的泛化能力，但当物体在任务执行过程中发生运动时则表现失效。这类模型将当前观测映射为动作，并假设观测与执行之间场景保持静止，因此在任何非零物体速度下，产生的延迟都会超过可用于抓取的时间。我们通过AHEAD（自适应动力学的前瞻性视界外推）方法弥补了这一差距——这是一种预测-动作封装模块，通过运动感知的潜在世界模型增强冻结的VLA模型。该小规模世界模型基于操作视频训练，能够在VLA特征空间中预测未来的分块令牌（patch token），其条件约束来自光流法计算的每令牌速度与加速度。语言-运动联合显著性掩码将预测聚焦于任务相关分块，模型沿自适应视界向前滚动，当预测不确定性超过阈值时停止。随后，冻结的动作解码器接收预测的未来令牌以替代当前令牌。AHEAD为冻结的7B参数OpenVLA模型新增4.9M参数，在20个动态仿真场景中达到了79%~97%的成功率，而最强基线方法仅能达到31%~58%。在实体UFactory xArm 7机械臂上，AHEAD在三个传送带与滚球任务中实现了29/30至30/30的成功率，在挡板拦截任务中为23/30，在抛体接捕任务中为19/30，而所有基线方法在该任务中均为0/30。
tldr: AHEAD augments a frozen VLA model with a latent world model that predicts future visual tokens, enabling the policy to handle dynamic object motion in manipulation tasks, achieving high success on dynamic simulation and real robot experiments.
tldr_zh: AHEAD 通过一个潜在的世界模型预测未来的视觉特征，增强了冻结的 VLA 模型处理动态物体运动的能力，在动态仿真和真实机器人实验中取得了高成功率。

title: Towards Precise Intent-Aligned VLA Aerial Navigation via Expert-Guided GRPO
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising end-to-end paradigm for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to accomplish complex tasks specified by fine-grained instructions. However, standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) suffers from data scarcity, limited generalization, and weak supervision for nuanced and complicated human intents. Reinforcement fine-tuning offers a natural way to mitigate these challenges and align policy behaviors with human intents through designable feedback, but applying it to aerial navigation remains challenging due to inefficient exploration in expansive continuous spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce an efficient reinforcement learning (RL) framework for VLA-based aerial navigation. At its core, we propose EG-GRPO (Expert-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization) to augment online rollouts with few-shot expert data. Additionally, we design a heterogeneous pipeline enabling parallel simulation and inference, which reduces rollout time by 43.5%. Across multiple tasks specified by complex human intents, EG-GRPO improves the success rate to 2.13x that of the SFT baseline, while improving intent alignment performance by 60.9%. These results demonstrate that our framework can move aerial navigation toward precise intent-aligned flight.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为无人机（UAV）执行由细粒度指令指定的复杂任务提供了一种有前景的端到端范式。然而，标准监督微调（SFT）面临数据稀缺、泛化能力有限以及针对细微复杂人类意图的弱监督问题。强化微调为解决这些挑战提供了自然途径，可通过可设计的反馈使策略行为与人类意图对齐，但将其应用于空中导航仍面临挑战，原因在于大范围连续空间中的低效探索。针对这些问题，我们提出了一种基于VLA的空中导航高效强化学习（RL）框架。其核心是专家引导的组相对策略优化（EG-GRPO），通过少量专家数据增强在线轨迹生成。此外，我们设计了一种异构流水线，支持并行仿真与推理，将轨迹生成时间缩短了43.5%。在多个由复杂人类意图指定的任务中，EG-GRPO将成功率提升至SFT基线的2.13倍，同时使意图对齐性能提高60.9%。这些结果表明，我们的框架能够推动空中导航向精准意图对齐飞行迈进。
tldr: This paper proposes EG-GRPO, an expert-guided reinforcement learning framework to fine-tune VLA models for precise intent-aligned UAV navigation, achieving 2.13x success rate and 60.9% improved intent alignment over SFT.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于专家引导的GRPO强化学习框架，用于精细调优VLA模型以实现精确的意图对齐无人机导航，成功率达SFT基线的2.13倍，意图对齐性能提升60.9%。

title: FATE-VLA:Failue-aware test generation for vision-language-action models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly used as generalist robot policies, yet their evaluation still relies largely on static benchmarks that randomly sample task scenes. In high-dimensional embodied spaces, failures are sparse and clustered, so static benchmarking can underestimate robustness risks. We reframe VLA evaluation as an active failure-discovery problem and propose a failure-aware test-generation approach that combines diversity-driven exploration with surrogate models learned from observed executions. The method steers testing toward high-risk yet diverse scene regions. Across four state-of-the-art VLA models, it uncovers substantially more failures (up to +29.7 % over selected baselines) while revealing more diverse failure modes. This mean that, for instance, in the case of GR00T-N1.6, success rate dropped from 64.4% to 34.7%. More broadly, our findings call for a shift in VLA evaluation: from passive measurement on fixed task suites to adaptive, failure-seeking test generation that exposes the structure of model weaknesses before deployment.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型正越来越多地被用作通用机器人策略，但对其评估仍主要依赖于随机采样任务场景的静态基准。在高维具身空间中，失败是稀疏且聚集的，因此静态基准测试可能低估鲁棒性风险。本文将VLA评估重新定义为主动故障发现问题，并提出一种故障感知测试生成方法，该方法将多样性驱动探索与从观测执行中学习到的代理模型相结合。该技术将测试导向高风险且具有多样性的场景区域。在四种最先进的VLA模型上，该方法发现了显著更多的故障（相比选定基线最多提升29.7%），同时揭示了更多样化的故障模式。这意味着，例如在GR00T-N1.6模型中，成功率从64.4%降至34.7%。更广泛地，我们的研究呼吁VLA评估的范式转变：从固定任务集上的被动测量转向自适应、故障寻找的测试生成，从而在部署前暴露模型弱点的结构。
tldr: Proposes a failure-aware test generation method for VLA models that actively searches for high-risk, diverse failure modes, revealing significantly more failures than static benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种面向VLA模型的故障感知测试生成方法，通过主动搜索高风险且多样的故障模式，比静态基准测试发现显著更多的故障。

title: RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are built on the premise that semantic understanding from pretrained language or vision-language backbones should guide robot action prediction. Yet robot fine-tuning is optimized as imitation over task-specific action distributions, and many evaluations can be solved through visual or instruction-action shortcuts. We introduce RoboSemanticBench (RSB), an embodied benchmark for diagnosing semantic grounding in action prediction: whether post-trained VLA models can use complex instruction semantics to select and manipulate the correct physical target. In each episode, a robot receives a multiple-choice math or general-knowledge question, observes candidate answer blocks, and must grasp the block corresponding to the correct answer. RSB covers controlled arithmetic, grade-school mathematical understanding, and commonsense or factual understanding under four-choice and ten-choice suites. Across representative VLA models, we find that many policies learn to grasp candidate blocks but select the semantically correct block at near-random or below-random rates after controlling for grasp success, revealing a persistent gap between backbone-level semantic competence and action prediction.
summary_zh:
**摘要**  
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基于这样一个前提：预训练语言或视觉-语言骨干网络的语义理解能力应能指导机器人动作预测。然而，机器人微调过程被优化为对任务特定动作分布的模仿，且许多评估可通过视觉或指令-动作捷径解决。我们引入RoboSemanticBench（RSB），这是一个用于诊断动作预测中语义接地能力的具身基准测试：即经过后训练的VLA模型能否利用复杂指令语义来选择和操作正确的物理目标。在每次任务中，机器人接收一道数学或常识类的多项选择题，观察候选答案块，并必须抓取对应正确答案的方块。RSB涵盖受控算术、小学水平的数学理解，以及四选一和十选一套题中的常识或事实性理解。在对代表性VLA模型的评估中，我们发现许多策略学会了抓取候选方块，但在控制抓取成功率后，选择语义正确方块的概率接近随机或低于随机水平，揭示出骨干网络层面的语义能力与动作预测之间持续存在的差距。
tldr: RoboSemanticBench is a benchmark that diagnoses whether VLA models truly ground instruction semantics in action prediction, revealing that many policies perform near-random on semantic target selection.
tldr_zh: RoboSemanticBench 是一个基准测试，用于诊断视觉-语言-动作模型是否真正将指令语义落实到动作预测中，结果显示许多策略在语义目标选择上表现接近随机。

title: Dexterity-BEV: Aligning 3D World and Actions for Generalizable Robot Policies Learning
summary: End-to-end manipulation policies, combined with web-scale pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show the promise for generalizable and dexterous robotic manipulation. However, they inherit two key limitations from 2D foundation models: 1) the reliance on 2D RGB inputs that ignores the intrinsically 3D nature of manipulation; and 2) the lack of spatial 3D alignment between input-output spaces as well as across diverse robot embodiments, camera setups, and trajectory datasets. In this paper, we present a series of contributions to address these issues. First, we introduce aligned vertex map and vertex spectrum -- a pixel-wise 3D representation that elevates 2D visual inputs to 3D, using camera calibration and optional depth. This novel input representation marries 3D awareness with the generalization of 2D large VLMs. Then, we propose to align the inputs and outputs of manipulation policies by expressing per-pixel 3D information of each camera view and robot actions to a shared coordinate. Based on this, we designate a canonical Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) alignment frame and innovatively propose to construct BEV images, producing a view-invariant representation robust to camera pose variations. To enable training and evaluation at scale, we develop a comprehensive data processing pipeline to perform such alignments; we also introduce a novel temporal alignment scheme for trajectories across diverse robots, human operators, and datasets. These contributions collectively mitigate input and output spatial-temporal misalignments, improving the consistency and generalization for real-world manipulation. Pretrained checkpoint, source code and data processing pipeline are available in https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV.
summary_zh: 端到端操作策略结合大规模预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM），在实现通用且灵巧的机器人操作方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，这类策略继承了二维基础模型的两项关键局限：1）依赖忽略操作固有三维特性的二维RGB输入；2）在输入输出空间之间以及跨不同机器人构型、摄像头设置和轨迹数据集时缺乏三维空间对齐。本文提出一系列创新方法解决上述问题。首先，我们引入对齐顶点图与顶点谱——一种利用相机标定与可选深度信息将二维视觉输入提升至三维的像素级表征。这种新型输入表征将三维感知能力与二维大型视觉-语言模型的泛化性相结合。其次，我们通过将每个相机视角的逐像素三维信息与机器人动作映射至共享坐标系，实现操作策略输入输出的对齐。基于此，我们指定标准化的鸟瞰图（BEV）对齐框架，并创新性地提出构建BEV图像，生成对相机位姿变化鲁棒的视角不变表征。为支持大规模训练与评估，我们开发了完整的数据处理管线以实现此类对齐；同时引入针对跨不同机器人、操作员与数据集的轨迹时序对齐方案。上述贡献共同缓解了输入输出的时空错位问题，提升了真实环境操作的一致性与泛化能力。预训练模型、源代码及数据处理管线已开源至：https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV
tldr: Dexterity-BEV introduces a 3D-aligned input representation (aligned vertex maps, vertex spectrum) and a canonical BEV alignment frame to address spatial-temporal misalignments in VLM-based robotic manipulation policies, enabling view-invariant and embodiment-agnostic learning from diverse datasets.
tldr_zh: Dexterity-BEV 提出了一种三维对齐的输入表示（对齐顶点图、顶点谱）和规范的 BEV 对齐框架，以解决基于 VLM 的机器人操作策略中的时空错位问题，从而实现视角不变和跨本体、跨数据集的通用学习。

title: World-Task Factorization for Robot Learning
summary: Robot learning must produce policies that generalize to new combinations of constraints, teammates, and environments. To achieve this, we must structurally factor the policy, which is a choice that dictates what generalizes, what requires retraining, and what remains entangled. Existing methods span a wide spectrum, from expecting structure to emerge from data scaling, to hand-designing it via hierarchies, skill libraries or learned specializations. In this paper, we study what we argue is the most fundamental factorization in robotics: separating the world from the task. We investigate the conditions under which this factorization is principled. World factors are properties of the embodied system and the environment; they exist independently of intent. Task factors are defined by the task's logic over what the world admits. We formalize this asymmetry through Bayesian model evidence: it aligns with the data-generating process, maintains high likelihood through an analytical world model, and reduces the Occam razor's penalty on task parameters. We instantiate this factorization by pairing AICON, a differentiable graph of recursive estimators and interconnections that is compositional, operates without task-specific data, and propagates cost gradients to actuators, with a compact, learned policy that modulates gradient paths. Gradients serve as the interface between the two factors: they carry world structure through the graph and task structure through costs, enabling low-dimensional learning while preserving structural generalization. We test the world/task factorization across three problems that encompass heterogeneous robots, environments, task logic and sensorimotor modalities. Our framework outperforms end-to-end baselines and analytical heuristics in all settings, generalizes zero-shot to out-of-distribution configurations, and transfers to real hardware without retraining.
summary_zh: 机器人学习必须生成能够泛化至新约束、新队友及新环境组合的策略。为实现这一目标，我们必须对策略进行结构性分解——这一选择决定了哪些部分可泛化、哪些需要重新训练、哪些仍保持纠缠状态。现有方法涵盖广泛范围：从期望通过数据扩展自然涌现结构，到通过层级结构、技能库或习得特化机制进行人工设计。本文研究的核心问题是机器人领域最基础的分解方式：将世界与任务相分离。我们探究这种分解具备原则性的条件。世界因子是具身系统与环境的固有属性，独立于意图存在；任务因子则由任务逻辑对世界所容许内容进行定义。通过贝叶斯模型证据正式化这种非对称性：该分解与数据生成过程一致，通过解析世界模型维持高似然性，并降低奥卡姆剃刀对任务参数的惩罚。我们通过配对AICON（一种可微分图结构，由递归估计器与相互连接组成，具备组合性、无需任务特定数据运行、可将成本梯度传播至执行器）与紧凑型习得策略（可调节梯度路径）来实例化该分解。梯度作为两因子间的接口：通过图结构传递世界结构，通过成本传递任务结构，从而在保持结构泛化能力的同时实现低维学习。我们在涵盖异构机器人、环境、任务逻辑及感知运动模态的三个问题上测试世界/任务分解。本框架在所有场景中均优于端到端基线方法与分析启发式算法，可零样本泛化至分布外配置，且无需重新训练即可迁移至真实硬件。
tldr: This paper proposes a world-task factorization for robot learning, separating world model (AICON, a differentiable graph) from task policy, enabling zero-shot generalization to new tasks, environments, and robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种世界-任务分解的机器人学习方法，将世界模型（AICON，可微图结构）与任务策略分离，实现对不同任务、环境和机器人的零样本泛化。

title: Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects
summary: World models enable intelligent agents to predict the consequences of their actions on the environment. In this paper, we propose Multi Rigid Object Gaussian World Model (MRO-GWM), a novel model that learns action-conditional dynamics of rigid objects in 3D. By representing the scene by object-centric Gaussians, we can represent arbitrary object shapes and multi-object scenes. We develop a novel spatio-temporal transformer architecture that predicts future rigid body motion from a history of object Gaussians and future actions. Objects are represented by their Gaussians in a canonical frame, which allows for describing object motion as rigid body transformation. Our model is trained on reconstructions from multiple viewpoints, which requires the model to handle partial observations of objects due to occlusions. We analyze prediction performance of our approach on synthetic datasets composed of typical household objects with multi-object dynamics and interactions by a robot end effector. We also evaluate our model in model-predictive control for non-prehensile manipulation in simulation.
summary_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够预测其行为对环境产生的影响。本文提出多刚体对象高斯世界模型（MRO-GWM），这是一种学习三维环境中刚体对象动作条件动力学的新型模型。通过使用以物体为中心的高斯分布表征场景，我们能够表示任意物体形状及多物体场景。我们开发了新型时空变换器架构，该架构可从物体高斯分布的历史记录与未来动作中预测刚体运动。物体通过其规范坐标系下的高斯分布进行表征，这使得物体运动可被描述为刚体变换。该模型基于多视角重建数据进行训练，因此需要模型能够处理因遮挡导致的物体局部观测问题。我们分析了该方法在由典型家居物体构成、包含多物体动力学及机器人末端执行器交互的合成数据集上的预测性能，并在仿真环境中通过模型预测控制对非抓取操作进行了评估。
tldr: This paper introduces MRO-GWM, a world model that uses object-centric Gaussian splatting and a spatio-temporal transformer to predict future rigid-body motion from action sequences, enabling model-predictive control for non-prehensile manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MRO-GWM，一种基于物体中心高斯散射和时空变换器的世界模型，用于从动作序列预测未来刚体运动，并支持非抓取操作中的模型预测控制。

title: Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections
summary: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful framework for robotic manipulation. However, like other behavior cloning methods, they remain vulnerable to distributional shift, often requiring human-in-the-loop interventions to correct failures during deployment. These interactions naturally provide paired supervision in the form of the robot's undesired actions and the human teacher's corrective actions. Yet existing data aggregation pipelines and standard behavior cloning losses largely ignore this negative signal from undesired actions, leading to overfitting to teacher's actions and an increasing reliance on costly expert data. To address this limitation, we propose Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), a novel learning framework that utilizes contrastive action-chunk data to train diffusion policies from human corrections. From paired positive and negative action-chunks, SDP constructs a set of desired action-chunks and designs a training pipeline that encourages the diffusion policy to align with the set. Through extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks, we demonstrate that SDP consistently improves policy performance, with particularly strong gains in robustness to noisy data. Moreover, SDP induces high-quality aggregated datasets, enabling more efficient and reliable policy learning from human-in-the-loop corrections. Our code is available at https://set-supervised-diffusion-policy.github.io/.
summary_zh: 扩散策略近期已成为机器人操作领域的强大框架。然而，与其他行为克隆方法类似，它仍易受分布偏移影响，通常需要人为介入来纠正部署中的失误。这类交互自然形成了成对监督信号：即机器人的非期望动作与人类教师的矫正动作。但现有数据聚合流程及标准行为克隆损失函数基本忽略了非期望动作中的负向信号，导致对教师动作的过拟合，且日益依赖昂贵的专家数据。为解决该局限，我们提出集合监督扩散策略（SDP），这是一种利用对比式动作块数据从人类修正中训练扩散策略的新型学习框架。通过配对的正面与负面动作块，SDP构建期望动作块集合，并设计训练流程促使扩散策略与该集合对齐。在多项机器人操作任务的广泛实验中，我们证明SDP能持续提升策略性能，尤其在噪声数据鲁棒性方面表现突出。此外，SDP可产生高质量聚合数据集，从而通过人在回路修正实现更高效可靠的政策学习。代码已开源至 https://set-supervised-diffusion-policy.github.io/。
tldr: Proposes Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), a framework that uses paired positive and negative action-chunks from human corrections to train diffusion policies for robotic manipulation, improving robustness to distributional shift and data efficiency.
tldr_zh: 提出了集合监督扩散策略（SDP），利用人工修正中的正负动作片段对来训练机器人操作的扩散策略，提高了对分布偏移的鲁棒性和数据效率。

title: PHASOR: Phase-Anchored Universal Action Representations for Humanoid Embodiments
summary: Learning a good action embedding space is fundamental to scalable robot policy learning, yet existing methods treat action latents as task-specific intermediates rather than first-class representations. The resulting latents are unstructured, embodiment-specific, and weakly tied to motion semantics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and transferability across robots. We position the action embedding space itself as a first-class design target, with downstream policy quality emerging from representation quality. Exploiting motion's intrinsic periodicity, we factorize it into a phase manifold that captures cyclic structure via FFT-parametric coefficients, together with a pose branch that conditions the manifold on non-periodic configuration detail. Combined with motion-semantic distillation, this factorized structure yields a cross-embodiment motion manifold that is interpretable and embodiment-agnostic by design. Anchoring multiple humanoid robots to a shared human-pretrained manifold then produces a unified action embedding space across diverse platforms, achieving strong cross-embodiment retrieval and consistent gains on downstream robot tasks.
summary_zh: 学习一个良好的动作嵌入空间对于可扩展的机器人策略学习至关重要，然而现有方法将动作潜在变量视为特定于任务的中间产物，而非第一类表征。由此产生的潜在变量结构松散、具身特异性强，且与运动语义关联薄弱，从而限制了其可解释性、可控性以及跨机器人的迁移能力。我们将动作嵌入空间本身定位为第一类设计目标，并认为下游策略质量源于表征质量。利用运动固有的周期性，我们将其分解为一个通过傅里叶变换参数化系数捕捉循环结构的相位流形，以及一个在该流形上施加非周期性构型细节条件的位置分支。结合运动语义蒸馏，这种分解结构产生了一个跨具身的运动流形，该流形在设计上具有可解释性且与具身无关。将多个人形机器人锚定至一个共享的、基于人类预训练的流形，即可在多种平台上生成统一的动作嵌入空间，从而实现强大的跨具身检索，并在下游机器人任务中取得一致的性能提升。
tldr: This paper proposes PHASOR, a method that learns a phase-anchored, embodiment-agnostic action embedding space for multiple humanoid robots by exploiting motion periodicity and distilling motion semantics from human data, enabling cross-embodiment retrieval and improved downstream task performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PHASOR，一种通过利用运动周期性和从人类数据中蒸馏运动语义，为多个人形机器人学习相位锚定的、跨本体的动作嵌入空间的方法，实现了跨本体检索并提升了下游任务性能。

title: The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space
summary: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作策略在机器人操作中取得了显著成功，但存在一个我们称之为 **欧几里得谬误** 的基本几何错误：将SE(3)位姿表示为平坦的$\mathbb{R}^{12}$向量。这种近似会导致：（1）违反SO(3)约束的流形漂移，（2）坐标变换下等变性的破坏，以及（3）运动学代价过高的非测地轨迹。为此，我们提出 **李扩散作用器（LDA）**——一种固有地在SE(3)上运行的扩散框架。该方法通过左不变随机微分方程注入噪声，在切空间中预测分数，并通过指数映射回缩样本。该构造从原理上消除了流形漂移，同时保证了坐标系的等变性和测地最优性。在CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D任务上，LDA将平均任务长度从$3.27$提升至$3.51$（$+7.3\%$）。我们进一步在真实机器人上验证了该方法，结果表明我们的方法在多数任务上优于基线。
tldr: Introduces Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA), a diffusion framework that operates directly on SE(3) to correct the Euclidean fallacy in VLA policies by using left-invariant SDEs and tangent-space score matching, improving manipulation task success.
tldr_zh: 提出李群扩散动作器（LDA），这是一个直接在SE(3)上操作的扩散框架，通过使用左不变SDE和切空间分数匹配来纠正VLA策略中的欧几里得谬误，提高了操作任务的成功率。

title: RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Video world models are increasingly used in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate them under valid, feasible, and safe instructions. We introduce RoboTrustBench, a benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of video world models under four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. Built from real-world DROID episodes, RoboTrustBench contains 1,207 expert-validated instruction-image pairs and a six-dimensional evaluation protocol with 13 fine-grained criteria. Evaluating seven representative video world models with human and MLLM assessment, we find that current models often generate visually coherent videos, but struggle with constraint reasoning, counterfactual grounding, physical interaction, and unsafe-instruction suppression. These results show that visual quality and surface-level instruction following are insufficient for trustworthy robotic video world modeling.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型在机器人操作领域应用日益广泛，但现有基准测试主要在有效、可行且安全的指令下对其进行评估。我们提出RoboTrustBench基准，用于在四种场景下评估视频世界模型的可信度：正常场景、约束敏感场景、反事实场景和对抗场景。该基准基于真实世界的DROID片段构建，包含1,207个经过专家验证的指令-图像对，以及一套包含13个细粒度标准的六维评估协议。通过人类与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评估对七个代表性视频世界模型进行测试，我们发现当前模型生成的视频在视觉上往往具有连贯性，但在约束推理、反事实基础、物理交互及不安全指令抑制方面存在明显不足。这些结果表明，仅凭视觉质量和表面指令遵循能力，不足以构建可信的机器人视频世界模型。
tldr: Introduces RoboTrustBench, a benchmark to evaluate the trustworthiness of video world models for robotic manipulation under normal, constrained, counterfactual, and adversarial scenarios, revealing that current models fail at reasoning and safety.
tldr_zh: 提出了RoboTrustBench，一个评估视频世界模型在机器人操作中可信度的基准，涵盖正常、约束、反事实和对抗场景，发现现有模型在推理和安全方面存在不足。

title: Hierarchical Semantic-Augmented Navigation: Optimal Transport and Graph-Driven Reasoning for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) poses a formidable challenge for autonomous agents, requiring seamless integration of natural language instructions and visual observations to navigate complex 3D indoor spaces. Existing approaches often falter in long-horizon tasks due to limited scene understanding, inefficient planning, and lack of robust decision-making frameworks. We introduce the \textbf{Hierarchical Semantic-Augmented Navigation (HSAN)} framework, a groundbreaking approach that redefines VLN-CE through three synergistic innovations. First, HSAN constructs a dynamic hierarchical semantic scene graph, leveraging vision-language models to capture multi-level environmental representations, from objects to regions to zones, enabling nuanced spatial reasoning. Second, it employs an optimal transport-based topological planner, grounded in Kantorovich's duality, to select long-term goals by balancing semantic relevance and spatial accessibility with theoretical guarantees of optimality. Third, a graph-aware reinforcement learning policy ensures precise low-level control, navigating subgoals while robustly avoiding obstacles. By integrating spectral graph theory, optimal transport, and advanced multi-modal learning, HSAN addresses the shortcomings of static maps and heuristic planners prevalent in prior work. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging VLN-CE datasets demonstrate that HSAN achieves state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in navigation success and generalization to unseen environments.
summary_zh: 连续环境下的视觉-语言导航（VLN-CE）对自主智能体提出了严峻挑战，要求其无缝整合自然语言指令与视觉观测，在复杂的3D室内空间中进行导航。现有方法由于场景理解有限、规划效率低下以及缺乏鲁棒的决策框架，在长程任务中往往表现不佳。本文提出**分层语义增强导航（HSAN）框架**，这是一种开创性方法，通过三项协同创新重新定义了VLN-CE。首先，HSAN构建动态分层语义场景图，利用视觉-语言模型捕捉从物体到区域再到功能区的多层次环境表征，从而实现精细的空间推理。其次，它采用基于最优传输的拓扑规划器（以Kantorovich对偶性为基础），通过平衡语义相关性与空间可达性选择长期目标，并具备最优性的理论保证。第三，基于图感知的强化学习策略确保精准的低层级控制，在避开障碍物的同时可靠地导航子目标。通过整合谱图理论、最优传输与先进的多模态学习，HSAN克服了先前工作中静态地图与启发式规划器的缺陷。在多个具有挑战性的VLN-CE数据集上的大量实验表明，HSAN实现了最先进的性能，在导航成功率与对未知环境的泛化能力方面均有显著提升。
tldr: HSAN introduces a hierarchical VLN-CE framework with a dynamic semantic scene graph, optimal transport-based topological planning, and graph-aware RL for long-horizon navigation, achieving SOTA results.
tldr_zh: HSAN提出了一个分层VLN-CE框架，结合动态语义场景图、最优传输拓扑规划和图感知强化学习，在长时程导航中取得最优结果。

title: Geometry-Aware Implicit Memory for Video World Models
summary: Video world models aim to simulate controllable visual environments, but long-horizon rollouts depend on what the model remembers after observations leave its native context window. Explicit memories retain frames or online 3D reconstructions, which can suffer from heuristic retrieval errors, redundant appearance storage, or reconstruction artifacts. Implicit memories compress history into a compact state, but existing designs are not explicitly constrained to encode cross-view scene geometry. We propose GIM-World, a geometry-aware implicit memory framework for video world models. A lightweight transformer encoder compresses variable-length history into fixed-size memory tokens, a camera-queryable geometry head distills 3D scene structure from a frozen foundation model into the memory during training, and an information-guided pruning rule keeps encoding cost bounded as history grows. The geometry teacher is discarded at inference, leaving a lightweight memory module. Experiments on MIND show that GIM-World better preserves long-horizon geometric and visual consistency than both explicit- and implicit-memory baselines.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
视频世界模型旨在模拟可控的视觉环境，但长程推演依赖于模型在观测数据离开其原生上下文窗口后所保留的记忆。显式记忆保留帧或在线三维重建结果，但可能受到启发式检索错误、冗余外观存储或重建伪影的影响。隐式记忆将历史信息压缩为紧凑状态，但现有设计未明确约束其编码跨视角场景几何结构的能力。本文提出GIM-World——一种面向视频世界模型的几何感知隐式记忆框架。其中，轻量级Transformer编码器将变长历史信息压缩为固定大小的记忆令牌；在训练阶段，可通过相机查询的几何头从冻结基础模型中提取三维场景结构并蒸馏至记忆；同时，信息引导的剪枝规则确保编码成本随历史增长而保持有界。推理阶段丢弃几何教师模型，仅保留轻量级记忆模块。在MIND数据集上的实验表明，GIM-World在长程几何与视觉一致性上均优于显式记忆和隐式记忆基线方法。
tldr: GIM-World introduces a geometry-aware implicit memory module that distills 3D scene structure from a frozen foundation model into compact memory tokens, enabling video world models to maintain long-horizon geometric and visual consistency without explicit frame or reconstruction storage.
tldr_zh: GIM-World 提出了一种几何感知的隐式记忆模块，通过从冻结的基础模型中蒸馏3D场景结构到紧凑的记忆标记中，使视频世界模型能够在不存储显式帧或重建的情况下保持长程几何和视觉一致性。

title: Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning
summary: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its discrete bottleneck with a frozen DINO feature space through feature decoding, while preserving appearance via RGB reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses. To inject geometric state-related cues, we add adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision during training and stabilize joint objectives with multi-codebook quantization. We evaluate the same learned tokens with a lightweight planning readout and a GPT-style next-token world model. Experiments on NAVSIM show improved reconstruction fidelity and representation consistency, competitive planning performance under a fixed decoder, and better generative quality under matched settings.
summary_zh: 离散视觉标记应为基于标记的自动驾驶世界建模与规划提供紧凑的表征方式。然而，当前大多数分词器继承自图像生成领域，主要针对像素重建进行优化，这可能导致易于生成的内容与对驾驶决策有用的解码信息之间存在差距。我们提出了一种表征引导与几何增强的分词器，在联合监督下学习离散标记。该分词器通过特征解码将其离散瓶颈与冻结的DINO特征空间对齐，同时通过感知损失与对抗损失的RGB重建保留外观信息。为注入几何状态相关线索，我们在训练过程中添加了相邻帧深度与相对位姿监督，并通过多码本量化稳定联合目标。我们使用轻量级规划读出器和GPT风格的下一个标记世界模型对所学标记进行评估。在NAVSIM上的实验表明，该方法提升了重建保真度与表征一致性，在固定解码器下展现出具有竞争力的规划性能，并在匹配设置下获得了更优的生成质量。
tldr: A discrete visual tokenizer for autonomous driving that aligns with DINO features and adds geometric supervision (depth, pose) to improve both world modeling and planning.
tldr_zh: 面向自动驾驶的离散视觉分词器，通过对齐DINO特征并加入几何监督（深度、位姿）来提升世界模型与规划性能。

title: IMAC-AgriVLN: Can Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents be Aware of Instruction Mistakes?
summary: Agricultural robots are serving as powerful assistants across a wide range of agricultural tasks, nevertheless, still heavily relying on manual operations or railway systems for movement. The AgriVLN method and the A2A benchmark pioneeringly extended Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) to the agricultural domain, enabling a robot to navigate to a target position following a natural language instruction. However, almost all the prior methods adopt an ideal assumption that the given instructions themselves are correct, which does not align with the realistic scenarios, because anybody may say an instruction with mistakes. To bridge this gap, we propose the A2A-MI benchmark, in which we build a semi-automatic data annotator to insert three mistake classifications into each original instruction in a more diversified and efficient way. We test several state-of-the-art agricultural VLN agents on it and observe a sufficient drop with -57% on SR and -9% on NE, from which we suggest that an agricultural VLN agent tends to assume that the given instruction is correct, so does not have the awareness to doubt it when the scenes it sees do not align with the instruction it receives. To build the awareness on instruction mistake, we propose the IMAC module analyzing the instruction and the current front-facing image, to judge whether the instruction has mistakes and attempt to correct it when needed. We integrate IMAC into the baseline model, and observe a noteworthy improvement, sufficiently narrowing the gap to the performance on instructions without mistakes. Project: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/IMAC-AgriVLN.
summary_zh: 农业机器人正作为得力助手广泛应用于各类农业任务，但依然严重依赖人工操作或轨道系统进行移动。AgriVLN方法与A2A基准开创性地将视觉与语言导航（VLN）拓展至农业领域，使机器人能够依据自然语言指令导航至目标位置。然而，几乎所有现有方法都采用了一个理想化假设——给定的指令本身是正确的，这与现实场景不符，因为任何人都可能说出存在错误的指令。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了A2A-MI基准，在其中构建了一个半自动数据标注器，能够以更多样化且高效的方式向每条原始指令中插入三类错误。我们在该基准上测试了多个最先进的农业VLN智能体，观察到其成功率（SR）下降了57%，导航误差（NE）增加了9%，这表明农业VLN智能体倾向于假设给定指令是正确的，因此在所见场景与接收指令不一致时缺乏质疑意识。为使智能体具备指令错误感知能力，我们提出了IMAC模块，该模块通过分析指令与当前正前方图像，判断指令是否存在错误并在必要时尝试修正。我们将IMAC集成至基线模型中，观察到显著改进，充分缩小了与无错误指令场景下的性能差距。项目地址：https://github.com/AlexTraveling/IMAC-AgriVLN。
tldr: This paper introduces the A2A-MI benchmark for instruction-mistake detection in agricultural VLN and proposes the IMAC module to enable agents to identify and correct such mistakes, improving robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于农业视觉语言导航中指令错误检测的A2A-MI基准，并设计了IMAC模块使智能体能够识别和纠正指令错误，从而提升鲁棒性。

title: NDPP-Grasp: Non-Differentiable Physical Plausibility Constraint-Guided Task-Oriented Dexterous Grasp Generation
summary: Task-oriented dexterous grasp generation aims to produce dexterous grasp poses that are both physically plausible and functionally suitable for specified manipulation tasks. Existing diffusion-based methods often address these two requirements in a decoupled manner: they first train a grasp diffusion model for task alignment and then rely on post-generation refinement to improve physical plausibility. However, this after-the-fact correction strategy applies physical plausibility guidance only once the grasp has already been generated, leaving the generation trajectory itself unguided by physical constraints and potentially leading to suboptimal grasps. To address this problem, we propose a novel framework that directly injects physical plausibility guidance into the denoising process of a task-aligned grasp diffusion model in a practical and effective manner, even when physical plausibility constraints are non-differentiable. This allows physical plausibility to shape grasp generation throughout denoising while preserving task alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our framework.
summary_zh: 面向任务的灵巧抓取生成旨在产生既符合物理可行性、又适用于特定操作任务的灵巧抓取姿态。现有基于扩散的方法通常以解耦方式处理这两类需求：首先训练一个用于任务对齐的抓取扩散模型，然后依赖后生成阶段的修正来提升物理可行性。然而，这种事后修正策略仅在抓取生成完成后才施加物理可行性引导，导致生成轨迹本身未受物理约束的指导，可能产生次优的抓取结果。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖框架，该框架以实用且有效的方式将物理可行性引导直接注入任务对齐抓取扩散模型的去噪过程中，即使物理可行性约束不可微也能实现。这使得物理可行性能够在整个去噪过程中塑造抓取生成，同时保持任务对齐。大量实验证明了该框架的有效性。
tldr: Proposes a diffusion-based framework that injects non-differentiable physical plausibility constraints directly into the denoising process for task-oriented dexterous grasp generation, improving both physical plausibility and task alignment.
tldr_zh: 提出一种扩散模型框架，将不可微的物理合理约束直接注入去噪过程，以生成既物理合理又任务对齐的灵巧抓取姿态。

title: Dynamics Are Learned, Not Told: Semi-Supervised Discovery of Latent Dynamics Geometries For Zero-Shot Policy Adaptation
summary: Real-world dynamics shifts pose a critical challenge for reinforcement learning in robotics, as policies tightly coupled to nominal environments often fail catastrophically when physical conditions change. Most existing methods rely on encoding explicitly identified physical parameters into a latent context, a parameter-centric paradigm that depends on pre-specified axes of variation and becomes brittle under unmodeled or compound dynamics changes. We revisit dynamics adaptation from an outcome-centric perspective: rather than telling policies what the dynamics are, we enable them to learn how dynamics affect interaction outcomes. Theoretically, this is grounded in a monotonic relationship between target-domain regret and the Lipschitz constant of a trajectory dynamics encoder. Practically, this constant can be upper-bounded through contrastive learning, yielding a smooth, task-relevant latent topology without privileged dynamics information. On MuJoCo benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms parameter-centric baselines under severe dynamics shifts, including unmodeled and time-varying parameters, while also improving in-distribution stability and latent interpretability. Overall, these results validate that controlling latent geometry is a principled mechanism for robust adaptation.
summary_zh: 真实世界中的动态变化为机器人强化学习带来了严峻挑战，因为与标称环境紧密耦合的策略在物理条件改变时往往会出现灾难性失效。现有方法大多依赖于将显式识别的物理参数编码到潜在情境中，这种以参数为中心的范式依赖于预先指定的变化轴，在未建模或复合动态变化下会变得脆弱。我们从结果中心视角重新审视动态适应问题：与其告诉策略动力学的具体形式，不如让策略学习动力学如何影响交互结果。理论上，这基于目标域遗憾值与轨迹动力学编码器Lipschitz常数之间的单调关系。实践中，该常数可通过对比学习获得上界，从而在无需特权动力学信息的情况下生成平滑且与任务相关的潜在拓扑结构。在MuJoCo基准测试中，我们的方法在严重动态变化（包括未建模和时变参数）下持续优于以参数为中心的基线方法，同时提升了分布内稳定性与潜在表示的可解释性。总体而言，这些结果验证了控制潜在几何结构是实现鲁棒适应的原则性机制。
tldr: This paper proposes a semi-supervised method for robot policy adaptation to dynamics shifts by learning a task-relevant latent geometry via contrastive learning, outperforming parameter-centric baselines on MuJoCo benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种半监督方法，通过对比学习学习任务相关的潜在几何结构，实现机器人策略对动力学变化的适应，在MuJoCo基准上优于基于参数的方法。

title: Co-training with Ego-centric Video and Demonstration for Robot Navigation Task
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for diverse robotic tasks, but their performance heavily depends on large-scale high-quality training data, whose collection on real robots is costly and time-consuming. While prior work has explored augmenting manipulation datasets with egocentric human videos, applying such approaches to mobile robot navigation remains challenging due to viewpoint changes during locomotion. In this paper, we propose a framework that converts egocentric walking videos into datasets for mobile robot imitation learning. The proposed method estimates camera motion from human videos and transforms it into action representations compatible with ground mobile robots. By jointly training a VLA model on human-derived and robot-collected datasets, the model achieves improved language understanding and more robust action generation than training with either data source alone. Experiments on a fruit-search navigation task demonstrate that human egocentric videos provide an effective and scalable data source for mobile robot learning.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在各类机器人任务中展现出广阔前景，但其性能高度依赖大规模高质量训练数据，而真实机器人上的数据采集成本高昂且耗时。尽管已有研究探索利用第一人称视角的人类视频来增强操作数据集，但由于运动过程中的视角变化，将这些方法应用于移动机器人导航仍面临挑战。本文提出一种框架，将第一人称行走视频转换为适用于移动机器人模仿学习的数据集。该方法从人类视频中估计相机运动，并将其转化为与地面移动机器人兼容的动作表示。通过联合训练基于人类数据与机器人采集数据的VLA模型，该模型在语言理解与动作生成鲁棒性方面均优于单独使用任一数据源的训练结果。在水果搜索导航任务上的实验表明，人类第一人称视频可为移动机器人学习提供高效且可扩展的数据源。
tldr: Proposes a framework to convert egocentric walking human videos into training data for mobile robot navigation, and shows that co-training a VLA model on human-derived and robot-collected data improves performance.
tldr_zh: 提出一个将人类第一人称行走视频转换为移动机器人导航训练数据的框架，并证明在人类衍生数据和机器人采集数据上联合训练VLA模型能够提升性能。

title: Trans2Occ: Voxel Occupancy Estimation and Grasp for Transparent Objects from Simulation to Reality
summary: Transparent objects remain challenging for robotic perception due to unreliable depth sensing caused by refraction and reflection. While prior approaches rely on multi-view reconstruction or depth completion, they are often difficult to scale or deploy in real-world robotic systems. In this paper, we present a practical framework for transparent object perception and manipulation based on single-view RGB input. Our approach predicts voxel-space occupancy directly from a single image, providing a geometry-aware representation that supports downstream robotic grasping. To enable large-scale training, we construct a simulation pipeline that generates paired RGB images and voxel occupancy annotations under diverse materials and lighting conditions. We demonstrate that the predicted occupancy representation is robust to domain shifts and transfers effectively from simulation to real-world robotic setups without fine-tuning. A simple rule-based grasping strategy built on top of the occupancy further achieves reliable grasp performance on transparent objects. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments show that our framework provides accurate 3D understanding and enables practical manipulation of transparent objects. These results suggest that single-view occupancy prediction offers a scalable and effective solution for transparent object perception in robotics.
summary_zh: 透明物体因折射和反射导致的深度感知不可靠，仍是机器人视觉感知中的挑战。现有方法多依赖多视角重建或深度补全，但往往难以规模化或部署于真实机器人系统。本文提出一种基于单视角RGB输入的透明物体感知与操作实用框架。该方法直接从单张图像预测体素空间占据状态，形成支持下游机器人抓取的几何感知表征。为支持大规模训练，我们构建了仿真流水线，可在多种材质与光照条件下生成配对的RGB图像与体素占据标注。实验证明，该预测的占据表征对域迁移具有鲁棒性，且无需微调即可从仿真有效迁移至真实机器人平台。基于该占据表征构建的简单规则式抓取策略，进一步实现了对透明物体的可靠抓取性能。在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验表明，本框架能提供精确的三维理解，并实现透明物体的实用化操作。这些结果证明，单视角占据预测为机器人透明物体感知提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a single-view RGB framework for transparent object perception and grasping by predicting voxel occupancy, using a simulation pipeline to train a model that transfers to real robots without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于单视图RGB的透明物体感知与抓取框架，通过预测体素占据，并利用仿真管线训练模型，实现无需微调即可迁移到真实机器人。

title: FlipItRight: Stable Pose-Targeted Throw-Flip Across Diverse Objects
summary: We propose FlipItRight, a framework for stable planar pose-targeted throw-flip with a high-DoF manipulator. The task is decomposed into an object-level planner, which generates candidate release states satisfying the desired landing pose, and a robot-level planner, which evaluates executability and constructs a feasible swing motion. Treating the release state as an explicit intermediate representation enables principled candidate filtering, adaptive selection of release and pre-swing configurations, and structured near-release motion design -- in particular, approximately constant end-effector velocities during the final swing phase to improve robustness to release-timing uncertainty. We validate on a real platform across objects of varying shape, size, and mass, achieving a 90% success rate across 120 trials. Ablation studies confirm that each design choice contributes to throwing performance, and the framework requires no prior data or learned model, enabling direct deployment on new objects and targets without environment-specific calibration or data collection.
summary_zh: 我们提出了FlipItRight框架，用于高自由度机械臂实现稳定的平面目标定向抛掷翻转动作。该任务被分解为两个层级：对象级规划器生成满足期望着陆姿态的候选释放状态，以及机器人级规划器评估可执行性并构建可行的摆臂运动。将释放状态作为显式的中间表征，能够实现基于原则的候选过滤、释放与预摆构型的自适应选择，以及结构化近释放运动设计——特别地，在最终摆动阶段保持近似恒定的末端执行器速度，以提升对释放时机不确定性的鲁棒性。我们在真实平台上对形状、尺寸和质量各异的物体进行了验证，在120次试验中实现了90%的成功率。消融研究证实每项设计选择均对抛掷性能有所贡献，且该框架无需先验数据或学习模型，能够直接部署于新物体和新目标，无需针对特定环境进行标定或数据采集。
tldr: FlipItRight presents a model-free, data-free framework for stable planar pose-targeted throw-flip manipulation with a high-DoF robot arm, achieving 90% success on diverse objects.
tldr_zh: FlipItRight 提出了一种无需模型和数据的框架，用于高自由度机械臂的稳定平面姿态投掷翻转，在多样物体上达到 90% 成功率。

title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）已成为连续环境下视觉-语言导航（VLN-CE）的通用基础。然而，大多数基于VLM的方法将导航任务建模为低级动作预测，这种接口具有歧义性、受限于短时运动基元，且因重复调用VLM而导致效率低下。我们提出Goal2Pixel，一种纯像素级范式，将VLN-CE重新诠释为可导航像素定位。不同于预测动作，Goal2Pixel将图像平面作为VLM推理与机器人运动之间的统一空间接口：模型预测一个对智能体可见的可导航像素，该像素被反投影为三维路径点以实现前向导航。对于非前向动作，我们在图像平面上附加辅助指示区域，其中左/右/下区域分别对应左转、右转和停止。为实现长时域导航，我们提出一种可见性感知的关键帧记忆机制，用于生成紧凑且信息丰富的历史表征。为将预训练VLM适配至可导航像素定位任务，我们引入语义嵌入和坐标感知辅助损失。Goal2Pixel在取得极具竞争力的最先进性能的同时，所需VLM推理调用次数少于先前方法。在R2R-CE Val-Unseen数据集上，它以每轮仅7.75次VLM调用实现54.1%的成功率（SR）和52.5%的路径长度加权成功率（SPL），而直接动作预测方法在32.9%的成功率下需46.62次调用，相当于推理效率提升6倍。该趋势在RxR-CE数据集上同样成立。项目页面：https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/。
tldr: Goal2Pixel reformulates vision-language navigation as pixel grounding, where the model predicts a visible navigable pixel that is back-projected into a 3D waypoint, reducing VLM inference calls by 6x while achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: Goal2Pixel将视觉语言导航重新定义为像素定位问题，模型预测可视的可导航像素并反投影为3D路径点，在减少6倍VLM推理调用的同时取得了最优结果。

title: Hierarchical Object Representation for Spatial Robot Perception: Points, Meshes, and Superquadrics
summary: Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs (3DSG) have emerged as an actionable and scalable representation for long-term autonomy incorporating metric, semantic, and topological information in the scene. However, the question of geometric representation of objects in 3DSG has been overlooked as most methods use simplified geometric models such as partial point clouds or 3D bounding boxes. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical object representation that can be leveraged for high-fidelity object-level reconstruction, object-based robust re-localization or map alignment, and efficient and analytical collision checking for safe robot navigation planning in dense and cluttered environments. The representation is structurally organized into four distinct layers, progressively abstracting the scene from raw sensor data to dense 3D meshes to analytical primitives such as superquadrics, which provide a sparse and analytical representation for object geometry. We develop a pipeline that builds the hierarchical object representation from RGB-D image stream captured by a robot, and demonstrate its working in real-world open-set object scenes in both indoor and outdoor environments. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets including HOPE, ReplicaCAD, Kimera-Multi, and NUS Campus Dataset collected using Unitree B2 Robot validate our pipeline in both indoor and outdoor environments. We show that our superquadric-based map alignment method outperforms the current state-of-the-art object based map alignment method ROMAN. Our code can be found at https://github.com/perceptica-robotics/Hickory.
summary_zh: 分层三维场景图（3DSG）已成为一种可操作且可扩展的长期自主性表征方式，能够将场景中的度量信息、语义信息与拓扑信息相融合。然而，当前多数方法仅采用简化几何模型（如部分点云或三维边界框），导致3DSG中物体的几何表征问题长期被忽视。本研究提出一种分层式物体表征方法，可支持以下应用：高保真物体级重建、基于物体的鲁棒重定位或地图对齐、以及密集杂乱环境中实现安全机器人导航规划所需的高效分析性碰撞检测。该表征在结构上划分为四个层级，逐步对场景进行抽象——从原始传感器数据到稠密三维网格，最终转化为超二次曲面等解析基元，从而为物体几何提供稀疏且可解析的表征。我们开发了一套流水线，能够从机器人采集的RGB-D图像流中构建分层式物体表征，并在室内外真实场景的开集物体环境中验证其有效性。通过在包括HOPE、ReplicaCAD、Kimera-Multi以及利用Unitree B2机器人采集的NUS Campus数据集在内的多个数据集上的大量实验，验证了本流水线在室内外环境中的性能。实验表明，我们基于超二次曲面的地图对齐方法优于当前最先进的基于物体的地图对齐方法ROMAN。相关代码已开源：https://github.com/perceptica-robotics/Hickory。
tldr: This paper introduces a hierarchical object representation for 3D scene graphs that layers raw sensor data, dense meshes, and analytical superquadrics, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction, robust map alignment, and collision checking for robot navigation in dense environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于三维场景图的层次化对象表示，将原始传感器数据、密集网格和分析性超二次曲面分层组织，从而实现高保真重建、鲁棒的地图对齐以及密集环境中的碰撞检测。

title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
summary: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.
summary_zh: 高质量、大规模仿真合成数据正成为推动机器人算法能力提升的基石。尽管空中机器人仿真器已各自独立发展出支持保真度、可微性与集群等专业需求的能力，但目前尚无能够跨所有领域合成数据的统一平台。为此，我们提出Crazyflow仿真器，旨在突破空中机器人算法开发的边界——覆盖从基于模型到数据驱动的方法、从基于梯度到基于采样的方法、以及从单智能体到多智能体系统。与现有最先进的无人机仿真器相比，Crazyflow在单机仿真速度上提升超过一个数量级，并可模拟包含4000架无人机的数千个集群。真实实验表明，Crazyflow既支持基于解析梯度的策略学习（无需领域随机化即可实现亚厘米级轨迹跟踪精度），也支持每秒超过五亿步的基于采样的避障方法。打破传统"训练-部署"范式，我们展示其前所未有的速度甚至可用于飞行中强化学习：通过将物理无人机抛向空中，在0.38秒内从头训练出恢复策略并成功稳定无人机。Crazyflow支持多层级仿真抽象，直接兼容所有开源Crazyflie模型，并通过提供轻量级系统辨识流程，实现跨定制无人机平台与应用的快速重构。通过同时提升精度、速度与可微性，Crazyflow成为开源合成数据生成资源，具备大规模并行化在线执行学习与优化的新兴能力，为新型算法开发敞开大门。
tldr: Crazyflow is a GPU-accelerated, differentiable drone simulator in JAX that achieves extreme speeds for both single-drone and large-scale swarm simulation, supports analytical-gradient policy learning and in-flight RL, and is validated on real Crazyflie hardware.
tldr_zh: Crazyflow 是一个基于 JAX 的 GPU 加速、可微分的无人机仿真器，在单机和集群仿真中均实现极速，支持基于解析梯度的策略学习和飞行中强化学习，并在真实 Crazyflie 硬件上验证。

title: MASER: Modality-Adaptive Specialist Routing for Embodied 3D Spatial Intelligence
summary: In 3D environments, Embodied Agents answer spatially relevant questions through reasoning from a mixture of modalities including natural language, RGB images, point clouds, depth maps and camera poses. Existing Vision-Language models (VLMs) are fine-tuned over a single modality. This completely ignores the question semantics which may favor a different modality than the finetuned modality. To address this, we propose MASER (Modality-Adaptive SpEcialist Routing), a lightweight framework that trains five different modality adapters of a shared VLM backbone and learns a neural routing policy that selects the best adapter based on the question during inference. We encode each question with a frozen sentence transformer and pass the embedding through a small Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) trained on oracle adapter-accuracy labels. We evaluate our methodology over the Open3D-VQA benchmark and our evaluations show that no single modality is universally optimal -- point-cloud answers are best in 51.5% of cases. MASER routes with 51.3% oracle agreement, outperforming a Random-Forest ablation (43.5%), with only a single adapter call per question.
summary_zh: 在三维环境中，具身智能体通过融合自然语言、RGB图像、点云、深度图及相机位姿等多模态信息进行推理，以回答与空间相关的问题。现有视觉语言模型仅针对单一模态进行微调，这完全忽略了问题语义可能倾向于与微调模态不同的其他模态。为解决该问题，我们提出MASER（模态自适应专家路由）——一种轻量级框架，通过训练共享视觉语言模型骨干网络的五个不同模态适配器，并学习一种神经路由策略，在推理时根据问题选择最佳适配器。我们将每个问题通过冻结的句子编码器进行编码，并将嵌入向量输入一个基于专家适配器准确率标签训练的小型多层感知机。在Open3D-VQA基准上的评估表明，没有任何单一模态具有普适最优性——点云答案在51.5%的案例中表现最佳。MASER的路由与专家判断的一致性达51.3%，优于随机森林消融实验的43.5%，且每个问题仅需调用一次适配器。
tldr: MASER introduces a lightweight routing framework that selects the best modality-specific adapter for a frozen VLM based on question semantics, improving 3D spatial question answering for embodied agents.
tldr_zh: MASER 提出一种轻量级路由框架，根据问题语义为冻结的 VLM 选择最佳模态适配器，改进了具身代理的 3D 空间问答能力。

title: COMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents
summary: Equipping language agents with world models enables them to anticipate environment dynamics and evaluate candidate actions before execution. However, existing textual world models are typically fixed after training, preventing them from adapting to the on-policy state-action distributions induced by an evolving agent. Meanwhile, agent-improvement methods often rely on external rewards or verifiers, limiting their applicability in realistic interactive environments. In this paper, we propose COMAP, a novel framework that co-evolves textual world models and agent policies through closed-loop interaction. At each decision step, the world model predicts future state feedback for candidate actions, and the agent performs future-aware reflection by estimating the reliability of this feedback and refining its action accordingly. The resulting on-policy trajectories are then used to update the world model via self-distillation, allowing it to better match the agent's evolving interaction distribution. Across embodied task planning, Web navigation, and tool-use benchmarks, COMAP consistently outperforms competitive baselines, e.g., +16.75% relative improvement with Qwen3-4B. Further analyses show that the co-evolutionary loop improves the world model's prediction accuracy over time and leads to more effective long-horizon decision-making. Our code is available at: https://github.com/loyiv/CoMAP.
summary_zh: 为语言代理配备世界模型，使其能够在执行动作前预测环境动态并评估候选动作。然而，现有的文本世界模型通常在训练后固定不变，无法适应由不断演化的代理所引发的在策略状态-动作分布。同时，代理改进方法往往依赖外部奖励或验证器，这限制了其在真实交互环境中的适用性。本文提出COMAP，一种通过闭环交互协同演化文本世界模型与代理策略的新型框架。在每个决策步骤中，世界模型预测候选动作的未来状态反馈，代理则通过评估该反馈的可靠性并据此优化动作，实现面向未来的反思。由此产生的在策略轨迹随后通过自蒸馏用于更新世界模型，使其更好地匹配代理不断变化的交互分布。在具身任务规划、网页导航和工具使用基准测试中，COMAP始终优于竞争基线，例如基于Qwen3-4B的相对性能提升达16.75%。进一步分析表明，协同演化循环能随时间提升世界模型的预测准确性，并带来更有效的长程决策。我们的代码开源在：https://github.com/loyiv/CoMAP。
tldr: COMAP proposes a co-evolutionary framework that jointly updates a textual world model and an LLM agent policy through closed-loop interaction, improving performance on embodied task planning, Web navigation, and tool-use benchmarks.
tldr_zh: COMAP 提出了一种共演进框架，通过闭环交互联合更新文本世界模型和 LLM 智能体策略，在具身任务规划、Web 导航和工具使用基准测试上提升了性能。

title: From Zero to Hero: Training-Free Custom Concept Spawning in World Models
summary: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for interactive video generation, allowing users to navigate dynamically generated environments through actions. These models are typically conditioned on a text prompt and/or a single reference frame, from which the entire world is generated. Yet the moment the user navigates beyond what is visible in that frame, the unseen regions are populated by the base model's priors, with no mechanism for the user to specify what should appear and where. This is a fundamental limitation for applications such as gaming, interactive storytelling, and simulation, where controllable scene composition is essential. We refer to this missing capability as concept spawning; introducing a user-specified visual concept into a world model, analogous to spawning in a game engine. We introduce SPAWN (Swapping Pinned Anchor with Windowed iNjection), a training-free method for concept spawning. SPAWN exploits a structural property of image-to-video backbones: the first slot of the context memory is pinned to the reference frame and acts as a foundational anchor for every generated chunk. By swapping this anchor with an external concept latent over a short injection window and letting the original anchor return, we cause the concept to propagate naturally through the rollout via the model's own memory. SPAWN supports concepts from fine-grained entities such as characters and props to large-scale elements such as buildings and landmarks, and accepts either a concept image or a text description as input. Experiments show that SPAWN integrates concepts with consistent lighting, scale, and perspective while preserving identity and temporal coherence, demonstrating that controllable concept spawning is achievable in existing autoregressive world models without any training.
summary_zh: 自回归世界模型已成为交互式视频生成的一种强大范式，允许用户通过动作在动态生成的环境中进行导航。这类模型通常以文本提示和/或单张参考帧为条件，由此生成整个世界。然而，一旦用户导航到该参考帧中可见区域之外，未见区域便会由基础模型的先验知识填充，用户无法指定哪些内容应出现在何处。这在游戏、交互式叙事和仿真等应用中是一个根本性的局限，因为这些场景中可控的场景组合至关重要。我们将这种缺失的能力称为“概念生成”——即将用户指定的视觉概念引入世界模型，类似于游戏引擎中的生成机制。本文提出SPAWN（交换固定锚点与窗口注入），一种无需训练的概念生成方法。SPAWN利用了图像到视频基础模型的结构特性：上下文记忆的第一个槽位固定为参考帧，并作为每个生成块的基础锚点。通过在短注入窗口内用外部概念潜变量替换该锚点，随后让原始锚点恢复，概念即可通过模型自身的记忆在展开过程中自然传播。SPAWN支持从角色、道具等细粒度实体到建筑、地标等大规模元素的概念，并可接受概念图像或文本描述作为输入。实验表明，SPAWN在保持身份一致性和时间连贯性的同时，能够以一致的光照、尺度和视角整合概念，证明了在现有自回归世界模型中无需训练即可实现可控的概念生成。
tldr: SPAWN enables training-free insertion of user-specified visual concepts into autoregressive world models by swapping the reference frame anchor, enabling controllable scene composition for interactive video generation.
tldr_zh: SPAWN 通过交换参考帧锚点，无需训练即可在自回归世界模型中插入用户指定的视觉概念，实现交互式视频生成中的可控场景组合。

title: RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?
summary: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench
summary_zh: 搜救任务要求具身智能体在多模态不确定性下探索陌生环境，执行多阶段交互，并在长时程中检索空间记忆。现有基准测试通常孤立评估这些能力，而未揭示当这些能力必须在实际工作流程中组合时如何产生级联故障。我们提出RescueBench——一个照片级真实的诊断基准测试，将搜救任务构建为四阶段流程：多模态探索、目标救援、记忆引导返回和最终交接。通过将顺序任务组合与阶段级评估相结合，RescueBench能够分析探索与记忆故障如何在具身救援工作流中传播。该基准包含五个渐进难度等级，在环境复杂度、线索模糊性和空间层次结构上逐级递增，并配备自动化场景生成与标注流程，以支持可扩展的评估与训练。我们评估了七个基线模型、一个理想化参考模型及人类玩家，结果显示在最困难难度下尚无基线模型能完整完成任务。阶段级诊断表明：自主探索是主要失效模式，而空间记忆是第二个独立瓶颈，这一发现暗示当前基于拓扑的视觉语言导航或地图方法尚未解决这些局限性。代码详见 https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench
tldr: RescueBench is a photo-realistic benchmark for embodied search-and-rescue that composes four stages (exploration, rescue, memory-guided return, handoff) and reveals exploration as the dominant failure mode across tested baselines.
tldr_zh: RescueBench是一个用于具身搜索与救援任务的逼真基准，它将四个阶段（探索、救援、记忆引导返回、交接）组合起来，并揭示了探索失败是所有测试基线的主要瓶颈。

title: PillarDETR: YOLO-Backbone and RT-DETR Head for Real-Time 3D Object Detection
summary: Real-time 3D object detection is a critical component for the safe operation of autonomous driving systems and robotics. While LiDAR point clouds provide accurate spatial information, processing them efficiently remains a significant challenge. Traditional methods rely on complex 3D convolutions or anchor-based paradigms that struggle to balance detection accuracy with inference speed. In this paper, we propose PillarDETR, a novel end-to-end 3D object detection architecture that combines the efficiency of pillar-based LiDAR encoding with the representational power of modern 2D vision models. Specifically, PillarDETR replaces standard convolutional backbones with a Cross Stage Partial (CSP) network derived from YOLOv8, enabling richer feature extraction from pseudoimages. Furthermore, we discard conventional anchor-based or center-based detection heads in favor of a Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR) decoder. This hybrid design allows the network to capture global context and directly predict 3D bounding boxes without relying on non-maximum suppression (NMS). Extensive experiments on the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that PillarDETR achieves a compelling trade-off between mean Average Precision (mAP) and inference latency. Our ablation studies confirm that integrating the YOLOv8 backbone and RT-DETR head yields substantial improvements over the PointPillars baseline, establishing PillarDETR as a highly effective solution for real-time 3D perception.
summary_zh: 实时三维目标检测是自动驾驶系统与机器人安全运行的关键技术。尽管激光雷达点云能提供精确的空间信息，但对其高效处理仍是一大挑战。传统方法依赖复杂的3D卷积或基于锚点的范式，难以在检测精度与推理速度之间取得平衡。本文提出PillarDETR——一种新型端到端三维目标检测架构，它将基于柱体的激光雷达编码效率与现代2D视觉模型的表征能力相结合。具体而言，PillarDETR采用源自YOLOv8的跨阶段局部网络（CSP）替代标准卷积主干网络，从而从伪图像中提取更丰富的特征。此外，我们摒弃传统的基于锚点或中心点的检测头，转而采用实时检测Transformer（RT-DETR）解码器。这种混合设计使网络能够捕获全局上下文信息，直接预测3D边界框，无需依赖非极大值抑制（NMS）。在KITTI和nuScenes基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PillarDETR在平均精度（mAP）与推理延迟之间实现了具备竞争力的平衡。消融研究证实，整合YOLOv8主干网络与RT-DETR检测头相较PointPillars基线带来了显著性能提升，使PillarDETR成为实时三维感知领域的高效解决方案。
tldr: PillarDETR combines a YOLOv8-based CSP backbone with a RT-DETR transformer head for pillar-based LiDAR 3D object detection, achieving real-time inference without NMS on KITTI and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: PillarDETR将YOLOv8的CSP骨干网络与RT-DETR变换器头部结合，用于基于柱体的激光雷达3D目标检测，在KITTI和nuScenes上实现了无需NMS的实时推理。

title: Coherent Off-Policy Improvement of Large Behavior Models with Learned Rewards
summary: Distilling expert demonstration data into large generative models using behavioral cloning is a scalable approach to learning capable policies for robotic control, particularly for dexterous manipulation. Reinforcement learning (RL) can be used as a means to finetune these policies further using additional experience. An open question is whether RL is more sample-efficient than collecting more human demonstrations. Prior work has finetuned large pretrained policies in a scalable fashion by applying RL to a smaller residual policy that corrects the pretrained model. However, for the typical sparse reward tasks, RL algorithms can struggle to optimize the behavior in a sample-efficient manner. We explore inverse reinforcement learning, where a dense reward function is learned from expert demonstrations, potentially reducing the challenge of RL finetuning. We specifically consider coherent imitation learning, an IRL method that facilitates improvement of the BC policy through using a specific reward formulation with theoretical guarantees. We show that our IRL method maintains or improves the performance of pi-0.5 on all six sparse manipulation tasks and achieves a $\geq 90\%$ success rate on five out of six complex manipulation tasks, outperforming RL-based baselines using sparse rewards. By ensuring our initial pretrained finetuning policy is optimal for our initial reward and critic, our method circumvents the initial drop commonly seen in RL finetuning and enables faster improvement.
summary_zh: 通过行为克隆将专家演示数据蒸馏到大型生成模型中，是一种可扩展的学习机器人控制（特别是灵巧操作）有效策略的方法。强化学习（RL）可作为利用额外经验进一步微调这些策略的手段。一个悬而未决的问题是：RL是否比收集更多人类演示更具样本效率？先前研究通过将RL应用于一个较小的残差策略（该策略用于修正预训练模型），以可扩展的方式对大型预训练策略进行微调。然而，对于典型的稀疏奖励任务，RL算法难以以样本高效的方式优化行为。我们探索了逆向强化学习（IRL）——从专家演示中学习密集奖励函数的方法，这有望降低RL微调的难度。我们特别考虑了相干模仿学习（一种IRL方法），它通过使用具有理论保证的特定奖励公式，促进BC策略的改进。我们证明，IRL方法在所有六个稀疏操作任务上维持或提升了pi-0.5的性能，在六个复杂操作任务中的五个上实现了$\geq 90\%$的成功率，优于使用稀疏奖励的基于RL的基线方法。通过确保初始预训练微调策略对初始奖励和评判器是最优的，我们的方法规避了RL微调中常见的性能初始下降，并实现了更快的改进。
tldr: This paper proposes using inverse reinforcement learning (coherent imitation learning) to finetune large pretrained behavior models for robotic manipulation, achieving higher success rates than RL with sparse rewards on dexterous manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出使用逆强化学习（连贯模仿学习）微调预训练的大型行为模型，在灵巧操作任务上实现了比稀疏奖励强化学习更高的成功率。

title: IMWM: Intuition Models Complement World Models for Latent Planning
summary: Planning with a learned latent world model is a promising route to control from raw pixels, but a strong world model alone is not enough. We show this experimentally: even with a perfect world model (operationalized by replacing the learned forward predictor with an idealized rollout of the true environment dynamics), a finite-budget sample-based planner still fails on some tasks, indicating that the bottleneck can lie in search rather than in world-model accuracy. Motivated by this gap, we propose IMWM (Intuition Model + World Model), which pairs the world model with an intuition model trained from demonstrations to recognize promising actions. The two models collaborate through three lightweight components: (i) Retrieval Initialization, which initializes the planner's action proposal from a retrieved demonstration; (ii) Hybrid Cost, which combines the intuition score with the world-model rollout cost; and (iii) a Reliability Gate, which adjusts how much the planner trusts intuition in each setting. Across four pixel-based goal-reaching tasks (Two-Room, Reacher, Push-T, and OGBench-Cube), IMWM has higher mean success than the world-model-only planner on all four, with the largest gains on Two-Room (99.2%, +11.5 percentage points) and OGBench-Cube (94.7%, +28.5 percentage points).
summary_zh: 利用学习到的潜在世界模型进行规划是从原始像素出发实现控制的一种有前景的途径，但仅凭强大的世界模型本身并不足够。我们通过实验证明了这一点：即使拥有完美的世界模型（通过用真实环境动态的理想化推演替代学习到的前向预测器来实现），基于有限预算的采样规划器仍会在某些任务上失败，这表明瓶颈可能在于搜索而非世界模型的准确性。受这一差距的启发，我们提出了IMWM（直觉模型+世界模型），该模型将世界模型与一个从示范中训练出来的、用于识别有前途动作的直觉模型配对使用。这两个模型通过三个轻量级组件协同工作：(i) 检索初始化，通过从检索到的示范中初始化规划器的动作提议；(ii) 混合代价，将直觉评分与世界模型推演代价相结合；(iii) 可靠性门控，用于调整规划器在每种场景下对直觉的信任程度。在四个基于像素的目标到达任务（Two-Room、Reacher、Push-T和OGBench-Cube）中，IMWM在所有四个任务上的平均成功率均高于仅使用世界模型的规划器，其中在Two-Room（99.2%，提升11.5个百分点）和OGBench-Cube（94.7%，提升28.5个百分点）上提升幅度最大。
tldr: This paper identifies that even with a perfect world model, sample-based planning can fail due to search bottlenecks, and proposes IMWM which pairs a world model with an intuition model trained from demonstrations to improve planning via retrieval initialization, hybrid cost, and a reliability gate.
tldr_zh: 本文发现即使拥有完美的世界模型，基于样本的规划仍可能因搜索瓶颈而失败，并提出IMWM，通过将世界模型与从演示中训练的直觉模型配对，利用检索初始化、混合成本和可靠性门控来提升规划性能。

title: Permissive Safety Through Trusted Inference: Verifiable Belief-Space Neural Safety Filters for Assured Interactive Robotics
summary: Autonomous robots that interact with people must make safe and efficient decisions under human-induced uncertainty, such as their preferences, goals, competency, and willingness to cooperate. Safety filters are a popular approach for ensuring safety in interactive robotics, since their modular design separates safety from performance, allowing robots to operate safely around people with minimal impact on task efficiency. While traditional safety filters typically operate only in the physical space, neglecting the robot's ability to learn and adapt online, the recently proposed belief-space safety filter (BeliefSF) reasons about robot safety in closed-loop with runtime inference that actively reduces the robot's uncertainty online, thereby reducing conservativeness in filtering. However, providing formal safety guarantees for robots deploying BeliefSF remains a significant challenge due to errors in runtime inference and neural approximation of safety filters required to handle the high dimensionality of belief spaces. In this paper, we propose an algorithmic approach to certify high-probability safety of BeliefSF using conformal prediction, while explicitly accounting for the reliability of the robot's runtime inference module. Our method leverages the structure of belief-space safety filtering by focusing verification on a region where inference is expected to be reliable. It preserves the simplicity and sample complexity of standard conformal prediction, yet can certify a substantially less conservative safety filter. Through a simulated human-vehicle interaction benchmark, we show that our approach verifies a significantly more permissive belief-space safety filter than a standard conformal prediction baseline.
summary_zh: 与人交互的自主机器人需在由人类行为引发的不确定性（如偏好、目标、能力及合作意愿）下做出安全且高效的决策。安全过滤器是保障交互式机器人安全性的常用方法，其模块化设计将安全与性能分离，使机器人在最小化对任务效率影响的前提下安全地围绕人类运行。传统安全过滤器通常仅在物理空间运行，忽视了机器人在线学习与自适应能力；而近期提出的信态空间安全过滤器（BeliefSF）则通过闭环运行中实时推理主动降低机器人不确定性，从而减少过滤的保守性。然而，由于运行时推理的误差以及为处理信态空间高维性所需的安全过滤器神经近似，为部署BeliefSF的机器人提供正式安全保证仍面临重大挑战。本文提出一种基于共形预测的算法方法，在明确考虑机器人运行时推理模块可靠性的前提下，验证BeliefSF的高概率安全性。该方法利用信态空间安全过滤的结构特性，将验证聚焦于推理预期可靠的区域；既保留了标准共形预测的简洁性与样本复杂度，又能验证保守性显著降低的安全过滤器。通过人-车交互仿真基准测试表明，相较标准共形预测基线，本方法可验证一个更具包容性的信态空间安全过滤器。
tldr: This paper proposes a conformal prediction-based verification method for belief-space safety filters that provide formal high-probability safety guarantees for interactive robots, explicitly accounting for runtime inference errors and neural approximation errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于共形预测的验证方法，用于信念空间安全过滤器，为交互式机器人提供正式的高概率安全保证，并显式考虑了运行时推理误差和神经网络近似误差。

title: Not All Points Are Equal: Uncertainty-Aware 4D LiDAR Scene Synthesis
summary: Constructing faithful 4D worlds from LiDAR-acquired sequences is crucial for embodied AI, yet current generative frameworks apply uniform modeling capacity across all spatial regions. This ignores that perceptual difficulty varies dramatically within a single scan: distant surfaces, occluded boundaries, and small-scale objects carry far higher uncertainty than well-observed structures. We present U4D, a new framework that explicitly leverages spatial uncertainty to guide LiDAR scene generation in a "hard-to-easy" schedule. U4D derives per-point uncertainty maps via Shannon Entropy from a pretrained segmentor, then applies an unconditional diffusion stage to synthesize high-entropy areas with precise geometry, followed by a conditional completion stage that fills in the remaining regions using these structures as priors. A MoST (Mixture of Spatio-Temporal) block further maintains cross-frame coherence by dynamically balancing spatial detail and temporal continuity. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI demonstrate state-of-the-art scene fidelity, temporal consistency, and downstream performance.
summary_zh: 从激光雷达采集序列中构建可靠的4D世界对于具身智能至关重要，然而当前生成框架对所有空间区域采用统一的建模能力。这种做法忽视了单次扫描中感知难度的显著差异：远距离表面、遮挡边界和小尺度物体相较于充分观测的结构具有更高的不确定性。我们提出U4D，一种显式利用空间不确定性以"由难到易"策略指导激光雷达场景生成的新框架。U4D通过预训练分割器的香农熵推导逐点不确定性图，首先采用无条件扩散阶段合成具有精确几何结构的高熵区域，随后通过条件补全阶段以这些结构为先验填充剩余区域。提出的MoST（时空混合）模块通过动态平衡空间细节与时间连续性进一步维持跨帧一致性。在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上的大量实验证明了其在场景保真度、时间一致性和下游任务性能方面均达到最优水平。
tldr: U4D is a 4D LiDAR scene synthesis framework that uses per-point uncertainty maps to guide generation in a hard-to-easy schedule, achieving state-of-the-art fidelity and temporal consistency.
tldr_zh: U4D是一个利用逐点不确定性图以“从难到易”方式引导4D LiDAR场景生成的框架，在保真度和时间一致性上达到最优。

title: DisFlow: Scene Flow from Distance Field for Object Pose, Velocity Tracking, and Dynamic Object Reconstruction
summary: We present \emph{DisFlow}, a novel framework for online scene flow estimation from distance field that enables \emph{6DoF dynamic object pose estimation}, \emph{motion tracking}, and \emph{surface reconstruction}. The scene is represented by Gaussian Process Implicit Surfaces (GPIS), with surface normals serving as derivative constraints, enabling accurate signed distance computations near the surface and gradient queries with uncertainty. With this representation as a foundation, we compute a scene flow from the distance field that describes how surface points are transported over time in consecutive frames. Through our flow, we can estimate an object's pose and motion by incrementally registering a new observed point cloud via an elegant closed-form optimisation. Unlike prior methods that operate in the camera or world frame, our approach performs probabilistic fusion directly in the \emph{object frame}, where the object remains geometrically consistent over time. The tight coupling of the DisFlow method in space and time yields dense geometry, surface normals, object pose trajectories, velocities, and uncertainty, all at real-time rates. We evaluate DisFlow on dynamic object sequences and demonstrate that it achieves accurate pose and motion tracking while simultaneously reconstructing high-quality object surfaces. Code publicly available at \href{https://github.com/LanWu076/disflow_ros2}{https://github.com/LanWu076/disflow\_ros2}
summary_zh: 我们提出了 **DisFlow**，一种基于距离场进行在线场景流估计的新颖框架，能够实现 **6自由度动态物体位姿估计**、**运动跟踪** 与 **曲面重建**。该场景采用高斯过程隐式曲面（GPIS）进行表示，其中曲面法向量作为导数约束，从而在曲面附近实现精确的有符号距离计算，并支持带有不确定性的梯度查询。以此表示为基石，我们从距离场中计算出描述相邻帧中曲面点随时间传输方式的场景流。通过该流，我们能够以优雅的闭式优化方法对观测到的点云进行增量配准，从而估计物体的位姿与运动。与以往在相机坐标系或世界坐标系中运行的方法不同，本方法直接在 **物体坐标系** 中进行概率融合，使得物体在时间上保持几何一致性。DisFlow 方法在空间与时间上的紧密耦合，能够以实时速率生成稠密几何、曲面法向量、物体位姿轨迹、速度及不确定性。我们在动态物体序列上对 DisFlow 进行了评估，结果表明该方法在实现精确位姿与运动跟踪的同时，还能高质量地重建物体表面。代码已公开于：\href{https://github.com/LanWu076/disflow_ros2}{https://github.com/LanWu076/disflow\_ros2}
tldr: DisFlow uses a distance field represented by Gaussian Process Implicit Surfaces to estimate scene flow for 6DoF object pose, motion tracking, and surface reconstruction at real-time rates.
tldr_zh: DisFlow 利用高斯过程隐式曲面表示的距离场来估计场景流，实现实时 6DoF 物体姿态、运动跟踪和表面重建。

title: Embedding Semantic Risk into Distance Fields and CBFs for Online Monocular Safe Control
summary: We propose an online monocular perception-to-control framework that embeds semantic risk into the distance field used by Control Barrier Function (CBF)-based safe navigation and teleoperation. Many perception-based safety filters assign the same distance-based safety margin to all mapped obstacles or use semantics only as a downstream controller adjustment, rather than encoding semantic risk in the spatial representation.
