GN-BAE formalizes high-fidelity 3DGS-rendered Bird's Eye View representations as compact memory, unlocking latent spatial reasoning in VLMs. Extensive evaluations on GN-Bench and VLN-CE show that GN0 outperforms state-of-the-art VLN methods. Overall, GN-Matrix offers a unified framework spanning data, simulation, and learning, advancing embodied navigation in research and industrial applications.
summary_zh: 具身导航将智能体与物理世界相连，是实现通用机器人智能的基础。受限于导航数据的可用性及质量，视觉-语言导航（VLN）系统的泛化能力与长时域规划能力受到制约。为解决此问题，我们精选多样化三维场景并开发自动化流水线，生成了大规模导航数据集GN-Matrix。基于三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）引擎，我们构建了支持交互式漫游与碰撞感知导航的高保真仿真平台。进一步提出GN-Bench——首个基于鸟瞰视图（BEV）的基准测试，其引入动态3DGS虚拟化身实现人机交互评估。为有效利用仿真器，我们研发了基于强化学习的导航基础模型Break and Establish（BAE）。经监督学习后，DAgger算法使模型暴露于策略执行产生的状态分布中，打破狭窄的专家中心分布，从而激发下游强化学习探索。该统一VLN范式整合了基于地图与无地图两类任务，包括指令跟随、人员跟随及目标导航。GN-BAE将高保真3DGS渲染的鸟瞰视图表征形式化为紧凑记忆，释放了视觉语言模型（VLM）的潜在空间推理能力。在GN-Bench与VLN-CE上的广泛评估表明，GN0性能超越当前最先进的VLN方法。总体而言，GN-Matrix提供了覆盖数据、仿真与学习的统一框架，推动具身导航在研究及工业应用中的发展。
tldr: GN0 presents a unified framework for Vision-Language Navigation, including a large-scale dataset (GN-Matrix), a 3DGS-based simulation platform, a BEV benchmark for human-robot interaction, and an RL-driven navigation foundation model (BAE) that outperforms prior methods on VLN tasks.
tldr_zh: GN0提出了一个视觉语言导航的统一框架，包括大规模数据集GN-Matrix、基于3D高斯泼溅的仿真平台、用于人机交互的BEV基准测试以及强化学习驱动的导航基础模型BAE，在VLN任务上超越了现有方法。

title: GeoAlign: Beyond Semantics with State-Guided Spatial Alignment in VLA Models
summary: Current Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often optimize for semantic grounding, whereas executable manipulation requires geometry-aware spatial alignment and dynamic affordance selection. We introduce GeoAlign, a state-guided spatial alignment architecture for VLA policy learning. GeoAlign post-trains an RGB geometry branch with robot-domain RGB-D supervision, yielding RGB-derived Geometry-Enhanced Post-Trained (GEP) features for policy rollout. The robot's proprioceptive state queries the GEP feature grid, producing compact, phase-dependent geometry tokens for action prediction. GeoAlign achieves 99.0% on LIBERO, 85.3% across three SimplerEnv-Fractal tasks, and 78.8% on eight geometry-critical real-world ALOHA tasks, with ablations confirming the value of geometry post-training and proprioceptive-state-guided querying.
summary_zh: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常侧重于语义对齐，而可执行的操控任务需要几何感知的空间对齐和动态可供性选择。我们提出GeoAlign，一种面向VLA策略学习的状态引导空间对齐架构。GeoAlign通过机器人域RGB-D监督对RGB几何分支进行后训练，生成基于RGB的几何增强后训练（GEP）特征用于策略推理。机器人本体感知状态查询GEP特征网格，产生紧凑且依赖于阶段的几何标记用于动作预测。GeoAlign在LIBERO上达到99.0%，在三个SimplerEnv-Fractal任务上达到85.3%，在八项几何关键的ALOHA真实世界任务上达到78.8%，消融实验证实了几何后训练和本体感知状态查询的价值。
tldr: GeoAlign introduces a state-guided spatial alignment module for VLA models that post-trains an RGB geometry branch with RGB-D supervision to produce geometry-enhanced features, improving manipulation performance on geometry-critical tasks.
tldr_zh: GeoAlign 为 VLA 模型引入了一种状态引导的空间对齐模块，通过 RGB-D 监督后训练 RGB 几何分支以生成几何增强特征，在几何关键的操作任务上提升了性能。

title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
summary: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/ License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3 . The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3 .
summary_zh: 我们推出Cosmos 3模型系列，这是一个全模态世界模型家族，采用统一的混合Transformer架构，可联合处理与生成语言、图像、视频、音频及动作序列。通过支持高度灵活的输入输出配置，Cosmos 3将物理人工智能的关键模态无缝统一——有效将视觉语言模型、视频生成器、世界模拟器以及世界动作模型整合至单一框架中。评估表明，Cosmos 3在多元的理解与生成任务上均树立了新的最优水平，验证了全模态世界模型作为具身智能体可扩展、通用型基础模型的潜力。据技术报告撰写时，经后训练的Cosmos 3模型在Artificial Analysis评测中被评为最佳开源文生图与图生视频模型，并在RoboArena中获得最佳策略模型称号。为加速物理人工智能领域的开放研究与部署，我们已在Linux基金会OpenMDW-1.1许可证（https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/）下，于https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos和https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3公开代码、模型检查点、精选合成数据集及评估基准。项目官网地址为https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3。
tldr: Cosmos 3 proposes a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture that jointly processes and generates language, image, video, audio, and action sequences, serving as a general-purpose backbone for embodied agents and achieving state-of-the-art results in multiple Physical AI tasks.
tldr_zh: Cosmos 3 提出了一种统一的混合变换器架构，能够联合处理和生成语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列，作为具身智能体的通用骨干网络，并在多个物理AI任务中取得最先进成果。

title: See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs
summary:
Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface.
  Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation.
  This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations.
  Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.
summary_zh:
泛化能力仍是视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的核心瓶颈：在干扰物、外观变化及语义相似任务场景下，策略往往需要从粗略指令中推断局部执行细节，同时判断图像中哪些部分与控制相关。我们提出S2（少看多指定）框架，通过以更清晰的接口训练执行器来提升VLA泛化能力。  
多指定机制保留原始指令作为稳定的高层目标，同时将每条轨迹重标注为精细化的轨迹级与子任务级语言描述，以消除当前执行模式的歧义。与原生注意力不同，少看机制施加显式的视觉证据预算，训练执行器基于任务充分证据而非无约束的视觉上下文行动，无需任何区域或掩码标注。  
该接口使执行器能够遵循精细化引导，无需依赖干扰性视觉块或自行解决可规避的歧义，且通过上下文学习保持与现有VLM规划器的兼容性。在主要评估设置中，S2通过改变执行器的学习问题提升整体泛化指标：粗略指令会导致可规避的监督混叠；保留目标的局部引导在主要消融实验中优于指令替换；显式证据预算在效率考量之外，进一步降低了对广泛视觉上下文的依赖。  
在TX-G2（兼容AgiBot G2的变体平台）与HSR机器人的八项真实任务中，相较于pi0.5基线，S2将子任务平均成功率从54.2%提升至79.0%。综合结果表明，当执行器被训练为基于信息性局部引导与任务充分视觉证据行动，而非从弱监督中同时恢复两者时，VLA泛化能力将显著提升。
tldr: S2 improves VLA generalization by training the executor with refined language guidance and an explicit visual evidence budget, boosting real-robot task success from 54.2% to 79.0%.
tldr_zh: S2 通过精细语言引导和显式视觉证据预算训练执行器，提升 VLA 泛化能力，在真实机器人任务上将成功率从 54.2% 提高至 79.0%。

title: Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
summary: We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achieving unprecedented zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks. Extensive experiments and scaling analyses show that our model establishes a new performance frontier, demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.
summary_zh: 我们提出Humanoid-GPT，一种采用因果注意力机制的GPT风格Transformer，在十亿级运动语料上训练以实现全身控制。不同于受限于数据稀缺与敏捷性-泛化权衡的浅层MLP跟踪器，Humanoid-GPT在包含所有主流动作捕捉数据集及大规模内部录制的20亿帧重定向语料上进行了预训练。通过扩展数据与模型规模，该生成式Transformer不仅能跟踪高动态行为，更在未见过的运动与控制任务上实现了前所未有的零样本泛化能力。大量实验与规模分析表明，我们的模型建立了新的性能基准，在跟踪高动态复杂运动的同时，展现出对未知任务的强零样本泛化能力。
tldr: Humanoid-GPT is a GPT-style Transformer pretrained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control, achieving zero-shot motion tracking and generalization to unseen motions and tasks.
tldr_zh: Humanoid-GPT 是一个基于 GPT 架构的 Transformer，在十亿级运动语料上预训练，实现了全身控制、零样本运动跟踪以及对未见运动与任务的泛化。

title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) improves sample efficiency in real-robot manipulation through online human intervention. However, successful trajectories may include suboptimal actions that deviate from the desired task-execution path and force human intervention. Existing HIL-RL methods typically apply the consistent credit assignment principle to all transitions, uniformly propagating discounted terminal rewards through suboptimal segments, ignoring the actual contribution of each transition to task success. This overestimates Q-values for critic learning and indirectly misguides actor updates toward suboptimal behavior patterns. To this end, we propose PACT, a Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training framework that leverages the implicit preference signals induced by intervention to perform credit reassignment on identified suboptimal segments while directly guiding policy training for unbiased critic-actor learning. Specifically, we first design a progress model that learns from human demonstration and identifies suboptimal segments for credit correction. Then, from the human action and resampled policy action at the intervention state, we build preference pairs to define a counterfactual advantage that penalizes Bellman targets of the identified suboptimal segment, enabling directional credit calibration. Moreover, we directly align the policy with human corrective actions in the bounded mean space, providing an additional signal beyond critic-guided updates. Across five real-robot manipulation tasks, PACT improves the average success rate by 24.5% and achieves 1.3 times faster convergence, thereby improving both RL sample efficiency and performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05.
summary_zh: 人机协同强化学习（HIL-RL）通过在线人工干预提升了真实机器人操作中的样本效率。然而，成功轨迹中可能包含偏离期望任务执行路径、迫使人类干预的次优动作。现有HIL-RL方法通常对所有状态转移采用一致的信用分配原则，在次优轨迹段中均匀传播折扣终端奖励，忽略了每个状态转移对任务成功的实际贡献。这会导致评论家学习的Q值被高估，并间接误导演员向次优行为模式更新。为此，我们提出PACT（偏好校准的演员-评论家训练框架），该框架利用干预行为所蕴含的隐式偏好信号，对识别出的次优轨迹段进行信用重分配，同时直接引导策略训练以实现无偏的评论家-演员学习。具体而言，我们首先设计了一个从人类示教中学习的进度模型，用于识别需要信用修正的次优轨迹段。随后，在一次干预状态下，基于人类动作和重采样策略动作构建偏好对，定义了一个反事实优势函数来惩罚被识别次优轨迹段的贝尔曼目标，实现方向性信用校准。此外，我们在有界均值空间中将策略与人类修正动作直接对齐，提供超越评论家引导更新的额外信号。在五项真实机器人操作任务中，PACT将平均成功率提升24.5%，收敛速度加快1.3倍，从而同时提高了强化学习的样本效率和性能。代码开源地址：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05。
tldr: Proposes PACT, a preference-calibrated actor-critic framework that uses human intervention as implicit preference signals to reassign credit in suboptimal trajectory segments, improving sample efficiency and success rate in real-robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出 PACT，一种偏好校准的演员-评论家框架，利用人类干预作为隐式偏好信号，对次优轨迹片段进行信用重新分配，从而在真实机器人操作任务中提高样本效率和成功率。

title: PointAction: 3D Points as Universal Action Representations for Robot Control
summary: Video-Action Models (VAMs) leverage the broad visual dynamics captured by pre-trained video diffusion models, offering a promising path toward generalizable robot manipulation. However, RGB-only video rollouts are not directly actionable: they leave metric 3D motion, contact geometry, and fine-grained spatial constraints under-specified, making action grounding ambiguous. Meanwhile, scaling action supervision across diverse tasks and embodiments remains costly. We present PointAction, a framework that bridges video predictions to robot actions through explicit point-based 4D modeling. PointAction fine-tunes a foundation video generation model to jointly predict future RGB frames and dynamic 3D pointmaps, producing temporally consistent 3D motion of task-relevant scene geometry. These point dynamics serve as a structured, embodiment-agnostic action interface, which a diffusion-based action decoder maps to executable robot actions. By using metric 3D point dynamics as the interface between video prediction and control, PointAction reduces the ambiguity of RGB-only action grounding and supports transfer across tasks and embodiments with limited action supervision. Experiments show that PointAction achieves state-of-the-art 4D generation quality on robot scenes, outperforms existing baselines in simulation, and generalizes to two real robot arms unseen during pretraining.
summary_zh: 视频-动作模型（Video-Action Models, VAMs）利用预训练视频扩散模型捕获的广泛视觉动态，为可泛化的机器人操作提供了有前景的路径。然而，纯RGB视频 rollout 无法直接执行：其在度量3D运动、接触几何和细粒度空间约束方面存在欠指定问题，导致动作定位存在歧义。同时，跨不同任务和本体进行动作监督的规模化扩展仍代价高昂。我们提出PointAction框架，通过显式的基于点云的4D建模，将视频预测与机器人动作衔接起来。PointAction微调基础视频生成模型，使其联合预测未来RGB帧和动态3D点云图，生成任务相关场景几何的时间一致性3D运动。这些点动力学作为结构化的、与本体无关的动作接口，由基于扩散的动作解码器将其映射为可执行的机器人动作。通过将度量3D点动力学作为视频预测与控制之间的接口，PointAction降低了纯RGB动作定位的歧义性，并支持在有限动作监督下跨任务和本体的迁移。实验表明，PointAction在机器人场景中实现了最优的4D生成质量，在仿真中超越现有基线方法，并能泛化至预训练阶段未见过的两款真实机器人机械臂。
tldr: PointAction bridges video prediction and robot control by fine-tuning a video diffusion model to predict 4D point dynamics, which serve as an embodiment-agnostic action interface that reduces ambiguity in action grounding.
tldr_zh: PointAction通过微调视频扩散模型预测4D点动态，作为具身无关的动作接口，减少动作歧义，从而连接视频预测与机器人控制。

title: Denoising Tells When to Replan: Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking for Flow-Based Robot Policies
summary: Action chunking has become a common inference strategy for flow-based robot policies, improving action coherence by modeling multi-step temporal dependencies in demonstrations. However, the execution horizon is still typically set as an empirical fixed value, overlooking that predictable free-space motions and precision-critical interaction phases often require different replanning frequencies. In this work, we first show that the denoising process of flow-based policies contains an intrinsic signal of task phases: clean-action estimates remain stable during predictable motion phases, but fluctuate more strongly around contact-rich or precision-sensitive operations. Motivated by this observation, we propose DVAC (Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking), a test-time method that adaptively determines how many actions to execute from each predicted chunk. DVAC measures the variance of clean-action estimates over the final denoising steps, executes the stable low-variance prefix, and replans before high-variance future actions are committed. To transfer across tasks and rollouts, DVAC further calibrates the threshold with a rolling estimate of the local variance scale. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation show that DVAC improves task success while reducing replanning frequency. With a $π_{0.5}$-based policy, DVAC improves LIBERO success from 94.75% to 98.00% and reduces replanning by 43.0%, while also yielding aggregate gains on RoboTwin and CALVIN and improving real-world execution efficiency.
summary_zh: 动作分块已成为基于流的机器人策略中一种常见的推理策略，通过建模演示中的多步时间依赖关系来提升动作连贯性。然而，执行步长通常仍被设置为经验性的固定值，忽略了可预测的自由空间运动与精度关键交互阶段往往需要不同的重规划频率。在本工作中，我们首先表明，基于流策略的去噪过程包含任务阶段的固有信号：清洁动作估计在可预测运动阶段保持稳定，但在接触密集或精度敏感操作附近波动更为剧烈。受此观察启发，我们提出DVAC（去噪方差自适应分块）——一种测试时方法，能够自适应决定从每个预测分块中执行多少动作。DVAC测量最终去噪步骤中清洁动作估计的方差，执行稳定的低方差前缀，并在提交高方差未来动作之前进行重规划。为了实现跨任务和跨 rollout 的迁移，DVAC进一步利用局部方差尺度的滚动估计来校准阈值。在LIBERO、RoboTwin、CALVIN以及真实世界操作上的实验表明，DVAC在降低重规划频率的同时提升了任务成功率。基于π₀.₅策略，DVAC将LIBERO成功率从94.75%提升至98.00%，并将重规划频率降低43.0%，同时在RoboTwin和CALVIN上取得总体增益，并提升了真实世界执行效率。
tldr: This paper proposes DVAC, a test-time method that adaptively determines execution length for flow-based robot policies by monitoring denoising variance, improving success rates and reducing replanning frequency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DVAC，一种测试时自适应方法，通过监测去噪方差为基于流的机器人策略动态决定执行长度，提高成功率并减少重新规划频率。

title: Let the Dynamics Flow: Stable Flow Matching Dynamical Systems
summary: Flow matching has recently emerged as a powerful approach for imitation learning, enabling scalable, expressive, and multimodal motion policies. However, incorporating formal stability guarantees into these generative models, a prerequisite to ensure safe and generalizable robot behaviors, remains a significant challenge. While modeling robot motions as dynamical systems allows for such stability-based inductive biases, existing frameworks struggle to capture the rich action distributions inherent in complex robotic tasks. This paper introduces Stable Flow Matching Dynamical Systems (SFMDS), a novel framework that bridges the gap between high-capacity generative modeling and formal Lyapunov stability guarantees. SFMDS parametrizes dynamical systems via flow matching while simultaneously constraining the model to a family of stable solutions. We propose two variants: a soft constraint based on a penalty term, and a hard structural constraint embedded directly in the model architecture. We further extend both formulations to Lie groups. Experiments on benchmark datasets, in simulation, and on a humanoid robot show that SFMDS learns stable, scalable, and multimodal dynamical systems in low- and high-dimensional state spaces, enabling safe and expressive robot motion generation.
summary_zh: 流匹配近期作为一种强大的模仿学习方法涌现，可生成可扩展、表达力强且多模态的运动策略。然而，在这类生成模型中纳入形式稳定性保证——这是确保机器人行为安全且具备泛化能力的前提——仍是一项重大挑战。尽管将机器人运动建模为动态系统能够引入这种基于稳定性的归纳偏置，但现有框架难以捕捉复杂机器人任务中固有的丰富动作分布。本文提出稳定流匹配动态系统（SFMDS），这是一种连接高容量生成建模与形式化李雅普诺夫稳定性保证的新型框架。SFMDS通过流匹配参数化动态系统，同时将模型约束于稳定解族。我们提出了两种变体：基于惩罚项的软约束，以及直接嵌入模型架构的硬结构约束。进一步将两种形式推广至李群。在基准数据集、仿真环境及人形机器人上的实验表明，SFMDS能够在低维与高维状态空间中学习稳定、可扩展且多模态的动态系统，从而生成安全且富有表现力的机器人运动。
tldr: This paper introduces Stable Flow Matching Dynamical Systems (SFMDS), a framework that combines flow matching for imitation learning with Lyapunov stability guarantees, enabling safe and expressive robot motion generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了稳定流匹配动态系统 (SFMDS)，将流匹配模仿学习与李雅普诺夫稳定性保证相结合，实现安全且富有表现力的机器人运动生成。

title: UnsOcc: 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction in Unstructured Scene via Rendering Fusion
summary: Unstructured scenes present unique challenges for autonomous driving, as irregular obstacles and sparse scene layouts undermine the effectiveness of traditional perception methods such as 3D object detection. 3D semantic occupancy prediction has emerged as a prominent focus due to its ability to provide dense spatial representations by assigning semantic labels to individual voxels in 3D space. However, directly applying 3D semantic occupancy prediction to unstructured scenes remains challenging because scene sparsity hinders effective cross-modal fusion and the more severe long-tail distribution in these scenarios further degrades prediction performance. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we construct a dedicated dataset of unstructured scenes collected from open-pit mines. Based on this, we propose UnsOcc, a multi-modal 3D semantic occupancy prediction framework that improves robustness in unstructured environments. At its core, we introduce a rendering-based fusion module, RenderFusion, which enhances cross-modal feature alignment through bidirectional rendering supervision. Furthermore, we propose GSRefinement, a detail-aware auxiliary supervision method based on Gaussian Splatting that projects sparse 3D occupancy predictions into dense 2D semantic segmentation maps, enabling effective supervision for long-tail categories. Extensive experiments on both the open-pit mine dataset and the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_zh: 非结构化场景对自动驾驶提出了独特挑战，因为不规则障碍物与稀疏场景布局削弱了三维目标检测等传统感知方法的有效性。三维语义占用预测因其能够通过为三维空间中的每个体素分配语义标签来提供密集空间表征的能力，已成为研究焦点。然而，将三维语义占用预测直接应用于非结构化场景仍面临困难：场景稀疏性阻碍了有效的跨模态融合，而此类场景中更严重的长尾分布进一步降低了预测性能。为验证方法的有效性，我们构建了露天矿区非结构化场景专用数据集。基于此，我们提出UnsoCC——一种提升非结构化环境中鲁棒性的多模态三维语义占用预测框架。其核心是引入基于渲染的融合模块RenderFusion，通过双向渲染监督增强跨模态特征对齐。此外，我们提出基于高斯泼溅的细节感知辅助监督方法GSRefinement，将稀疏的三维占用预测投影为密集的二维语义分割图，实现对长尾类别的有效监督。在露天矿区数据集和nuScenes数据集上的大量实验证明，我们的方法显著优于现有最先进方法。
tldr: UnsOcc proposes a multi-modal 3D semantic occupancy prediction framework for unstructured autonomous driving scenes, using rendering-based fusion and Gaussian Splatting refinement to handle sparse layouts and long-tail categories.
tldr_zh: UnsOcc提出了一种针对非结构化自动驾驶场景的多模态3D语义占用预测框架，通过基于渲染的融合和高斯泼溅细化处理稀疏布局和长尾类别。

title: Partially Observable Adversarial Patch Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are gaining attention in robotics, yet their robustness to adversarial attacks remains largely unexplored. Existing work shows that adversarial patches can mislead VLA-based robots but assumes full access to the entire execution trajectory, an unrealistic requirement in practice. We address this limitation by formulating a partially observable threat model, where the adversary can exploit only a short prefix of the trajectory to generate a fixed patch applied to all subsequent frames. Under this setting, we propose a two-phase framework. First, we localize the patch using the model's attention maps to identify visually critical regions that correspond to the full instruction. Then, we optimize the patch to disrupt the semantic grounding of target objects and increase the curvature of action trajectories, thereby compounding failures in both perception and control. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world robotic environments show that our method sustains adversarial effects under partial observability, inducing long-horizon disruptions and significantly reducing task success rates.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人领域日益受到关注，但其对对抗攻击的鲁棒性仍基本未被探索。现有研究表明，对抗性补丁能够误导基于VLA的机器人，但这些研究假设攻击者可完全访问整个执行轨迹，这在实践中是不切实际的要求。我们通过构建一个部分可观测的威胁模型来突破这一局限：在该模型中，攻击者仅能利用轨迹的一小段前缀生成一个固定补丁，并将其应用于所有后续帧。在此设定下，我们提出一个两阶段框架。首先，利用模型的注意力图定位补丁，识别与完整指令对应的视觉关键区域。随后，优化补丁以破坏目标对象的语义锚定，并增大动作轨迹曲率，从而在感知与控制层面同时加剧失效。在仿真及真实机器人环境中的大量实验表明，我们的方法能够在部分可观测条件下维持对抗效果，诱导长时域干扰并显著降低任务成功率。
tldr: Proposes a partially observable adversarial patch attack on VLA robot policies, using attention maps to localize critical regions and optimize patches that disrupt both perception and control over long horizons.
tldr_zh: 提出一种部分可观测的对抗性贴片攻击方法，利用注意力图定位关键视觉区域并优化贴片，在长期任务中破坏VLA机器人策略的感知与控制。

title: Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots
summary: Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.
summary_zh: 富有表现力的全身运动对于在人类环境中运行的人形机器人至关重要，这类机器人需在稳定运动的同时展现出可读且可调节的身体行为。然而，目前大多数富有表现力的运动仍源于固定演示或人工编写的脚本，导致示范风格难以在不同运动内容间复用。受人类运动风格通过步态节奏、姿态、手臂摆动和身体摇摆传递情感与意图线索的启发，本文提出了一种仿生生成-控制框架，用于在人形机器人上实现基于示例的风格迁移。给定一段简短的人类风格示例与目标内容运动，该框架可生成风格化的全身运动参考，在保留预定运动内容的同时迁移示范风格。本文开发了一种物理感知的多条件潜扩散模型，用于融合风格、内容与轨迹条件，并通过无分类器引导实现无需重新训练的风格强度调节。为提升硬件可执行性，在训练过程中对解码后的运动施加接触一致性与时间平滑性正则化约束。生成的参考运动随后被转换为兼容G1型机器人参考轨迹，并通过基于预览的全身跟踪策略执行——该策略采用聚类与蒸馏技术训练。仿真实验与Unitree G1实体机器人实验表明：所提方法能将简短的人类风格示例迁移至多样化的机器人运动内容，相比面向动画的风格迁移基线方法减少了接触与抖动伪影，在125次真实机器人试验中实现了96.0%的成功率。研究结果证实了将简短人类运动示例作为可复用仿生源，用于生成物理可执行的富有表现力人形运动的可行性。
tldr: A bionic generation-to-control framework that transfers short human motion style exemplars to physically executable whole-body motions for humanoid robots using a physics-aware latent diffusion model and a preview-based tracking policy, achieving 96% real-robot success rate.
tldr_zh: 提出一种仿生生成到控制框架，将人体运动风格短示例迁移至人形机器人的可执行全身运动，利用物理感知潜扩散模型和预览跟踪策略，实机成功率达96%。

title: Human2Humanoid: Physics-Aware Cross-Morphology Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Robots
summary: Retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is critical for teleoperation, imitation learning and human-robot interaction. However, it remains challenging because of substantial morphological discrepancies between humans and robots, including differences in skeletal topology, limb proportions and degrees of freedom, as well as the scarcity of paired motion data. This paper presents Human2Humanoid, an unsupervised motion retargeting framework that transfers human motions to humanoid robot behaviors with high fidelity. To bridge the domain gap under unpaired data, we adopt a CycleGAN-based architecture equipped with a skeleton-aware graph convolutional network to capture topology-dependent motion features. To address cross-domain scale mismatches, we introduce a morphology-invariant end-effector consistency loss that aligns normalized end-effector trajectories to preserve motion semantics across embodiments. To improve physical plausibility and reduce contact artifacts, we impose explicit physics-aware feasibility constraints to encourage reproduction of the contact patterns in the source motion. Experimental results show that the proposed method successfully retargets human motion to the Unitree G1 humanoid robot without paired data, and outperforms existing methods in both downstream controllability and physical feasibility.
summary_zh: 将人体动作重定向至人形机器人对于远程操控、模仿学习以及人机交互至关重要。然而，由于人与机器人之间存在显著的形态学差异——包括骨骼拓扑结构、肢体比例与自由度的不同，以及配对动作数据的匮乏——这一任务仍面临挑战。本文提出Human2Humanoid框架，一种无监督的动作重定向方法，能以高保真度将人体动作迁移至人形机器人行为。为解决非配对数据下的领域差异，我们采用基于CycleGAN的架构，并融合骨架感知图卷积网络以捕捉拓扑相关的动作特征。针对跨域尺度不匹配问题，我们引入形态不变末端执行器一致性损失，通过对齐归一化的末端执行器轨迹来保留跨本体的动作语义。为提升物理合理性并减少接触伪影，我们施加显式的物理感知可行性约束，以激励对源动作中接触模式的复现。实验结果表明，所提方法无需配对数据即可成功将人体动作重定向至Unitree G1人形机器人，并在下游可控性与物理可行性方面均优于现有方法。
tldr: Proposes Human2Humanoid, an unsupervised motion retargeting framework that transfers human motions to humanoid robots using CycleGAN, graph convolutional networks, and physics-aware constraints, achieving high-fidelity retargeting on a real humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: 提出Human2Humanoid，一种无监督运动重定向框架，利用CycleGAN、图卷积网络和物理感知约束将人体运动迁移至人形机器人，并在真实人形机器人上实现高保真重定向。

title: OpenEAI-Platform: An Open-source Embodied Artificial Intelligence Hardware-Software Unified Platform
summary: Embodied AI in the real world requires both accurate hardware and robust vision-language-action (VLA) policies. We present OpenEAI-Platform, a fully open-source platform that integrates a low-cost 6+1 degree-of-freedom (dof) robotic arm (OpenEAI-Arm) and a reproducible VLA model (OpenEAI-VLA). OpenEAI-Arm provides open-source mechanical designs for low manufacturing cost and compliant control methods for higher accuracy. OpenEAI-VLA builds on Qwen3-VL-4B and uses a Diffusion Transformer action head, and is trained in two stages with only open-source robot and multimodal datasets. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, OpenEAI-Arm outperforms two commercial 6+1-dof arms under the same policy, and OpenEAI-VLA achieves success rates comparable to the large-scale pretrained pi0 baseline with only limited pretraining data. We will release the full hardware designs, drivers, models, and training/data pipelines to support reproducible research and scalable data collection. Our codes, layouts, and models will be released after the paper is accepted.
summary_zh: 具身人工智能在现实世界中的应用既需要精确的硬件，也需要稳健的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。我们提出OpenEAI-Platform，这是一个完全开源的平台，集成了低成本6+1自由度机械臂（OpenEAI-Arm）与可复现的VLA模型（OpenEAI-VLA）。OpenEAI-Arm提供开源机械设计以降低制造成本，并采用柔顺控制方法提升精度。OpenEAI-VLA基于Qwen3-VL-4B，使用扩散Transformer动作头，并仅利用开源机器人及多模态数据集进行两阶段训练。在四项真实世界操作任务中，OpenEAI-Arm在相同策略下优于两款商用6+1自由度机械臂，而OpenEAI-VLA在仅有有限预训练数据的条件下，达到了与大规模预训练pi0基线相当的成功率。我们将发布完整的硬件设计、驱动程序、模型及训练/数据流水线，以支持可重复研究与可扩展数据采集。本研究的代码、布局及模型将在论文接收后公开。
tldr: OpenEAI-Platform is an open-source hardware-software unified platform integrating a low-cost 6+1-DOF robotic arm and a reproducible VLA model based on Qwen3-VL-4B and Diffusion Transformer, achieving competitive performance against commercial arms and large-scale baselines in real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: OpenEAI-Platform是一个开源软硬件统一平台，集成了低成本6+1自由度机械臂和基于Qwen3-VL-4B与扩散Transformer的可复现VLA模型，在真实操作任务中达到了与商业机械臂和大规模基线模型相当的性能。

title: Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution: A Closed Two-Stage Framework for Precise and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
summary: In robotic manipulation, the tight coupling between grasping and motion planning often obscures the true source of failure, leading to inefficient trial-and-error. To enable efficient long-horizon manipulation, we propose GTP-FA (Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution), a task-oriented two-stage grasp-then-plan framework that generates grasp candidates and performs downstream motion planning conditioned on the selected grasp. Given a failed manipulation trajectory, we learn a failure attribution model that generalizes to unseen grasps and produces a stable distribution over failure modes for diagnosis-guided optimization. Based on these attribution results, we then optimize both modules in a diagnosis-driven manner: on the grasping side, we inject task-level priors and risk penalties into grasp candidate scoring and optimization to suppress unstable or task-incompatible grasps; on the planning side, we target high-risk initial states through data collection and fine-tuning to address genuine planning bottlenecks. We evaluate the proposed framework in both simulation and real-robot experiments, and show that GTP-FA improves the corresponding base learners across RL, IL, diffusion-policy, and VLA-based settings, achieving substantially higher overall task success rates.
summary_zh: 在机器人操作中，抓取与运动规划之间的紧密耦合常掩盖故障的真实原因，导致低效的试错过程。为实现高效的长时域操作，我们提出GTP-FA（先抓取后规划与故障归因）——一种面向任务的两阶段"抓取-规划"框架，该框架可生成抓取候选方案，并基于所选抓取姿态执行后续运动规划。针对失败的操作轨迹，我们学习了一个故障归因模型，该模型可泛化至未知抓取姿态，并生成故障模式的稳定分布以指导诊断优化。基于这些归因结果，我们以诊断驱动的方式对两个模块进行优化：在抓取端，通过注入任务级先验和风险惩罚来改进抓取候选评分与优化过程，从而抑制不稳定或与任务不兼容的抓取；在规划端，则通过数据收集与微调重点关注高风险初始状态，以解决真实的规划瓶颈。我们在仿真与真实机器人实验中评估了所提框架，结果表明GTP-FA在基于强化学习、模仿学习、扩散策略及视觉-语言-动作模型的方法上均显著提升了底层学习器的性能，实现了更高的总体任务成功率。
tldr: Proposes a closed two-stage grasp-then-plan framework with a failure attribution model to improve long-horizon robotic manipulation by diagnosing and optimizing both grasping and planning modules.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种具有失败归因的闭环两阶段抓取-规划框架，通过诊断和优化抓取与规划模块来改进长程机器人操作。

title: GPU-Parallel Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Demonstration Guided Policy Optimization
summary: Large scale GPU-parallel reinforcement learning has changed what can be trained in robot simulation, yet most systems still optimize one specialist policy per task. We propose a construction methodology for turning structured manipulation task families into GPU-parallel multi-task RL benchmarks, and instantiate it as MT-Libero using LIBERO assets and task predicates in Isaac Lab. The resulting benchmark supports simultaneous reinforcement learning over heterogeneous task suites with parallel rendering, physics randomization, and state-input or visual-input policies. To make such training practical under sparse success signals and limited prior data, we further propose DGPO, an on-policy demonstration guided method that combines importance weighted PPO with adaptive behavior cloning on matched demonstration actions. DGPO enables a tunable preference toward demonstrated task distributions, outperforming both prior-free RL and existing demonstration-based methods while preserving the stability and online improvement benefits of on-policy PPO.
summary_zh: 大规模GPU并行强化学习已经拓展了机器人仿真中可训练任务的边界，但大多数系统仍针对单个任务优化专用策略。我们提出一种将结构化操作任务族转化为GPU并行多任务强化学习基准的构建方法，并利用LIBERO资源库及Isaac Lab中的任务谓词，将其具体实现为MT-Libero。该基准支持在异构任务集上同步进行强化学习，具备并行渲染、物理随机化以及状态输入或视觉输入策略的能力。为在稀疏成功信号和有限先验数据条件下实现此类训练的可行性，我们进一步提出DGPO——一种基于在线策略的演示引导方法，该方法将重要性加权PPO算法与匹配演示动作的自适应行为克隆相结合。DGPO能够对演示任务分布进行可调节偏好，在保持在线策略PPO的稳定性与持续优化优势的同时，性能超越无先验强化学习及现有基于演示的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces MT-Libero, a GPU-parallel multi-task RL benchmark for manipulation, and DGPO, an on-policy demonstration-guided method combining importance-weighted PPO with adaptive behavior cloning to handle sparse rewards and limited data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MT-Libero，一个用于操作的GPU并行多任务强化学习基准，以及DGPO，一种结合重要性加权PPO和自适应行为克隆的在线演示引导方法，以处理稀疏奖励和有限数据。

title: SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires stable whole-body control under varying object masses and pickup/placement heights. This becomes particularly challenging in sim-to-real transfer, where object-induced load variation and robot-side dynamics mismatch interact during physical contact. Existing history-based adapters often compress these factors into a single latent representation, which can weaken robustness under heavy-load manipulation. We propose \textbf{SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation}, which freezes a pretrained box manipulation policy and extends it with object/load and dynamics-aware context encoders trained with split world-model objectives, GRL-based cross-adversarial regularization, and hierarchical Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM). In sim-to-sim experiments and real-world deployment, SplitAdapter improves Full-task success over the base policy and world-model FiLM baselines across object masses of $2$, $4$, and $6$ kg and pickup/placement heights of $0$, $30$, and $60$ cm, with the largest improvements under heavy-load conditions.
summary_zh: 类人机器人全身操作需要在不同物体质量和抓取/放置高度下实现稳定的全身控制。这在仿真到现实的迁移中尤为具有挑战性，因为物体引起的负载变化与机器人侧动力学失配会在物理接触期间相互影响。现有的基于历史记录的适配器通常将这些因素压缩为单一潜在表征，从而削弱了重负载操作下的鲁棒性。我们提出**SplitAdapter：通过因子化适配实现负载感知的类人机器人全身操作**，该方法冻结预训练的箱体操作策略，并利用分离世界模型目标训练的物体/负载与动力学感知上下文编码器、基于梯度反转层的交叉对抗正则化以及层级特征线性调制（FiLM）对其进行扩展。在仿真到仿真实验及真实世界部署中，SplitAdapter在2、4、6千克物体质量以及0、30、60厘米抓取/放置高度下，相较于基础策略与世界模型FiLM基线，全面提升了全任务成功率，其中在重负载条件下改进最为显著。
tldr: SplitAdapter introduces a factorized adaptation method for humanoid loco-manipulation that separates load and dynamics contexts, improving sim-to-real transfer performance under heavy loads.
tldr_zh: SplitAdapter 提出了一种分解式适配方法，将负载和动力学上下文分离，用于人形机器人全身操控，在重负载下提升了仿真到现实的迁移性能。

title: Bridging Predictive Uncertainty and Safe Action: Sample-Conditioned Differentiable Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Complex, dynamic, and interactive driving environments pose significant challenges for autonomous driving, primarily due to the pervasive uncertainty of surrounding traffic. A fundamental bottleneck in current systems is the disconnect between highly expressive uncertainty modeling and interpretable, safe motion planning. In this paper, we propose a novel sample-conditioned differentiable planning framework that bridges this gap by explicitly incorporating diffusion-generated future trajectories into the optimization process. Rather than compressing predictions into a single deterministic future or relying on black-box end-to-end architectures, our approach leverages a conditional diffusion model to generate a diverse set of plausible future scenarios. Crucially, these samples are directly fed into a differentiable planner, which explicitly mitigates predictive uncertainty via an empirical Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) tail-risk constraint. This allows the planner to optimize a physically interpretable trajectory that is robust to rare yet safety-critical interactions. Furthermore, we introduce a directed graph representation for scene context that yields substantial improvements in both predictive effectiveness and computational efficiency. Validated through extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations on the Waymo Open Motion and Argoverse 2 datasets, our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in safety, efficiency, and ride comfort.
summary_zh: 复杂、动态且交互式的驾驶环境对自动驾驶构成了重大挑战，主要源于周围交通普遍存在的不确定性。当前系统的一个根本瓶颈在于高度表达性的不确定性建模与可解释、安全运动规划之间的脱节。本文提出了一种新颖的样本条件可微分规划框架，通过将扩散生成的未来轨迹显式纳入优化过程，弥合了这一差距。我们的方法并非将预测压缩为单一的确定性未来，或依赖黑箱端到端架构，而是利用条件扩散模型生成一组多样化的可信未来场景。关键在于，这些样本被直接输入可微分规划器，并通过经验性条件风险价值（CVaR）尾部风险约束显式缓解预测不确定性。这使得规划器能够优化具有物理可解释性的轨迹，从而对罕见但安全关键性的交互具有鲁棒性。此外，我们引入了一种用于场景上下文的有向图表示，显著提升了预测有效性和计算效率。通过在Waymo开放运动数据集和Argoverse 2数据集上进行的大量开环与闭环评估，我们的框架在安全性、效率及乘坐舒适性方面均显著优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: This paper presents a sample-conditioned differentiable planning framework for autonomous driving that uses a conditional diffusion model to generate diverse future scenarios and incorporates CVaR tail-risk constraints, achieving state-of-the-art results on Waymo and Argoverse datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的样本条件可微分规划框架，利用条件扩散模型生成多样化的未来场景，并通过CVaR尾部风险约束进行鲁棒规划，在Waymo和Argoverse数据集上取得了领先结果。

title: Dive into the Scene: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Vision-Language Decision Making via Focus Plan Generation
summary: In embodied vision-language decision making tasks such as robotic manipulation and navigation, Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models (VLMs & VLAs) are powerful tools with different benefits: VLMs are better at long-term planning, while VLAs are better at reactive control. However, their performance is limited by the same perceptual bottleneck: visual hallucinations arise due to the models' inability to distinguish task-relevant objects from distractors. In principle, accurate identification and focus on critical objects while filtering out irrelevant ones is the key to break this limitation. A straightforward solution is one-step focus: directly attending to essential objects. However, this approach proves ineffective because effective focus inherently requires deep scene understanding. To this end, we propose SceneDiver, a coarse-to-fine focus plan generation method for VLMs leveraging their long-term planning abilities, that first constructs a holistic scene graph to establish initial comprehension, then progressively decomposes the task into simpler sub-problems through an iterative cycle of recognition, understanding, and analysis. To enable reactive control, we also design a lightweight adapter for distilling the deliberate focus ability into VLAs. Evaluations on standard embodied AI benchmarks confirm that our method substantially reduces visual hallucinations for both VLMs and VLAs, while preserving computational efficiency in tasks requiring fast execution. Our code and data are released at: https://future-item.github.io/SceneDiver.
summary_zh: 在面向具身视觉-语言决策任务（如机器人操作与导航）中，视觉-语言模型（VLM）及视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）作为功能强大的工具各具优势：VLM更擅长长期规划，而VLA更擅长反应式控制。然而，两者的性能均受制于相同的感知瓶颈：因模型无法区分任务相关物体与干扰物，导致产生视觉幻觉。原则上，精确识别并聚焦关键物体、同时过滤无关信息，是突破这一局限的关键。一种直接的解决方案是单步聚焦：直接关注必要物体。但该方法被证明效果不佳，因为有效聚焦本质上需要深度场景理解。为此，我们提出SceneDiver —— 一种利用VLM长期规划能力、由粗到细的聚焦方案生成方法。该方法首先构建整体场景图以建立初步理解，随后通过识别、理解与分析的迭代循环，逐步将任务分解为更简单的子问题。为实现反应式控制，我们还设计了一种轻量级适配器，将审慎聚焦能力蒸馏至VLA中。在标准具身AI基准上的评估证实，我们的方法显著减少了VLM与VLA的视觉幻觉，同时保持了需要快速执行任务的计算效率。我们的代码与数据已发布于：https://future-item.github.io/SceneDiver。
tldr: SceneDiver proposes a coarse-to-fine focus plan generation method that reduces visual hallucinations in VLMs and VLAs for embodied decision-making tasks by first constructing a scene graph and then progressively decomposing tasks into sub-problems.
tldr_zh: SceneDiver 提出了一种从粗到细的聚焦计划生成方法，通过先构建场景图再逐步分解任务为子问题，减少 VLM 和 VLA 在具身决策任务中的视觉幻觉。

title: EaDex: A Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation Framework from Low-Cost Demonstrations
summary: Dexterous manipulation learning has long been hindered by the high costs of data and training, as pure reinforcement learning typically requires large-scale interactive exploration and imitation learning depends on high-quality demonstrations that are expensive to collect. To address this problem, we propose EaDex, a multi-embodiment dexterous manipulation learning framework under low-cost demonstration conditions, which enables rapid generation of demonstration data and consequently reduces training time for efficient dexterous manipulation. At the data level, EaDex captures human hand motions using only a single RGB-D camera and constructs structured demonstration data through MANO-based hand modeling, data normalization, and motion retargeting. At the learning level, we introduce a contact-reward-based dynamic demonstration annealing mechanism, which guides early-stage exploration under demonstration and gradually transitions to autonomous optimization with accumulating contact rewards. Using our custom dataset, we evaluate EaDex on three dexterous hands and three articulated object-opening tasks, covering nine cross-embodiment manipulation settings, achieving a 55.3% relative improvement over the baseline without demonstration annealing. These results validate the effectiveness of the proposed low-cost demonstration pipeline and the dynamic demonstration annealing strategy for dexterous manipulation learning.
summary_zh: 灵活操作学习长期以来一直受限于数据和训练的高昂成本，因为纯强化学习通常需要大规模交互式探索，而模仿学习则依赖成本高昂的高质量示范数据。为解决这一问题，我们提出EaDex——一种在低成本示范条件下实现多形态灵活操作的学习框架，该框架能够快速生成示范数据，从而减少训练时间，实现高效的灵活操作。在数据层面，EaDex仅使用单个RGB-D摄像头捕捉人类手部运动，并通过基于MANO的手部建模、数据归一化及运动重定向构建结构化示范数据。在学习层面，我们引入一种基于接触奖励的动态示范退火机制，该机制在示范引导下进行早期探索，并随着接触奖励的累积逐渐过渡到自主优化。利用我们自建的数据集，EaDex在三种灵巧手和三种铰接式物体开启任务中进行了评估，覆盖九种跨形态操作场景，相较于未使用示范退火的基线方法实现了55.3%的相对提升。这些结果验证了所提出的低成本示范流程及动态示范退火策略在灵活操作学习中的有效性。
tldr: EaDex proposes a cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation framework that combines low-cost RGB-D hand-capture for demonstration generation with a contact-reward-based demonstration annealing mechanism to efficiently learn policies across multiple robot hands.
tldr_zh: EaDex提出一种跨本体的灵巧操作框架，通过低成本RGB-D手部捕捉生成示教数据，并利用基于接触奖励的动态示教退火机制，在多个机器人手上高效学习操作策略。

title: AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models
summary: Navigating a drone in unseen and cluttered environments requires reliable generalization to unseen scene layouts and understanding of environmental structure relative to the robot's capabilities. Previous methods, which assume the same environment configuration, often rely heavily on human-designed perception pipelines and predefined rules to guide the robot toward the target. This process is environment-dependent and generalizes poorly across environments. Inspired by animal navigation behavior, we design a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome these issues. In addition, a sparse reward function without hand-crafted shaping terms is designed to avoid local minima traps and encourage yaw control behaviors. In simulation and on real drones, our method exhibits emergent capabilities for navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail. In challenging maps, it achieves a 5.3% higher navigation success rate than best baseline. Furthermore, the proposed framework achieves effective sim-to-real transfer without any tuning during deployment. The code will be publicly available.
summary_zh: 在未知且杂乱环境中操控无人机，需要具备对未见场景布局的可靠泛化能力，以及理解与机器人能力相关的环境结构。以往假设环境配置相同的方法，通常过度依赖人工设计的感知流水线和预定义规则来引导机器人抵达目标。这一过程依赖于特定环境，跨环境泛化能力较差。受动物导航行为启发，我们设计了一种导航框架，该框架在基于世界模型的环境理解之上，采用基于强化学习的策略进行导航，以克服上述问题。此外，我们设计了一种无需人工设计奖励项的稀疏奖励函数，以避免局部极小值陷阱并鼓励偏航控制行为。在仿真实验与真实无人机测试中，我们的方法展现出在复杂未知环境中导航、以及在其他方法失效时逃逸局部最优的涌现能力。在具有挑战性的地图中，该方法比最佳基线方法导航成功率高出5.3%。此外，所提出的框架在部署过程中无需任何调参即可实现有效的仿真到现实迁移。代码将公开提供。
tldr: AirDreamer proposes a drone navigation framework that combines reinforcement learning with a world model to achieve robust generalization to unseen environments and successful sim-to-real transfer without tuning.
tldr_zh: AirDreamer提出了一种结合强化学习和世界模型的无人机导航框架，能够在未见环境中实现鲁棒泛化，并无需调参即可完成仿真到现实的迁移。

title: GeoSem-WAM: Geometry- and Semantic-Aware World Action Models
summary: Recent World Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in embodied decision-making. However, whether their effectiveness stems from explicit future imagination during inference or representation learning induced by predictive training remains an open question. Emerging evidence suggests the primary advantage lies in learning robust latent representations rather than generating future observations at test time. Nevertheless, existing WAMs mainly rely on RGB-based future prediction, which provides limited structural and spatial understanding of complex environments. To address this, we propose a structured world modeling framework that enhances latent representations through geometric and semantic supervision. Alongside future RGB prediction, our model introduces two auxiliary prediction branches for future geometry and semantic representations, enabling it to jointly capture scene dynamics, spatial geometry, and semantic context within a unified latent space. Crucially, our approach preserves efficient inference by avoiding explicit future rollout or video generation at test time. Extensive experiments show that incorporating structured world supervision consistently improves action prediction accuracy, scene understanding, and robustness under challenging embodied scenarios, highlighting its potential for advancing scalable and efficient WAMs.
summary_zh: 最近的世界动作模型（WAMs）在具身决策中展现了令人印象深刻的能力。然而，其有效性究竟源于推理过程中的显式未来想象，还是源于预测训练引发的表征学习，这一问题仍悬而未决。新出现的证据表明，其主要优势在于学习稳健的潜在表征，而非在测试时生成未来观测。尽管如此，现有的WAMs主要依赖基于RGB的未来预测，这在对复杂环境的结构与空间理解方面存在局限。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种结构化世界建模框架，通过几何与语义监督增强潜在表征。在未来的RGB预测之外，我们的模型引入了两个辅助预测分支，分别用于未来几何与语义表征，使其能够在统一潜在空间中联合捕捉场景动态、空间几何与语义上下文。关键在于，我们的方法避免了测试时显式的未来推演或视频生成，从而保持了高效的推理。大量实验表明，融入结构化世界监督能够持续提升动作预测精度、场景理解能力以及在挑战性具身场景下的鲁棒性，凸显了其在推进可扩展且高效的WAMs方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes GeoSem-WAM, a world action model that enhances latent representations by adding auxiliary prediction branches for future geometry and semantic information alongside RGB prediction, improving action prediction and robustness in embodied tasks without requiring explicit future rollout at test time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GeoSem-WAM，一种世界动作模型，通过在未来RGB预测之外增加几何和语义辅助预测分支来增强潜在表示，在不进行显式未来 rollout 的情况下提升动作预测准确性和鲁棒性。

title: Ask When It Pays: Cost-Aware Open-Ended Interaction for Instance Goal Navigation
summary: Instance Goal Navigation (IGN) requires an embodied agent to find a specific object instance among distractors from an under-specified natural-language description. Such ambiguity often cannot be resolved from perception and language alone, making interaction with an oracle a natural mechanism for disambiguation. Prior interactive methods allow oracle queries but treat lightweight clarification and route-level guidance alike, letting agents boost success rate through repeated high-information questions rather than by resolving the underlying ambiguity efficiently. We recast interactive IGN as a cost-sensitive uncertainty-reduction problem, where the agent should ask the question whose answer provides the largest reduction in navigation uncertainty relative to its penalty. To this end, we apply an information-gain analysis on existing navigation corpora to identify which cues reduce navigation uncertainty, yielding a compact set of question types and data-derived weights. However, existing interactive navigation benchmarks do not model the cost of different question types or evaluate how efficiently agents use interaction, making them unsuitable for studying cost-sensitive interaction. Based on this taxonomy, we construct a benchmark for diagnosing interaction behavior and efficiency, together with a Weighted Success Rate metric that penalizes each query by its derived cost. We further propose a zero-shot MLLM navigator that selectively queries at each decision step only when the expected uncertainty reduction justifies the interaction cost.
summary_zh: 实例目标导航（IGN）要求具身智能体在干扰物中，根据一条信息不充分的自然语言描述找到特定物体实例。这种歧义通常无法仅通过感知和语言解决，因此与“神谕”进行交互成为一种自然的消歧机制。现有的交互方法允许向神谕提问，但将轻量级澄清与路径级指导视为等同，使得智能体能够通过重复提出高信息量的问题来提高成功率，而非高效地解决根本性歧义。我们将交互式IGN重新定义为一种成本敏感的不确定性降低问题，在此问题中，智能体应提出这样的问题：其答案能相对于惩罚成本带来导航不确定性的最大降幅。为此，我们对现有导航语料库进行信息增益分析，以识别哪些线索能降低导航不确定性，从而得出一组紧凑的问题类型及数据驱动的权重。然而，现有交互式导航基准并未对不同问题类型的成本进行建模，也未评估智能体使用交互的效率，因此它们不适合研究成本敏感的交互。基于上述分类体系，我们构建了一个用于诊断交互行为与效率的基准，并引入加权成功率指标，该指标根据推导出的成本对每次查询进行惩罚。我们进一步提出了一种零样本多模态大语言模型导航器，该导航器仅在预期不确定性降低足以证明交互成本的合理性时，才在每一步决策中选择性地进行查询。
tldr: This paper introduces a cost-aware, uncertainty-reduction framework for interactive Instance Goal Navigation, where an agent selectively queries an oracle only when expected information gain justifies the interaction cost, and provides a benchmark with weighted success metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种成本感知的不确定性减少框架用于交互式实例目标导航，智能体仅在预期信息增益超过交互成本时才选择性查询Oracle，并提供了带有加权成功指标的基准。

title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models trained on large-scale data have made remarkable progress, but they remain vulnerable to distribution shifts at deployment time. Recent VLA models suggest that prompts can serve as an efficient interface for steering policy behavior, but existing prompt-based steering typically relies on external guidance. This raises a natural question: can test-time training (TTT) for VLA be achieved by optimizing a prompt, so that the steering interface itself can be learned and adapted from interaction? We address this question with TTT-VLA, a test-time training framework based on Latent Prompt Optimization (LPO). During training, the latent prompt is learned with an additional proxy task, providing an extra learned conditioning signal for policy learning. At test time, TTT is performed by collecting interaction data from the current environment and optimizing only the latent prompt on those data using the proxy task's self-supervised signal, without modifying the policy itself. Experiments on SimplerEnv demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves task success rates in both single- and multi-embodiment settings. Further analysis shows that the gains arise primarily from correcting a small number of critical decisions rather than globally altering policy behavior. These results suggest that LPO provides an effective and practical pathway for deployment-time improvement of foundation manipulation policies.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在大规模数据训练下取得了显著进展，但在部署时仍易受分布偏移影响。近期VLA模型表明，提示可作为高效的策略调控接口，然而现有基于提示的调控通常依赖外部引导。这引发了一个自然问题：能否通过优化提示实现VLA的测试时训练（TTT），使调控接口自身能够从交互中学习并适应？我们通过TTT-VLA解决这一问题，该框架基于潜在提示优化（LPO）。在训练阶段，潜在提示通过附加代理任务进行学习，为策略学习提供额外的条件信号。在测试阶段，通过从当前环境收集交互数据，仅利用代理任务的自监督信号优化潜在提示（不修改策略本身）来执行TTT。在SimplerEnv上的实验表明，所提方法在单实体和多实体场景中均能持续提升任务成功率。进一步分析显示，性能提升主要源于纠正少量关键决策，而非全局改变策略行为。这些结果表明，LPO为基础操控策略的部署时优化提供了有效且实用的途径。
tldr: TTT-VLA proposes a test-time training framework for VLA models that optimizes a latent prompt using interaction data and self-supervised proxy tasks, improving policy adaptation under distribution shift without modifying the policy weights.
tldr_zh: TTT-VLA 提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作模型的测试时训练框架，通过交互数据和自监督代理任务优化潜在提示，在不修改策略权重的情况下改进策略在分布偏移下的适应性。

title: The Road Ahead in Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Multimodal Dataset
summary: Existing autonomous driving datasets have enabled major progress, but fall short in sensor fidelity, map completeness, or geographic diversity. We present KITScenes Multimodal, a European dataset built around high-fidelity sensors and maps. Our fully synchronized sensor suite combines high-resolution global-shutter cameras, long-range lidar beyond 400m, 4D imaging radar, and redundant GNSS/INS localization. Our HD maps are, to our knowledge, the most complete of any sensor dataset, validated through autonomous driving trials on open-source software. For the first time in a public dataset, all driving-relevant traffic elements, such as traffic lights, are mapped in 3D to a reprojection-accurate level with full topological connectivity. Recorded in cities with irregular street layouts and mixed traffic modes, our dataset complements existing datasets by broadening the available geographic diversity. We also introduce four benchmarks, each advancing spatial learning for embodied AI: online HD map construction, long-range depth estimation, novel view synthesis, and end-to-end driving. Project page: https://kitscenes.com/
summary_zh: 现有自动驾驶数据集虽已推动重大进展，但在传感器保真度、地图完整度或地理多样性方面仍存在不足。本文提出KITScenes多模态数据集，这是一个基于高保真传感器与地图构建的欧洲数据集。我们完全同步的传感器套件集成了高分辨率全局快门相机、探测距离超400米的长距激光雷达、4D成像雷达以及冗余GNSS/INS定位系统。据我们所知，我们的高精地图是所有传感器数据集中最完整的，并通过开源软件上的自动驾驶试验验证。作为公开数据集的首创，所有与驾驶相关的交通要素（如红绿灯）均以三维形式映射至重投影级精度，并包含完整拓扑连接。该数据集采集于街道布局不规则且交通模式混合的城市，通过拓宽现有地理多样性，对现有数据集形成补充。我们还引入四个面向具身AI空间学习的基准任务：在线高精地图构建、长距离深度估计、新视角合成及端到端驾驶。项目主页：https://kitscenes.com/
tldr: This paper introduces the KITScenes Multimodal dataset, a high-fidelity, geographically diverse autonomous driving dataset with advanced sensors and complete HD maps, along with four benchmarks for spatial learning and end-to-end driving.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了KITScenes多模态数据集，这是一个具有高保真传感器和完整高清地图、地理多样性的自动驾驶数据集，并提出了四个推进空间学习和端到端驾驶的基准。

title: AURA: Action-Gated Memory for Robot Policies at Constant VRAM
summary:
The KV-cache is the right memory for datacenters but the wrong memory for robots. Datacenter inference batches many short requests and resets them, amortizing an attention cache across a crowd. Embodied agents instead run one long, non-resetting episode on bandwidth-limited edge hardware, where high-bandwidth memory and flash are scarce, flash has finite write endurance, and memory writes rather than compute can become the binding constraint.
  AURA-Mem (Action-Utility Recurrent Adaptive Memory) targets this regime. It wraps a frozen vision-language-action backbone with a constant-size recurrent memory and a learned gate that writes only when the current observation would change the next action: memory that knows when to stay silent. Unlike reconstruction-based memory, the gate is trained directly against a closed-loop action-error signal. Its inference state is fixed at 4,224 bytes regardless of horizon, while a KV-cache grows to 6,061 times larger at 100,000 steps.
  On a controlled synthetic benchmark, AURA-Mem matches the best O(1) baseline in accuracy while using 5.19-6.13 times fewer writes, and up to 9.19 times fewer writes on easier configurations. Budget-matched random and periodic schedules do not recover this gain, isolating the benefit to the action-surprise signal. On a trained closed-loop OpenVLA-OFT 7B panel on LIBERO-Long (n=60 episodes per arm), the gate does not hurt success: AURA-Mem matches the ungated base policy (0.233) and slightly exceeds an always-write KV arm (0.217), while using 7.0 times fewer writes and constant memory. We also instantiate an approximate-information-state value-loss bound as a methodology demonstration; at this scale, the bound is vacuous rather than a guarantee.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
KV缓存适用于数据中心，却不适用于机器人。数据中心推理通过批量处理大量短请求并重置缓存，将注意力缓存在多个请求间均摊。而具身智能体则需在带宽受限的边缘硬件上执行单个长周期且不复位的任务，此时高带宽内存与闪存稀缺，闪存写入寿命有限，内存写入而非计算可能成为关键约束。  
AURA-Mem（行动-效用递归自适应内存）正是针对这一场景设计。它采用固定大小的递归内存包裹冻结的视觉-语言-动作骨干网络，并通过学习型门控机制实现：仅当当前观测会改变下一步动作时才写入——即具备“静默识别”能力的内存。不同于基于重建的内存，该门控直接通过闭环动作误差信号训练。其推理状态固定为4,224字节，不受时间跨度影响；而KV缓存在10万步时体积增至约6,061倍。  
在受控合成基准测试中，AURA-Mem在达到最佳O(1)基线精度的同时，写入次数减少5.19-6.13倍；在简单配置下最高减少9.19倍。同等预算的随机与周期性调度方案无法复现此优势，从而证实该增益来源于动作意外性信号。在LIBERO-Long平台运行的闭锁闭环OpenVLA-OFT 7B面板测试中（每组60个回合），门控机制未降低成功率：AURA-Mem与无门控基础策略（0.233）表现持平，略优于始终写入的KV策略（0.217），同时写入次数减少7.0倍且内存恒定。作为方法论验证，我们还实例化了近似信息状态的价值损失界限；在该尺度下，此界限虽非严格保证但并非空泛。
tldr: AURA-Mem introduces a constant-size recurrent memory with a learned action-surprise gate for VLA models, drastically reducing memory writes and VRAM usage on embodied agents while maintaining task accuracy.
tldr_zh: AURA-Mem 针对具身智能体提出一种恒定大小的循环记忆和基于动作惊奇的习得门控机制，大幅减少内存写入和显存消耗，同时保持任务精度不变。

title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are promising general-purpose robot policies, but adapting them to new tasks typically requires costly task-specific teleoperation data. As an alternative, we study one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs, where a robot policy is conditioned on a single demonstration video of an unseen task. We find that existing end-to-end approaches often struggle when successful execution requires precisely localizing small target regions. To address this limitation, we propose SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that encourages precise spatial grounding through visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces. To enable reproducible evaluation with cross-embodiment demonstrations, we introduce and release RoboCasa-DC, a demo-conditioned extension of RoboCasa with episode-paired humanoid videos. Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines, achieving the best success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improving real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）是颇具前景的通用机器人策略，但使其适应新任务通常需要昂贵的任务特定遥操作数据。作为替代方案，我们研究一次性演示条件化VLA，即机器人策略基于单个未见任务的演示视频进行条件控制。我们发现，当成功执行需要精确定位小型目标区域时，现有的端到端方法往往难以胜任。为解决这一局限，我们提出SeeTraceAct——一个通过可见性感知的未来末端执行器轨迹预测来增强精确空间定位能力的演示条件化VLA框架。为实现跨实体演示的可重复评估，我们引入并发布了RoboCasa-DC——基于RoboCasa构建的演示条件化扩展数据集，包含与场景片段配对的人形机器人视频。在RoboCasa-DC以及一项真实世界基准测试（以Franka Panda机械臂基于人类演示视频进行条件控制）上的实验表明，SeeTraceAct优于基准方法，在RoboCasa-DC全部四个场景中均取得最佳成功率，并将真实世界平均成功率提升12.5个百分点。
tldr: Proposes SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that improves spatial grounding through visibility-aware future trace prediction, enabling one-shot policy adaptation from cross-embodiment videos.
tldr_zh: 提出 SeeTraceAct，一种通过可见性感知的未来轨迹预测提升空间定位的演示条件 VLA 框架，实现跨本体视频的一次性策略适应。

title: EvoDrive: Pareto Evolution for Safety-Critical Autonomous Driving via Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Generating safety-critical scenarios is essential for validating and improving autonomous driving systems, yet it inherently requires maximizing adversariality to expose failures while preserving realism. Existing methods usually manage this trade-off with handcrafted heuristics, confining generation to known priors and overlooking underexplored patterns. While recent open-ended agentic evolution can push this limit, unconstrained general agents lack strict simulator grounding and tend to collapse the multi-objective tension into single-scalar maximization. Here we present EvoDrive, the first automated, LLM-based agentic evolution framework for multi-objective scenario generation. EvoDrive employs a simulator-grounded actor-critic architecture where a memory-driven actor iteratively proposes improvements to the generators and critics filter out implausible candidates, and a self-evolving world evaluator routes promising proposals to optimize simulation budgets. EvoDrive further maintains a Pareto archive of evaluated candidates to preserve diverse attack-realism trade-offs and guide future evolution via simulation feedback. Benchmark results on MetaDrive and CARLA show that EvoDrive not only significantly expands the Pareto frontier across various generators, but also produces valuable scenarios for policy training.
summary_zh: 生成安全关键场景对于验证和提升自动驾驶系统至关重要，但这本质上要求最大化对抗性以暴露系统缺陷，同时保持场景的真实性。现有方法通常通过人工设计的启发式规则来权衡这一矛盾，导致生成结果局限于已知先验领域，忽视了尚未充分探索的模式。尽管近期开放式的智能体进化方法突破了这一限制，但无约束的通用智能体缺乏严格的仿真器约束，容易将多目标张力退化为单一标量最大化问题。本文提出EvoDrive——首个基于大语言模型的自动化智能体进化框架，用于多目标场景生成。该框架采用仿真器赋能的"行动者-评论家"架构：由记忆驱动的行动者迭代式向生成器提出改进方案，评论家则过滤掉不可行的候选方案；同时，自进化的世界评估器将具有潜力的方案优先分配至仿真预算进行优化。EvoDrive进一步维护已评估候选方案的帕累托存档，以保留多样化的攻击性与真实性权衡关系，并通过仿真反馈指导后续进化。在MetaDrive和CARLA基准测试上的结果表明，EvoDrive不仅显著扩展了多个生成器的帕累托前沿，还为策略训练生成了极具价值的场景。
tldr: EvoDrive proposes an LLM-based agentic evolution framework that generates adversarial yet realistic driving scenarios by maintaining a Pareto archive, outperforming prior methods on MetaDrive and CARLA.
tldr_zh: EvoDrive提出了一种基于LLM的智能体进化框架，通过维护帕累托存档生成既具对抗性又真实的驾驶场景，在MetaDrive和CARLA上优于先前方法。

title: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data
summary: Video world models are a foundational generative technology for embodied AI and the Metaverse, yet existing approaches are inherently limited to a single agent observing from a single perspective. Extending these models to multi-agent settings introduces two critical challenges: data scarcity (coordinated multi-view recordings are prohibitively expensive to collect for general open-domain scenarios) and world state alignment (independently generated video streams cannot ensure that shared physical environments and events evolve consistently across views). To address these challenges, we propose MetaWorld, a novel framework that scales multi-agent video world models to open-domain environments directly from single-view videos. First, we introduce Monocular World-State Unrolling (MWSU) to explicitly decompose monocular footage into the camera operator's ego-motion and the visible subject's spatial trajectory. This camera-trajectory decomposition naturally extracts synchronized multi-agent motion data within a shared 3D space, completely bypassing the need for multi-camera setups. Second, for precise visual control, we develop the Subject-Aware World Generator to enable appearance-driven simulation conditioned on per-agent identity images. Finally, to ensure both views are grounded in the identical physical reality, we propose World-State Alignment, a per-frame inter-branch cross-attention mechanism inserted at every transformer layer of the video DiT. By jointly synchronizing the denoising process, WSA enforces both static geometric consistency and dynamic motion consistency, encouraging that the shared 3D environment and physical events remain well-aligned across both egocentric views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MetaWorld achieves superior cross-view consistency and identity fidelity, establishing a highly scalable, physics-driven paradigm for multi-agent video world modeling.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型是具身智能与元宇宙的基础性生成技术，但现有方法本质上局限于单智能体从单一视角进行观察。将此类模型扩展至多智能体场景面临两大关键挑战：数据稀缺（在通用开放域场景中，协调多视角录制的成本过高，难以大规模采集）以及世界状态对齐（独立生成的视频流无法确保共享物理环境与事件在各视角间的一致性演化）。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MetaWorld——一种创新框架，可从单视角视频直接扩展至开放域环境的多智能体视频世界模型。首先，我们引入单目世界状态展开（MWSU）方法，将单目影像显式分解为相机操作者的自运动与可见主体的空间轨迹。这种相机-轨迹分解可自然地在共享三维空间中提取同步的多智能体运动数据，完全无需多相机系统支持。其次，为实现精准视觉控制，我们开发了主体感知世界生成器，能够基于每个智能体的身份图像实现外观驱动的仿真。最后，为确保所有视角均锚定于相同的物理现实，我们提出世界状态对齐（WSA）机制——在视频扩散变换器的每一层Transformer中嵌入逐帧跨分支交叉注意力。通过联合同步去噪过程，WSA同时强制实现了静态几何一致性与动态运动一致性，促使共享三维环境与物理事件在各第一人称视角间保持高度对齐。大量实验证明，MetaWorld在跨视角一致性与身份保真度方面表现优异，为多智能体视频世界建模构建了高度可扩展、物理驱动的范式。
tldr: MetaWorld proposes a framework to train multi-agent video world models from single-view video data by decomposing monocular footage into ego-motion and subject trajectory, using cross-attention mechanisms to ensure cross-view consistency.
tldr_zh: MetaWorld 提出了一种从单视角视频数据训练多智能体视频世界模型的框架，通过分解单目视频为自我运动与主体轨迹，并利用交叉注意力机制确保跨视角一致性。

title: Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation
summary: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.
summary_zh: 近期世界动作模型通过将广泛的视觉动力学先验与可执行的机器人动作对齐，从而利用视频基础模型。我们从分布角度重新审视这种对齐。现有公式通常将对齐先验缩小为基于观测的未来动作策略分布。相比之下，我们通过在多种条件设置下对交互视频与可执行手部轨迹的联合空间进行建模，保持更广泛的分布。我们提出Donk——一种针对灵巧手的统一视频-动作去噪模型。在语言、初始图像和初始手部状态的引导下，Donk采样未来视频及双手MANO轨迹作为动作策略。在无图像条件下，相同的去噪架构从文本条件分布中采样成对的视频-动作展开，将对齐的视频先验转化为数据引擎。在动作、视频及纯文本生成评估中，Donk在统一的训练方案下提升了灵巧手轨迹精度、保持了强大的视频保真度，并生成了平滑的文本条件动作序列。
tldr: Proposes Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands that jointly models interaction videos and hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes for action policy and data generation.
tldr_zh: 提出了Donk，一个用于灵巧手的统一视频-动作去噪模型，能在多种条件设定下联合建模交互视频和手部轨迹，用于动作策略和数据生成。

title: GeoDrive-Bench: Benchmarking Region-Specific Multimodal Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) for autonomous driving have shown promising performance, but their ability to handle region-specific traffic rules remains underexplored, raising uncertainties about their deployment across diverse global settings. We therefore introduce GeoDrive-Bench, a novel benchmark that enables the systematic investigation of VLMs' geo-culturally grounded driving reasoning. We curated 5,053 human-validated multiple-choice QA pairs across six countries covering diverse driving cultures. Specifically, we emphasize four driving tasks: perception, prediction, planning, and region reasoning. Each question requires models to infer the correct driving behavior from visual evidence and local traffic conventions without explicit country labels. Beyond evaluation, we further design a distillation algorithm that injects region-specific traffic-rule knowledge into the internal representations of VLMs, enabling models to better align visual scene understanding with local driving policies. Experiments on nine state-of-the-art VLMs show substantial performance variations across geo-driving cultures for each task, while our proposed baseline models exhibit improved geo-cultural reasoning across regions. These results suggest that current VLMs still lack robust region-aware driving intelligence and highlight GeoDrive-Bench as a diagnostic and training-oriented testbed for deployable autonomous driving foundation models.
summary_zh: 用于自动驾驶的视觉语言模型已展现出良好性能，但其处理特定区域交通规则的能力仍未被充分探索，这引发了对其在全球多样化环境中部署的不确定性。为此，我们提出GeoDrive-Bench——一个能够系统研究视觉语言模型基于地理文化进行驾驶推理的新型基准测试。我们整理了覆盖六国不同驾驶文化的5,053个经人工验证的多选题问答对，重点聚焦四项驾驶任务：感知、预测、规划与区域推理。每个问题要求模型在不提供国家标签的前提下，依据视觉证据与当地交通惯例推断正确的驾驶行为。除评估功能外，我们还设计了一种蒸馏算法，将特定区域的交通规则知识注入视觉语言模型的内部表征，使模型能更好地将视觉场景理解与本地驾驶政策对齐。在九个最先进的视觉语言模型上的实验表明，每项任务在不同地理驾驶文化间存在显著性能差异，而我们提出的基线模型在跨区域的地理文化推理能力上有所提升。这些结果表明，现有视觉语言模型仍缺乏稳健的区域感知驾驶智能，同时凸显GeoDrive-Bench作为面向可部署自动驾驶基础模型的诊断与训练导向型测试平台的重要价值。
tldr: Introduces GeoDrive-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating region-specific multimodal reasoning in autonomous driving VLMs, and proposes a distillation algorithm to inject local traffic-rule knowledge.
tldr_zh: 提出GeoDrive-Bench基准，用于评估自动驾驶视觉语言模型的地域特定多模态推理能力，并设计一种蒸馏算法将本地交通规则知识注入模型。

title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
summary: Reconstructing interactive, simulation-ready 3D scenes from a single image is a critical bottleneck for robotic manipulation. While recent single-image lifters recover plausible per-object shapes, composing them yields scenes that collapse under physical simulation due to interpenetrating, hovering, or sinking objects. Existing physics-aware methods address this strictly as a post-hoc layout correction, leaving the underlying geometric errors unresolved. To address this, we introduce SimuScene, a compositional 3D reconstruction pipeline that puts physics in the loop of shape and layout estimation. Rather than using physics merely for layout cleanup, we utilize the physics engine as a diagnostic measurement tool during the generative process itself. By diagnostically simulating reconstructed objects under gravity, we convert penetration and support failures into quantitative correction signals that drive gravity-axis stretching and amodal shape resampling. This physics-informed feedback loop mitigates accumulated reconstruction errors and produces a stable, simulation-ready compositional 3D scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on physical stability and geometric alignment benchmarks. We further highlight SimuScene's utility by deploying reconstructed environments in humanoid control and robot-arm manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 从单张图像重建可用于交互式仿真的三维场景，是机器人操作领域的关键瓶颈。现有单图像升维方法虽能恢复合理的单个物体形状，但将这些形状组合后，场景会因物体相互穿透、悬浮或下沉而在物理仿真中坍塌。现有物理感知方法仅将物理约束作为后处理布局修正手段，未能解决基础几何误差。为此，我们提出SimuScene——一种将物理机制融入形状与布局估计的合成三维重建流程。该方法并非仅将物理用于布局清理，而是在生成过程中将物理引擎作为诊断测量工具。通过对重建物体在重力作用下的诊断仿真，我们将穿透与支撑失效转化为量化修正信号，驱动重力轴拉伸与非完整形状重采样。这种物理驱动的反馈循环可减轻累积重建误差，生成稳定且可直接用于仿真的合成三维场景。大量实验表明，该方法在物理稳定性与几何对齐基准上达到最优性能。我们进一步通过将重建环境部署于人形控制与机械臂操作任务，验证了SimuScene的实用性。
tldr: SimuScene introduces a physics-in-the-loop pipeline that corrects interpenetration and support failures during compositional 3D scene reconstruction from a single image, producing simulation-ready scenes validated on humanoid control and robot-arm manipulation.
tldr_zh: SimuScene提出了一种物理在环的流水线，在从单张图像合成3D场景的重建过程中修正穿插和支撑失败，生成可直接用于仿真的场景，并在人形控制和机械臂操作任务上得到验证。

title: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation
summary: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained tansformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习在实现自主机器人完成复杂导航任务方面展现出显著潜力。然而，其实际应用仍高度依赖人工设计的奖励函数与反复手动调优，这一过程耗时且无法保证目标任务的高成功率。本文提出AgenticRL——一种智能体引导的强化学习框架，可增强无人机（UAV）导航任务在奖励函数设计、策略优化及真实环境部署中的自主性。AgenticRL采用多模态生成式预训练Transformer（GPT）智能体，通过解析任务信息与视觉场景观测生成特定任务的奖励函数，利用近端策略优化（PPO）算法训练策略，随后以诊断包评估训练策略并生成反馈，扮演批判者角色。基于该反馈，智能体可识别失败模式并闭环迭代优化奖励函数。在推理阶段，为进一步发挥多模态GPT智能体能力，AgenticRL通过真实场景图像与自然语言任务信息自动识别当前运行场景，并选择相应的预训练策略执行。该框架在多项导航任务中进行了评估，包括穿越门廊、避障、越障着陆、轨迹跟踪及运动行为学习。实验结果表明，闭环优化流程相较于初始奖励函数将策略性能提升了71%。同时，我们验证了该框架的仿真到现实迁移能力，真实环境任务成功率达91%，仿真-现实准确率为94%。
tldr: AgenticRL uses a GPT agent to automatically design and refine reward functions for UAV navigation in a closed-loop self-improving process, achieving significant performance gains and successful sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: AgenticRL 利用 GPT 代理自动设计和优化无人机导航的奖励函数，通过闭环自我改进过程显著提升性能，并成功实现仿真到现实的迁移。

title: Semantic-weighted ICP for LiDAR Odometry: Class-Aware Residual Reweighting for Robust Scan Registration
summary: LiDAR odometry is a fundamental component of autonomous robotic systems, relying on geometric registration between consecutive point clouds to estimate ego-motion. However, traditional geometric approaches often degrade in dynamic or unstructured environments due to unreliable correspondences caused by moving objects, sparse geometric features, vegetation, and semantically ambiguous structures. Existing works have shown that, some of these limitations can be addressed by introducing semantic information from the environment in the registration process. In this work, we build on this, and show that not all elements in the environment are equally relevant for registration. Hence, we propose a semantic class-weighted ICP for LiDAR odometry. Instead of strictly filtering out points belonging to specific semantic classes, the proposed approach weights the residuals of points belonging to semantic categories based on their expected geometric stability. This strategy enables informative but potentially unstable structures, to contribute to the registration process while mitigating the influence of dynamic objects. The experimental evaluation was conducted on the SemanticKITTI and RELLIS-3D datasets, which include urban, highway, rural, and off-road environments. The empirical results show that the proposed Semantic-weighted ICP improves pose estimation, especially in challenging off-road scenarios where conventional rigid features are scarce. Furthermore, the analysis reveals that the effectiveness of this weighting strategy is highly environment-dependent, influenced by the structural and semantic composition of the scene.
summary_zh: 激光雷达里程计是自主机器人系统的基础组成部分，它依赖连续点云之间的几何配准来估计自主运动。然而，传统的几何方法在动态或非结构化环境中常常性能下降，原因是移动物体、稀疏几何特征、植被以及语义模糊的结构会导致不可靠的对应关系。现有研究表明，在配准过程中引入来自环境的语义信息可以解决其中一些局限性。本文在此基础上进一步证明，并非环境中所有元素对配准的贡献程度相同。因此，我们提出了一种用于激光雷达里程计的语义类别加权ICP算法。该方法并非严格过滤掉属于特定语义类别的点，而是根据点所属语义类别的预期几何稳定性对其残差进行加权。这一策略使具有信息价值但可能不稳定的结构能够参与配准过程，同时减轻动态物体的影响。实验评估在SemanticKITTI和RELLIS-3D数据集上进行，涵盖了城市、高速公路、乡村及越野场景。实验结果表明，所提出的语义加权ICP改善了位姿估计，尤其是在传统刚性特征稀缺的具有挑战性的越野场景中。此外，分析表明该加权策略的有效性高度依赖于环境，受场景的结构和语义组成影响。
tldr: This paper introduces Semantic-weighted ICP, a LiDAR odometry method that reweights point residuals according to the semantic class of the point, improving registration robustness in dynamic and unstructured environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出语义加权ICP，根据点的语义类别重新加权残差，提高动态和非结构化环境中激光雷达里程计的鲁棒性。

title: Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory
summary: Robots solving generalist tasks need to be able to ground instructions in their past experience, since humans may refer to notable past events when giving a task (e.g., ``Take me to where the chemical spill happened yesterday''). Since memory limits make storing all past events infeasible, long-term robot memory must be selective, ideally retaining only those episodes with high utility for future tasks. However, future tasks are not typically given a priori for generalist robots. To select generically useful memories, we propose Bayesian surprise as a gating mechanism for memory formation. We present an approach to compute surprise in a semantically rich deployment-agnostic latent space provided by V-JEPA-2. Using our gated episodic memory to augment 4D scene graph-based spatial memory, we show a consistent improvement over state-of-the-art benchmarks in robot question answering, outperforming prior robot memory methods by $\geq12\%$ for temporal, spatial, and binary questions, and surpassing the performance of supervised and non-causal methods with an unsupervised causal method in event segmentation tasks.
summary_zh: 执行通用任务的机器人需要能够将指令与其过往经历相关联，因为人类在下达任务时可能提及显著的历史事件（例如：“带我去昨天发生化学品泄漏的地方”）。由于存储所有过往事件受内存限制而不可行，长期机器人记忆必须具备选择性，理想情况下仅保留对未来任务具有高实用性的片段。然而，通用机器人的未来任务通常并非先验给定。为筛选具有通用价值的记忆，我们提出将贝叶斯惊奇作为记忆形成的门控机制。我们开发了一种方法，在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富且部署无关的潜空间中计算惊奇。通过将这种门控情景记忆与基于4D场景图的增强型空间记忆相结合，我们在机器人问答任务中相比现有最优基准取得持续改进，在时序、空间和二元问题的回答上超越先前机器人记忆方法≥12%，并在事件分割任务中采用无监督因果方法超越监督和非因果方法的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a Bayesian surprise-based gating mechanism for robot episodic memory, using V-JEPA-2 embeddings to selectively store memorable events, improving performance on temporal, spatial, and binary question answering tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯惊讶的机器人情节记忆门控机制，利用V-JEPA-2嵌入选择性地存储难忘事件，在时间、空间和二元问答任务上提升了性能。

title: CADET: A Modular Platform for Evaluating Distributed Cooperative Autonomy in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary:
Deep learning models are increasingly central to autonomous vehicle (AV) pipelines, yet their integration has traditionally followed a monolithic design where perception, planning, and control execute on a single onboard computer. This design overlooks the emerging paradigm of cooperative autonomy, where vehicles interact with roadside units (RSUs), edge servers, and cloud-hosted intelligence through vehicle-to-everything (V2X) connectivity. Cooperative perception and control improve safety and efficiency, but also introduce systems-level challenges: network latency, compute heterogeneity, and multi-tenant contention, all critically affect real-time decision-making. These challenges are further amplified by the increasing reliance on large foundation models, whose scale necessitates cloud deployment.
  We present CADET (Cooperative Autonomy through Distributed Experimentation Toolkit), a modular platform for systematic and reproducible evaluation of distributed cooperative autonomy systems under realistic deployment conditions. CADET decouples the AV stack into composable modules that can be flexibly deployed across vehicles, infrastructure, and edge/cloud tiers. The framework integrates state-of-the-art models, incorporates trace-driven network and workload emulation, and provides synchronized model-, system-, and task-level instrumentation. Through V2V and V2I experiments, we show that distributed deployment choices fundamentally shape safety, with V2V intent packets outperforming cloud-based perception and RSU-assisted perception sustaining safety until overloaded by concurrent requests.
