tldr_zh: 提出SERF，一种时空神经特征图，通过为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供来自自我中心观察和本体感觉的局部与全局上下文，改善了长期移动操作任务的表现。

title: An Embodied Simulation Platform, Benchmark, and Data-Efficient Augmentation Framework for Wet-Lab Robotics
summary: Wet-lab robots can improve the reproducibility, throughput, and safety of biomedical experiments, but scaling their learning requires customizable simulators for safe and reproducible task generation, open editable laboratory assets, and efficient pipelines that turn limited demonstrations into usable training data. We present Pipette, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning. Pipette releases over 43 open-source and re-editable wet-lab assets, together with an extensible asset-building pipeline. A key component of Pipette is its simulation-based data augmentation pipeline, replaying human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations. We further introduce an 11-task wet-lab embodied benchmark covering sample handling, culture-ware manipulation, device operation, and precision placement. With only 30 demonstrations per task, ACT achieves 65.5% average success rate, while simulation augmentation improves SmolVLA from 44.1% to 74.7% and π0 from 40.4% to 46.5%, validating the effectiveness of Pipette for data-efficient VLA training and evaluation. Pipette also supports natural-language-driven scene construction and task registration, lowering the barrier for non-expert users to define new wet-lab robotic tasks.
summary_zh: 湿实验室机器人能够提升生物医学实验的可重复性、通量和安全性，但规模化其学习能力需要可定制的模拟器以支持安全且可重复的任务生成、开放的可编辑实验室资产，以及能将有限示范转化为可用训练数据的高效流水线。我们提出Pipette——一个面向湿实验室机器人学习的具身仿真平台、基准测试与数据高效增强框架。Pipette发布了超过43个开源且可重新编辑的湿实验室资产，并配套可扩展的资产构建流水线。其核心组件是基于仿真的数据增强流水线：在仿真环境中回放人类示范，施加光照、相机视角、速度与动作扰动，并通过自动任务成功检测过滤生成的情节片段，从而从有限的人工示范中快速扩充可用训练数据。我们进一步引入包含11项任务的湿实验室具身基准测试，涵盖样本处理、培养器具操作、设备操控及精密放置。在每项任务仅提供30次示范的条件下，ACT达到65.5%的平均成功率，而仿真增强将SmolVLA从44.1%提升至74.7%，将π0从40.4%提升至46.5%，验证了Pipette在数据高效的VLA训练与评估中的有效性。Pipette还支持自然语言驱动的场景构建与任务注册，降低了非专业用户定义新型湿实验室机器人任务的门槛。
tldr: Pipette provides a wet-lab robotic simulation platform, benchmark, and data augmentation pipeline that significantly boosts VLA policy performance from limited demonstrations.
tldr_zh: Pipette 为湿实验室机器人提供了一个仿真平台、基准测试和数据增强管线，从有限的示范中显著提升了 VLA 策略的性能。

title: Bounding Boxes as Goals: Language-Conditioned Grasping via Neuro-Symbolic Planning
summary: For robotics to be effectively integrated into household or industrial environments, machines must adapt to natural-language prompts in real time. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled zero-shot generalization in robot task and motion planning (TAMP), current state-of-the-art approaches often remain computationally "heavyweight" or require extensive training on thousands of demonstrations. We present GRASP (Grounded Reasoning and Symbolic Planning), a framework designed as a step toward open-vocabulary tabletop manipulation. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline. Unlike methods that rely on fixed color lists or hard-coded coordinates, GRASP enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as "top shelf" and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning. We achieve 73.3% overall success across 90 real-robot trials at three difficulty levels, requiring no task-specific training.
summary_zh: 为使机器人能够有效融入家庭或工业环境，机器必须实时适应自然语言指令。尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）已实现机器人任务与运动规划（TAMP）中的零样本泛化，但当前最先进的方法通常仍存在计算"繁重"的问题，或需要对数千个示范进行大量训练。我们提出GRASP（基础推理与符号规划）框架，旨在向开放词汇的桌面操作迈进一步。该方法利用预训练的VLM将自然语言查询转化为神经符号目标状态，并通过边界框检测管线将其与物理世界建立关联。与依赖固定颜色列表或硬编码坐标的方法不同，GRASP使机器人能够解读"顶层搁板"等抽象空间概念，并无需额外微调即可执行任务。在90次真实机器人试验中（涵盖三个难度等级），该方法实现了73.3%的总体成功率，且无需任何任务特定训练。
tldr: GRASP uses a pretrained VLM and bounding-box detection to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goals for tabletop grasping, achieving 73.3% success on real robots without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: GRASP 利用预训练的视觉语言模型和边界框检测，将自然语言查询转化为神经符号目标以实现桌面抓取，在无需任务特定训练的情况下，真实机器人成功率达到73.3%。

title: AIR-VLA+: Decoupling Movement and Manipulation via Cascaded Dual-Action Decoders with Asymmetric MoE for Aerial Robots
summary: Aerial manipulation systems have long suffered from representation coupling in end-to-end control, as platform-level Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) movement and end-effector-level arm manipulation differ substantially in action scale, dynamics, and control objectives. In this paper, we propose AIR-VLA+, a flow matching action generation architecture specifically designed for aerial manipulation, featuring cascaded dual-action decoders and an asymmetric feature-level Mixture of Experts (MoE). We construct cascaded manipulation and movement decoders, allowing the UAV to unidirectionally observe the manipulator's intent during movement to achieve workflow coordination, while isolating the impact of UAV movement information backpropagation on arm manipulation stability. Addressing the characteristic that UAV movement is highly dependent on high-level semantics and responsible for task state transitions in aerial manipulation, we design an input feature enhancement module for the UAV movement decoder. This module introduces an implicit visual grasp projector to perceive the interaction state between the gripper and the object, and injects compressed global semantic features. Within the UAV movement decoder, we deploy an implicit MoE architecture, enabling different movement experts to spontaneously exhibit capacity inclinations for various task stages during training. Through dense soft blending computation on the feature manifold, the UAV movement is endowed with stronger task-stage adaptability. Experiments on the standardized AIR-VLA benchmark demonstrate that our method comprehensively surpasses all baselines with an overall average score of 48.0. The overall task completion score improves by 80.2\% compared to the single-head $π_{0.5}$ policy, effectively mitigating the heterogeneous coordinated control conflicts of composite robots.
summary_zh: 空中操控系统长期受困于端到端控制中的表征耦合问题，因为平台级无人机（UAV）运动与末端执行器级机械臂操作在动作尺度、动力学特性及控制目标上存在显著差异。本文提出AIR-VLA+，一种专为空中操控设计的流匹配动作生成架构，其核心包含级联式双动作解码器与非对称特征级专家混合模型（MoE）。我们构建了级联的操控与运动解码器，使无人机在运动过程中能够单向观测机械臂意图以实现工作流协同，同时隔离无人机运动信息反向传播对机械臂操控稳定性的影响。针对空中操控中无人机运动高度依赖高层语义且负责任务状态转移的特点，我们为无人机运动解码器设计了输入特征增强模块。该模块引入隐式视觉抓取投影器以感知夹爪与物体的交互状态，并注入压缩后的全局语义特征。在无人机运动解码器内部部署隐式MoE架构，使不同运动专家在训练过程中自发呈现对不同任务阶段的能力倾向。通过在特征流形上的密集软混合计算，无人机运动被赋予更强的任务阶段适应性。在标准AIR-VLA基准上的实验表明，本方法以48.0的总体平均分全面超越所有基线，整体任务完成分数较单头$π_{0.5}$策略提升80.2%，有效缓解了复合机器人的异构协调控制冲突。
tldr: AIR-VLA+ proposes a dual-action decoder architecture with asymmetric Mixture of Experts to decouple UAV movement and arm manipulation control, improving coordinated aerial manipulation task performance.
tldr_zh: AIR-VLA+ 提出了一种双动作解码器架构与非对称混合专家，解耦了无人机移动与机械臂操作控制，提升了空中操纵任务的协调性能。

title: Stubborn: A Streamlined and Unified Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Motion Tracking and Fall Recovery for Humanoids
summary: Recent reinforcement learning approaches have shown great promise in improving humanoid motion tracking performance and achieving fall recovery under disturbances. However, most existing works treat motion tracking and fall recovery as different tasks and require multi-stage training with specialized recovery rewards and/or separate recovery policies. Moreover, existing reinforcement learning-based methods often terminate training episodes immediately after severe tracking failures, limiting recovery-oriented exploration in unstable or fallen states. To address the above issues, we propose Stubborn, a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery. Specifically, Stubborn uses an asymmetric Actor-Critic architecture and consists of three major components. First, a yaw-aligned tracking representation is adopted to reduce sensitivity to global drift and heading disturbances while preserving gravity-related balance information. Second, we introduce a Bernoulli-based probabilistic termination mechanism that enables the policy to encourage exploration of fall-recovery behaviors under varying failure modes. Third, we propose a probabilistic termination and tracking-error-driven strategy that dynamically reshapes the sampling distribution based on tracking performance, increasing the training efficiency for difficult motion segments and unstable states. Extensive comparisons with SOTA methods and ablation studies show that Stubborn achieved competitive performance, and the proposed probabilistic termination mechanism and adaptive sampling strategy contributed to the performance and robustness gains. For real-world demonstrations, please refer to https://aislab-sustech.github.io/Stubborn/.
summary_zh: 近期强化学习方法在提升仿人机器人运动跟踪性能及实现扰动状态下的防跌倒恢复方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有研究大多将运动跟踪与跌倒恢复视为不同任务，需要采用专用恢复奖励及/或独立恢复策略进行多阶段训练。此外，现有基于强化学习的方法常在严重跟踪失败后立即终止训练回合，限制了在不稳定或跌倒状态下的恢复导向探索。为解决上述问题，我们提出Stubborn——一种精简统一的强化学习框架，以实现鲁棒的仿人机器人运动跟踪与跌倒恢复。具体而言，Stubborn采用非对称的Actor-Critic架构，包含三个核心组件：首先，采用偏航对齐的跟踪表示，在保留重力相关平衡信息的同时降低对全局漂移和航向扰动的敏感性；其次，引入基于伯努利分布的概率终止机制，使策略能够鼓励在不同故障模式下探索跌倒恢复行为；第三，提出概率终止与跟踪误差驱动策略，根据跟踪性能动态重塑采样分布，提升困难运动片段和不稳定状态的训练效率。与现有最优方法的对比实验及消融研究表明，Stubborn实现了具有竞争力的性能，所提出的概率终止机制与自适应采样策略有效提升了性能表现与鲁棒性。实际演示请参见：https://aislab-sustech.github.io/Stubborn/。
tldr: Proposes Stubborn, a unified RL framework for robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery using asymmetric Actor-Critic, Bernoulli-based probabilistic termination, and adaptive sampling.
tldr_zh: 提出Stubborn，一个统一的强化学习框架，通过非对称Actor-Critic、基于伯努利分布的概率终止和自适应采样实现鲁棒的人形运动跟踪和摔倒恢复。

title: Sparse2Act: Learning Action-Aligned Sparse 3D Representations for Cross-Domain Robot Manipulation
summary: Explicit 3D representations are attractive for manipulation because they expose object shape, workspace geometry, and robot-object relations in metric coordinates. However, sparse 3D encoders are often learned through downstream task objectives, tying the representation to a particular data distribution, policy architecture, and action parameterization. We introduce Sparse2Act, an observation-action alignment framework for pretraining sparse point-cloud encoders. The key idea is to use task-space end-effector actions as geometric supervision: masked sparse 3D tokens are trained to organize scene features around the workspace motion paired with the observation. After pretraining, only the encoder initialization is reused by downstream policies, allowing them to retain their own architectures and action spaces, including joint-space commands. On the LIBERO-10 benchmark, our method achieves 86.9% average success after 500 fine-tuning steps. The same pretrained encoder supports LIBERO-to-Meta-World cross-domain transfer, achieving 73.4% average success on the Meta-World-5 benchmark. Ablations on the objective and decoder capacity show that the gains come from the masked action-alignment signal and remain useful across downstream action decoders. In real-world experiments, simulation pretraining followed by limited real-data fine-tuning achieves an average success rate of 72.5% across four tasks, demonstrating effective sim-to-real transfer. These results suggest that robot actions can provide compact geometric supervision for reusable sparse 3D representations.
summary_zh: 显式3D表示因其能够以公制坐标呈现物体形状、工作空间几何以及机器人-物体关系而具有操作优势。然而，稀疏3D编码器通常通过下游任务目标进行学习，导致其表示方式受限于特定数据分布、策略架构和动作参数化。我们提出Sparse2Act——一种用于预训练稀疏点云编码器的观测-动作对齐框架。其核心思想是利用任务空间中的末端执行器动作作为几何监督：被掩码的稀疏3D标记通过训练，对与观测配对的作业空间运动相关的场景特征进行组织。预训练后，仅编码器初始化参数被下游策略复用，使其能够保留原有架构和动作空间（包括关节空间指令）。在LIBERO-10基准测试中，经过500步微调后，该方法平均成功率达到86.9%。同一预训练编码器支持LIBERO至Meta-World的跨域迁移，在Meta-World-5基准测试中实现73.4%的平均成功率。针对目标函数与解码器容量的消融实验表明，性能提升源于掩码动作对齐信号，且该信号对多种下游动作解码器均保持有效。在真实世界实验中，仿真预训练配合少量真实数据微调，在四个任务上平均成功率达72.5%，展现出有效的仿真到真实迁移能力。这些结果表明，机器人动作可为可复用的稀疏3D表示提供紧凑的几何监督信号。
tldr: Sparse2Act proposes a pretraining framework that aligns sparse 3D point-cloud representations with robot actions via masked token reconstruction, enabling cross-domain and sim-to-real transfer for manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: Sparse2Act提出一种预训练框架，通过掩码令牌重建将稀疏3D点云表示与机器人动作对齐，支持跨领域和仿真到真实的操控策略迁移。

title: EquiDexFlow: Contact-Grounded SE(3)-Equivariant Dexterous Grasp Generative Flows
summary: Most learned dexterous grasp generators relegate contact forces to a downstream verification step, so a kinematically-plausible pose can still violate the conditions for a stable physical grasp. We address this with EquiDexFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching model that jointly predicts wrist pose, joint angles, fingertip contacts, surface normals, and contact forces from an object point cloud. Our architecture projects contacts onto the object surface and forces into the Coulomb friction cone by construction, so placement and friction compliance hold without loss penalties. We prove end-to-end SE(3) equivariance and verify it empirically over 200 rotations, with wrist residuals below $0.04^\circ$ and exactly zero joint deviation. Trained on 8,100 force-closure grasps across 81 objects for the 16-DoF Allegro Hand, our model achieves zero friction violations, the best composite score, and the lowest wrench residual among all ablation variants. We retarget decoded fingertip contacts to a 16-DoF LEAP Hand via per-finger inverse kinematics, and our hardware-feasible refinement places every joint at least 5% inside its actuator envelope while preserving wrench balance. On the physical robot, retargeted EquiDexFlow-decoded grasps complete open-loop pick-and-hold trials on all six test objects, with every asymmetric object succeeding at both the canonical pose and a $120^\circ$ co-rotation. Videos, code, and checkpoints are available at https://equidexflow.github.io.
summary_zh: 大多数基于学习的灵巧抓取生成器将接触力交由下游验证步骤处理，因此运动学上合理的位姿仍可能违反稳定物理抓取的条件。我们提出EquiDexFlow来解决这一问题，这是一个SE(3)等变流匹配模型，能够从物体点云中联合预测手腕位姿、关节角度、指尖接触点、表面法向量及接触力。我们的架构通过构造方式将接触点投影至物体表面，并将力约束至库仑摩擦锥内，从而在不引入损失惩罚项的情况下保证接触位置与摩擦合规性。我们证明了模型的端到端SE(3)等变性，并在200次旋转中进行了经验验证，手腕残差低于$0.04^\circ$且关节偏差严格为零。在针对16自由度Allegro Hand的81个物体共8100个力闭合抓取数据上训练后，我们的模型在所有消融变体中实现了零摩擦违规、最佳综合评分及最低力旋量残差。通过逐指逆运动学将解码后的指尖接触点重定位至16自由度LEAP Hand，我们的硬件可行性优化在保持力旋量平衡的同时，使每个关节至少处于其执行器包络范围的5%以内。在实体机器人上，重定位后的EquiDexFlow解码抓取在所有六个测试物体上完成了开环抓取保持实验，每个非对称物体在标准位姿及$120^\circ$共旋转位姿下均成功执行。视频、代码及检查点详见https://equidexflow.github.io。
tldr: EquiDexFlow is an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching model that jointly predicts wrist pose, joint angles, fingertip contacts, surface normals, and contact forces from an object point cloud, achieving zero friction violations and stable physical grasps on real robots.
tldr_zh: EquiDexFlow是一个SE(3)等变流匹配模型，能够从物体点云中联合预测手腕姿态、关节角度、指尖接触、表面法线和接触力，在真实机器人上实现零摩擦违规和稳定的物理抓取。

title: EgoEngine: From Egocentric Human Videos to High-Fidelity Dexterous Robot Demonstrations
summary: Dexterous manipulation is limited by the cost of collecting large-scale robot demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors, but directly using them for robot learning requires bridging two gaps: the visual gap between human and robot observations, and the action gap between human motion and robot-executable action. We propose EgoEngine, a scalable framework for transforming egocentric human manipulation videos into high-fidelity robot data. Given an egocentric RGB video, EgoEngine produces: (i) a high-fidelity robot observation video replacing human with robot while preserving scene context and temporal alignment, and (ii) a task-aligned, executable robot action trajectory under feasibility constraints. Experiments in simulation and on real robots show that EgoEngine enables scalable conversion of human videos into robot data and, to our knowledge, demonstrates the first zero-shot visuomotor dexterous policy learning from egocentric human videos without real-robot demonstrations. Project website: https://egoengine.github.io.
summary_zh: 灵巧操作受限于大规模机器人演示数据的采集成本。以自我为中心的人类视频提供了多样化操作行为的可扩展来源，但直接将其用于机器人学习需要弥合两个差距：人类与机器人观测之间的视觉差异，以及人类运动与机器人可执行动作之间的行为差距。我们提出EgoEngine，这是一个可扩展的框架，用于将自我为中心的人类操作视频转化为高保真机器人数据。给定一段自我为中心的RGB视频，EgoEngine可生成：(i) 高保真机器人观测视频，在保留场景上下文和时间对齐的同时用机器人替代人类，以及(ii) 在可行性约束下任务对齐且可执行的机器人动作轨迹。仿真实验和真实机器人实验表明，EgoEngine能够将人类视频可扩展地转化为机器人数据，并且据我们所知，首次实现了从自我为中心的人类视频中进行零样本视觉运动灵巧策略学习，而无需真实机器人演示。项目网站：https://egoengine.github.io。
tldr: EgoEngine converts egocentric human manipulation videos into high-fidelity robot demonstrations, enabling zero-shot visuomotor dexterous policy learning from human video without real-robot data.
tldr_zh: EgoEngine将第一人称人类操作视频转化为高保真机器人演示，首次实现从人类视频零样本学习视觉运动灵巧策略，无需真实机器人数据。

title: G-MAPP: GPU-accelerated Multi-Agent Planning and Perception for Reactive Motion Generation
summary: Reactive motion generation in unstructured environments remains an open challenge in robotics. Due to the computational complexity of collision-free motion generation, existing methods either generate global trajectories for static scenarios, or employ models that make conservative assumptions about the environment. This paper identifies the primary bottleneck as the runtime performance demand of planning on high-fidelity environments, and the temporal integration between the perception and planning modules. Therefore, we propose a framework that does not compromise on runtime performance and world representations for perception and planning by accelerating world modeling and vector-field based planning using the GPU. This allows us to achieve faster parallel state exploration for quasi-global trajectory planning, and tighter coupling of the perception-action loop in real-time for dynamic cluttered environments with off-the-shelf depth sensors. We quantitatively evaluate the computation-time and success rate differences for the CPU and GPU versions of our planner, and perform qualitative evaluations of our coupled framework using real-world experiments on a 7-DoF Franka Emika robot. Experimental results demonstrate that our GPU-based framework achieves up to a 5x speedup over the CPU version and successfully avoids collisions across both trivial and challenging physical world scenarios.
summary_zh: 非结构化环境下的反应式运动生成仍是机器人学中的一个开放挑战。由于无碰撞运动生成的计算复杂性，现有方法要么为静态场景生成全局轨迹，要么采用对环境做出保守假设的模型。本文指出，主要瓶颈在于高保真环境下的规划运行时性能需求，以及感知与规划模块之间的时间集成。为此，我们提出一个框架，通过利用GPU加速世界建模和基于向量场的规划，在不牺牲运行时性能及感知与规划所依赖的世界表征的前提下，实现准全局轨迹规划的更快并行状态探索，并与现成深度传感器配合，在动态杂乱环境中实现感知-动作闭环的实时紧耦合。我们定量评估了规划器CPU版本与GPU版本的计算时间及成功率差异，并在7自由度Franka Emika机器人上通过真实世界实验对所提出的耦合框架进行定性评估。实验结果表明，基于GPU的框架相比CPU版本实现了最高5倍的加速，并在简单及具有挑战性的物理世界场景中均成功避免了碰撞。
tldr: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated framework for reactive motion generation in robotics, achieving faster parallel state exploration and tighter perception-action coupling for collision-free trajectory planning in dynamic, cluttered environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于GPU加速的机器人反应式运动生成框架，通过并行状态探索和感知-动作紧密耦合，在动态杂乱环境中实现更快的碰撞避免轨迹规划。

title: Agentic MPC for Semantic Control System Resynthesis
summary: While MPC effectively handles structured, diverse, and low-level specifications, it lacks the capability to dynamically incorporate high-level contextual information such as social norms, user intent, or natural language instructions. To address this limitation, this manuscript introduces an agentic MPC framework that enables context-aware, semantically adaptive control synthesis by integrating with large language model-based agents. The agent interprets heterogeneous inputs, including natural language messages, environmental observations, and external knowledge, to resynthesize the control specifications. The effectiveness of the framework is demonstrated in an autonomous driving scenario, where the system aligns with personal preferences or responds to social situations such as emergency vehicle yielding.
summary_zh: 虽然模型预测控制（MPC）能够有效处理结构化、多样化且低层级的技术规范，但其缺乏动态融入高层级情境信息的能力，例如社会规范、用户意图或自然语言指令。为弥补这一局限，本文提出了一种基于智能体的MPC框架，通过与基于大语言模型的智能体集成，实现了具备情境感知与语义自适应能力的控制综合。该智能体能够解析包括自然语言信息、环境观测数据及外部知识在内的异构输入，从而重新生成控制规范。该框架的有效性在自动驾驶场景中得到验证，系统可依据个人偏好进行调整，或对紧急车辆避让等社会情境作出响应。
tldr: This paper introduces an agentic MPC framework that integrates LLM-based agents to dynamically resynthesize control specifications from heterogeneous inputs, demonstrated in autonomous driving scenarios for context-aware semantic control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种智能体MPC框架，通过集成基于大语言模型的智能体，从异构输入动态重综合控制规范，并在自动驾驶场景中展示其上下文感知的语义控制能力。

title: PersonaDrive: Human-Style Retrieval-Augmented VLA Agents for Closed-Loop Driving Simulation
summary: Closed-loop driving simulators typically populate their environments with non-ego traffic agents that behave largely the same way, produced either by rule-based traffic managers or by learned models trained toward a single behavioral mode. Recent work introduces style variation through post-hoc labels on observational data or LLM-inferred reward weights, but these signals act as proxies for what a style should reward rather than demonstrations of humans explicitly asked to drive in that style. We introduce PersonaDrive, a pipeline that conditions a vision-language-action (VLA) driving agent on retrieved demonstrations from a style-instructed human driving dataset, in which participants drive CARLA leaderboard routes under aggressive, neutral, and conservative instructions on a driver-in-the-loop rig. The pipeline has three stages: (i) offline triplet mining over per-style human driving data using a combined image-text similarity score; (ii) training a lightweight retrieval head that fuses frozen visual features with a small control encoder over per-style databases; and (iii) fine-tuning a single VLA backbone to treat retrieved context points as in-context behavioral demonstrations during waypoint prediction. At inference, the same backbone is conditioned on any style by swapping which per-style database the retrieval head queries, so selecting a style requires no per-style retraining while enabling human-style, style-diverse non-ego agents for closed-loop simulation. On Bench2Drive, PersonaDrive (no style) improves the driving score by 4.6% over SimLingo and 2.5% over HiP-AD, and under style conditioning attains the highest driving score in every style within a roughly 2% band (its weakest style surpassing the strongest baseline, DMW, by 5.4%), while average speed and acceleration rise by 18% and 25% from the conservative to the aggressive instruction.
summary_zh: 闭环驾驶模拟器通常会在其环境中填充行为高度一致的非自车交通代理，这些代理要么由基于规则的交通管理器生成，要么由针对单一行为模式训练的学习模型产生。近期研究通过基于观测数据的后验标签或大语言模型推断的奖励权重引入了风格变化，但这些信号仅作为风格应奖励内容的代理指标，而非人类被明确要求以该风格驾驶的真实示范。我们提出PersonaDrive框架，该框架使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶智能体能够根据从风格指导的人类驾驶数据集中检索到的示范进行条件化——在该数据集中，参与者在驾驶员在环平台上，按照激进、中立和保守指令驾驶CARLA排行榜路线。该框架包含三个阶段：（i）使用图像-文本联合相似度评分，对每种风格的人类驾驶数据进行离线三元组挖掘；（ii）训练轻量级检索头，该检索头将冻结的视觉特征与小型控制编码器融合，并基于每种风格的数据库运行；（iii）微调单个VLA主干网络，使其在航点预测过程中将检索到的上下文点视为上下文化的行为示范。在推理时，通过切换检索头查询的特定风格数据库，同一主干网络可基于任意风格进行条件化——因此选择风格无需针对每种风格重新训练，同时能够为闭环模拟提供具有人类风格且风格多样的非自车代理。在Bench2Drive上，PersonaDrive（无风格设置）的驾驶评分相比SimLingo提升4.6%，相比HiP-AD提升2.5%；而在风格条件化下，其每种风格的驾驶评分均达到最高，且波动幅度约在2%以内（其最弱风格仍超越最强基线DMW达5.4%），同时从保守指令到激进指令，平均速度和加速度分别提升18%和25%。
tldr: PersonaDrive presents a retrieval-augmented VLA pipeline for closed-loop driving simulation that conditions a single backbone on human driving styles (aggressive, neutral, conservative) by swapping per-style demonstration databases, improving driving score over baselines on Bench2Drive.
tldr_zh: PersonaDrive 提出了一种检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）流水线用于闭环驾驶仿真，通过切换每种驾驶风格的演示数据库，使单一骨干网络能够遵循人类驾驶风格（激进、中性、保守），在 Bench2Drive 上相比基线提升了驾驶得分。

title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
summary: This work presents RepWAM, a representation-centric world action model (WAM) built on representation visual-action tokenizers. Existing WAMs typically inherit reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers from pretrained video generation models. Although these tokenizers preserve visual fidelity, pixel reconstruction alone provides limited guidance for learning instruction-following dynamics that connect future prediction with robot control. To address this, we explore a semantic visual-action latent space for representation-centric world action modeling. Specifically, we train a representation visual-action tokenizer that maps visual inputs into aligned visual and latent action tokens. We then pretrain our WAM to jointly model future visual states and the latent actions that connect them under language instructions, followed by adaptation to real robot trajectories for closed-loop manipulation. Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks show that RepWAM delivers strong performance across diverse manipulation settings, while ablations highlight the value of semantic visual-action tokenization over reconstruction-oriented alternatives. These results establish representation visual-action tokenization as a promising foundation for world action models and a step toward generalist robot policies. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/wdrink/RepWAM.
summary_zh: 本文提出RepWAM，一种基于表征性视觉-动作分词器的表征中心世界动作模型。现有的世界动作模型通常继承自预训练视频生成模型中面向重建的视频分词器。尽管这些分词器能保持视觉保真度，但仅靠像素重建为学习连接未来预测与机器人控制的指令跟随动态所提供的指导有限。为解决此问题，我们探索了一种用于表征中心世界动作建模的语义视觉-动作潜在空间。具体而言，我们训练了一个表征性视觉-动作分词器，将视觉输入映射为对齐的视觉令牌与潜在动作令牌；随后预训练世界动作模型，使其在语言指令下联合建模未来视觉状态及连接这些状态的潜在动作，并进一步适配真实机器人轨迹以实现闭环操控。在真实世界操控任务与仿真基准上的实验表明，RepWAM在多种操控场景中均展现出强劲性能，而消融实验则凸显了语义视觉-动作分词相较于面向重建替代方案的优势。这些结果确立了表征性视觉-动作分词作为世界动作模型有前景的基础，并向通用机器人策略迈进一步。代码与权重将发布于https://github.com/wdrink/RepWAM。
tldr: RepWAM introduces representation visual-action tokenizers for world action modeling, enabling semantic latent space joint modeling of future visual states and actions for closed-loop manipulation, outperforming reconstruction-based alternatives.
tldr_zh: RepWAM提出基于表征性视觉-动作分词器的世界动作模型，通过语义潜在空间联合建模未来视觉状态与动作，在真实机器人操作任务中优于传统重建方法。

title: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold
summary: We present MoVerse, a real-time video world model that creates an interactively navigable scene from a single narrow-field-of-view image. This setting is challenging because the input observes only a small fraction of the environment, while interactive roaming requires a complete surrounding world, persistent geometry, controllable camera motion, and temporally coherent high-fidelity observations. MoVerse addresses this problem by separating world construction from observation rendering. It first expands the input into a gravity-aligned 360$^\circ$ panorama with topology-aware diffusion, closing the missing field of view before 3D reasoning. It then lifts the panorama into a persistent 3D Gaussian scaffold using panoramic geometry-aware residual prediction, yielding a dense and directly renderable spatial memory. Finally, a Gaussian-conditioned video renderer translates scaffold renderings along user-specified camera trajectories into photorealistic video. To make this renderer practical for interaction, we train a bidirectional diffusion teacher for high-quality conditional rendering and distill it into a causal autoregressive student for bounded-latency streaming. This design combines the controllability and long-range consistency of explicit 3D representations with the perceptual quality of generative video models. MoVerse supports real-time scene roaming at 8~FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX~4090 GPU, demonstrating a practical path toward single-image world creation with interactive video output.
summary_zh: 我们提出了MoVerse——一种实时视频世界模型，能够从单张窄视野图像创建可交互漫游的场景。该设定极具挑战性，因为输入仅观测到环境的极小部分，而交互式漫游需要完整的周边世界、持久的三维几何结构、可控的相机运动以及时间连贯的高保真观测。MoVerse 通过将世界构建与观测渲染相分离来解决这一问题。它首先利用拓扑感知扩散技术将输入扩展为重力对齐的360°全景图，在三维推理前填补缺失的视场。随后，通过全景几何感知残差预测，将全景图提升为持久的3D高斯支架，形成密集且可直接渲染的空间记忆。最后，一个高斯条件视频渲染器将用户指定相机轨迹上的支架渲染结果转换为逼真的视频。为使该渲染器适用于交互场景，我们训练了一个双向扩散教师模型以实现高质量条件渲染，并将其蒸馏为因果自回归学生模型，以实现有界延迟的流式输出。这一设计将显式3D表示的可控性与长程一致性，与生成式视频模型的感知质量相结合。MoVerse 在单块NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上支持8 FPS的实时场景漫游，展示了面向单图像世界创建与交互式视频输出的实用路径。
tldr: MoVerse is a real-time video world model that constructs an interactively navigable 360-degree scene from a single image by separating world building (panoramic Gaussian scaffold) from rendering (distilled autoregressive video renderer), enabling 8 FPS roaming.
tldr_zh: MoVerse是一种实时视频世界模型，可从单张图像构建可交互漫游的360度场景，通过分离世界构建（全景高斯支架）与渲染（蒸馏自回归视频渲染器），实现8 FPS的实时漫游。

title: VLADriveBench: Evaluating CoT-Action Relationship in VLA for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning alongside driving trajectories, but existing benchmarks evaluate only trajectory quality and do not assess whether the CoT is relevant, consistent, or causally connected to the driving action. We introduce VLADriveBench, a framework that combines observational metrics (mentioning, hallucination, contradiction, action alignment) with a CoT intervention protocol to provide complementary views of the CoT-action relationship. Applying VLADriveBench to three models across two architectures, we find that the two analyses can diverge sharply: ORION scores highest on observational alignment yet its CoT is epiphenomenal, while Alpamayo v1.5 scores lower yet its CoT is strongly causal, with visual salience gating the extent of CoT influence.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在生成驾驶轨迹的同时会输出思维链（CoT）推理过程，但现有基准仅评估轨迹质量，并未检验CoT是否与驾驶动作相关、一致或具有因果联系。我们提出VLADriveBench框架，该框架将观测性指标（提及率、幻觉率、矛盾率、动作对齐度）与CoT干预协议相结合，为CoT-动作关系提供互补性视角。将VLADriveBench应用于两种架构下的三个模型后，我们发现两类分析结果可能呈现显著差异：ORION模型在观测对齐度上得分最高，但其CoT属于附带现象；而Alpamayo v1.5模型虽然得分较低，其CoT却具有强因果性，且视觉显著性会调控CoT的影响程度。
tldr: VLADriveBench is a benchmark for evaluating the relevance and causal connection between chain-of-thought reasoning and driving actions in VLA models for autonomous driving, revealing that high observational alignment can coexist with epiphenomenal CoT.
tldr_zh: VLADriveBench 是一个用于评估自动驾驶中 VLA 模型链式思维推理与驾驶动作之间相关性和因果联系的基准，发现高观测对齐可能与认知过程的附带现象共存。

title: MCR-Bionic Hand: Anatomical Structural Priors for Dexterous Manipulation
summary:
Dexterous robotic hands are usually formulated as high dimensional active control systems governed by degrees of freedom, actuation, and algorithms. Human hand dexterity, however, is partly encoded in the physical architecture of bones, ligaments, tendons, aponeuroses, and intrinsic muscles. This work describes that contribution as two linked forms of structural intelligence: structural prior generation, in which wrist to finger tenodesis, FDS/FDP routing, and the dorsal extensor hood transform low dimensional posture inputs into default grasp configurations and PIP to DIP coordination; and muscle mediated modulation, in which extrinsic muscles, lumbricals, and interossei regulate MCP posture, distal stability, fingertip force paths, and contact states around that default state.
  Based on this framework, MCR-Bionic Hand is developed as a 1:1 musculoskeletal biomimetic hand integrating a two row eight bone wrist, cross wrist tendons, anatomical flexor routing, volar plate and collateral ligament constraints, the dorsal extensor hood, and intrinsic muscle pathways within one body. Functional demonstrations and geometric mechanical models show that wrist posture induces multi joint pre shaping, the extensor hood maps PIP posture to a coupled DIP response, and intrinsic plus pathways modulate distal stability and fingertip action direction after grasp formation. Contact rich tasks, including coin rotation, pen transfer, dorsal coin flipping, and cube manipulation, show that MCR-Bionic links low dimensional state generation with fine post contact modulation. These results suggest that anatomical biomimetics is valuable not for visual similarity, but for identifying human hand structures that perform part of control.
summary_zh:
灵巧机器人手通常被表述为由自由度、驱动系统及算法控制的高维主动控制系统。然而，人类手的灵巧性部分编码于骨骼、韧带、肌腱、腱膜及内在肌的物理结构中。本研究将这种贡献描述为两种相互关联的结构智能形式：结构先验生成——其中腕指固定术、FDS/FDP走行路径及背侧伸肌腱帽将低维姿态输入转化为默认抓取构型及PIP-DIP协调；以及肌肉介导调节——即外在肌、蚓状肌与骨间肌围绕该默认状态调控MCP姿态、远端稳定性、指尖力路径及接触状态。

基于此框架，MCR-Bionic仿生手被开发为1:1肌肉骨骼仿生手，将双列八骨腕部结构、跨腕肌腱、解剖屈肌腱走行路径、掌板与侧副韧带约束、背侧伸肌腱帽及内在肌通路集成于同一本体。功能演示与几何力学模型表明：腕姿诱导多关节预成形；伸肌腱帽将PIP姿态映射为耦合的DIP响应；抓握形成后，内在肌正位通路调节远端稳定性与指尖动作方向。硬币旋转、笔传递、硬币背翻及方块操控等密集接触任务显示，MCR-Bionic实现了低维状态生成与接触后精细调节的联结。这些结果表明，解剖仿生学的价值不在于视觉相似性，而在于识别执行部分控制功能的人类手部结构。
tldr: This paper introduces the MCR-Bionic Hand, a biomimetic robotic hand that incorporates anatomical structural priors (e.g., tenodesis, tendon routing, extensor hood mechanics) to reduce control complexity for dexterous manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍MCR-Bionic Hand，一种仿生机器人手，通过整合解剖学结构先验（如肌腱固定、肌腱路径、伸肌罩机制）来降低灵巧操作的控制复杂度。

title: Proprioceptive-visual correspondence enables self-other distinction in humanoid robots
summary: Distinguishing self from others is a prerequisite for social intelligence, yet humanoid robots that increasingly share workspaces with humans still lack this ability. Here we show that a humanoid robot can learn self-other distinction from proprioceptive-visual correspondence, without any identity labels or kinematic models. Once established, this distinction bootstraps a predictive self-model that maps joint configurations to three-dimensional body occupancy, capturing how the robot's body changes with action. In multi-agent scenes involving humans or morphologically identical robots, the system reliably identifies itself, learns a 3D self-model, and supports downstream tasks including target reaching, collision-aware motion planning, and human-to-robot motion retargeting. Together, these results outline a route toward bodily self-representation in robots that act and coordinate alongside others in shared physical environments. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/humanoid-self-model/.
summary_zh: 区分自我与他人是社会智能的前提，然而与人类共享工作空间的仿人机器人却仍缺乏这一能力。本研究表明，仿人机器人无需任何身份标签或运动学模型，仅通过本体感觉-视觉对应关系即可学习自我-他人区分。一旦建立区分能力，该机制将引导出一个预测性自我模型，该模型将关节构型映射至三维身体占据空间，捕捉机器人身体随动作变化的方式。在涉及人类或形态相同机器人的多智能体场景中，该系统能可靠识别自身，学习三维自我模型，并支持下游任务，包括目标抓取、碰撞感知运动规划以及人机运动重定向。这些研究结果共同勾勒出一条路径，使机器人在共享物理空间中与他人协同行动时具备身体自我表征能力。项目页面：https://euron-zc.github.io/humanoid-self-model/。
tldr: This paper shows that a humanoid robot can learn to distinguish itself from others by leveraging the correspondence between proprioception and visual input, without requiring identity labels or kinematic models. This self-other distinction then enables learning a predictive 3D self-model that supports downstream tasks like target reaching, collision-aware motion planning, and human-to-robot motion retargeting.
tldr_zh: 本文展示了人形机器人可以通过利用本体感觉与视觉输入的对应关系，无需身份标签或运动学模型，学习区分自身与他人。这种自我-他人区分进而能够学习一个预测性的3D自我模型，支持后续任务如目标到达、碰撞感知运动规划和人类到机器人的动作重定向。

title: Embedding ISO 10218 Safety Compliance in Robots via Control Barrier Functions for Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) requires strict adherence to safety standards, such as ISO 10218, to prevent harmful interactions. Standard Speed and Separation Monitoring (SSM) filters calculate safe robotic speeds based on conservative assumptions, such as constant human velocity, which prevents accurate predictions of minimum separation distances and causes unnecessary operational halts. This paper proposes a Control Barrier Function (CBF) that explicitly incorporates human acceleration data to analytically forward-predict the minimum human-robot separation distance during a worst-case robotic stopping trajectory. To guarantee safety at the control level, this predictive CBF is integrated as an inequality constraint within a Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) framework. Specifically, two methods are proposed: Method I, a CBF-constrained PD safety filter; and Method II, a task-scaling SQP controller that enforces a spatial tube constraint. Simulated and real-world experiments on a UR10e robot evaluate the two proposed methods against a standard industrial SSM module baseline. Results demonstrate that Method II dynamically modulates execution speed and confines spatial deviations. Compared to Method I, Method II achieves a 63\% reduction in mean trajectory error and avoids excessive evasive manoeuvres, ensuring high task throughput while complying with ISO 10218 SSM guidelines.
summary_zh: 人机协作（HRC）要求严格遵守安全标准（如ISO 10218），以防止有害交互。基于恒定人体速度等保守假设的标准速度与分离监测（SSM）滤波器计算出的安全机器人速度，无法准确预测最小分离距离，并导致不必要的操作中断。本文提出一种显式包含人体加速度数据的控制障碍函数（CBF），以解析方式前向预测最坏情况下机器人制动轨迹中的人机最小分离距离。为在控制层面保障安全，该预测性CBF作为不等式约束被集成到序列二次规划（SQP）框架中。具体提出两种方法：方法一为CBF约束的PD安全滤波器；方法二为执行空间管状约束的任务缩放SQP控制器。基于UR10e机器人的仿真与真实实验，以标准工业SSM模块为基线对两种方法进行评估。结果表明，方法二能动态调节执行速度并限制空间偏差。相比方法一，方法二的平均轨迹误差降低63%，并避免了过度规避操作，在符合ISO 10218 SSM指引的同时确保了高任务吞吐量。
tldr: This paper integrates Control Barrier Functions with human acceleration data to predict minimum separation distances, ensuring ISO 10218 safety compliance in human-robot collaboration while reducing unnecessary halts and improving task efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将控制屏障函数与人类加速度数据结合，预测最小安全距离，在确保ISO 10218人机协作安全合规的同时减少不必要的停机并提高任务效率。

title: Redesigning Regularization for Effective Policy Smoothing
summary: This paper proposes a novel regularization design to effectively smooth policy functions in reinforcement learning. While regularization that enhances ``global'' Lipschitz continuity was initially considered, it has been limited to ``local'' Lipschitz continuity due to a tradeoff between smoothness and expressiveness. However, it has become apparent that the original implementation is cumbersome and does not provide sufficient smoothing, leading to a preference for simpler implementations. This stems from a discrepancy between theory and implementation, and a more appropriate implementation can expect to facilitate smoothing. Therefore, this paper identifies three reasons why the original implementation does not function adequately and provide remedies for them. This modified regularization performs well across multiple tasks and algorithms, successfully achieving smooth motion while improving control performance. Furthermore, by applying it to sim-to-real reinforcement learning for a quadruped robot, it is demonstrated that smooth motion provides robustness against sudden changes in target velocity commands.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种新颖的正则化设计，以有效平滑强化学习中的策略函数。尽管最初考虑增强“全局”Lipschitz连续性的正则化方法，但由于平滑性与表达能力之间的权衡，其实际效果局限于“局部”Lipschitz连续性。然而，已有研究表明原始实现方式繁琐且无法提供充分平滑，导致研究者更倾向于采用更简洁的实现方案。这一现象源于理论与实现之间的偏差，而更恰当的实现方式有望改善平滑效果。因此，本文识别了原始实现无法有效运作的三方面原因，并针对性地提出修正方案。经改进的正则化方法在多种任务和算法中表现优异，成功在提升控制性能的同时实现平滑运动。此外，通过将该方法应用于四足机器人的仿真到现实强化学习，验证了平滑运动能够增强对目标速度指令突变的鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper redesigns regularization for policy smoothing in reinforcement learning, addressing the gap between theory and implementation to achieve smoother motion and improved control, with validation on a quadruped robot in sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文重新设计了强化学习中用于策略平滑的正则化方法，解决了理论与实现之间的差距，实现了更平滑的运动和更好的控制性能，并在四足机器人的仿真到现实迁移中进行了验证。

title: FTP-1: A Generalist Foundation Tactile Policy Across Tactile Sensors for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Despite the success of vision-based generalist robotic policies, existing tactile-based policies remain tied to fixed embodiments and sensor setups. This is because tactile signals are highly heterogeneous across hardware, making cross-sensor generalization difficult. We present FTP-1,the first generalist foundation tactile policy pretrained to acquire transferable tactile manipulation abilities across diverse sensors and embodiments. FTP-1 supports varied tactile inputs, including image-, array-, and state-based signals, by using heterogeneous encoders to project them into unified morphology-aware latent tokens that are jointly modeled by a shared tactile Transformer expert. Pretrained on around 3,000 hours of tactile manipulation data aggregated from 26 data sources, spanning human and robot demonstrations across 21 sensors, FTP-1 learns tactile skills that transfer beyond the sensors seen during pretraining. Across downstream finetuning experiments spanning 5 hardware configurations, FTP-1 improves contact-rich manipulation on seen sensor setups by +17.2% and, surprisingly, transfers to two previously unseen tactile-sensor setups, achieving a +31% gain in success rate. FTP-1 establishes the first unified foundation baseline for tactile manipulation, providing future tactile policies with a shared model-level starting point. Pretrained models, datasets, training code and more visualization at https://ftp1-policy.github.io.
summary_zh: 尽管基于视觉的通用型机器人策略已取得显著成功，现有的触觉策略仍受限于固定硬件载体与传感器配置。这是由于触觉信号在不同硬件间存在高度异质性，导致跨传感器泛化困难。我们提出FTP-1——首个通用基础触觉策略，通过预训练获得可迁移至多种传感器与载体结构的触觉操作能力。FTP-1采用异构编码器将图像型、阵列型及状态型等多样化触觉输入投影为统一的形态感知隐层表征，并通过共享触觉Transformer专家模块进行联合建模。该模型基于从26个数据源聚合的约3000小时触觉操作数据（涵盖21种传感器的人类与机器人示教）进行预训练，习得了可迁移至预训练阶段未见传感器的触觉技能。在横跨5种硬件配置的下游微调实验中，FTP-1在已知传感器配置上将接触密集操作成功率提升17.2%，更令人惊喜的是，在两种未见过的触觉传感器配置上实现了31%的成功率增益。FTP-1为触觉操作建立了首个统一的基础模型基线，为未来触觉策略提供了共享的模型级初始起点。预训练模型、数据集、训练代码及更多可视化内容详见 https://ftp1-policy.github.io。
tldr: FTP-1 is a foundation tactile policy pretrained on diverse tactile sensor data, enabling cross-sensor and cross-embodiment generalization for contact-rich manipulation.
tldr_zh: FTP-1 是一种预训练的触觉基础策略，能在不同触觉传感器和机器人形态间泛化，用于接触丰富的操作任务。

title: Scale Buys Interpolation, Structure Buys a Horizon: Certified Predictability for Equivariant World Models
summary:
Scale buys interpolation; structure buys a certified horizon. A world model's average error says nothing about whether a particular prediction can be trusted, or for how long. For equivariant latent world models we give a computable, multi-step certificate of the predictable horizon: $T$-step rollout error is provably constant over each symmetry orbit (Theorem A) and stratified channel-by-channel by the predictor's Lyapunov spectrum, $T_j(ε)\sim\log(1/ε)/λ_j$. The horizon is two-sided -- a matching lower bound makes approximate equivariance provably horizon-limited -- and the certificate is exclusive to structure: orbit-constant error characterizes equivariance, so no non-equivariant model has it at any scale. Empirically, on 40-D Lorenz-96 only a $\mathbb{Z}_N$-equivariant network recovers the full Lyapunov spectrum ($R^2{=}0.98$); dense and recurrent baselines fail.
  Because the spectrum is faithful, the certificate acts, a priori: under a fixed sensing budget a $c\times$-inflated certificate provably needs $c\times$ the budget, and the equivariant certificate meets a budget its inflated dense counterpart cannot -- with zero calibration data. The same read-out, unchanged, audits public pretrained world models training-free: TD-MPC2 checkpoints land on the certificate's own scope taxonomy -- calibrated where strongly expansive (ratio 0.94-1.02), optimistic where weakly expansive, correctly abstaining where contracting -- a map a deployed monitor replicates cell-by-cell, out-of-sample. Across the official 1M-317M multitask ladder, calibration does not improve with parameters. On V-JEPA 2-AC (1B, real robot data) the measured cross-check correctly overrides an over-promising tangent spectrum -- the cross-validated audit, not the raw number, is the deployable object. Scale buys interpolation, not a calibrated horizon.
summary_zh:
**摘要**  
规模换取插值，结构换取可认证的预测时域。世界模型的平均误差无法说明某一特定预测是否可信，也无法说明其可信的持续时长。针对等变潜世界模型，我们给出了可计算的、多步预测时域认证指标：在每一对称轨道上，$T$步展开误差是可控且恒定的（定理A），并依据预测者的李雅普诺夫谱进行分通道分层，满足$T_j(ε)\sim\log(1/ε)/λ_j$。该时域具有双向性——匹配的下界使得近似等变性在时域上严格受限——且该认证指标为结构所独有：轨道恒定误差表征了等变性，因此任何非等变模型无论规模多大都无法具备该性质。实验上，在40维Lorenz-96系统中，仅$\mathbb{Z}_N$等变网络能完整恢复李雅普诺夫谱（$R^2=0.98$），而密集网络和循环网络均失败。  
由于谱是可信的，该认证指标具有先验作用：在固定感知预算下，放大$c$倍的认证指标必然需要$c$倍预算，且等变认证指标能在零校准数据下达到其放大后的密集模型所无法达到的预算要求。相同的读取器（未经修改）可在无训练条件下审计公开的预训练世界模型：TD-MPC2检查点落入了认证指标自身的范围分类——在强扩张区域被校准（比率0.94-1.02），在弱扩张区域偏乐观，在收缩区域正确弃权——这一映射可由部署监控器逐单元复制，且样本外有效。在官方1M-317M多任务阶梯模型中，校准效果并不随参数规模提升。在V-JEPA 2-AC（1B参数，真实机器人数据）上，实测交叉校验正确覆盖了过度乐观的正切谱——可部署的对象是交叉验证后的审计结果，而非原始数值。规模换取插值，而非可认证的预测时域。
tldr: This paper provides a certified predictability horizon for equivariant latent world models, proving that rollout error is constant over symmetry orbits and stratified by Lyapunov spectrum, with applications to auditing pretrained world models like TD-MPC2 and V-JEPA.
tldr_zh: 本文为等变潜世界模型提供了可认证的可预测性界限，证明推出误差在对称轨道上恒定并按李雅普诺夫谱分层，可用于审计预训练的世界模型如TD-MPC2和V-JEPA。

title: Y-BotFrame: An Extensible Embodied Agent Framework for Quadruped Robot Assistants
summary: Quadruped robots are capable of traversing a wide range of complex terrains with high flexibility. As highly mobile ground-based intelligent platforms, they can be equipped with modules for navigation control, environmental perception, and intelligent interaction, thereby serving as real-world mobile deployment platforms for various algorithms. In this paper, we introduce Y-BotFrame, an extensible embodied platform that turns a robot into an intelligent ground assistant. Y-BotFrame integrates multimodal perception capabilities, including speech, vision, and LiDAR, and employs a large language model as the cognitive core for environmental understanding, contextual reasoning, and task planning. The system maps user natural-language instructions into executable embodied task units that can be carried out by the robot. Y-BotFrame supports natural interaction through voice commands and visual feedback, removing the need for a remote controller and enabling efficient human-robot collaboration. With a highly extensible framework, Y-BotFrame supports plug-and-play integration of new functional modules as well as modular upgrades and iterative development, offering a reference implementation for the real-world deployment of general-purpose, instruction-driven embodied agents.The supplementary video is available at https://xdei-group.github.io/Y-BotFrame/.
summary_zh: 四足机器人能够以极高的灵活性穿越各类复杂地形。作为高机动性的地面智能平台，它们可搭载导航控制、环境感知与智能交互等模块，从而成为多种算法在实际场景中的移动部署平台。本文介绍Y-BotFrame——一个可扩展的具身化平台，能够将机器人转变为智能地面助手。Y-BotFrame集成了包括语音、视觉和激光雷达在内的多模态感知能力，并以大语言模型作为认知核心，实现环境理解、上下文推理与任务规划。该系统将用户自然语言指令映射为可由机器人执行的可操作具身任务单元。Y-BotFrame支持通过语音指令与视觉反馈进行自然交互，无需遥控器即可实现高效的人机协作。凭借高度可扩展的架构，Y-BotFrame支持新功能模块的即插即用集成，以及模块化升级与迭代开发，为通用型、指令驱动的具身智能体在实际场景中的部署提供了参考实现。补充视频见https://xdei-group.github.io/Y-BotFrame/。
tldr: Y-BotFrame is an extensible embodied agent framework for quadruped robots that integrates multimodal perception (speech, vision, LiDAR) with a large language model as the cognitive core, enabling natural-language-driven task planning and execution.
tldr_zh: Y-BotFrame 是一个可扩展的四足机器人具身智能框架，集成语音、视觉和激光雷达等多模态感知，以大语言模型为认知核心，实现自然语言驱动的任务规划与执行。

title: RoboProcessBench: Benchmarking Process-Aware Understanding in Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly explored as visual critics, reward generators, and failure detectors in robotic manipulation. These roles implicitly require models to judge not only final task success, but also how a manipulation execution is physically and temporally progressing. However, existing evaluations fail to test whether VLMs possess fine-grained process understanding. To address this gap, we present RoboProcessBench, a benchmark for process-aware understanding in vision-language robotic manipulation. RoboProcessBench decomposes such capability into two complementary dimensions, \emph{static monitoring} and \emph{dynamic reasoning}, instantiated as 12 diagnostic question families covering phase, contact, motion, coordination, primitive-local progress, temporal order, outcome, and primitive-level transitions. Built from physically grounded execution traces, the curated benchmark corpus ProcessData contains \textasciitilde 58k question-answer pairs across 260 manipulation tasks, which is further split into ProcessData-SFT and ProcessData-Eval for post-training and evaluation purposes. Extensive evaluation of various VLMs on ProcessData-Eval reveals broad limitations across 12 diagnostic task families, suggesting current models still lack robust process-aware understanding of manipulation executions. But with ProcessData-SFT, the post-trained \textit{Qwen2.5-VL-7B} and \textit{InternVL-3-8B} exhibit consistent gains on local state, motion, progress, and primitive-aware cues. These results demonstrate that RoboProcessBench serves as both an evaluation benchmark and a learnable supervision source for developing VLMs capable of monitoring and evaluating robotic manipulation processes. Project webpage: \href{https://processbench-2026.github.io/RoboProcessBench-Web/}{https://processbench-2026.github.io}.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被探索用于机器人操作中的视觉评判、奖励生成与故障检测等任务。这些角色隐含地要求模型不仅能判断最终任务是否成功，还需评估操作执行过程在物理与时间维度上的进展。然而，现有评估未能检验VLM是否具备细粒度的过程理解能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出RoboProcessBench——一个面向视觉-语言机器人操作中过程感知理解的基准测试。RoboProcessBench将此类能力分解为两个互补维度：**静态监控**与**动态推理**，具体化为12个诊断性问题族，涵盖阶段、接触、运动、协调、基元级进度、时间顺序、结果及基元级转换。基于物理可执行轨迹构建的基准语料库ProcessData包含约5.8万对问答对，覆盖260项操作任务，并进一步划分为ProcessData-SFT（用于后训练）与ProcessData-Eval（用于评估）两个子集。在ProcessData-Eval上对多种VLM的广泛评估揭示了其在12个诊断任务族中的普遍局限，表明当前模型仍缺乏对操作执行过程的稳健过程感知理解。然而，借助ProcessData-SFT进行后训练的Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL-3-8B在局部状态、运动、进度及基元感知线索上展现出持续提升。这些结果表明，RoboProcessBench既可作为评估基准，也可作为可学习的监督来源，用于开发能够监控与评估机器人操作过程的VLM。项目主页：https://processbench-2026.github.io。
tldr: This paper introduces RoboProcessBench, a benchmark and dataset for evaluating vision-language models' fine-grained process understanding in robotic manipulation, covering static monitoring and dynamic reasoning across 12 diagnostic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoboProcessBench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在机器人操作中细粒度过程理解的基准和数据集，涵盖静态监控和动态推理的12个诊断任务。

title: Towards Reliable Sequential Object Picking in Clutter: The Runner-up Solution to RGMC 2025
summary: As a long-standing challenge in robotic manipulation, stable and efficient grasping in cluttered environments is of great importance in industrial settings. While recent studies have achieved relatively high success rates in grasping from clutter, there remain few mature solutions for more demanding tasks such as sequential object search and sorting. This work addresses sequential object picking in cluttered environments based on the Cluttered Environment Picking Benchmark (CEPB) and presents our solution to the Pick-in-Clutter track of the 10th Robotic Grasping and Manipulation Competition (RGMC) at ICRA 2025. The task poses several key challenges. First, it requires robust and collision-aware grasping with high success rates across a diverse set of objects, including both rigid and deformable ones. Second, it demands efficient search for target objects, which places stringent requirements on the decluttering and searching strategies of the solution. To address the above challenges, we design an integrated hardware-software pipeline that combines object recognition, decluttering, and multi-modal grasping. The main contributions include the hardware design of a multifunctional gripper and novel representations for object distribution and occlusion relationships in cluttered space. This pipeline enables efficient recognition, search, and sequential grasping of objects in clutter, demonstrating strong performance in both laboratory tests and competition scenarios, and ultimately achieving second place in the Pick-in-Clutter track of the RGMC 2025.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在机器人操作领域，稳定高效地在杂乱环境中抓取物体是一个长期挑战，在工业场景中具有重要意义。尽管近期研究在杂乱环境抓取方面已取得较高成功率，但对于更复杂的任务，如顺序目标搜索与分拣，仍缺乏成熟的解决方案。本文基于杂乱环境抓取基准（CEPB）研究杂乱环境中的顺序物体抓取问题，并提出了我们在2025年ICRA第十届机器人抓取与操作竞赛（RGMC）“杂乱环境抓取”赛道的解决方案。该任务面临若干关键挑战：首先，需要具备高成功率的鲁棒且考虑碰撞的抓取能力，涵盖刚性与可变形物体；其次，要求高效搜索目标物体，这对解决方案的清理与搜索策略提出了严格要求。为应对上述挑战，我们设计了一套集成化的软硬件流程，融合了物体识别、杂物清理与多模态抓取。主要贡献包括多功能夹爪的硬件设计，以及杂乱空间中物体分布与遮挡关系的新型表征方法。该流程实现了对杂乱环境中物体的高效识别、搜索与顺序抓取，在实验室测试与竞赛场景中均展现出优异性能，最终在RGMC 2025“杂乱环境抓取”赛道中获得第二名。
tldr: This paper presents an integrated hardware-software pipeline for sequential object picking in cluttered environments, combining object recognition, decluttering, and multi-modal grasping, achieving second place in the Pick-in-Clutter track of RGMC 2025.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种集成硬件-软件流水线，用于在杂乱环境中进行顺序物体抓取，结合了物体识别、清理和多模态抓取，在RGMC 2025的杂乱拾取赛道中获得第二名。

title: EWAM: An Enhanced World Action Model for Closed-Loop Online Adaptation in Embodied Intelligence
summary: In this paper, we propose the Enhanced World Action Model (EWAM), a closed-loop online adaptation architecture built upon a pretrained and fully frozen Cosmos3 backbone network. Evaluated entirely under a zero-shot task protocol, EWAM is centrally focused on reducing the amount of additional deployment data required to adapt to new task layouts. Notably, no extra task-specific demonstration sets were introduced in any of the evaluations, and no fine-tuning was performed on the backbone network. Its performance gains stem entirely from an inference-time co-reasoning mechanism composed of four inserted lightweight neural layers: the Neural Experience Memory Layer located in the intermediate layers of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) provides task-relevant execution context; the Neural Anomaly Detection Layer after the state prediction head monitors the divergence between predicted and actual states in real time; the Neural Policy Routing Layer dynamically selects direct execution, conservative replanning, or rollback recovery based on the anomaly severity; and the Neural Action Correction Layer refines the generated action chunks using execution diagnostics. Unlike naive feature fusion, the memory, anomaly detection, and correction modules are deeply integrated into the Cosmos3 forward path in a differentiable manner, with only the final routing decision being a discrete supervised one.
summary_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了增强型世界动作模型（EWAM），这是一种基于预训练且完全冻结的Cosmos3骨干网络构建的闭环在线自适应架构。该模型完全在零样本任务协议下进行评估，核心目标是减少适应新任务布局所需的额外部署数据量。值得注意的是，所有评估均未引入额外的任务特定演示数据集，且未对骨干网络进行任何微调。其性能提升完全源于由四个插入的轻量级神经层组成的推理时协同推理机制：位于扩散变换器（DiT）中间层的神经经验记忆层提供与任务相关的执行上下文；状态预测头之后的神经异常检测层实时监测预测状态与实际状态之间的偏差；神经策略路由层根据异常严重程度动态选择直接执行、保守重规划或回滚恢复；神经动作修正层利用执行诊断信息对生成的动作块进行精细化调整。与简单的特征融合不同，记忆、异常检测和修正模块以可微分方式深度集成到Cosmos3的前向传播路径中，仅最终路由决策为离散监督方式。
tldr: EWAM introduces a closed-loop online adaptation architecture for embodied AI, using four lightweight neural layers inserted into a frozen Cosmos3 backbone to enable zero-shot task adaptation without extra demonstrations.
tldr_zh: EWAM提出了一种用于具身智能的闭环在线自适应架构，通过在冻结的Cosmos3骨干网络中插入四个轻量级神经层，实现了无需额外示范的零样本任务自适应。

title: From Imitation to Alignment: Human-Preference Flow Policies for Long-Horizon Sidewalk Navigation
summary: Autonomous long-horizon sidewalk navigation is essential for micro-mobility applications such as robotic food delivery and assistive electronic wheelchairs. Unlike autonomous driving on the road, long-horizon sidewalk navigation requires precise maneuvering through unpredictable sidewalk terrains and pedestrians, with a lightweight perception stack as minimal as a single monocular RGB camera. While imitation learning (IL) from demonstrations offers a practical solution, the resulting autopilot policy often suffers from compounding errors, a lack of social compliance on sidewalks, and deficiencies in counterfactual reasoning to handle complex situations. To address these challenges, we introduce FlowPilot, a mapless navigation policy that achieves robust and efficient long-horizon navigation performance using only a monocular RGB camera. We first propose to use anchored flow matching as an action representation for policy pre-training on large-scale robot fleet data and to capture the diverse, complex, multimodal distribution of sidewalk navigation behaviors. To bridge the gap between imitation and alignment, we further design a human-in-the-loop preference learning scheme to tune the policy on a small amount of human intervention data. It strengthens the model's counterfactual reasoning and social compliance on sidewalks. We evaluate FlowPilot through extensive simulation and real-world experiments in diverse sidewalk environments. FlowPilot achieves 42% success rate and 66% route completion in simulation, while FlowPilot-HP further improves real-world robustness and social compliance, reducing IR by 40.0% and NIR by 52.1% relative to the base model.
summary_zh: 自主长程人行道导航对于机器人送餐、辅助电动轮椅等微出行应用至关重要。与道路上自动驾驶不同，长程人行道导航需要在不可预测的人行道地形和行人环境中实现精准机动，且感知栈需尽可能轻量化——最低配置仅需单个单目RGB摄像头。尽管基于示范的模仿学习（IL）提供了实用解决方案，但由此产生的自动驾驶策略常存在复合误差、人行道社交合规性不足，以及应对复杂情境的反事实推理能力缺陷。为应对这些挑战，我们提出FlowPilot——一种仅依赖单目RGB摄像头的无地图导航策略，可实现稳健高效的长程导航性能。首先，我们提出将锚定流匹配作为动作表征，用于大规模机器人集群数据的策略预训练，以捕捉人行道导航行为的多样化、复杂多模态分布。为弥合模仿与对齐之间的差距，我们进一步设计了一种人在回路中的偏好学习方案，通过少量人工干预数据调整策略。该方法增强了模型的反事实推理能力与人行道社交合规性。我们通过多样化人行道环境中的大量仿真与真实世界实验评估FlowPilot。仿真中FlowPilot实现了42%的成功率与66%的路径完成率，而FlowPilot-HP进一步提升了真实世界的鲁棒性与社交合规性，相较于基础模型，干预率（IR）降低40.0%，非预期干预率（NIR）降低52.1%。
tldr: FlowPilot introduces a mapless sidewalk navigation policy using anchored flow matching for action representation and human-in-the-loop preference learning to improve social compliance and counterfactual reasoning.
tldr_zh: FlowPilot 提出了一种无地图人行道导航策略，利用锚定流匹配进行动作表示，并通过人在环偏好学习提升社会合规性和反事实推理能力。

title: A Tutorial on World Models and Physical AI
summary: World modeling is emerging as a central principle for building intelligent systems capable of prediction, reasoning, and decision making. A central distinction can be drawn between explicit world models, which learn structured dynamics for rollout-based reasoning and planning, and implicit world models, which encode predictive structure within scalable learned representations. These complementary paradigms provide a foundation for physical AI in domains such as robotics and autonomous driving, enabling intelligence beyond reactive control under real-world constraints. Recent foundation models further suggest a pathway toward unified systems integrating perception, prediction, and action. Despite rapid progress, major challenges remain in hierarchical reasoning, long-horizon planning, and autonomous goal formation, which are critical for advancing toward artificial general intelligence. This tutorial presents a coherent framework in which diverse world modeling approaches are unified through shared predictive structure and differentiated by how such structure is represented and exploited.
summary_zh: 世界建模正逐步成为构建具备预测、推理与决策能力的智能系统的核心原则。显式世界模型与隐式世界模型之间存在关键区别：前者学习结构化动力学以支持基于展开的推理与规划，后者则将预测性结构编码至可扩展的学习表征中。这两种互补范式为机器人与自动驾驶等领域的物理人工智能奠定了基础，使其能够在现实约束条件下实现超越反应式控制的智能。近期的基础模型进一步揭示了构建统一感知、预测与行动系统的可行路径。尽管进展迅速，但在分层推理、长时域规划及自主目标形成等关键方向上仍面临重大挑战，这些能力对于迈向通用人工智能至关重要。本教程提出一个统一框架，通过共享的预测性结构将多样化的世界建模方法联系起来，并依据此类结构的表征方式与利用途径加以区分。
tldr: This tutorial provides a unified framework for explicit and implicit world models, highlighting their role in physical AI for robotics and autonomous driving, while discussing challenges toward AGI.
tldr_zh: 本教程为显式和隐式世界模型提供了统一框架，强调其在机器人和自动驾驶中的物理AI应用，并讨论了通往AGI的挑战。

title: VISA: VLM-Guided Instance Semantic Auditing for 3D Occupancy World Models
summary: Semantic 3D occupancy provides a voxelized world state for autonomous driving and robot decision making, but object and rare-class errors can affect free-space interpretation, collision checking, and temporal state propagation. We show that a common VLM strategy, aligning 3D voxel or object features with crop-caption embeddings, improves text-space similarity without reliably improving closed-set occupancy mIoU. Motivated by this mismatch, we propose VISA, a training-time semantic auditing approach for existing occupancy world models. VISA queries an offline VLM on a representative crop of each physical object instance, obtains a structured audit with class hypotheses, plausible confusions, reliability, attributes, and evidence, and propagates it along the object track. The audit is grounded to matched 3D object voxels and distilled into semantic logits through reliability-weighted taxonomy, attribute-factor, and scene-level audit graph losses, while inference remains unchanged and requires no VLM. On nuScenes, averaged across three runs, VISA improves OccWorld from 19.06 to 20.05 mIoU and GaussianWorld from 21.36 to 21.91 mIoU; on GaussianWorld, object mIoU improves from 18.18 to 19.16 and rare-class mIoU from 15.60 to 16.79. These results suggest that VLMs are better suited to closed-set occupancy as reliability-aware semantic auditors than as generic caption-embedding targets.
summary_zh: 语义三维占据表示为自动驾驶和机器人决策提供了体素化的世界状态，但物体和稀有类别的误差会影响自由空间解译、碰撞检测以及时间状态传播。我们证明，一种常见的VLM策略——将三维体素或物体特征与裁剪-字幕嵌入对齐——能提升文本-空间相似性，却无法可靠地改善闭集占据任务的mIoU指标。受此错配启发，我们提出VISA，一种针对现有占据世界模型的训练时语义审计方法。VISA对每个物理对象实例的代表性裁剪区域查询离线VLM，获取包含类别假设、合理混淆、可靠性、属性及证据的结构化审计结果，并将其沿对象轨迹传播。审计结果被关联到匹配的三维目标体素，并通过可靠性加权分类法、属性因子及场景级审计图损失蒸馏为语义逻辑值，而推理过程保持不变且无需VLM。在nuScenes数据集上，三次运行的平均结果表明，VISA使OccWorld的mIoU从19.06提升至20.05，GaussianWorld的mIoU从21.36提升至21.91；在GaussianWorld上，目标mIoU从18.18提升至19.16，稀有类别mIoU从15.60提升至16.79。这些结果表明，VLM更适合作为可靠性感知的语义审计器，而非通用的字幕嵌入目标，以服务于闭集占据任务。
tldr: VISA uses an offline VLM to audit object instances in occupancy world models, distilling the structured feedback as training losses to improve closed-set occupancy mIoU without requiring VLM at inference.
tldr_zh: VISA 利用离线 VLM 对占用世界模型中的物体实例进行审计，将结构化的审计结果蒸馏为训练损失，在不依赖 VLM 推理的情况下提升闭集占用 mIoU。

title: EPM-JEPA: Operator-Side Experience Modulation in JEPA-Family World Models
summary: JEPA-family world models use a static predictor whose weights do not adapt when test-time dynamics diverge from training. We compare two mechanisms for incorporating accumulated experience into a JEPA predictor under distribution shift: operand-side injection, where a compressed experience representation is added as a residual to the predictor's hidden state (EI-JEPA), and operator-side modulation, where the same representation generates low-rank weight deltas via LoRA applied to the predictor's weights (EPM-JEPA). On a pre-registered comparison (Moving MNIST, gravity shift), EPM-JEPA (D_shift^{n=50} = 0.7848 +/- 0.0078, three seeds) differs from EI-JEPA (0.8238) by delta = 4.74% - Outcome C: a null result - by our stated criterion, a valid outcome. As a secondary, non-pre-registered observation, EPM-JEPA improves 1.90% over a no-memory baseline (0.8000), consistently across seeds, while EI-JEPA underperforms the baseline, indicating the benefit is specific to weight-level modulation. Our primary contribution is a mechanism analysis: the D_shift^{n=50} trajectory reflects three independent dynamical processes - buffer cycling, EMA target drift, and an intrinsic LoRA settling transient of +0.021 - rather than convergence to equilibrium. These findings motivate PEM-JEPA, a physics-grounded successor addressing this dynamical-peak limitation.
summary_zh: JEPA系列世界模型采用静态预测器，其权重在测试时动力学偏离训练分布时无法自适应调整。本文比较了两种在分布漂移条件下将累积经验融入JEPA预测器的机制：操作数侧注入（EI-JEPA），将压缩后的经验表示作为残差添加到预测器的隐藏状态中；以及算子侧调制（EPM-JEPA），通过将低秩权重增量（LoRA）应用于预测器权重，使同一表示生成参数调整。在一项预注册对比实验（移动MNIST、重力偏移）中，EPM-JEPA（D_shift^{n=50} = 0.7848 ± 0.0078，三组随机种子）与EI-JEPA（0.8238）的差异为Δ = 4.74%——根据我们预设的标准，该结果属于无效结果（结果C）。作为非预注册的次要观察，EPM-JEPA相较于无记忆基线（0.8000）稳定提升1.90%，而EI-JEPA的表现则低于基线，表明性能提升特属于权重级调制。我们的主要贡献在于机制分析：D_shift^{n=50}轨迹反映三种独立动力学过程——缓冲区循环、EMA目标漂移以及+0.021的LoRA固有暂态稳定——而非收敛至平衡态。这些发现推动了PEM-JEPA这一基于物理原理的后续模型的构建，旨在解决该动力学峰值局限。
tldr: The paper proposes EPM-JEPA, a method for adapting JEPA-family world models to distribution shifts via LoRA-based weight modulation, but a pre-registered comparison on Moving MNIST yields a null result.
tldr_zh: 本文提出EPM-JEPA，通过基于LoRA的权重调制适应分布漂移的JEPA系列世界模型，但在Moving MNIST上的预注册比较结果为无效。

title: Learning to Adapt: Representation-Based Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Task Skill Transfer
summary: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in learning complex control policies, yet its applicability remains limited due to sample inefficiency and poor generalization across tasks. In this work, we propose RepMT-SAC, a framework for multi-task RL that enables efficient knowledge sharing and robust transfer to new tasks. RepMT-SAC uses spectral MDP decomposition to capture transferable dynamics, structuring the value function into a task-agnostic core with a minimal task-specific adjustment. This design allows for strong zero-shot performance on in-distribution tasks and rapid few-shot adaptation to out-of-distribution tasks. We evaluate RepMT-SAC on quadcopter trajectory-following tasks across in-distribution and out-of-distribution contexts, demonstrating that it outperforms baselines by up to 30%.
summary_zh: 强化学习在复杂控制策略的学习中取得了显著成功，但由于样本效率低下和跨任务泛化能力不足，其应用范围仍受到限制。本文提出RepMT-SAC框架，一种面向多任务强化学习的方案，能够实现高效的知识共享并鲁棒地迁移至新任务。RepMT-SAC采用谱MDP分解来捕捉可迁移的动力学特征，将价值函数结构化为任务无关的核心模块与极小化的任务特定调整模块。该设计使得在分布内任务上具备强大的零样本表现，并在分布外任务上实现快速的小样本适应。我们在四旋翼飞行器轨迹跟踪任务上对RepMT-SAC进行了评估——涵盖分布内与分布外场景，结果表明其性能相较基线方法提升高达30%。
tldr: This paper proposes RepMT-SAC, a multi-task reinforcement learning framework that uses spectral MDP decomposition for efficient knowledge sharing and transfer, demonstrated on quadcopter trajectory-following tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RepMT-SAC，一种基于频谱MDP分解的多任务强化学习框架，实现高效的知识共享与迁移，并在四旋翼飞行器轨迹跟踪任务上验证了性能。

title: Functional Cache Grafting: Robust and Rapid Code-Policy Synthesis for Embodied Agents
summary: Code-writing large language models (CodeLLMs) generate executable code policies for embodied agents by translating natural language goals and environmental constraints into structured control programs. However, policy generation in open-domain embodied environments suffers from two fundamental limitations: (i) delayed decoding caused by repetitive prefill computation over long prompts, and (ii) limited robustness due to fully generative decoding, which often produces API mismatches, missing safety guards, and unstable control logic. To address these limitations, we present FCGraft, a Functional Cache Grafting framework. FCGraft maintains a library of function-level validated code skeletons and their associated prompt-level Transformer key-value (KV) caches, and synthesizes new policies by retrieving relevant functions and grafting their KV caches when a new task is provided. Given retrieved function caches, FCGraft performs cache grafting via stitching, which composes cached function segments into a composite policy, and patching, which locally adapts only the necessary code regions to satisfy task-specific parameters and constraints with minimal additional decoding. By eliminating redundant prefill computation, this approach reduces generation latency, while reusing validated control structures improves robustness over prompt-level caching methods RAGCache, achieving 18.31% higher task success rate and 2.3x faster policy synthesis.
summary_zh: 代码编写大语言模型（CodeLLMs）通过将自然语言目标与环境约束转化为结构化控制程序，为具身智能体生成可执行代码策略。然而，开放域具身环境中的策略生成存在两个根本性限制：（i）对长提示词进行重复预填充计算导致的延迟解码，以及（ii）完全生成式解码带来的有限鲁棒性——此类解码常引发API不匹配、安全防护缺失及控制逻辑不稳定等问题。针对这些局限，本文提出FCGraft功能缓存嫁接框架。FCGraft维护一个函数级已验证代码骨架库及其关联的提示词级Transformer键值（KV）缓存，当新任务出现时，通过检索相关函数并嫁接其KV缓存来合成新策略。给定检索到的函数缓存后，FCGraft通过拼接（stitching）实现缓存嫁接——将缓存函数片段组合成复合策略，并通过修补（patching）局部调整必要代码区域以满足任务特定参数和约束，仅需极少量额外解码。该方法通过消除冗余预填充计算降低生成延迟，同时复用已验证控制结构提升了鲁棒性，相较于提示词级缓存方法RAGCache，任务成功率提高18.31%，策略合成速度提升2.3倍。
tldr: FCGraft accelerates code-policy synthesis for embodied agents by grafting validated function-level KV caches, reducing latency and improving robustness over prompt-level caching.
tldr_zh: FCGraft 通过嫁接经过验证的函数级 KV 缓存来加速具身代理的代码策略合成，降低延迟并提高鲁棒性，优于提示级缓存方法。

title: WISE: A Long-Horizon Agent in Minecraft with Why-Which Reasoning
summary: Rapid advances have been made in developing general-purpose embodied agent in environments like Minecraft through the adoption of LLM-augmented hierarchical approaches. Despite their promise, low-level controllers often become performance bottlenecks due to repeated execution failures. We argue that a key limitation is not only the lack of episodic memory, but also the decoupling of \textit{what-where-when} memory from \textit{which-why} reasoning. To address this, we propose \textbf{WISE} (Which-Why Informed Semantic Explorer), a long-horizon agent framework with an enhanced low-level controller equipped with a Causal Event Graph that augments episodic memory with explicit causal structure linking observations to task relevance. Unlike prior work such as MrSteve, which relies on feature similarity for retrieval, WISE enables robust recall under viewpoint changes and supports opportunistic task reordering through causal reasoning. Building on this memory, we propose an Opportunistic Task Scheduler that dynamically re-prioritizes subtasks when causally relevant opportunities are detected. We further equip WISE with a multi-scale progressive exploration strategy to provide spatially comprehensive observations for downstream reasoning. Experiments show that WISE largely improves task success and efficiency on long-horizon sparse tasks, particularly in settings requiring adaptive decision-making.
summary_zh: 在《我的世界》等环境中开发通用具身智能体方面，通过采用大语言模型增强的分层方法已取得快速进展。尽管这些方法前景广阔，但低级控制器常因重复执行失败而成为性能瓶颈。我们认为关键局限不仅在于缺乏情景记忆，更在于\textit{什么-何处-何时}记忆与\textit{哪个-为何}推理的相互解耦。为解决此问题，我们提出\textbf{WISE}（因果知情语义探索器），一种长周期智能体框架，其增强型低级控制器配备因果事件图，通过将观测与任务相关性显式关联的因果结构来扩展情景记忆。不同于依赖特征相似性进行检索的先前工作（如MrSteve），WISE能够在视角变化下实现稳健回忆，并支持通过因果推理进行机会性任务重排序。基于该记忆机制，我们提出机会性任务调度器，当检测到因果相关机会时可动态重新调整子任务优先级。我们进一步为WISE配备多尺度渐进式探索策略，为下游推理提供空间全面的观测。实验表明，WISE在长周期稀疏任务中显著提升了任务成功率与效率，尤其在需要自适应决策的场景中表现突出。
tldr: WISE introduces a causal event graph and opportunistic task scheduler to improve low-level control in long-horizon Minecraft agents, enhancing task success and adaptive decision-making.
tldr_zh: WISE 通过因果事件图和机会性任务调度器增强低层级控制，提升了 Minecraft 中长期任务的成功率和自适应决策能力。

title: DIMOS: Disentangling Instance-level Moving Object Segmentation
summary: Moving instance segmentation (MIS) attracts increasing attention due to its broad applications in traffic surveillance, autonomous driving, and animal tracking. Event cameras record asynchronous brightness changes, providing high temporal resolution and dynamic range, which makes them highly sensitive to motion information. By fusing event and image features, motion cues from events can complement spatial details from images, enhancing the performance of MIS. However, current multimodal MIS methods still struggle to segment small moving instances, as event cameras often yield sparse features under limited resolution. Moreover, event features entangle appearance attributes with motion cues, which further restricts effective cross-modal fusion. To address these challenges, we first propose a dual-disentangling feature extraction framework that separates and extracts appearance and motion information within both image and event modalities, thereby improving feature density. Subsequently, a multi-granularity cross-modal alignment is introduced to align distributionally and semantically consistent features across modalities, enabling more effective fusion with rich spatial and temporal details. The experiment results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in multimodal MIS, especially for small instances under challenging conditions such as fast motion and low-light settings.
summary_zh: 运动实例分割（MIS）因其在交通监控、自动驾驶和动物追踪等领域的广泛应用而日益受到关注。事件相机记录异步亮度变化，具有高时间分辨率和动态范围，使其对运动信息高度敏感。通过融合事件与图像特征，事件中的运动线索可补充图像的空间细节，从而提升MIS的性能。然而，当前的多模态MIS方法仍难以分割小型运动实例，因为事件相机在有限分辨率下常产生稀疏特征。此外，事件特征中外观属性与运动线索相互纠缠，进一步限制了有效的跨模态融合。针对这些挑战，我们首先提出一种双分离特征提取框架，在图像和事件模态内分别提取外观与运动信息，从而提升特征密度。随后引入多粒度跨模态对齐方法，对齐跨模态中分布一致且语义一致的特征，实现富含空间与时间细节的更有效融合。实验结果表明，我们的方法在多模态MIS任务中达到了最优性能，尤其在快速运动与低光照等挑战性场景下的小型实例分割中表现突出。
tldr: Proposes a dual-disentangling feature extraction framework for moving instance segmentation that separates appearance and motion information in both event and image modalities, with multi-granularity cross-modal alignment to improve segmentation of small moving instances, especially under fast motion and low-light conditions.
tldr_zh: 提出一种双解耦特征提取框架，将事件和图像模态中的外观与运动信息分离，并通过多粒度跨模态对齐提升运动实例分割性能，尤其针对快速运动和低光照下的小目标。

title: Context-Aware Feature-Fusion for Co-occurring Object Detection in Autonomous Driving
summary: Object detection in autonomous driving requires precise localization and an inherent understanding of the relational context between co-occurring objects. In extremely complex heterogeneous environments rare classes, small-scale objects, and frequently appearing objects are difficult for standard object detection frameworks to handle. In this paper, we propose a novel framework called Context-Centric Feature Fusion (CCFF), which utilizes two attention-based modules, Local Context Fusion Module (LCFM) uses the RoI-to-RoI self-attention mechanism to resolve spatial interactions, mainly considering small and partially obscured objects, while Global Context Attention Module (GCAM) converts the co-occurrence of objects priors by pooling top-K RoI features into a global context attention token, avoiding the computational overhead of pixel-level global pooling. This fusion of local and object-centric global features yields contextualized embeddings that enhance classification results and co-occurring objects detection. Our method is evaluated on two datasets, Cityscapes and BDD100K which demonstrate significant improvement on relational consistency, achieving a Category-level Consistency Strategy (CCS) of 0.973 and 0.969, respectively. Furthermore, our approach produces substantial gains in small object detection (AP_S: 14.1%) and successfully recovers rare classes such as "Train" that are typically lost in large distributions. Our efficiency report shows that the framework processes images in real time with a 0.2 FPS overhead. The code is available at https://github.com/BinayKSingh/CCFF.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自动驾驶中的目标检测需要精确的定位以及对共现目标之间关系上下文的固有理解。在极为复杂的异质环境中，标准目标检测框架难以处理稀有类别、小尺度目标以及频繁出现的物体。本文提出了一种名为Context-Centric Feature Fusion (CCFF) 的新型框架，该框架利用两个基于注意力的模块：局部上下文融合模块（LCFM）采用RoI-to-RoI自注意力机制来解析空间交互，主要针对小型及部分遮挡的目标；全局上下文注意力模块（GCAM）则通过对Top-K RoI特征进行池化，将其转换为全局上下文注意力标记，从而避免了像素级全局池化的计算开销。这种局部特征与以目标为中心的全局特征的融合，产生了上下文感知的嵌入表示，从而提升了分类结果及共现目标的检测性能。我们在Cityscapes和BDD100K两个数据集上进行了评估，结果表明该方法在关系一致性上取得了显著提升，类别级一致性策略（CCS）分别达到0.973和0.969。此外，本方法在小目标检测方面获得了显著提升（AP_S: 14.1%），并成功恢复了通常在大量分布中丢失的稀有类别（如“火车”）。我们的效率报告显示，该框架能够实时处理图像，仅产生0.2 FPS的额外开销。代码可在https://github.com/BinayKSingh/CCFF获取。
tldr: Proposes Context-Centric Feature Fusion (CCFF), a framework with local self-attention and global context modules to improve co-occurring and small object detection in autonomous driving scenes.
tldr_zh: 提出了上下文中心特征融合（CCFF）框架，通过局部自注意力和全局上下文模块提升自动驾驶场景中共现物体和小物体的检测精度。

title: ProPlay: Procedural World Models for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents are expected to improve through interaction without external supervision, but this remains difficult in partially observable environments where agents must explore actively, learn from limited feedback, and decide when to trust prior experience. Existing LLM-agent methods often rely on memory or planning modules, yet they rarely close the loop between them to continually refine an internal understanding of environment dynamics. We introduce ProPlay, a procedural world model that supports procedure-level preplay, where agents can rehearse future procedural paths using the learned world knowledge. Rather than representing experience as isolated rules or low-level action constraints, ProPlay abstracts successful trajectories into procedures and organizes them in a procedure graph that captures causal transitions among task stages. Each transition is associated with a reliability record embedding to estimate its task-specific contribution from past outcomes. Before each episode, ProPlay simulates future procedural trajectories over known graph structures as structured soft guidance; after execution, it refines the graph using environment feedback. Experiments on public benchmarks show that ProPlay consistently improves environment understanding and self-evolution capability over strong baselines. Our code has been released in https://github.com/antman9914/proplay.
summary_zh: 自进化智能体预期能够通过交互在无外部监督的情况下实现自我提升，但在部分可观测环境中实现这一点仍存在困难——此类环境中智能体需主动探索、从有限反馈中学习，并判断何时信任过往经验。现有的大语言模型智能体方法通常依赖记忆或规划模块，但鲜少在两者间建立闭环机制以持续优化对环境动态的内在理解。我们提出ProPlay——一种支持程序级预演的过程性世界模型，使智能体能够运用已习得的世界知识预演未来程序路径。ProPlay不将经验表示为孤立规则或底层动作约束，而是将成功轨迹抽象为程序，并通过程序图进行组织，该图捕捉任务阶段间的因果转换关系。每个转换关联一个可靠性记录嵌入，用于从过往结果中评估其特定任务贡献。在每一回合开始前，ProPlay基于已知图结构模拟未来程序轨迹作为结构化软引导；执行后则利用环境反馈优化图结构。在公开基准上的实验表明，ProPlay在环境理解与自进化能力上持续优于强基线方法。我们的代码已发布于https://github.com/antman9914/proplay。
tldr: ProPlay introduces a procedural world model that abstracts trajectories into a procedure graph with reliability estimates, enabling LLM agents to simulate future paths and refine their understanding of environment dynamics for self-evolution.
tldr_zh: ProPlay提出了一种过程世界模型，将轨迹抽象为带可靠性估计的过程图，使LLM代理能够模拟未来路径并根据环境反馈不断优化对环境动态的理解，实现自我进化。

title: Low cost, easily manufactured, highly flexible strain and touch sensitive fiber for robotics applications
summary: Existing stretch and touch sensors for robots are generally expensive with respect to at least one of material costs, required manufacturing equipment, or manufacturing time. We present and experimentally characterize a conductive fiber made using only inexpensive commercial off-the-shelf parts (conductive thread at $0.07/ft, silicone tubing at $0.94/ft) and tools (loop-style needle threader at $2), which can be manufactured quickly (20 cm length in 2 minutes.) We demonstrate its use as a resistive strain sensor with three applications: Triggering a grasp in a pneumatically actuated assistive finger, sensing the pose of a pneumatically actuated robotic strap, and estimating the pose of a flexible solid. We also demonstrate that it can be used as a capacitive sensor with two applications: First, as a touch sensor which triggers a commercial robot arm to move, and second, as a near-field sensor enabling the robot arm to follow a moving hand. The capacitive sensors are knitted, showcasing the high flexibility of the fiber. We discuss methods for improving manufacturing scalability and their cost trade-offs. Finally, we demonstrate a method for repairing a cut fiber.
tldr: Presents a low-cost, easily manufactured conductive fiber for resistive strain sensing and capacitive touch/near-field sensing, demonstrated on several robotic applications.
tldr_zh: 提出一种低成本、易于制造的导电纤维，用于电阻应变传感和电容触摸/近场传感，并在多个机器人应用中进行了演示。

title: Visual Place Recognition in Forests with Depth-Aware Distillation
summary: Visual place recognition in natural forest environments remains challenging due to repetitive vegetation, weak structural cues, and significant appearance variation across traversals. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a lightweight depth-aware distillation framework that injects geometric cues into a DINOv2-based place recognition model, while maintaining its pre-trained descriptor space. Evaluated on the recent WildCross benchmark, the proposed approach yields gains over an appearance-only counterpart, providing robustness to appearance variations. These results demonstrate the importance of depth as a strong complementary modality for place recognition in natural environments and identify depth-aware distillation as a promising direction for more robust forest perception.
tldr: Proposes a depth-aware distillation framework to inject geometric cues into a DINOv2-based visual place recognition model for forests, improving robustness to appearance variations.
tldr_zh: 提出一种深度感知蒸馏框架，将几何线索注入基于DINOv2的视觉地点识别模型，增强其在森林环境中对表观变化的鲁棒性。

title: Heterogeneous LiDAR Early Fusion and Learned Re-Ranking Strategy for Robust Long-Term Place Recognition in Unstructured Environments
summary: Robust localization in unstructured environments, such as agricultural fields, is a critical challenge for autonomous systems. LiDAR sensors provide detailed 3D information about the environment and are invariant to lighting conditions. For this reason, LiDAR-based place recognition methods have gained significant attention. In this paper, we propose MinkUNeXt-VINE++, a novel approach that combines early fusion of heterogeneous LiDAR data from two sensors (Livox Mid-360 and Velodyne VLP-16) and a learned re-ranking strategy in inference time. This fusion leverages the strengths of each sensor to provide a more comprehensive representation of the environment. Additionally, the re-ranking approach is particularly important in repetitive environments, such as vineyards, as finding true positives is a major challenge. We evaluated our approach using the TEMPO-VINE dataset, which provides heterogeneous LiDAR data in vineyard environments across different phenological stages. Our results demonstrate that MinkUNeXt-VINE++ significantly improves place recognition performance compared to single-sensor approaches and state-of-the-art methods.
