summary_zh: 动作分块已成为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的常见接口，使得低频策略推理能够驱动高频机器人执行。然而，一旦动作分块被提交，在随机动力学、硬件执行误差和部分可观测性条件下，其开环执行可能变得脆弱。我们提出DREAM-Chunk，一种测试时扩展方法，通过轻量级潜在世界模型增强基于分块的策略，且无需额外的策略微调。在测试时，DREAM-Chunk采样多个候选动作分块，推演其预测的潜在未来轨迹，并从预测状态与实际执行结果匹配最佳的分块中选择动作。通过这种方式，DREAM-Chunk利用额外的测试时计算覆盖多种可能的随机未来，并在长周期分块执行中提升响应性。在Kinetix基准测试中，DREAM-Chunk在增强动作噪声下的鲁棒性得到提升，且受益于更大的候选样本规模，尤其在演示包含纠正行为时。我们进一步在两个机器人平台的四项操作任务和两种VLA策略上验证DREAM-Chunk，涵盖多种随机性来源。在仿真和硬件实验中，DREAM-Chunk提升了动作分块策略在随机动力学中的鲁棒性。
tldr: DREAM-Chunk enhances action-chunking VLA policies by using a lightweight latent world model at test time to select actions that best match observed rollouts, improving robustness under stochastic dynamics without requiring additional fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: DREAM-Chunk通过使用轻量级潜在世界模型在测试时选择与观察到的滚动结果最匹配的动作，增强了动作分块VLA策略的鲁棒性，无需额外微调即可应对随机动态。

title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
summary: We introduce VEGA, an approach for training navigation VisionLanguage-Action (VLA) models from unlabeled egocentric navigation videos. Internet-scale egocentric videos provide a scalable source of navigation-relevant visual observations, capturing cluttered scenes, close-range obstacles, and natural human motion through real-world spaces. However, these videos are not directly usable for policy learning because they do not provide obstacle-aware trajectories conditioned on explicit navigation goals in the robot's coordinate frame. VEGA addresses this gap by reconstructing local scene geometry from monocular video, sampling navigation goals (represented as text, image, or spatial waypoints) and generating obstacle-aware trajectories using the constructed geometry. The resulting trajectory distribution is then used to train a flow-matching VLA navigation policy. By using geometry exclusively during training, VEGA distills obstacle-aware planning directly into a vision-based policy. Furthermore, we introduce VEGA-Bench, a benchmark containing 250k scenes and approximately 5 million navigation goals paired with scene geometry, designed to evaluate goal progress, collision avoidance, and obstacle clearance of VLAs. Our evaluation shows that VEGA achieves competitive goal progress while reducing collisions by 33.0% and improving obstacle clearance by 17.9% over the strongest baseline on VEGABench, while improving success by at least 150.0%, reducing collisions by at least 66.7%, and improving obstacle clearance by at least 60.0% in real-world trials. Ultimately, we demonstrate that video-derived geometric supervision provides a scalable and effective signal for training obstacle-aware navigation VLAs. The code and benchmark will be released at the time of publication.
summary_zh: 我们提出VEGA——一种利用无标注自我中心导航视频训练导航视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的方法。互联网规模的自我中心视频提供了导航相关视觉观察的可扩展来源，能够捕捉杂乱场景、近距离障碍物以及人类在真实空间中的自然运动。然而，这些视频无法直接用于策略学习，因为它们未能提供基于机器人坐标系中明确导航目标的障碍感知轨迹。VEGA通过从单目视频重建局部场景几何、采样导航目标（以文本、图像或空间路径点的形式表示）并利用重建几何生成障碍感知轨迹来弥补这一差距。所得的轨迹分布随后用于训练流匹配VLA导航策略。通过仅在训练阶段使用几何信息，VEGA将障碍感知规划直接提炼为基于视觉的策略。此外，我们提出VEGA-Bench基准测试，包含25万个场景及约500万个与场景几何配对的导航目标，旨在评估VLA的目标进展、碰撞规避与障碍物清除能力。评估结果表明，在VEGA-Bench上，VEGA在保持竞争性目标进展的同时，碰撞率降低33.0%，障碍物清除能力提升17.9%，优于最强基线；在实际场景测试中，成功率至少提升150.0%，碰撞率至少降低66.7%，障碍物清除能力至少提升60.0%。最终，我们证明视频衍生的几何监督为训练障碍感知导航VLA提供了可扩展且有效的信号。代码与基准测试将在论文发表时开源。
tldr: VEGA trains navigation VLAs from unlabeled egocentric video by reconstructing scene geometry to generate obstacle-aware trajectories, achieving significant improvements in collision avoidance and obstacle clearance in both benchmark and real-world trials.
tldr_zh: VEGA通过从无标注的第一人称视频中重建场景几何来生成避障轨迹，从而训练导航VLA模型，在基准测试和真实环境中显著降低了碰撞率并提升了障碍物通过能力。

title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World foundation models (WFMs) are powerful simulators, yet they predominantly operate in a single-view setting and lack the multi-view 3D consistency required for robotic manipulation. While robotic systems rely on multiple cameras (egocentric, eye-to-hand, and wrist-mounted) for policy learning, current multi-view world models simply concatenate view tokens without explicit geometric reasoning. This causes cross-view object drift, depth inconsistency, and texture misalignment. We trace these failures to two deficiencies: the absence of an explicit inter-view communication mechanism and the lack of a 3D geometric prior. We argue that resolving both simultaneously is necessary and sufficient. To address this, we present PAIWorld, a framework that augments diffusion-transformer world models via three core components: (1) Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention blocks that establish an explicit pathway across views, (2) Geometric Rotary Position Embedding that encodes camera ray directions and extrinsic poses into the attention mechanism, and (3) Latent 3D-REPA, which distills 3D-aware features from frozen 3D foundation models to ensure 3D consistency. Built upon a DiT-based world foundation model, PAIWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-view 3D consistency on robotic manipulation benchmarks, ranking 1st on the WorldArena leaderboard and 2nd on the AgiBot-Challenge2026 leaderboard, while enabling downstream applications such as model-based planning, world action models, and multi-view policy post-training.
summary_zh: 世界基础模型（WFMs）是强大的模拟器，但主要在单视角设置下运行，缺乏机器人操作所需的多视角三维一致性。尽管机器人系统依赖多摄像头（自我中心视角、眼手视角及腕装视角）进行策略学习，当前的多视角世界模型仅简单拼接视角标记，缺乏显式的几何推理。这导致跨视角物体漂移、深度不一致以及纹理错位。我们将这些失败归因于两个缺陷：缺乏显式的视角间通信机制，以及缺少三维几何先验。我们认为同时解决这两个问题既必要又充分。为此，我们提出PAIWorld框架，通过三个核心组件增强扩散变换器世界模型：（1）几何感知跨视角注意力模块，建立跨视角的显式通路；（2）几何旋转变换位置编码，将相机射线方向与外部位姿编码至注意力机制中；（3）潜在三维表征对齐方法，从冻结的三维基础模型中蒸馏三维感知特征以确保三维一致性。基于DiT世界基础模型，PAIWorld在机器人操作基准测试中实现了最先进的多视角三维一致性，在WorldArena排行榜上位列第一，在AgiBot-Challenge2026排行榜上位列第二，同时支持基于模型的规划、世界行动模型及多视角策略后训练等下游应用。
tldr: PAIWorld augments diffusion-transformer world models with geometry-aware cross-view attention, geometric rotary position encoding, and latent 3D-REPA distillation to achieve multi-view 3D-consistent video prediction for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: PAIWorld 通过几何感知的跨视图注意力、几何旋转位置编码和潜在3D-REPA蒸馏增强扩散变换器世界模型，为机器人操作实现多视图3D一致的视频预测。

title: A Mixed-Reality Testbed for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: We propose a mixed-reality, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testbed for autonomous vehicles that seamlessly integrates a physical testbed of mobile robots with a high-fidelity simulation environment. The virtual simulation enables the creation of diverse, safety-critical driving scenarios to validate state-of-the-art perception, planning, and control algorithms, while augmenting simulations with physical robots equipped with multimodal sensors in photorealistic virtual environments further facilitating rigorous validation. Our testbed also features vehicular connectivity using wireless communication and can accommodate a large number of agents through the combination of physical robots and virtual simulated agents, supporting research on multi-agent systems including Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs). Finally, we present a safety-guaranteed framework combining perception, planning and a novel online learning-based controller using Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) for CAVs. Experiments using the proposed framework are used to validate and demonstrate the key functionalities and the overall utility of the testbed to bridge the gap between simulation and real-world hardware deployment.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种用于自动驾驶汽车的混合现实硬件在环（HIL）测试平台，该平台将移动机器人的物理测试平台与高保真仿真环境无缝集成。虚拟仿真能够创建多样化的、涉及安全关键性的驾驶场景，以验证最先进的感知、规划与控制算法；同时，通过在多光子真实的虚拟环境中搭载多模态传感器的物理机器人来增强仿真，进一步支持严格的验证。我们的测试平台还利用无线通信实现车辆互联，并通过结合物理机器人与虚拟仿真智能体容纳大量代理，从而支持包括智能网联汽车（CAVs）在内的多智能体系统研究。最后，我们提出了一种结合感知、规划及一种基于控制障碍函数（CBFs）的新型在线学习控制器的安全保证框架，用于CAVs。利用所提出框架进行的实验，验证并展示了测试平台的关键功能及其在弥合仿真与真实硬件部署之间差距方面的整体效用。
tldr: This paper presents a mixed-reality hardware-in-the-loop testbed that integrates physical mobile robots with high-fidelity simulation to validate autonomous driving algorithms, including a safety-guaranteed controller using Control Barrier Functions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合现实硬件在环测试平台，将物理移动机器人与高保真仿真集成，用于验证自动驾驶算法，包括使用控制屏障函数的安全保证控制器。

title: CABLE: Cloud-Assisted Bandwidth-efficient LMM-based Encoding for V2X Systems
summary: Cloud-hosted large multimodal models (LMMs) can provide strong open-vocabulary perception for Vehicle-to-Everything systems, but naively transmitting full-resolution frames from edge to cloud causes severe communication overhead and high cloud-side prefill latency. We present CABLE, a cloud-assisted bandwidth-efficient LMM-based encoding framework for edge-cloud perception. CABLE propagates the previous cloud segmentation mask on the edge using ego-motion compensation, refines it with residual-motion cues, and consolidates disconnected regions via a corridor envelope to form a robust region of interest (ROI). Only ROI-masked images are uploaded, while the cloud segmentation output is fed back as the prior for the next frame, forming a mask-to-ROI-to-LMM feedback loop. Experiments on five datasets (nuScenes, WOD-ZB, Waymo, KITTI, and CADC) show consistent communication savings while largely preserving perception, achieving $73$--$87\%$ ROI pixel-coverage reduction with $5$--$8\times$ estimated LMM prefill speedup at a modest detection-quality trade-off relative to full-frame inference.
summary_zh: 云托管的大规模多模态模型为车联万物系统提供了强大的开放词汇感知能力，但将全分辨率帧从边缘端直接传输至云端会带来严重的通信开销和较高的云端预填充延迟。我们提出CABLE——一种面向边缘-云端感知的、基于大规模多模态模型的带宽高效编码框架。CABLE利用自运动补偿在边缘端传播先前的云端分割掩码，通过残差运动线索进行优化，并采用通道包络方法整合不连续区域，形成鲁棒的感兴趣区域。仅上传经感兴趣区域掩码处理的图像，同时将云端分割输出作为下一帧的先验信息反馈，构成“掩码→感兴趣区域→大规模多模态模型”的闭环。在五个数据集（nuScenes、WOD-ZB、Waymo、KITTI和CADC）上的实验表明，该方法在基本保持感知性能的同时持续降低通信量，实现73%-87%的感兴趣区域像素覆盖率缩减，预估大规模多模态模型预填充速度提升5-8倍，且相对于全帧推理仅有适度的检测质量折衷。
tldr: CABLE improves edge-to-cloud V2X perception by propagating cloud segmentation masks on the edge to define a ROI, uploading only masked images, and feeding cloud outputs back as priors, achieving large bandwidth savings and LMM prefill speedup with minimal detection loss.
tldr_zh: CABLE通过将云端分割掩码在边缘传播以定义感兴趣区域（ROI）、仅上传掩码图像并将云端输出反馈为下一帧先验，大幅节省V2X感知中的通信带宽并加速LMM预填充，同时检测性能损失很小。

title: OneCanvas: 3D Scene Understanding via Panoramic Reprojection
summary: Existing approaches to 3D scene understanding in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) either rely on complex, model-specific geometry encoders or large training budgets in pursuit of spatial reasoning. Instead, OneCanvas aggregates patch features from all views onto a single equirectangular panoramic canvas. Namely, each patch is unprojected to a 3D world coordinate using its depth and camera pose, then placed on the canvas at the continuous longitude and latitude of that point as seen from the canvas origin, with no rasterization or aggregation across overlapping views. A 3D position embedding of the patch's metric coordinates is added to its feature, restoring the depth lost when collapsing the world position to an angular canvas coordinate. Patches from all frames thus share one spatial coordinate system with no fusion or major architectural modifications of the backbone. The pretrained VLM consumes this representation as if it were an ordinary image. Because the canvas can be centered on any pose of interest, the same representation directly supports situated reasoning from a specific viewpoint, a common requirement in robotics and embodied AI. Thanks to this representation, we can also introduce a spatial pretraining curriculum: by procedurally placing patch features of objects, drawn from real images, at chosen 3D world positions on an otherwise empty canvas, we generate on-the-fly supervision spanning a broad range of spatial reasoning tasks, with answer distributions controlled to reduce spatial reasoning shortcuts. OneCanvas achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SQA3D and VSI-Bench, and generalizes to out-of-distribution data on SPBench, using an order of magnitude less training compute than the strongest competing methods.
summary_zh: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的三维场景理解方法，要么依赖复杂的、模型专用的几何编码器，要么为追求空间推理能力而投入大量训练预算。与之不同，OneCanvas将所有视角的图像块特征聚合到单一等距柱面全景画布上。具体来说，每个图像块利用其深度和相机姿态被反投影到三维世界坐标中，然后以该点相对于画布原点的连续经纬度坐标放置在画布上，过程中无需进行光栅化或跨重叠视图的聚合操作。图像块度量坐标的三维位置嵌入被添加到其特征中，从而恢复将世界位置压缩为角度画布坐标时丢失的深度信息。因此，所有帧的图像块共享一个空间坐标系，无需对主干网络进行融合或重大架构修改。预训练的VLM可像处理普通图像一样消费这一表征。由于画布可以以任意感兴趣的姿态为中心，同一表征可直接支持从特定视角进行情景推理，这是机器人和具身智能领域的常见需求。借助这种表征，我们还可以引入空间预训练课程：通过将真实图像中提取的物体图像块特征，以程序化方式放置在空白画布上选定的三维世界位置，我们能够实时生成覆盖广泛空间推理任务的监督信号，并通过控制答案分布来减少空间推理捷径。OneCanvas在SQA3D和VSI-Bench上达到了最先进的准确率，并能泛化至SPBench上的分布外数据，而训练计算量比最强竞争方法低一个数量级。
tldr: OneCanvas projects multi-view patch features onto a single panoramic canvas with 3D position embeddings, enabling a pretrained VLM to perform 3D scene understanding without complex architectural changes, and achieves SOTA on spatial reasoning benchmarks with lower training compute.
tldr_zh: OneCanvas 将多视图的补丁特征投影到单一全景画布上，并添加 3D 位置编码，使预训练的 VLM 无需复杂架构修改即可进行 3D 场景理解，在空间推理基准上以更少的训练计算达到 SOTA。

title: Mobile Pedipulation for Object Sliding via Hierarchical Control on a Wheeled Bipedal Robot
summary: In this letter, we present a hierarchical control framework that enables wheeled bipedal robots to perform planar object sliding tasks with their wheeled legs. The proposed approach formulates a nonlinear model predictive controller (NMPC) based on a reduced-order three rigid bodies (TRB) dynamical model that explicitly accounts for the hip roll degree of freedom and multiple wheel-environment contact modes, which is essential for lateral stepping and pedipulation tasks. Within this framework, the NMPC simultaneously regulates robot locomotion and interaction forces, allowing the robot to stably execute both rolling and object manipulation behaviors. A trajectory-optimization-based robot-object motion planner is developed to generate reference motions that incorporate stick-slip transitions in ground-object contact. Two representative pedipulation motions, namely scooting and lateral sliding, are validated through real-world hardware experiments, in which the robot successfully retrieves a 1 kg object from under a desk and slides a 4 kg object over a distance of 0.228 m via scooting.
summary_zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了一种分层控制框架，使轮式双足机器人能够利用其轮式腿执行平面物体滑动任务。所提出的方法构建了一个基于三刚体（TRB）降阶动力学模型的非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC），该模型显式考虑了髋关节侧摆自由度及多种轮地接触模式，这对于侧向跨步和腿部操控任务至关重要。在该框架下，NMPC同时调节机器人 locomotion 与交互力，使机器人能够稳定执行滚动和物体操控行为。我们开发了一种基于轨迹优化的机器人-物体运动规划器，能够生成包含地面-物体接触中粘滑过渡的参考运动。通过实物硬件实验验证了两种代表性的腿部操控动作——侧滑与平移滑动，实验中机器人成功从桌底取出1千克物体，并通过平移滑动将4千克物体推移0.228米。
tldr: A hierarchical control framework enabling wheeled bipedal robots to perform planar object sliding (pedipulation) using a reduced-order model NMPC and trajectory optimization, validated on real hardware.
tldr_zh: 提出一种分层控制框架，使轮式双足机器人能够通过简化模型NMPC和轨迹优化实现平面物体滑动（足部操作），并在真实硬件上验证。

title: FAST-LIVGO: A Degeneracy-Robust LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-GNSS Fusion Odometry
summary: Robust state estimation and mapping in long-term, large-scale, and highly dynamic environments remains a key challenge in robotics. Existing LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) systems achieve strong local accuracy but suffer from accumulated drift over long distances and may fail in geometrically degraded or textureless scenes. Meanwhile, GNSS-aided fusion frameworks often rely on LiDAR or visual odometry for state prediction and outlier rejection, making them vulnerable when odometry degenerates. To address these limitations, we propose a tightly coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-GNSS fusion framework based on an Error-State Iterated Kalman Filter. An online spatiotemporal alignment module using Dynamic Time Warping is introduced for highly dynamic conditions. To better exploit GNSS precision, we develop observation models based on Doppler shifts and fixed-anchor Time-Differenced Carrier Phase, providing millimeter-level relative constraints without augmenting historical anchor states. We further design a degeneracy-aware dual-mode outlier rejection strategy that switches between LIVO-prior-guided rejection and GNSS-aided recovery according to the LIVO degeneracy level. Experiments on the public M3DGR dataset and a custom 20~m/s fixed-wing UAV dataset demonstrate that our system reduces accumulated drift and map ghosting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and robustness.
summary_zh: 鲁棒的状态估计与建图在长期、大规模且高度动态的环境中仍是机器人领域的关键挑战。现有的激光-惯性-视觉里程计系统虽能实现较高的局部精度，但在长距离运行中会产生累积漂移，并可能在几何退化或无纹理场景中失效。与此同时，GNSS辅助的融合框架通常依赖激光或视觉里程计进行状态预测与异常值剔除，当里程计退化时容易失效。为解决上述局限，我们提出一种基于误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波的紧耦合激光-惯性-视觉-GNSS融合框架。针对高度动态条件，引入基于动态时间规整的在线时空对齐模块。为更充分利用GNSS精度，我们基于多普勒频移和固定锚点时间差分载波相位建立观测模型，在无需扩充历史锚点状态的前提下提供毫米级相对约束。进一步设计了一种退化感知的双模式异常值剔除策略，根据激光-惯性-视觉里程计退化程度，在优先引导剔除与GNSS辅助恢复模式间切换。在公共M3DGR数据集及自研20米/秒固定翼无人机数据集上的实验表明，本系统有效降低了累积漂移与地图重影，在精度与鲁棒性上均超越现有最优方法。
tldr: A tightly coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-GNSS fusion odometry framework that uses a degeneracy-aware dual-mode outlier rejection and Doppler/TDCP-based GNSS models to reduce drift in long-range, dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 一种基于误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波的紧耦合 LiDAR-惯性-视觉-GNSS 融合里程计框架，通过退化感知双模式异常值抑制和基于多普勒/时差载波相位的 GNSS 观测模型，减少长距离、动态环境中的漂移和地图重影。

title: FlexLAM: Resolving the Bottleneck Trade-off in Latent Action Learning
summary: Latent actions provide a compact interface between action-free video and downstream decision-making, yet existing Latent Action Models (LAMs) force every transition through a fixed-capacity bottleneck. We identify a bottleneck trade-off: overly tight codes can discard transition cues needed for action alignment, while overly loose codes preserve additional transition variation that must be resolved when alignment labels are scarce or narrowly distributed. FlexLAM replaces this fixed capacity with variable-length latent actions trained by nested dropout, yielding prefix-valid codes that capture compact transition structure first and add detail only when needed, without new architectures or losses. A single FlexLAM matches or surpasses separately trained fixed-capacity LAMs at every evaluated token budget under standard scarce-label supervision and under a low-return single-task alignment stress test, indicating that FlexLAM is not merely adjustable at inference time but learns a better latent-action interface at the same token budgets. The same model supports inference-time token-budget adjustment without retraining, and FlexLAM improves Ego4D transition reconstruction. These results suggest that variable-length latent actions are an architecture-free, drop-in upgrade to the fixed-capacity bottleneck in latent action models, latent-action world models, and video-pretrained action interfaces.
summary_zh: 潜在动作为无动作视频与下游决策之间提供了紧凑的接口，然而现有的潜在动作模型（LAMs）强制要求每一次转换都需经过固定容量的瓶颈。我们发现了一个瓶颈权衡问题：过于紧凑的编码会丢弃动作对齐所需的转换线索，而过于宽松的编码则会保留额外的转换变异，当对齐标签稀缺或分布狭窄时，这些变异必须被解析。FlexLAM通过嵌套丢弃法训练的变长潜在动作取代了这种固定容量，生成了前缀有效的编码，这些编码首先捕获紧凑的转换结构，仅在必要时添加细节，而无需引入新架构或损失函数。在标准的稀疏标签监督下以及在低回报单任务对齐压力测试中，单个FlexLAM在每一个评估的令牌预算下，均能达到或超越分别训练的固定容量LAMs的性能。这表明FlexLAM不仅能在推理时调整，还能在相同令牌预算下学习到更好的潜在动作接口。同一模型支持推理时无需重新训练的令牌预算调整，并且FlexLAM改进了Ego4D转换重建效果。这些结果表明，变长潜在动作是对潜在动作模型、潜在动作世界模型及视频预训练动作接口中固定容量瓶颈的一种无需架构调整、即插即用的升级方案。
tldr: FlexLAM replaces fixed-capacity latent action bottlenecks with variable-length codes via nested dropout, resolving a trade-off between discarding and preserving transition details and improving transition reconstruction and alignment under scarce labels.
tldr_zh: FlexLAM通过嵌套dropout用可变长度潜变量代码替代固定容量的潜动作瓶颈，解决了丢弃或保留过渡细节之间的权衡，在标签稀缺下改进了过渡重建和对齐。

title: Monocular 3D Occupancy Perception for Robots on Sidewalks via Hybrid 2D-3D Learning
summary: Sidewalks in the real world are crowded, cluttered, and less structured than roads, making 3D occupancy prediction a key ingredient for the safe navigation of mobile robots such as delivery bots and electric wheelchairs. Existing occupancy learning pipelines are largely designed for on-road autonomous driving and often train on large-scale paired LiDAR-RGB datasets with dense 3D supervision and multiple camera inputs, which are costly to collect and do not adequately capture sidewalk-specific characteristics. We propose WalkOCC, a hybrid Ray-marching monocular 3D occupancy perception framework for robots operating on sidewalks. WalkOCC explicitly couples geometric grounding from LiDAR-RGB paired data with scalable learning from large-scale unpaired monocular images. It bootstraps pseudo occupancy supervision from paired sequences and jointly learns image-level representations on additional 2D-only data. It yields stable optimization and improved generalization without requiring costly 3D occupancy annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains in prediction accuracy, fine-grained segmentation of subtle urban structures such as curbs and gutters, and robustness to environmental and cross-embodiment shifts compared with self-supervised image-based baselines. To facilitate evaluation and benchmarking, we also introduce Sidewalk3D, a large-scale sidewalk perception dataset with LiDAR-camera paired sequences collected across multiple locations and time periods, along with 3D semantic occupancy annotations for evaluation. Code and data will be made available.
summary_zh: 现实世界中的人行道拥挤、杂乱且结构不如道路规整，这使得三维占用预测成为送餐机器人、电动轮椅等移动机器人安全导航的关键要素。现有的占用学习管线主要面向道路自动驾驶场景设计，通常依赖大规模配准的激光雷达-RGB数据集进行训练，需要密集的三维监督信号和多摄像头输入，成本高昂且难以充分捕捉人行道的独特特征。我们提出WalkOCC——一种面向人行道作业机器人的混合式射线追踪单目三维占用感知框架。该框架通过显式耦合激光雷达-RGB配对数据中的几何先验与大尺度非配对单目图像的可扩展学习能力，利用配对序列引导生成伪占用监督信号，并在额外纯二维数据上联合学习图像级表征。该方法在无需昂贵三维占用标注的情况下实现了稳定优化与泛化性能提升。大量实验表明，与基于自监督图像的基准方法相比，本方法在预测精度、路缘/排水沟等细微城市结构的细粒度分割以及环境与跨形态场景变化的鲁棒性方面均取得持续改进。为便于评估与基准测试，我们还发布了Sidewalk3D——涵盖多时段多地点采集的激光雷达-相机配对序列的大规模人行道感知数据集，并附带用于评估的三维语义占用标注。代码与数据将开源。
tldr: A monocular 3D occupancy perception framework for sidewalk robots, using hybrid 2D-3D learning to combine LiDAR-RGB geometric grounding with scalable unpaired image learning, and introducing the Sidewalk3D dataset.
tldr_zh: 一个针对人行道机器人的单目3D占据感知框架，通过混合2D-3D学习结合激光雷达-RGB几何信息与可扩展的无配对图像学习，并引入了Sidewalk3D数据集。

title: GCNGrasp-VP: Affordance-Guided View Planning for Efficient Task-Oriented Grasping
summary: Task-oriented grasping performance degrades significantly when object views suffer from occlusions. Existing task-oriented grasping methods typically assume task-relevant regions are visible in the initial frame, while view planning approaches enable active perception but often ignore task semantics and rely on time-consuming scene reconstruction. To address these limitations, we present GCNGrasp-VP, an efficient framework integrating affordance field prediction with active view planning. Central to this framework is GCNGrasp-v2, a task-oriented grasp model that simultaneously supports grasp evaluation and affordance field prediction, achieving constant-time inference complexity. Leveraging this capability, our Affordance-guided View Planner (Affordance-VP) utilizes the affordance field as an information gain metric to guide camera observation of task-relevant regions without requiring scene reconstruction. View planning results show that our method significantly outperforms scene-uncertainty-driven baselines with only one view adjustment. Real-world validation further confirms substantial improvements in grasp success rates for single-object scenarios while maintaining millisecond-level computational latency. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Instinct323/GCNGrasp-VP.
summary_zh: 面向任务的抓取性能在目标视角存在遮挡时会显著下降。现有面向任务的抓取方法通常假设初始视角中任务相关区域可见，而视角规划方法虽能实现主动感知，却往往忽略任务语义并依赖耗时场景重建。为解决上述局限，我们提出GCNGrasp-VP——一种将可供性场预测与主动视角规划相结合的高效框架。该框架的核心是GCNGrasp-v2，一种同时支持抓取评估与可供性场预测的面向任务抓取模型，实现了恒定时间推理复杂度。基于此能力，我们提出的可供性引导视角规划器（Affordance-VP）将可供性场作为信息增益度量指标，无需场景重建即可引导相机观测任务相关区域。视角规划结果表明，本方法仅通过单次视角调整即显著优于基于场景不确定性的基线方法。实际场景验证进一步证实，该方法能在维持毫秒级计算延时的同时，大幅提升单物体场景的抓取成功率。代码与模型已开源至https://github.com/Instinct323/GCNGrasp-VP。
tldr: GCNGrasp-VP integrates affordance field prediction into active view planning for task-oriented grasping, enabling efficient occlusion handling without scene reconstruction and achieving millisecond-level latency.
tldr_zh: GCNGrasp-VP 将可供性场预测集成到主动视角规划中，无需场景重建即可高效处理遮挡问题，实现毫秒级延迟并获得抓取成功率提升。

title: ART-VS: Adaptive Resolution Tiling for Vision Transformer Visual Servoing
summary: Visual servoing with self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) features enables training-free robotic positioning with strong generalization, but faces a fundamental trade-off between robustness and precision. Coarse patch-level descriptors provide stable correspondences yet limit positioning accuracy. Increasing image resolution improves precision but yields only marginal robustness gains - under perturbation, high-resolution processing improves convergence success rate from 76.6% to just 81.0% despite 12x more ViT patches. Therefore, we propose Adaptive Resolution Tiling Visual Servoing (ART-VS), a two-phase method that adapts feature granularity to servoing progress: a coarse phase at native ViT resolution for stable alignment, then a tiled high-resolution phase that restricts matching to local neighborhoods improving positioning accuracy. Without any task-specific training, ART-VS achieves 95.4% convergence under perturbation, outperforming standard and full-resolution ViT-based servoing by 18.8 and 14.4 percentage points. Over the former it reduces positioning error by 53%, while running at over 10x higher speed and 27% lower VRAM than the latter. We validate ART-VS across three ViT backbones and demonstrate real-world category-level grasping of unseen object instances, achieving 95/100 on transparent bottles and 98/100 on shoes. Code available under https://art-vs.github.io/.
summary_zh: 采用自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）特征的视觉伺服方法，无需训练即可实现强泛化能力的机器人定位，但面临鲁棒性与精度之间的根本性权衡。粗粒度图像块级描述符能提供稳定对应关系，却限制了定位精度。提升图像分辨率可改善精度，但仅带来微弱的鲁棒性增益——在扰动条件下，尽管ViT图像块数量增加12倍，高分辨率处理仅将收敛成功率从76.6%提升至81.0%。为此，我们提出自适应分辨率分块视觉伺服（ART-VS）方法，该两阶段方案根据伺服进程自适应调整特征粒度：首先在原始ViT分辨率下进行粗粒度阶段实现稳定对齐，随后转入分块高分辨率阶段，将匹配限制在局部邻域内以提升定位精度。无需任何任务特定训练，ART-VS在扰动条件下达到95.4%的收敛率，较标准分辨率和全分辨率ViT伺服方法分别提升18.8和14.4个百分点。与前者相比，定位误差降低53%，同时以后者10倍以上的速度和27%更低的显存消耗运行。我们在三种ViT骨干网络上验证了ART-VS性能，并在真实场景中实现了未见物体实例的类别级抓取：透明瓶装物95/100成功率，鞋类98/100成功率。代码发布于https://art-vs.github.io/。
tldr: ART-VS proposes an adaptive resolution tiling method for Vision Transformer visual servoing that improves both robustness and precision by switching from coarse to high-resolution tiled patches during alignment, achieving superior convergence and speed without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: ART-VS 提出了一种自适应分辨率分块方法，用于 Vision Transformer 视觉伺服，通过在对齐过程中从粗粒度切换到高分辨率分块补丁，在无需特定任务训练的情况下实现了更优的收敛性和速度。

title: Sensor Configuration Matters: A Systematic Evaluation of Multimodal SLAM on Quadruped Robots
summary: Autonomous navigation of quadrupedal robots in diverse environments fundamentally relies on resilient Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While visual-inertial SLAM has matured across wheeled, handheld, and aerial platforms, a critical evaluation gap remains regarding how hardware-level sensor configurations affect performance under the aggressive dynamics of legged locomotion. Quadrupeds introduce distinct embodiment-induced sensory challenges, including foot-impact shocks, high-frequency mechanical vibrations, and rapid angular rotations, which degrade standard perception pipelines. To address this gap, we present a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art visual, visual-inertial, and LiDAR-visual-inertial SLAM methods using the GrandTour dataset recorded on an ANYmal D quadruped. We isolate and quantify the impacts of camera modalities, shutter techniques, and inertial sensor tiers, analyzing their trade-offs across localization accuracy, algorithmic robustness, and computational resource utilization. Our empirical findings demonstrate that hardware selection has substantial influence on system resilience: stereo configurations consistently outperform monocular and RGB-D modalities, global shutter cameras significantly mitigate motion-induced tracking failures compared to rolling shutter cameras, and, crucially, standard inertial integration can degrade the performance of primarily vision-based frameworks under harsh legged locomotion. These insights additionally offer concrete design guidelines for tailoring custom sensor payloads to achieve dependable perception on agile legged systems.
summary_zh: 四足机器人在复杂环境中的自主导航根本上有赖于鲁棒的同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）。虽然视觉-惯性SLAM已在轮式、手持和空中平台上趋于成熟，但在足式运动剧烈动力学条件下，硬件级传感器配置如何影响性能仍存在关键评估空白。四足机器人会带来独特的具身感知挑战，包括足部冲击、高频机械振动和快速角运动，这些都会降低标准感知流程的性能。为填补这一空白，我们利用在ANYmal D型四足机器人上采集的GrandTour数据集，对当前先进的视觉、视觉-惯性及激光雷达-视觉-惯性SLAM方法进行了系统性评估。我们分离并量化了相机模态、快门类型和惯性传感器等级的影响，分析了它们在定位精度、算法鲁棒性和计算资源利用之间的权衡。实验结果表明，硬件选择对系统鲁棒性具有显著影响：立体配置持续优于单目和RGB-D模态；相较于卷帘快门相机，全局快门相机能显著减少运动导致的跟踪失败；尤为关键的是，在剧烈的足式运动下，标准惯性融合反而可能降低以视觉为主的框架的性能。这些发现还为定制传感器载荷提供了具体设计指导，以实现敏捷足式系统的可靠感知。
tldr: Empirical evaluation of how sensor configuration (camera type, shutter, inertial tier) affects SLAM performance on a quadruped robot under legged locomotion dynamics.
tldr_zh: 系统评估了传感器配置（相机类型、快门、惯性层级）对四足机器人SLAM在腿部运动动态下性能的影响。

title: DiffusionVS: A Generative Framework for Robust Visual Servoing Based on Diffusion Policy
summary:
Visual servoing is a fundamental technique in robotic manipulation and navigation. Regression-based visual servoing frequently experiences trajectory jitter as a result of noise-sensitive single-step mappings and the accumulation of errors during distribution shifts. In contrast, Diffusion Policy maintains temporal consistency by predicting action sequences and improves robustness through implicit data augmentation.
  This paper presents a novel diffusion-based servoing method. Based on Diffusion Policy, the proposed approach uses normalized image coordinates of observed tag corners as input and generates camera velocity through conditional denoising. To overcome the generalization limitations of models trained on static datasets, an online training paradigm is adopted, continuously expanding the diversity of training data through interactive experience collection. This strategy substantially enhances both the performance and generalization capability of the model. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving success rates of nearly 100\% in simulation and 93\% in physical experiments. Beyond the specific pipeline, we further validate the generality of the diffusion mechanism. Experiments show that existing visual servoing networks consistently achieve improved performance when integrated with our diffusion-based module. These results indicate that the proposed strategy possesses broad applicability and can enhance various visual servoing systems beyond the specific architecture presented here.
summary_zh:
视觉伺服是机器人操作与导航中的一项基础技术。基于回归的视觉伺服方法常因噪声敏感的单步映射以及分布偏移中的误差累积而出现轨迹抖动。相比之下，扩散策略通过预测动作序列保持时间一致性，并利用隐式数据增强提升鲁棒性。

本文提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的伺服方法。该方法以扩散策略为基础，将观测到的标签角点的归一化图像坐标作为输入，通过条件去噪生成相机速度。为克服基于静态数据集训练的模型在泛化能力上的局限，本文采用了在线训练范式，通过交互式经验采集持续扩展训练数据的多样性。该策略显著提升了模型的性能与泛化能力。全面的仿真及真实世界实验验证了所提方法的有效性，在仿真中实现了近100%的成功率，在物理实验中实现了93%的成功率。除了具体的流程之外，本文进一步验证了扩散机制的通用性。实验表明，当集成基于扩散的模块时，现有视觉伺服网络的性能均得到一致提升。这些结果表明，所提策略具备广泛的适用性，能够超越本文所呈现的具体架构，增强多种视觉伺服系统。
tldr: This paper introduces a diffusion policy-based visual servoing framework that uses conditional denoising to generate smooth camera velocity commands, overcoming trajectory jitter and generalization issues via online training, achieving high success in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于扩散策略的视觉伺服框架，通过条件去噪生成平滑的相机速度指令，并利用在线训练克服轨迹抖动和泛化问题，在仿真和真实实验中均取得了高成功率。

title: Generating Natural and Expressive Robot Gestures through Iterative Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback using LLMs
summary: Expressive gestures are essential for natural and effective communication, complementing speech when verbal cues alone are insufficient (e.g., pointing). For social robots such as the humanoid Pepper, producing natural and expressive movements is critical for improving human-robot interaction (HRI) and long-term acceptance. However, generating gestures remains challenging due to reliance on expert-authored animations, resulting in rigid behaviors that are impractical for dynamic and diverse environments. Alternatively, machine learning approaches often struggle to capture perceived naturalness, becoming increasingly challenging with more degrees of freedom. Consequently, producing expressive robot gestures requires a system that can adapt to the environment while adhering to social norms and physical constraints. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable dynamic code generation, offering new opportunities for runtime gesture synthesis from natural language. In this paper, we integrate ChatGPT into the humanoid robot Pepper to generate co-speech gestures aligned with conversational output. While this baseline enables flexible gesture generation, the resulting motions are often perceived as stiff and unnatural. To address this limitation, we introduce an iterative reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) system that finetunes gesture generation based on user evaluations, leveraging an iterative user study to compare Pepper's generated gestures. Our results show that RLHF improved the LLM's co-speech generative capabilities, producing more expressive, relevant and fluid movements.
summary_zh: 表达性手势对于自然且有效的沟通至关重要，能在仅靠言语提示不足时（例如指向动作）补充语言。对于像人形机器人Pepper这样的社交机器人而言，产生自然且富有表现力的动作，对于改善人机交互及长期接受度至关重要。然而，由于依赖专家编写的动画，生成手势仍具挑战性，这导致机器人行为僵化，难以适应动态多样的环境。另一方面，机器学习方法往往难以捕捉人类感知的自然性，且随着自由度的增加，挑战也愈发艰巨。因此，生成富有表现力的机器人手势需要一个既能适应环境，又能遵循社会规范与物理约束的系统。大语言模型的最新进展实现了动态代码生成，为根据自然语言实时合成手势带来了新机遇。本文中，我们将ChatGPT集成到人形机器人Pepper中，以生成与对话输出相一致的伴随语言手势。尽管这一基线方案实现了灵活的手势生成，但生成的动作往往被感知为生硬且不自然。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一种基于人类反馈的迭代强化学习系统，根据用户评价对手势生成进行微调，并通过迭代用户研究比较Pepper生成的手势。结果表明，RLHF提升了大语言模型在伴随语言手势生成方面的能力，产生了更具表现力、相关性更强且更流畅的动作。
tldr: This paper uses LLMs and iterative reinforcement learning with human feedback to generate natural, expressive co-speech gestures on a humanoid robot (Pepper), addressing the stiffness of baseline LLM-generated motions.
tldr_zh: 本文利用大语言模型和迭代式人类反馈强化学习，在类人机器人Pepper上生成自然、富有表现力的共语手势，改善了基线LLM生成动作的僵硬问题。

title: Stealthy World Model Manipulation via Data Poisoning
summary: Model-based learning agents use learned world models to predict future states, plan actions, and adapt to new environments. However, the process of updating world models from collected experience creates a training-time attack surface: adversarially poisoned fine-tuning trajectories can manipulate the learned dynamics and thereby corrupt downstream planning. In this paper, we propose SWAAP, the first two-stage data poisoning framework for learned world models. In the first stage, SWAAP identifies a harmful target world model that induces low-return behavior under planning while remaining close to clean dynamics, using first-order bilevel optimization enabled by a transition-gradient theorem. In the second stage, SWAAP realizes this target through stealth-constrained gradient matching, modifying only a limited fraction of fine-tuning transition targets so that the induced training gradients steer the victim model toward the adversarial target, while a prediction-error regularizer encourages the poisoned targets to remain close to the world model's natural approximation error. To assess attack stealthiness, we evaluate defenses and detectability across three stages of the poisoning pipeline: pre-training detection of poisoned transitions, robust training during fine-tuning, and test-time monitoring of the resulting world model. Across diverse continuous-control tasks, SWAAP causes substantial performance degradation while keeping poisoned transitions close to clean data and evading the evaluated non-adaptive residual/CUSUM/TRIM-style defenses. These results reveal a practical vulnerability in world-model adaptation pipelines and highlight the need for robustness methods that protect both world-model training data and learned dynamics.
summary_zh: 基于模型的学习智能体利用学得的世界模型来预测未来状态、规划行动并适应新环境。然而，从收集的经验中更新世界模型的过程产生了一个训练时攻击面：对抗性污染的微调轨迹可以操纵学得的动态特性，进而破坏下游规划。本文提出SWAAP，这是首个针对学得世界模型的两阶段数据投毒框架。在第一阶段，SWAAP利用基于转移梯度定理的一阶双层优化，识别出一个有害的目标世界模型，该模型在规划下诱导低回报行为，同时保持与清洁动态的接近性。在第二阶段，SWAAP通过隐蔽约束的梯度匹配实现该目标，仅修改有限比例的微调转移目标，使诱导的训练梯度将受害者模型引向对抗目标，同时预测误差正则化器促使被污染目标保持接近世界模型的自然逼近误差。为评估攻击隐蔽性，我们在投毒管道的三个阶段评估防御措施与可检测性：微调后受污染转移的预训练检测、微调过程中的鲁棒训练，以及所得世界模型的测试时监控。在多种连续控制任务中，SWAAP导致显著的性能下降，同时保持被污染转移接近清洁数据，并规避了评估中的非自适应残差/CUSUM/TRIM类防御。这些结果揭示了世界模型适应管道中的实际脆弱性，并凸显了保护世界模型训练数据与学得动态的鲁棒性方法的必要性。
tldr: This paper proposes SWAAP, the first data poisoning framework targeting learned world models in model-based reinforcement learning, demonstrating that stealthily poisoned fine-tuning trajectories can degrade downstream planning performance while evading common defenses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SWAAP，首个针对基于模型强化学习中世界模型的数据投毒框架，展示了通过隐蔽投毒的微调轨迹可降低下游规划性能并规避常见防御。

title: EffiNav: Fusing Depth and Vision-Language for Efficient Object Goal Navigation
summary: To locate a target object while exploring the unknown environment is a fundamental capability for autonomous agents, with applications ranging from search-and-rescue to field robots. A simplified version of such task is Object Goal Navigation (ObjNav). In ObjNav, successful arrival at the target object provides a basic measure of performance; however, the efficiency of the navigation trajectory is equally important, as it indicates how intelligently the agent explores and how much time remains for subsequent tasks. In unknown environments, the key to efficient navigation lies in deciding where to explore next. While many prior works aim to address this core challenge and achieved promising performance in certain settings, recent training-based models and non-training frameworks still suffer from generalization and efficiency issues respectively, which in the worst cases can lead to excessive exploration of already-visited areas or redundant back-and-forth motion. We evaluate EffiNav on two widely used simulation benchmarks Habitat Matterport 3D (HM3D) and Open-Vocabulary Object goal Navigation (OVON), and further validate its effectiveness on physical robots in real-world settings. We conduct failure analysis on massive simulation episodes. With minimal modification, we also extend EffiNav to a memory-augmented ObjNav task on the GOAT-BENCH dataset, demonstrating its adaptability beyond standard ObjNav settings. Across two standard metrics--Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL), EffiNav matches or outperforms recent baselines, reflecting its efficiency, robustness, and practical applicability. Recognizing the different emphases of the two datasets, the performances reveals this framework is more balanced and generalizable for efficient ObjNav.
summary_zh: 在未知环境中探索并定位目标物体，是自主智能体的核心能力，其应用涵盖搜索救援与现场机器人等领域。该任务的简化形式即目标物体导航（ObjNav）。在目标物体导航中，成功抵达目标位置是衡量性能的基础指标；然而，导航轨迹的效率同样关键——它既体现智能体探索的智能程度，也反映后续任务可用的剩余时间。未知环境中高效导航的关键在于决定下一步探索方向。尽管诸多前期研究致力于解决这一核心挑战，并在特定场景下取得了显著成效，但近期基于训练的模型与非训练框架仍分别面临泛化性与效率问题，最坏情况下可能导致对已探索区域的过度遍历或冗余的往返运动。我们提出的EffiNav框架在两大主流仿真基准——Habitat Matterport 3D（HM3D）与开放词汇目标导航（OVON）上进行了评估，并在真实场景的物理机器人上验证了其有效性。基于大规模仿真场景的失败分析表明，通过最小化修改，我们还将EffiNav扩展至GOAT-BENCH数据集上的记忆增强型目标物体导航任务，验证了其在标准设定之外的适应性。在成功率（SR）与路径长度加权成功率（SPL）两项标准指标上，EffiNav达到或超越了最新基准方法，彰显了其高效性、鲁棒性与实际应用价值。针对两个数据集的不同侧重点，性能表现揭示该框架在高效目标物体导航任务中展现出更均衡的特性与更优的泛化能力。
tldr: EffiNav fuses depth and vision-language models for efficient object goal navigation, achieving strong success rate and path efficiency across simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: EffiNav 融合深度与视觉语言模型，实现高效的目标物体导航，在仿真和真实环境中均取得了良好的成功率与路径效率。

title: SRL: Combining SLIP Model and Reinforcement Learning for Agile Robotic Jumping
summary: Robotic jumping is pivotal in applications such as search and rescue and logistics, where crossing obstacles and enhancing mobility efficiency are critical. The Spring-Loaded Inverted Pendulum (SLIP) model leverages simplified spring-mass dynamics that naturally encode biologically plausible hopping motions, yet its performance degrades on irregular terrain due to idealized assumptions regarding contact and joint dynamics. Meanwhile, Reinforcement Learning (RL) can adapt to diverse and complex environments but often requires extensive data from unguided exploration. The complementary strengths of SLIP's physically grounded baseline and RL's adaptive capabilities motivate a hybrid framework that overcomes these individual limitations. We therefore propose Spring-loaded Reinforcement Learning (SRL), which integrates SLIP-based feedforward control signals with RL-driven real-time feedback, enabling continuous optimization of robotic jumping. Experimental results demonstrate that SRL can achieve more stable jumps with much less training time than the baseline method, maintaining an average position tracking error below 0.1 m and velocity tracking errors within +/-3% of the target values. Through bipedal and quadrupedal simulations of ground and stair jumping, as well as sim-to-sim and sim-to-real validations, SRL exhibits robust adaptability to various task requirements and environmental complexities, underscoring its potential for real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 机器人跳跃在搜索救援与物流等应用中至关重要，此类场景下跨越障碍与提升机动效率尤为关键。弹簧负载倒立摆（SLIP）模型利用简化的弹簧-质量动力学特性，能够自然生成符合生物机制的跳跃动作，但由于其对接触与关节动力学的理想化假设，在非平坦地形上的性能会有所下降。与此同时，强化学习（RL）可适应多样化的复杂环境，但通常需要从无引导探索中获取大量数据。SLIP的物理基准基础与RL的适应能力形成互补优势，这促使我们提出一种能够克服各自局限性的混合框架。为此，我们提出弹簧负载强化学习（SRL），该方法将基于SLIP的前馈控制信号与RL驱动的实时反馈相结合，实现对机器人跳跃的持续优化。实验结果表明，相较于基线方法，SRL能以更少的训练时间实现更稳定的跳跃，其平均位置跟踪误差保持在0.1米以下，速度跟踪误差控制在目标值的±3%以内。通过双足与四足机器人的地面及楼梯跳跃仿真，以及仿真到仿真与仿真到现实的验证，SRL展现出对各类任务需求与环境复杂性的强适应性，凸显了其在实际部署中的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes Spring-loaded Reinforcement Learning (SRL), a hybrid framework integrating SLIP model feedforward control with RL feedback for agile robotic jumping, achieving stable jumps with reduced training time and robust adaptability in bipedal/quadrupedal simulation and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出弹簧加载强化学习（SRL），一种将SLIP模型前馈控制与强化学习反馈相结合的混合框架，用于敏捷机器人跳跃，在双足/四足仿真和仿真到现实迁移中实现了稳定跳跃、减少训练时间和鲁棒适应性。

title: Dual-Channel Grounded World Modeling (DCGWM): Structural Prevention of Objective Interference Collapse via Heterogeneous External Grounding with Inward-Only Gradient Flow
summary: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a leading approach to world model representation learning. We identify a failure mode in JEPA-based world models grounded against two qualitatively distinct external signals: physical dynamics (sparse, high-magnitude, constraint-satisfying gradient corrections) and social-behavioral dynamics (diffuse, distribution-matching corrections). We term this Objective Interference Collapse (OIC): we argue that joint learning in a shared latent space causes the dominant channel to systematically collapse the subordinate channel's representational subspace, in a manner not resolvable by loss weighting alone. We propose Dual-Channel Grounded World Modeling (DCGWM), designed to structurally prevent OIC through a partitioned latent space (physical subspace Z_p, behavioral subspace Z_b) with inward-only gradient flow. A Physical Grounding Channel updates only Z_p via VICReg-style alignment to physical measurements; a Social-Behavioral Grounding Channel updates only Z_b via alignment to trajectories from an emergent multi-agent simulation. An Inter-Channel Interface Module couples the subspaces at the task level without cross-subspace gradients. An Asymmetric Grounding Adherence Loss penalizes rollout drift with a hard hinge for physical violations and a soft KL for behavioral divergence. A Generative Rendering Layer is architecturally isolated from the latent world model. We present three theoretical results: the partition removes the gradient-interference pathway implicated in OIC; each grounded subspace inherits anti-collapse guarantees from its alignment objective; and generative isolation is necessary under a stated assumption on the generative objective's geometry. This manuscript establishes the problem formulation and architecture; experimental validation is ongoing and will be reported in a future revision.
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）是世界模型表征学习的主流方法。我们发现，基于JEPA的世界模型在面对两种性质不同的外部信号时存在失效模式：物理动力学（稀疏、高幅度、满足约束的梯度修正）与社会行为动力学（弥散、分布匹配型修正）。我们将此称为目标干扰崩溃（OIC）：我们认为，在共享潜空间中进行联合学习会导致主导通道系统性地压缩从属通道的表征子空间，且这种效应无法仅通过损失权重调整来解决。为此，我们提出双通道接地世界建模方法（DCGWM），通过分区潜空间（物理子空间Z_p、行为子空间Z_b）结合单向梯度流动，在结构上防止OIC。物理接地通道仅通过VICReg风格对齐到物理测量值来更新Z_p；社会行为接地通道仅通过对齐涌现式多智能体仿真轨迹来更新Z_b。通道间接口模块在任务层级耦合子空间，但不产生跨子空间梯度。非对称接地依从损失采用硬铰链项约束物理违规，软KL散度项约束行为偏差，对展开漂移施加惩罚。生成渲染层在架构上与潜世界模型解耦。我们提出三项理论结果：分区机制消除了与OIC相关的梯度干扰通路；各接地子空间从其对齐目标中继承了抗崩溃保障；在关于生成目标几何特性的既定假设下，生成隔离具有必要性。本文确立了问题框架与架构设计；实验验证正在进行中，将后续报告相关结果。
tldr: The paper identifies a failure mode (Objective Interference Collapse) in world models grounded against two distinct external signals and proposes a dual-channel architecture with partitioned latent spaces and inward-only gradient flow to structurally prevent it.
tldr_zh: 论文识别了在双外部信号接地下世界模型中的目标干扰坍塌失败模式，并提出一种双通道架构，通过分区潜在空间和内向梯度流从结构上防止该问题。

title: Modeling Branches for Active Manipulation using Iterative Parameter Estimation
summary: This study presents a method for modeling diverse plant branches by iteratively estimating material parameters to support delicate branch manipulation. Branch manipulation is necessary in agricultural robotics for plant repositioning, stabilizing, and clearing visual obstructions in dense foliage. The proposed method builds a tetrahedral branch model from point-cloud data and simulates its behavior using the finite element method. Using real observed deformation data, it iteratively estimates branch parameters and then computes an optimal path with a deformation-aware motion planner to move and stabilize branches within another robot's field of view. Across 30 trials on branches with varying geometries and material properties, the proposed method reduced the deformation energy by 35.69% while increasing the path length by 8.10% on average.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种通过迭代估计材料参数来建模多样化植物枝条的方法，以支持精细化的枝条操控。在农业机器人应用中，枝条操控对于植物 repositioning、固定以及清除茂密枝叶中的视觉障碍至关重要。该方法基于点云数据构建四面体枝条模型，并利用有限元法模拟其行为。通过真实观测的形变数据，迭代估计枝条参数，随后利用考虑形变的运动规划器计算最优路径，以将枝条移动并稳定在另一台机器人的视野范围内。在30次针对不同几何形状与材料属性的枝条实验中，该方法使形变能量平均降低35.69%，同时路径长度平均增加8.10%。
tldr: This paper presents a method for modeling plant branches using iterative parameter estimation and finite element simulation, enabling gentle manipulation for agricultural robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过迭代参数估计和有限元模拟对植物枝条进行建模的方法，从而实现对农业机器人的柔性操作。

title: Seeing Through Occlusion: Deterministic Arm Kinematic Correction for Robot Teleoperation
summary: Markerless, single-RGB-D-camera motion capture provides a low-cost and non-invasive alternative to conventional marker-based systems for robot teleoperation; however, depth estimation often degrades in the presence of self-occlusion, particularly during upper-limb motion. This paper presents an Arm Kinematic Correction (AKC) method that improves depth estimation by enforcing geometric constraints based on constant arm lengths. The proposed approach reconstructs occluded joint depths by leveraging wrist positions and predefined arm lengths via a deterministic formulation based on the Pythagorean theorem, thereby avoiding the need for complex probabilistic modeling or parameter tuning. Experimental validation against a Vicon reference system demonstrates reliable performance for both static and dynamic joint motions, evaluated using root-mean-square error (RMSE) and Pearson correlation. Furthermore, motion-mapping teleoperation is successfully demonstrated in both simulated and physical robot environments. The results show that AKC enhances robustness and preserves anatomical consistency under long-duration, severe self-occlusion, even when paired with less reliable temporal filters, highlighting its practicality for real-time applications such as robot teleoperation and human-robot interaction.
summary_zh: 无标记单RGB-D相机运动捕捉为机器人遥操作提供了一种低成本、非侵入性的替代传统标记点系统的方法；然而，深度估计在存在自遮挡时（尤其是上肢运动期间）常会出现退化。本文提出一种手臂运动学校正（AKC）方法，通过施加基于恒定臂长的几何约束来改善深度估计。该方法利用手腕位置和预定义臂长，基于勾股定理的确定性公式重建被遮挡的关节深度，从而避免了复杂的概率建模或参数调优。与Vicon参考系统的实验验证表明，该方法在静态和动态关节运动中均表现出可靠的性能，并采用均方根误差（RMSE）和皮尔逊相关系数进行评估。此外，在仿真和真实机器人环境中均成功展示了运动映射遥操作。结果表明，AKC即使在搭配可靠性较低的时间滤波器时，也能在长时间、严重自遮挡条件下增强鲁棒性并保持解剖一致性，突显了其在机器人遥操作与人机交互等实时应用中的实用性。
tldr: A deterministic arm kinematic correction method that improves depth estimation under self-occlusion for robot teleoperation using single RGB-D camera by enforcing constant arm length constraints.
tldr_zh: 一种确定性手臂运动学校正方法，通过强制恒定臂长约束，改善单RGB-D相机在自遮挡下的深度估计，用于机器人遥操作。

title: Constant Time-Delay Leader Following with Neural Networks and Invariant Extended Kalman Filters for Arbitrary Trajectories
summary: This paper proposes a constant time-delay trajectory tracking method for vehicle convoys operating without inter-vehicle communication, a common coordinate system, or global positioning. The method integrates a probabilistic sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) neural network with an invariant extended Kalman filter (IEKF) to warm-start the prediction process, allowing accurate estimation of a leader vehicle's relative trajectory on the SE(2) manifold. A geometric model predictive controller is further incorporated to fully exploit the manifold-based trajectory predictions for improved control performance. The system can handle arbitrary nonlinear trajectories with varying speeds and motion profiles while reducing the need for expert-based domain knowledge for the design of trajectory following systems, even under long trajectory delays. The effectiveness of the method is validated through comparisons with a pure IEKF baseline, learning-based methods, and the ground-truth trajectory in kinematic simulations, as well as in experiments using real robotic vehicles.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于无车间通信、无共同坐标系及无全局定位条件下车辆队列的恒定时滞轨迹跟踪方法。该方法将概率序列到序列（Seq2Seq）神经网络与不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器（IEKF）相结合，以热启动预测过程，从而在SE(2)流形上实现对前车相对轨迹的精确估计。进一步引入几何模型预测控制器，充分利用基于流形的轨迹预测以提升控制性能。该系统能够处理具有变速及不同运动模式的任意非线性轨迹，同时减少轨迹跟踪系统设计中对专家领域知识的依赖，即便在长时滞条件下依然有效。通过运动学仿真中与纯IEKF基线、基于学习的方法及真实轨迹的对比，以及实际机器人车辆实验，验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a constant time-delay trajectory tracking method for vehicle convoys using a Seq2Seq neural network and invariant extended Kalman filter on SE(2), validated with real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对车辆队列的恒定时延轨迹跟踪方法，结合序列到序列神经网络与不变扩展卡尔曼滤波在SE(2)流形上的应用，并通过真实机器人实验验证。

title: Viking Hill Dataset: A Lidar-Radar-Camera Dataset for Detection and Segmentation in Forest Scenes
summary: Autonomous robots operating under forest canopies need robust perception of trees and surrounding vegetation across varying seasonal conditions. Existing forestry datasets provide lidar or camera data with per-tree annotations, but none include co-registered 4D imaging radar -- a modality of growing interest for its resilience to visual degradation, surface contamination, and vegetation occlusion. We introduce a multi-sensor forest dataset collected by a mobile robot equipped with a high-resolution FMCW imaging radar, lidar, RGB camera, IMU, and RTK-GNSS. The site was recorded in two sessions under contrasting vegetation states, and 3D cuboid annotations -- including per-tree diameter estimates -- provide shared semantic labels across all three perception modalities. Furthermore, we provide baseline results for semantic segmentation of the radar and lidar point clouds using MinkowskiUNet. Radar achieves IoU scores competitive with lidar for dominant classes (ground 91%, canopy 86%) while lagging on geometrically fine structures such as tree trunks (56% vs. 74%). A cross-modality analysis further compares lidar and radar trunk segmentation against an RGB detection model, and a diameter-stratified evaluation reveals how trunk segmentation quality varies with tree size. Beyond segmentation, the co-registered multi-modal data and RTK-GNSS-aided reference positioning support research in mapping, localization, and sensor fusion under canopy. The dataset and annotation tools are publicly available.
summary_zh: 在森林冠层下运行的自主机器人需要在不同季节条件下对树木及周围植被具备鲁棒的感知能力。现有林业数据集提供了带有单棵树标注的激光雷达或相机数据，但均未包含共配准的四维成像雷达——这类传感器因其对视觉退化、表面污染及植被遮挡的鲁棒性而日益受到关注。我们介绍一个由配备高分辨率FMCW成像雷达、激光雷达、RGB相机、惯性测量单元（IMU）及实时动态差分全球导航卫星系统（RTK-GNSS）的移动机器人采集的多传感器森林数据集。该场地在两个植被状态截然不同的时段进行了记录，三维长方体标注（包含单棵树直径估计）为所有三种感知模态提供了共享语义标签。此外，我们提供了使用MinkowskiUNet对雷达和激光雷达点云进行语义分割的基线结果。在主要类别中，雷达的分割交并比（IoU）得分与激光雷达相当（地面91%、冠层86%），但在几何精细结构（如树干）方面表现落后（56%对74%）。跨模态分析进一步将激光雷达和雷达的树干分割结果与RGB检测模型进行了比较，基于直径分层的评估揭示了树干分割质量如何随树木尺寸变化。除分割外，共配准的多模态数据及RTK-GNSS辅助的参考定位支持了冠层下的地图构建、定位及传感器融合研究。该数据集与标注工具已公开提供。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-sensor forest dataset with co-registered lidar, 4D imaging radar, and RGB camera data, providing semantic annotations for tree detection and segmentation across seasonal conditions, and presents baseline segmentation results on radar and lidar point clouds.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个多传感器森林数据集，包含共配准的激光雷达、4D成像雷达和RGB相机数据，提供跨季节条件下的树木检测与分割语义标注，并展示了雷达和激光雷达点云上的基线分割结果。

title: Congestion-Aware Robot Tour Planning in Crowded Environments
summary: Autonomous mobile service robots are often required to complete tours that require navigating through a set of locations in an environment. Example domains include guiding people through a shopping mall, delivering packages in a fulfilment centre, or giving guided tours in a museum. However, in crowded environments, the presence of people may negatively impact robot performance. For example, humans will activate robot collision avoidance manoeuvres that slow the robot down. Crowds move stochastically and vary throughout the day. In this paper we present a probabilistic tour planner for crowded environments which explicitly reasons over human congestion. We learn circular linear flow field (CLiFF) maps which predict human trajectories given an initial observation. We then use these predictions to build and solve a Markov decision process online which efficiently routes the robot through the environment. Our approach is scalable enough to re-plan as new people are observed. We evaluate our approach on a real-world crowd dataset in a shopping mall.
summary_zh: 自主移动服务机器人通常需要完成一系列任务，这些任务要求机器人在环境中导航经过一组指定位置。典型应用场景包括在购物中心引导行人、在配送中心运送包裹，或在博物馆提供导览服务。然而，在拥挤环境中，人群的存在可能会对机器人性能产生负面影响。例如，行人会触发机器人的避障动作，从而降低其移动速度。人群的运动具有随机性，且在不同时段会发生变化。本文提出了一种针对拥挤环境的概率性巡游规划器，该规划器能够显式地对人群拥堵进行推理。我们学习了一种圆形线性流场（CLiFF）地图，该地图可根据初始观测数据预测行人轨迹。随后，我们利用这些预测在线构建并求解一个马尔可夫决策过程，从而高效地引导机器人穿越环境。该方法具有良好的可扩展性，能够在观测到新行人时重新规划路径。我们基于购物中心的真实人群数据集对方法进行了评估。
tldr: A probabilistic tour planner for crowded environments uses learned flow maps and online MDP solving to route robots through human congestion.
tldr_zh: 针对拥挤环境，提出一种概率性路径规划器，通过学习流场图并在线求解MDP来引导机器人避开人群。

title: TactSpace: Learning a Physics-enriched Shared Latent Space for Tactile Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: Tactile sensing provides direct measurements of contact interactions that are essential for robotic manipulation. However, current simulators lack the fidelity to faithfully model the complex deformation and transduction mechanics of tactile sensors, severely hindering sim-to-real transfer in robot learning pipelines. To address this challenge, we propose a multi-modal representation learning framework that aligns heterogeneous tactile modalities within a shared latent space, eliminating the need for accurate raw-signal simulation while preserving relevant contact information. Our approach employs modality-specific encoders to project diverse tactile observations, such as simulated penetration depth and real-world capacitance, into a common embedding space. The model is trained using self- and cross-reconstruction objectives alongside contrastive alignment, encouraging modality-invariant yet information-rich representations. We evaluate the learned embeddings on indenter shape identification, force prediction, and geometric reconstruction tasks, training exclusively in simulation and testing directly on real sensor measurements. Our results demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across physically dissimilar representations. Furthermore, incorporating multi-physics simulation modalities yields more informative embeddings that transfer across diverse downstream tasks, demonstrating a 16.7% reduction in force prediction error and a 45.8% reduction in shape reconstruction error. Finally, we release an efficient Warp-based implementation of a penalty-based tactile simulation model for Isaac Lab, enabling scalable tactile data generation.
summary_zh: 触觉传感能够直接测量接触交互信息，这对机器人操作至关重要。然而，现有仿真器缺乏足够 fidelity 来精确模拟触觉传感器的复杂形变与换能机制，严重制约了机器人学习流程中的仿真到现实迁移。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种多模态表示学习框架，将异构触觉模态对齐到共享潜空间中，在保留相关接触信息的同时，无需精确模拟原始信号。该方法采用模态特定编码器，将不同类型的触觉观测（如仿真穿透深度与真实电容值）映射至公共嵌入空间。模型通过自重构与交叉重构目标函数结合对比对齐进行训练，从而鼓励生成模态不变且信息丰富的表示。我们分别在仿真环境中训练模型，并直接对真实传感器测量值进行测试，评估其在压头形状识别、力预测及几何重构任务中的嵌入效果。结果表明，我们实现了跨物理异构表征的零样本仿真到现实迁移。此外，融合多物理场仿真模态可生成信息更丰富的嵌入表示，能够迁移至多种下游任务，使力预测误差降低16.7%，形状重构误差降低45.8%。最后，我们为Isaac Lab发布了一套基于Warp的高效惩罚式触觉仿真模型实现，支持可扩展的触觉数据生成。
tldr: A framework for sim-to-real transfer of tactile sensing in robotics, aligning simulated and real tactile modalities into a shared latent space and demonstrating zero-shot transfer.
tldr_zh: 一个用于机器人触觉传感的仿真到现实迁移框架，将模拟和真实触觉模态对齐到共享潜空间，并展示了零样本迁移。

title: High-Degree-of-Freedom Lightweight Bioinspired Leg for Enhanced Mobility in Small Robots
summary: In microrobotics, enhancing locomotion capabilities by increasing the degrees of freedom (DoF) of leg mechanisms under severe spatial constraints remains a significant challenge. Inspired by insect locomotion, this paper presents a novel micro-scale parallel leg mechanism with four degrees of freedom, and systematically analyzes its mechanical design, electrical system, and kinematics. The design incorporates two spherical five-bar linkages to achieve spatial motion within a parallel four-bar configuration. Furthermore, a concentric design strategy is employed to simplify the analytical solution of the leg kinematics. Due to the parallel system architecture, all actuators are located on the main body, substantially reducing the equivalent inertia of moving parts compared to traditional high-DOF leg structures. The total mass of the system is only 18.9 g, with an end-effector output force of approximately 0.5 N and a workspace exceeding 22255 mm3. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed single-leg mechanism achieves excellent motion flexibility, highlighting its potential for micro bio-inspired robotics.
summary_zh: 在微型机器人领域，如何在严苛的空间约束下通过增加腿部机构的自由度来提升运动能力仍是一项重大挑战。受昆虫运动启发，本文提出了一种新型四自由度微型并联腿机构，并系统分析了其机械设计、电气系统及运动学特性。该设计采用两个球面五杆机构在并联四杆构型中实现空间运动。此外，通过同心设计策略简化了腿部运动学的解析解。由于采用并联系统架构，所有驱动器均位于主体上，与传统高自由度腿部结构相比，大幅降低了运动部件的等效惯量。系统总质量仅为18.9克，末端执行器输出力约为0.5牛，工作空间超过22255立方毫米。实验结果表明，所提出的单腿机构具有优异的运动灵活性，展现了其在微型仿生机器人领域的应用潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a novel micro-scale parallel leg mechanism with four degrees of freedom inspired by insect locomotion, featuring a concentric design for simplified kinematics and a lightweight, high-output-force structure for enhanced mobility in small robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种受昆虫启发的微型并联腿机构，具有四个自由度，通过同心设计简化运动学，实现了轻量、高输出力，提升了小机器人的运动灵活性。

title: DNN Koopman-Based Deviation Compensation for UGV Path Tracking Control on Coupled Slope and Potholed Road
summary: Unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) operating in off-road scenarios are confronted with complex terrain disturbances that can substantially degrade path tracking performance. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a deep neural network (DNN) Koopman-based deviation compensation strategy for UGV path tracking control. Firstly, based on the vehicle dynamic function on coupled slope, an adaptive forgetting recursive least squares method with decoupled error terms is designed to estimate tire cornering stiffness. On this basis, a Laguerre model predictive control (LMPC) path tracking control strategy is designed by incorporating Laguerre functions, which can reduce computational resource usage while maintaining reliable tracking performance across different coupled slope scenarios. Then, by integrating Koopman operator theory with DNN, a DNN Koopman (DK) path deviation compensation method is proposed, which significantly improves the path tracking accuracy of UGV under potholed road disturbances. Furthermore, an event-triggered parallel cooperative (EPC) compensation mechanism that couples LMPC with DK is established based on compensation activation criteria and credibility verification. This mechanism improves path tracking accuracy on potholed road while ensuring the feasibility of overall steering command and stability of vehicle after DK compensation. Finally, a hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) experimental platform is constructed for validation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed UGV path tracking strategy improves tracking performance by more than 11.5% across multiple operating conditions.
summary_zh: 无人地面车辆（UGV）在越野场景中运行时面临复杂的地形扰动，这可能导致路径跟踪性能严重下降。针对这一挑战，本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络（DNN）Koopman的偏差补偿策略，用于UGV路径跟踪控制。首先，基于耦合坡道上的车辆动力学函数，设计了一种具有解耦误差项的自适应遗忘递推最小二乘法，用于估计轮胎侧偏刚度。在此基础上，结合Laguerre函数设计了一种Laguerre模型预测控制（LMPC）路径跟踪控制策略，该策略能在不同耦合坡道场景下降低计算资源消耗，同时保持可靠的跟踪性能。随后，通过将Koopman算子理论与DNN相结合，提出了一种DNN Koopman（DK）路径偏差补偿方法，显著提升了UGV在坑洼路面扰动下的路径跟踪精度。此外，基于补偿激活准则与可信度验证，建立了一种耦合LMPC与DK的事件触发并行协同（EPC）补偿机制。该机制在提升坑洼路面路径跟踪精度的同时，确保了整体转向指令的可行性以及DK补偿后车辆的稳定性。最后，搭建了硬件在环（HiL）实验平台进行验证。实验结果表明，所提出的UGV路径跟踪策略在多种工况下的跟踪性能提升了11.5%以上。
tldr: Proposes a DNN Koopman-based deviation compensation strategy combined with Laguerre MPC to improve UGV path tracking on coupled slope and potholed roads, validated with hardware-in-the-loop experiments.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于DNN Koopman的偏差补偿策略，结合Laguerre MPC，以提高UGV在耦合坡度和坑洼路面上的路径跟踪精度，并通过硬件在环实验验证。

title: Technical Report for ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Leveraging DINOv3 for Robust Outdoor Scene Understanding in Field Robotics
summary: The GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Field Robotics evaluates dense semantic segmentation of off-road imagery over a fine-grained taxonomy of 64 classes and 11 evaluated non-void coarse categories. We present the first-place solution to this challenge. Our solution comprises two complementary improvements: (a) a network-level design that combines a self-supervised DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone, a ViT-Adapter, and a Mask2Former mask-classification decoder, together with a coarse-category auxiliary loss on the global [CLS] token; and (b) an inference-time aggregation strategy based on multi-scale and horizontal-flip test-time augmentation and an ensemble of the top three checkpoints selected using Codabench scores. Our method achieves an official composite score of 76.57%, consisting of 69.32% fine-class mIoU and 83.81% category-level mIoU, and ranks first on the final phase leaderboard: www.codabench.org/competitions/14257/#/results-tab.
summary_zh: GOOSE 2D细粒度语义分割挑战赛作为ICRA 2026现场机器人学研讨会的一部分，旨在评估越野图像在64个细粒度类别及11个被评价的非空洞粗粒度分类上的密集语义分割性能。我们提出了该挑战赛的第一名解决方案。该方案包含两项互补性改进：(a) 网络级设计，结合自监督DINOv3 ViT-L/16骨干网络、ViT适配器与Mask2Former掩码分类解码器，并在全局[CLS]令牌上引入粗粒度类别辅助损失；(b) 推理时聚合策略，基于多尺度与水平翻转测试时增强，以及利用Codabench评分选出的前三名检查点集成。我们的方法取得了官方综合得分76.57%（其中细粒度类别mIoU为69.32%，类别级mIoU为83.81%），在最终阶段排行榜上位列第一：www.codabench.org/competitions/14257/#/results-tab。
tldr: First-place solution for the GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge, using a DINOv3 backbone, Mask2Former decoder, and multi-scale TTA to achieve 76.57% composite score on off-road imagery.
tldr_zh: 针对野外细粒度语义分割挑战的第一名方案，采用DINOv3骨干网络、Mask2Former解码器和多尺度测试增强，在越野图像上达到76.57%的综合得分。

title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents
summary: To assist humans over extended periods in real homes, embodied agents must remember user routines, world states, and past interactions. Existing long-term memory benchmarks mainly evaluate language-centric retrieval and question answering, while embodied benchmarks often focus on short-horizon task execution without testing long-term memory use in dynamic environments. We introduce WorldLines, a project-driven benchmark for long-horizon embodied household assistance. It constructs temporally extended household traces with dialogues, actions, execution feedback, object and device state changes, and converts them into evidence-linked samples for Memory QA and Embodied Task Planning. We further propose ObsMem, an observer-grounded memory framework that maintains visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails for state-aware decisions. Experiments reveal persistent challenges in partial observability, overwritten world states, and translating long-term memory into embodied plans, while ObsMem offers a stronger reference architecture for this setting.
summary_zh: 为了在真实家庭环境中长时间辅助人类，具身代理必须记住用户习惯、世界状态以及过往交互。现有长期记忆基准主要评估以语言为中心的检索和问答任务，而具身基准通常侧重于短期任务执行，并未在动态环境中测试长期记忆的使用。我们提出WorldLines——一项面向长期具身家务辅助的项目驱动型基准。该基准构建了包含对话、动作、执行反馈、物体与设备状态变化的延展家庭交互轨迹，并将其转化为关联证据的样本，用于记忆问答和具身任务规划。我们进一步提出ObsMem——一种基于观察者的记忆框架，该框架维护可见性感知记忆与动作原生状态轨迹，以支持状态感知决策。实验揭示了部分可观测性、被覆盖的世界状态以及将长期记忆转化为具身规划等持续存在的挑战，而ObsMem为该场景提供了更优的参考架构。
tldr: WorldLines introduces a benchmark for long-horizon embodied household assistance with memory-augmented evaluation, and proposes the ObsMem memory framework for state-aware decision-making.
tldr_zh: WorldLines 提出了一个用于长期家庭辅助的具身智能基准测试，包含记忆增强评估，并设计了 ObsMem 记忆框架以实现状态感知决策。

title: Do as the Romans Do: Learning Universal Behaviors from Heterogeneous Agents
summary: Humans often acquire new skills by observing others, since observed behaviors implicitly reveal how to act in an environment. However, observations drawn from a heterogeneous population introduce conflicting behavioral signals, making it difficult to determine which behaviors are worth imitating. We address this challenge with General Reward Inference and Disentanglement (GRID), a social learning method that extracts universally useful behaviors from a heterogeneous population of demonstrators pursuing different goals. GRID decomposes per-agent reward functions into a general reward, capturing behaviors shared across all agents, and specific rewards, capturing individual preferences and objectives. Training exclusively on the general reward provides a new paradigm of generalist pretraining. It yields a generalist agent that internalizes universal environmental competencies, such as safety and basic task proficiency, without the mode-averaging bias that afflicts standard learning from demonstration techniques. This generalist serves as a superior prior for fine-tuning to downstream tasks, including preferences unseen during training. Experiments across a synthetic basis function decomposition, multi-agent Craftax, and a continuous autonomous driving simulator (Highway-Env) confirm that GRID successfully disentangles reward structure in a semantically meaningful way, outperforms standard learning from demonstration baselines, and enables more efficient and stable specialization.
summary_zh: 人类常通过观察他人来习得新技能，因为观察到的行为隐含着如何在环境中行动的线索。然而，从异质群体中获取的观察会引入相互矛盾的行为信号，导致难以判断哪些行为值得模仿。针对这一挑战，我们提出了通用奖励推断与解耦方法（GRID）——一种从追求不同目标的异质演示者群体中提取普遍有用行为的社会学习方法。GRID将每个智能体的奖励函数分解为：捕捉所有智能体共享行为的通用奖励，以及反映个体偏好与目标的特定奖励。仅基于通用奖励进行训练，开创了通才预训练的新范式。该方法能培养出内化环境通用能力（如安全性与基础任务熟练度）的通才智能体，且不会受到困扰标准示范学习技术的模态平均偏差的影响。该通才模型可作为下游任务微调（包括训练中未见过的偏好场景）的优质先验。在合成基函数分解、多智能体Craftax环境以及连续自主驾驶模拟器（Highway-Env）上的实验证实：GRID能以语义意义明确的方式成功解耦奖励结构，其性能优于标准示范学习基准方法，并能实现更高效、更稳定的特化过程。
tldr: Proposes GRID, a social learning method that disentangles general (universal) from specific rewards in heterogeneous demonstrations, yielding a generalist agent useful for fine-tuning; validated on synthetic tasks, multi-agent Craftax, and an autonomous driving simulator.
tldr_zh: 提出GRID，一种从异构示范中分离通用奖励与特定奖励的社会学习方法，获得可用于微调的通用智能体；在合成任务、多智能体Craftax和自动驾驶模拟器上验证。

title: UBP2: Uncertainty-Balanced Preference Planning for Efficient Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Preference-based RL provides an approach to learning reward models from pairwise comparisons of behaviors, bypassing the need for explicit reward design. However, existing methods typically rely on passive data collection and suffer from poor sample efficiency, especially during the early stages of learning. We introduce a model-based approach that actively directs exploration by jointly reasoning over uncertainties in the reward, dynamics, and value functions. Our method, Uncertainty-Balanced Preference Planning (UBP2), uses ensembles of reward, dynamics, and value function models to evaluate candidate trajectories according to a unified score that combines expected reward, terminal value, and epistemic uncertainty. Planning under this objective yields an explicit tradeoff between exploitation and information acquisition without requiring ad hoc exploration heuristics. Under standard regularity assumptions, we establish sublinear regret guarantees for both finite-horizon and infinite-horizon settings. Empirically, experiments on the Meta-World benchmark show UBP2 achieves substantially higher sample efficiency than model-free preference-based methods and non-optimistic model-based baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes UBP2, a model-based preference-based RL method that actively balances exploration via uncertainty quantification over reward, dynamics, and value functions, achieving higher sample efficiency on robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出UBP2，一种基于模型的偏好强化学习方法，通过对奖励、动态和值函数的不确定性量化主动平衡探索，在机器人操作基准上实现了更高的样本效率。

title: Hardware- and Vision-in-the-Loop Validation of Deep Monocular Pose Estimation for Autonomous Maritime UAV Flight
summary: Autonomous UAV operations on ships require reliable vision-based relative pose estimation, yet at-sea validation is costly, weather-dependent, and risky. This paper presents a hardware-validated vision-in-the-loop framework that enables fully autonomous indoor flight while emulating photorealistic maritime environments. Rendered maritime views are processed onboard by a deep transformer-based monocular pose estimator. Delayed vision measurements are fused with high-rate IMU data using a delayed Kalman filter to provide consistent state estimates for geometric control. The system captures critical embedded effects, including perception latency, asynchronous updates, and computational constraints, that are absent in pure simulation. Autonomous takeoff, trajectory tracking, and landing experiments demonstrate stable closed-loop flight. The results establish a safe and hardware-realistic intermediate stage for developing maritime UAV autonomy prior to shipboard deployment.
tldr: This paper presents a hardware-validated vision-in-the-loop framework for autonomous UAV flight in maritime environments, using a transformer-based monocular pose estimator and delayed Kalman filter.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种硬件在环的视觉在环框架，通过基于变压器的单目位姿估计器和延迟卡尔曼滤波器，实现自主无人机在海上环境中的稳定飞行。

title: C-ARC: Continuous-Adaptive Range Clustering for Non-Repetitive LiDAR Sensors
summary: Real-time LiDAR clustering identifies structures in point clouds, which is an essential prerequisite for many mobile robotics algorithms. Current methods are mostly developed for repetitive mechanical LiDAR sensors. Recently, the use of non-repetitive LiDAR sensors is strongly increasing due to their small cost and form factor. Such non-repetitive Risley prism-based sensors violate two key assumptions of repetitive mechanical sensors: structured scan lines and well-defined frame boundaries. Their Rhodonea-curve trajectories produce non-uniform point distributions, and the absence of a rotation cycle renders conventional scan line indexing inapplicable. To meet such new requirements, we developed C-ARC, a Continuous-Adaptive Range Clustering framework that maintains a persistent dual-graph over a sliding window, decoupling high-frequency point insertion from on-demand cluster retrieval. This is crucial for key functionalities like SLAM or tracking. An adaptive range grid resolution mechanism calibrates grid dimensions at initialization using an exponential control loop, balancing the sparsity-collision trade-off without prior knowledge of the scanning pattern. Implemented as an open-sourced single-threaded C++17 library, C-ARC produces real-time cluster output at 20 Hz on commodity hardware for the Livox Mid-360. Evaluation on the Livox Avia identifies unbounded cell occupancy as the primary limitation for sensors with strongly concentrated scan patterns. The adaptive resolution mechanism additionally improves clustering quality for existing grid-based methods on non-repetitive data.
tldr: C-ARC proposes a real-time LiDAR clustering framework designed for non-repetitive solid-state sensors, using a persistent dual-graph with adaptive range grid resolution to handle non-uniform point distributions.
tldr_zh: C-ARC 提出了一种专为非重复式固态激光雷达设计的实时点云聚类框架，通过持久化双图结构和自适应距离网格分辨率来处理非均匀点分布。

title: AI Sandboxes: A Threat Model, Taxonomy, and Measurement Framework
summary: AI systems are increasingly evaluated in bounded environments that combine isolation, simulation, instrumentation, supervision, and evidence capture. For physical AI, AIoT, and cyber-physical systems, this shift is not a matter of terminology: the system under test may sense, decide, actuate, communicate, and fail through physical processes, networked devices, and human operators. This article develops an assurance-oriented account of AI sandboxes as controlled environments for testing, evaluation, verification, and validation across digital AI, embodied autonomy, and cyber-physical deployments. We formalize the sandbox boundary and a weakest-link rule for composing per-dimension evidence into a bounded deployment claim; separate major sandbox archetypes; define a cyber-physical threat model that includes attacks on the assurance apparatus itself; and introduce a measurement framework spanning fidelity, controllability, observability, containment, reproducibility, and governance artifacts, instantiated on three worked case studies of real sandboxes. The resulting threat model, taxonomy, and measurement framework clarify what a sandbox can validly test, which risks it can contain, and what forms of evidence it can support for safety, security, and regulatory assurance.
tldr: This paper introduces a formal threat model, taxonomy, and measurement framework for AI sandboxes, focusing on safety and security assurance for physical AI and cyber-physical systems.
tldr_zh: 本文为AI沙盒提出了一个形式化的威胁模型、分类法和测量框架，专注于物理AI和网络物理系统的安全与保障。

title: Shape Sensing of Continuum Robots using Direct Laser Writing
summary: Continuum robots offer a promising approach for minimally invasive and natural-orifice surgical procedures due to their inherent compliance and dexterity. However, this flexibility also makes estimating the current shape of the robot challenging. Several approaches have been used to reconstruct the shape of these robots, including imaging, optical sensing, magnetic sensing, and resistive sensing. Strain sensors fabricated using direct laser writing (DLW) could provide an alternative sensing method. This technique involves using a laser to induce carbonization of certain polymers to create graphene patterns, such as strain sensors. In this paper, we demonstrate how a flexible continuum joint and a DLW sensor can be machined as one monolithic structure using the same laser and the same setup. The fabricated sensors are characterized using linear and nonlinear models, which are used to predict the joint angle with error as low as 1.76 degrees. Furthermore, we demonstrate how a DLW sensor can be used to implement closed-loop control in a robotic joint, achieving tracking error under 3 degrees.
tldr: This paper presents a method for fabricating and using direct laser writing (DLW) strain sensors integrated into a continuum robot joint for shape sensing, achieving closed-loop control with low tracking error.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用直接激光写入（DLW）应变传感器集成在连续体机器人关节中进行形状感知的方法，实现了低跟踪误差的闭环控制。

title: Space Is Intelligence: Neural Semigroup Superposition for Riemannian Metric Generation
summary: Traditional approaches place intelligence in the agent, whether as a learned policy or a search procedure. We instead place intelligence in the space itself: a scene induces a Riemannian metric on the configuration manifold, and action reduces to following the geodesics of that metric rather than invoking a separate planner or collision checker. A single Encoder-Router network realizes this idea through three complementary parameter groups -- frame parameters that orient the generators, modulation parameters that govern their spatial propagation, and basic coefficients that determine their strength. These groups combine through a shared semigroup-superposition mechanism to produce a single Riemannian metric field, yielding a compact architecture whose geometry scales naturally with scene complexity. Trained on a single two-obstacle scene, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization across unseen obstacle configurations, with orders-of-magnitude separation between collision-free and obstacle-penetrating path costs.
tldr: The paper proposes placing intelligence in the environment's geometry by learning a Riemannian metric from the scene, enabling collision-free path planning via geodesics without a separate planner or collision checker. A compact Encoder-Router architecture with a semigroup superposition mechanism generalizes zero-shot to unseen obstacle configurations.
tldr_zh: 论文提出将智能置于环境的几何结构中，通过学习场景的黎曼度量实现无需独立规划器或碰撞检测的测地线路径规划。一种紧凑的编码器-路由器架构利用半群叠加机制，在未见过的障碍物配置上实现零样本泛化。

title: Leveraging Energy Features for Surface Classification with Deep Learning: A Comparative Analysis Across Three Independent Datasets
summary: The energy-based method remains a comparatively underexamined approach for surface classification in mobile robotics, despite promising results in constrained environments. This study evaluated the viability of using energy-derived features as either a standalone classification modality or as supplementary input to inertial data. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted across three publicly available datasets, comparing the performance of modern deep learning architectures including recurrent neural networks, convolutional neural networks, encoder-only transformers, and Mamba state-space models, under automated hyperparameter tuning and input sequence length optimization. The models achieved higher accuracy than previously reported values on all evaluated datasets, with the convolutional neural network yielding the highest overall performance. When relying exclusively on energy-based features, the models attained classification accuracies in the range of 85-90%, approximately 5-10% lower than those achieved when combined with inertial features (96-99%). Augmenting inertial data with energy features resulted in a consistent mean accuracy improvement of 1-2%. These findings indicate that classifiers relying solely on energy features offer sufficient accuracy for standalone deployment, while also providing a consistent gain when used in combination with other sensing modalities.
tldr: This paper explores using energy-based features for surface classification in mobile robotics, achieving 85-90% accuracy with energy alone and a 1-2% boost when combined with inertial data across three datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在移动机器人中利用能量特征进行地面分类，单独使用能量特征达到85-90%的准确率，与惯性数据结合可提升1-2%。

title: Spatially Stratified Distillation for Heterogeneous Radar Place Recognition
summary: Scalable, all-weather place recognition increasingly relies on heterogeneous radar place recognition to bridge diverse hardware platforms. A notable application is matching queries from cost-effective 4D automotive radars against high-fidelity reference maps built by dense spinning radars. This process is fundamentally limited by the extreme sparsity (and narrow field-of-view) of the 4D sensor, which captures only a fraction of the structural density present in the spinning radar database. Prior efforts address this issue by unifying different radar signals. That is, projecting both signals into a common representational space. Yet, they suffer performance degradation in multi-session environments. In this paper, we propose spatially-stratified distillation (SSD); a strategy that replaces standard uniform distillation with an asymmetric spatial alignment derived directly from physical radar returns. In regions where both radars exhibit overlapping returns, SSD enforces strong feature alignment.
