title: Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents
summary: Long-horizon tasks are common in real-world robotic deployments, yet failure detection for such tasks remains underexplored. Detecting failures in long-horizon robotic tasks is particularly challenging because failure onset is often ambiguous and dense temporal annotations are typically unavailable. We present Foresight, a failure detection framework that monitors manipulation trajectories using latent representations from an action-conditioned world model. Foresight is trained using only final task-level success or failure labels. By leveraging predictive world-model embeddings, our method provides a unified framework for failure detection across different policies. We further use functional conformal prediction (FCP) to calibrate detection thresholds adaptively. We evaluate Foresight with state-of-the-art vision-language-action policies in simulation on LIBERO-Long, ManiSkill-Long, and BEHAVIOR-1K, compare it against state-of-the-artfailure detection methods, and validate it on real robots with three long-horizon tasks on a ReactorX-200 arm and one task on a Franka arm. Our results suggest that action-conditioned world-model embeddings provide a scalable representation for reliable failure monitoring in long-horizon manipulation.
summary_zh: 在现实机器人部署中，长时域任务十分常见，但针对此类任务的故障检测研究仍不充分。长时域机器人任务中的故障检测尤为困难，因为故障起始点往往模糊不清，且通常缺乏密集的时间标注。我们提出Foresight——一种利用动作条件世界模型的潜在表征来监控操作轨迹的故障检测框架。Foresight仅需最终任务层面的成功/失败标签进行训练。通过利用预测性世界模型嵌入，我们的方法为不同策略下的故障检测提供了统一框架。我们进一步采用功能性共形预测（FCP）自适应校准检测阈值。我们在LIBERO-Long、ManiSkill-Long和BEHAVIOR-1K仿真环境中，将Foresight与最先进的视觉-语言-动作策略进行对比评估，并与当前最优的故障检测方法进行比较；同时，在ReactorX-200机械臂上执行三项长时域任务、在Franka机械臂上执行一项长时域任务进行真实机器人验证。实验结果表明，动作条件世界模型嵌入为长时域操作中的可靠故障监控提供了可扩展的表征方案。
tldr: Foresight uses action-conditioned world model latents to detect failures in long-horizon robotic manipulation, training only on final success/failure labels and leveraging conformal prediction for adaptive thresholding.
tldr_zh: Foresight 利用动作条件世界模型隐变量检测长时间机器人操作中的失败，仅使用最终成功/失败标签训练，并采用共形预测自适应调整阈值。

title: TEXEDO : Test Time Scaling for Controller-aware Language-conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
summary: Text-conditioned motion generation is a promising interface for programming humanoid robots, yet current generators are often trained on human motion datasets retargeted to robot morphologies. Although such data provides rich semantic and kinematic priors, it fails to capture the nuances of whole-body tracking controllers, including balance, contact dynamics, actuation limits, and controller-specific failure modes. As a result, generated motions can be semantically plausible but difficult or impossible for the robot to execute. We introduce TEXEDO, a test-time scaling framework for humanoid motion generation that improves motion quality without requiring a stronger underlying generator. Given a text prompt, TEXEDO samples multiple candidate motions from a pretrained text-conditioned generator and selects the best motion that is both executable and task-aligned. The reward model combines a dynamic feasibility verifier, distilled from whole-body tracking rollouts to predict physical executability, with a semantic alignment verifier that measures text-motion alignment in a learned co-embedding space. Our pipeline treats dynamic feasibility as a hard constraint and semantic alignment as the selection objective within the feasible set. Through large-scale simulation studies and real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, we show that TEXEDO consistently improves both tracking fidelity and text alignment. These results demonstrate that grounded verification is an effective path toward deployable language-guided humanoid motion generation. Project website: https://jianuocao.github.io/TEXEDO/
summary_zh: 文本条件运动生成是一种有前景的人形机器人编程接口，但当前的生成器通常基于重定向到机器人形态的人体运动数据集进行训练。尽管此类数据提供了丰富的语义和运动学先验，却未能捕捉全身跟踪控制器的细微特征，包括平衡性、接触动力学、驱动限制以及控制器特有的失效模式。因此，生成的运动在语义上可能合理，但机器人难以甚至无法执行。我们提出TEXEDO——一种面向人形运动生成的测试时扩展框架，在无需增强底层生成器的情况下即可提升运动质量。给定文本提示，TEXEDO从预训练的文本条件生成器中采样多个候选运动，并选择既具可执行性又与任务对齐的最佳运动。其奖励模型结合了动态可行性验证器（从全身跟踪展开中提炼而来，用于预测物理可执行性）与语义对齐验证器（在学习的共嵌入空间中度量文本-运动对齐程度）。该流水线将动态可行性视为硬约束，并将语义对齐作为可行集内的选择目标。通过大规模仿真研究及在宇树G1人形机器人上的实际部署，我们证明TEXEDO能持续提升跟踪保真度与文本对齐度。这些结果表明，基于真实场景的验证是迈向可部署的语言引导人形运动生成的有效路径。项目网站：https://jianuocao.github.io/TEXEDO/
tldr: TEXEDO is a test-time scaling framework that uses a dynamic feasibility verifier (distilled from whole-body tracking rollouts) and a semantic alignment verifier to select executable, text-aligned motions from a pretrained humanoid motion generator, improving tracking fidelity and text alignment in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: TEXEDO 是一个测试时扩展框架，通过从全身跟踪 rollout 中蒸馏的动态可行性验证器和语义对齐验证器，从预训练的人形运动生成器中选择可执行且与文本对齐的运动，在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 机器人上提升了跟踪精度和文本对齐度。

title: HiL-ResRL: A Model-Agnostic Finetuning Adapter via Human-in-the-loop Residual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent advancements in generative imitation learning have significantly propelled the field of robotic manipulation. However, the majority of existing models rely heavily on Behavior Cloning (BC), a paradigm that suffers from compounding errors and distributional shift. Consequently, the efficacy of these models in practical industrial deployments remains limited. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel, plug-and-play fine-tuning pipeline designed to facilitate the robust deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in real-world environments. In contrast to contemporary reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning strategies, which are often constrained by specific model architectures, our proposed framework is model-agnostic and adaptable to a diverse range of VLA models. We conceptualize VLA-generated actions as a unified interface, upon which we train a residual policy. This policy is designed to rectify suboptimal actions and address the distributional shift inherent in imitation learning. Additionally, we incorporate human-in-the-loop guidance to ensure safe exploration and maximize training efficiency. We conduct experiments directly in real-world robotic settings. The results demonstrate that within only 1.5 hour of real-world online RL training, the average success rate exceeds 95% on real robots. Our work presents a practical solution for deploying behavior cloning models in industrial scenarios.
summary_zh: 近期，生成式模仿学习领域的进展显著推动了机器人操作技术的发展。然而，现有模型大多依赖于行为克隆范式，该范式存在复合误差与分布偏移问题，导致这些模型在实际工业部署中的有效性仍然有限。针对上述挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的即插即用微调流程，旨在实现视觉-语言-动作模型在真实环境中的稳健部署。与当前受限于特定模型架构的强化学习微调策略不同，本框架具有模型无关性，可适配多种VLA模型。我们将VLA模型生成的动作为统一接口，在此基础上训练残差策略，用于修正次优动作并解决模仿学习固有的分布偏移问题。此外，我们引入人工干预引导机制，确保安全探索并最大化训练效率。我们在真实机器人环境中开展实验，结果表明：仅需1.5小时真实在线强化学习训练，机器人的平均成功率即超过95%。本研究为行为克隆模型在工业场景中的部署提供了切实可行的解决方案。
tldr: This paper proposes HiL-ResRL, a model-agnostic fine-tuning pipeline that uses residual reinforcement learning with human-in-the-loop guidance to correct distribution shift and suboptimal actions in VLA models, achieving over 95% success on real robots after 1.5 hours of online training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出HiL-ResRL，一种模型无关的微调管道，通过残差强化学习和人在环指导来纠正VLA模型中的分布偏移和次优动作，在1.5小时在线训练后在真实机器人上达到超过95%的成功率。

title: Verifiable Foundation Models for Robot Safety
summary: Deploying foundation models for robot control raises a central challenge: the expressive power that enables rich, multimodal perception also makes these models opaque and difficult to analyze formally, rendering them intractable for existing verification tools. In this paper, we present FEARL (Foundation-Enabled Assured Robot Learning), a framework that addresses this tension through a modular architectural decomposition. FEARL separates the policy into a large Controller (C) responsible for high-dimensional perception and task reasoning, and a small Safety module (S) that receives low-dimensional observations from dedicated safety sensors together with a bounded context embedding from C and produces the final action. Since many robot safety requirements, such as collision avoidance and workspace boundary constraints, can be expressed over these safety sensor observations, formal verification can be applied to S rather than to the full foundation-model backbone. This makes formal analysis tractable with existing tools while preserving the Controller's expressive power for task reasoning. To show that the decomposed policy remains capable of solving diverse tasks, we evaluate FEARL on three simulated robotic domains using multiple Controller backbones and training procedures, including pretrained off-the-shelf vision-language-action models. We further transfer the learned policy from one of our simulated tasks to a physical robot, suggesting that the low-dimensional safety interface supports practical sim-to-real transfer.
summary_zh: 将基础模型应用于机器人控制面临一个核心挑战：支撑丰富多模态感知的表达能力，同时也使这些模型变得不透明且难以进行形式化分析，导致现有验证工具难以处理。本文提出FEARL（Foundation-Enabled Assured Robot Learning，基础模型赋能的可信机器人学习）框架，通过模块化架构分解来应对这一矛盾。FEARL将策略拆分为两大模块：承担高维感知与任务推理功能的大型控制器（Controller, C），以及接收专用安全传感器提供的低维观测数据并结合C生成的受限上下文嵌入，最终输出动作的小型安全模块（Safety module, S）。由于碰撞规避、工作空间边界约束等众多机器人安全需求可基于这些安全传感器观测值进行表达，因此形式验证可应用于S而非完整的基础模型主干网络。这使得现有工具能够对系统进行可操作的形式化分析，同时保留控制器在任务推理方面的表达能力。为验证分解后的策略仍能胜任多样化任务，我们在三个仿真机器人领域中使用多种控制器主干网络与训练流程（包括预训练的现成视觉-语言-动作模型）对FEARL进行了评估。我们进一步将学习策略从仿真任务迁移至实体机器人，结果表明该低维安全接口能有效支持从仿真到现实的迁移。
tldr: FEARL separates a robot policy into a large vision-language-action Controller and a small formally verifiable Safety module, enabling tractable verification of safety constraints while retaining expressive task reasoning, demonstrated in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: FEARL将机器人策略分解为大型视觉-语言-动作控制器和小型可形式验证的安全模块，使得在保持任务推理能力的同时能够对安全约束进行可处理的验证，并在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。

title: Attacking the Trusted Imagination: Oracle-Level Integrity Attacks on Imagine-then-Act World Models
summary: Many recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies adopt an imagine-then-act design. A world-action model (WAM) first imagines a short future as a latent trajectory z~, on which the action is then conditioned. We identify this trusted imagination, rather than the reactive policy, as the exposed attack surface. A downstream oracle, such as a safety gate, a visual model-predictive-control (MPC) planner, or an imagine-then-check verifier, consumes z~ as a prediction of the future. The robustness of the policy therefore does not entail the robustness of systems that rely on the WAM. The underlying phenomenon is an asymmetry. Corrupting the imagination is easy, since it requires only displacing z~ from its natural-future manifold. Steering it precisely is hard, since it must reach a specified on-manifold target. We adopt a capability-based threat model with an L-infinity-bounded observation perturbation. The attacker applies projected gradient descent through the fully differentiable observation-to-imagination map. The same off-manifold property motivates a parameter-free denoiser detector. We evaluate three targets: RynnVLA-002, LingBot-VA, and LaDi-WM. Untargeted corruption is roughly 60x stronger than random and is detected at AUC 1.0. Targeted control remains bounded. An adaptive attacker evades detection only by forgoing corruption. The reactive policy remains robust to corrupted imagination. A native imagination-driven MPC, however, exhibits the first adversary-specific task failure (at epsilon=0.01, success 0.70 versus 0.05; Fisher p < 10^-4).
summary_zh: 许多近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略采用了“先想象后行动”的设计。一种世界-动作模型（WAM）首先将短期未来想象为潜在轨迹z~，随后动作以此为基础。我们发现，这种被信任的想象（而非反应式策略）才是暴露的攻击面。下游的验证器（如安全门、视觉模型预测控制（MPC）规划器或“先想象后检查”验证器）将z~作为对未来的预测加以利用。因此，策略的鲁棒性并不等同于依赖WAM的系统的鲁棒性。其根本现象是一种不对称性：破坏想象很容易，因为只需将z~从其自然流形中偏移即可；而精确引导则很困难，因为必须使其到达指定流形上的目标。我们采用基于能力的威胁模型，并施加L无穷范数有界的观测扰动。攻击者通过完全可微的“观测到想象”映射应用投影梯度下降。同离流形特性也激发了一种无参数去噪检测器。我们针对三个目标进行了评估：RynnVLA-002、LingBot-VA和LaDi-WM。无目标破坏的强度大约是随机的60倍，且AUC为1.0时可被检测到；有目标控制仍受限；自适应攻击者只有放弃破坏才能规避检测。反应式策略对受破坏的想象保持鲁棒性。然而，原生基于想象的MPC却表现出首个针对攻击者的任务失败（在epsilon=0.01时，成功率0.70 vs 0.05；Fisher p < 10^-4）。
tldr: This paper identifies a vulnerability in 'imagine-then-act' world-action models (WAMs) used in VLA policies, showing that untargeted attacks can corrupt latent future predictions with minimal perturbation, while targeted steering is harder; a simple denoiser detector achieves perfect detection, but the reactive policy itself remains robust.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示了VLA策略中“想象-行动”世界模型（WAM）的漏洞：无目标攻击可轻易破坏未来潜在预测，而精准操控则困难；一个简单的去噪检测器可完美检测攻击，但反应式策略本身保持鲁棒。

title: Intend, Reflect, Refine: An Adaptive Multimodal Reflection Framework for Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by incorporating reasoning for better interpretability and planning quality. However, most existing approaches directly generate the final trajectory without explicitly examining its future consequences, which limits their reliability in complex and dynamic environments. To address this limitation, we propose IRR-Drive (Intend, Reflect, Refine), an adaptive multimodal reflection framework for autonomous driving. Specifically, to tightly couple high-level reasoning with physical constraints, IRR-Drive first generates a preliminary textual intention and anticipates potential interactions by predicting future semantic bird's-eye view (BEV) representations. This dual-modality (Text + BEV) reflection space explicitly models anticipated scene evolution, enabling the model to rigorously self-correct and refine its initial intent before generating the final trajectory. Furthermore, to balance planning performance and computational efficiency, we construct reflection-oriented training data and design an adaptive reflection reward, enabling the model to adaptively select its reasoning mode according to scene complexity. Instead of using reasoning primarily as an auxiliary interpretation, IRR-Drive directly integrates an adaptive reflection mechanism into the planning framework, enabling grounded, decision-aware trajectory correction that is driven by scene complexity. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the NAVSIM benchmark in both PDMS and EPDMS. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our multimodal reflection framework and validate the efficacy of the proposed adaptive reflection strategy.
summary_zh: 近期提出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过引入推理机制，提升了端到端自动驾驶的可解释性和规划质量。然而，现有方法大多直接生成最终轨迹，未明确检验其未来后果，这在复杂动态环境中限制了系统的可靠性。为解决这一局限，我们提出IRR-Drive（意图-反思-优化），一种适用于自动驾驶的自适应多模态反思框架。具体而言，为实现高层推理与物理约束的紧密耦合，IRR-Drive首先生成初步文本意图，并通过预测未来语义鸟瞰图（BEV）表征来预判潜在交互。这种双模态（文本+BEV）反思空间显式建模了预期的场景演化过程，使模型在生成最终轨迹前能够严格进行自我修正并优化初始意图。此外，为平衡规划性能与计算效率，我们构建了面向反思的训练数据并设计自适应反思奖励机制，使模型能根据场景复杂度自适应选择推理模式。与仅将推理作为辅助解释不同，IRR-Drive将自适应反思机制直接集成至规划框架中，实现了由场景复杂度驱动的、基于物理约束且具有决策感知的轨迹修正。本方法在NAVSIM基准测试的PDMS和EPDMS评估中均达到了最优性能。大量实验验证了所提多模态反思框架的有效性，并证明了自适应反思策略的优越性。
tldr: IRR-Drive proposes an adaptive multimodal reflection framework for autonomous driving that generates a textual intention and predicts future BEV representations to self-correct trajectories before final planning, achieving SOTA on NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: IRR-Drive 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的自适应多模态反思框架，通过生成文本意图并预测未来BEV表示，在最终规划前自我纠正轨迹，在NAVSIM上取得了最优结果。

title: Active Inference as the Test-Time Scaling Law for Physical AI Agents
summary: In this paper, a novel test-time scaling law for physical artificial intelligence (AI) agents is introduced. This scaling law enables physical AI agents to reason with their world models to generalize in unforeseen scenarios at test time. The derived scaling law is grounded in the first principle of active inference, which equips agents with the general objective to survive in the real world, under which their specific task objectives are subsumed. Active inference achieves this by providing the reasoning to resolve prediction errors that arise when the agent encounters unforeseen situations outside its training distribution, enabling generalization in non-stationary environments. The proposed scaling law captures this by dynamically updating the agent's policy with this reasoning at test time. This policy update is modeled as a soft Bayesian inference process in which beliefs about the policy are updated using the reasoning that reduces expected prediction errors under allowable policies as a likelihood. The resulting posterior policy admits a biological interpretation, recovering the scaling mechanism that engages the brain's basal ganglia and prefrontal cortex at test time. To solve this analytically intractable problem, a variational inference solution minimizing free energy bounds is developed. This solution extends to enable learning beyond training by reinforcing new instances, resolved at test time, in both the policy and world model. Unlike existing scaling laws constrained by model size and training data, the derived solution scales with the continuous real-world experience of a physical AI agent. Simulation results on an autonomous driving task demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms model-free Q-learning and model-based Bayesian reinforcement learning, achieving robust generalization to unforeseen scenarios while improving inference efficiency by over 36%.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向物理人工智能（AI）智能体的新型测试时缩放定律。该缩放定律使物理AI智能体能够利用其世界模型进行推理，从而在测试时泛化至未预见的场景。该定律基于主动推理的第一性原理推导，该原理赋予智能体在真实世界中生存的通用目标，而其具体任务目标则被包含于该目标之下。主动推理通过提供一种推理机制来解决智能体在训练分布外遭遇未预见情境时产生的预测误差，从而实现在非平稳环境中的泛化。本文提出的缩放定律通过在测试时动态更新策略来捕捉这一特性——该策略更新被建模为一种软贝叶斯推理过程，其中对策略的信念通过推理进行更新，该推理将允许策略下的预期预测误差降低作为似然函数。由此产生的后验策略具有生物学解释，揭示了测试时激活大脑基底核与前额叶皮层的缩放机制。为解决这一解析困难问题，本文开发了一种最小化自由能边界的变分推理方法。该方法通过强化测试时解决的新实例，将学习延伸至训练范围之外，并同时更新策略与世界模型。与受限于模型规模与训练数据的现有缩放定律不同，本文推导的解能够随物理AI智能体持续的实时经验而扩展。基于自动驾驶任务的仿真结果表明，所提方法优于无模型的Q学习与基于模型的贝叶斯强化学习，在对未预见场景实现稳健泛化的同时，推理效率提升超过36%。
tldr: This paper introduces a test-time scaling law for physical AI agents based on active inference, enabling reasoning with world models to generalize to unforeseen scenarios; it demonstrates improved performance and efficiency in an autonomous driving simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文基于主动推理为物理AI智能体提出了一种测试时缩放定律，使其能够利用世界模型进行推理以泛化到未预见场景，并在自动驾驶仿真中展示了超越基线方法的性能和超过36%的推理效率提升。

title: UECP: Uncertainty-Enhanced Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception serves as a pivotal solution to enhance the perception capability of individual agents in autonomous driving, where a core challenge lies in seeking reliable evidence to quantify and weight the contribution of each participating agent. Existing methods typically rely on a confidence map, which is co-trained with the detection head, but it is inherently correlated with the detection results and thus fails to provide unbiased physical evidence. Furthermore, how to deeply integrate evidence into the cooperative fusion process remains an open question. To address these issues, this paper first proposes an uncertainty map, a physically grounded and unambiguous metric for evaluating perception quality. This map is directly supervised by real-time sensor signals, i.e., LiDAR point density, ensuring decoupling from detection noise and thereby providing physical scenario-aware evidence for weighting agent contribution. Based on this map, we develop the Uncertainty-Enhanced Collaborative Perception (UECP) framework, centered on the Uncertainty-Aware Pyramid Fusion (UAPF) module. UAPF uses a coarse-to-fine strategy, with two key components: Uncertainty-Weighted Downsampling (UWD) for high-fidelity feature preservation, and Uncertainty-Guided Residual Fusion (UGRF) to reinforce ego features, suppressing noise and ensuring robust fusion. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show UECP outperforms state-of-the-art methods in effectiveness and robustness by embedding the uncertainty map into fusion. Code will be publicly available.
summary_zh: 协同感知是提升自动驾驶中单个智能体感知能力的关键方案，其核心挑战在于寻找可靠证据以量化并加权每个参与智能体的贡献。现有方法通常依赖与检测头联合训练的置信度图，但由于该图与检测结果存在固有相关性，无法提供无偏的物理证据。此外，如何将证据深度整合到协同融合过程中仍是一个开放性问题。针对这些问题，本文首先提出一种基于物理意义且无歧义的感知质量评估指标——不确定度图。该图通过实时传感器信号（即激光雷达点密度）直接监督，确保与检测噪声解耦，从而为智能体贡献加权提供具备物理场景感知特性的证据。基于该不确定度图，我们开发了以不确定感知金字塔融合（UAPF）模块为核心的增强型不确定协同感知（UECP）框架。UAPF采用从粗到精的策略，包含两个关键组件：用于高保真特征保留的不确定加权下采样（UWD）模块，以及通过抑制噪声并增强自车特征来实现鲁棒融合的不确定引导残差融合（UGRF）模块。在真实场景数据集上的大量实验表明，通过将不确定度图嵌入融合过程，UECP在有效性和鲁棒性上均超越现有最优方法。代码将开源。
tldr: UECP introduces a physically grounded uncertainty map supervised by LiDAR point density to weight agent contributions in collaborative perception for autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art fusion robustness.
tldr_zh: UECP 提出了一种由 LiDAR 点密度监督的物理不确定性图，用于加权协作感知中的智能体贡献，在自动驾驶融合鲁棒性上达到最优。

title: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL
summary: In many modern applications of reinforcement learning (RL), the natural reward for a task of interest is inherently sparse: a reward of 0 is given everywhere except when the task is completed, when a reward of +1 is given. Training a policy to maximize such a sparse reward requires solving a challenging credit assignment problem, leading to slow or ineffective RL improvement. We propose a simple approach to transform a sparse outcome reward into a dense process reward. Our approach relies on training a discriminator to distinguish between previous successful and unsuccessful episodes, and using this discriminator to incentivize the RL-learned policy to match the state-action visitations of successful episodes, while avoiding those of unsuccessful episodes. By incentivizing the policy to match the visitations over all states, not just those that correspond to task success, this reward provides dense feedback on whether progress is being made towards task completion, and, we show, provably achieves this without changing the optimal policy. Focusing on finetuning of robotic control policies, we demonstrate that our approach leads to significantly faster RL finetuning performance on both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, as compared to simply maximizing the sparse outcome reward.
summary_zh: 在强化学习的许多现代应用中，任务相关的自然奖励本质上是稀疏的：除任务完成时获得+1奖励外，其余所有状态均给予0奖励。训练策略最大化此类稀疏奖励需要解决极具挑战性的信用分配问题，导致强化学习改进缓慢或效果不佳。我们提出一种将稀疏结果奖励转化为密集过程奖励的简单方法。该方法通过训练判别器区分历史成功与失败的回合，并利用该判别器激励强化学习策略匹配成功回合的状态-动作访问模式，同时规避失败回合的访问模式。由于该奖励机制不仅关注任务成功对应的状态，而是对所有状态施加激励以匹配访问模式，因此能够提供关于任务进展的密集反馈信号。我们证明该方法在不改变最优策略的前提下可达成此效果。聚焦于机器人操控策略的微调场景，实验表明，相比直接最大化稀疏结果奖励，本方法在仿真与真实世界的操控任务中均能显著提升强化学习的微调效率。
tldr: This paper proposes Success Visitation Matching (SVM), a method that transforms sparse outcome rewards into dense process rewards by training a discriminator to distinguish successful from unsuccessful episodes, enabling faster RL fine-tuning on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出成功访问匹配（SVM）方法，通过训练判别器区分成功与失败的情节，将稀疏的结果奖励转化为密集的过程奖励，从而加速机器人操作任务的RL微调。

title: A Generative Model for Closed-Loop Microsimulation of Signalized Intersections
summary: Traffic microsimulators rely on hand-crafted behavior models that reproduce aggregate flow but miss the heterogeneous interactions between vehicles at signalized intersections. Learned trajectory predictors capture richer interactions but are short-horizon and tend to be unstable when run in closed loop. We present Enactor, an actor-centric generative model for closed-loop intersection microsimulation. The model focuses on vehicles; pedestrians are included as context that can influence vehicle decisions but not predicted. Dynamic actors and lane polylines are encoded in polar coordinates referenced to the intersection center. A transformer with separate spatial and temporal attention blocks predicts a distribution over each actor's next-step motion ($s$, $α$). Training uses a closed-loop curriculum so the model is exposed to its own predictions. We evaluate Enactor in two regimes. In a 4000-second simulation-in-the-loop test at two intersection geometries, Enactor controls every dynamic vehicle against a continuously refreshing actor set rather than the fixed cohort that learned trajectory predictors are usually evaluated against. It recovers the SUMO data generator's speed and travel-time distributions with KL divergence over an order of magnitude lower than a recent transformer baseline on travel time, and substantially lower on speed (roughly $5\times$ lower at Site 1), and reduces red-light violations relative to the same baseline by more than an order of magnitude. An ablation isolates the leader rear-bumper feature as the change with the largest effect on intersection-aware safety metrics. We also evaluate on real-world field data and apply the same architecture to naturalistic vehicle trajectories from a fish-eye camera at a signalized intersection and evaluate it on multi-horizon predictive tasks. Enactor outperforms a constant-velocity baseline at every horizon evaluated.
summary_zh: 交通微观仿真依赖于手工构建的行为模型，这类模型能够再现整体交通流，但忽略了信号交叉口车辆间的异质性交互。学习型轨迹预测器能够捕捉更丰富的交互特征，但预测时域较短，且在闭环运行时往往不稳定。我们提出Enactor——一种以智能体为中心的生成式闭环交叉口微观仿真模型。该模型聚焦于车辆；行人的作用作为可能影响车辆决策的上下文信息纳入（而非预测行人的轨迹）。动态智能体与车道折线以交叉口中心的极坐标系进行编码。采用具有独立空间与时间注意力模块的Transformer结构，预测每个智能体下一步运动状态（$s$, $α$）的分布。训练采用闭环课程策略，使模型暴露于自身预测结果中。我们在两种场景下评估Enactor：在两种交叉口几何布局下进行4000秒仿真环内测试，Enactor需持续控制不断刷新的动态智能体集（而非学习型轨迹预测器通常评估的固定队列）。Enactor能够恢复SUMO数据生成器的速度与行程时间分布，其KL散度在行程时间上比近期基于Transformer的基线模型低一个数量级以上，在速度上显著更低（地点1约降低5倍），并将红灯违章次数相对同一基线降低超过一个数量级。消融实验显示，前车后保险杠特征是对交叉口安全感知指标影响最大的因素。我们还基于真实路测数据开展评估，采用相同架构处理来自信号交叉口鱼眼摄像头的自然驾驶轨迹，并在多时域预测任务上进行测试。Enactor在所有评估时域上均优于恒定速度基线模型。
tldr: Enactor is an actor-centric generative model for closed-loop microsimulation of signalized intersections, using a transformer with spatial/temporal attention and closed-loop curriculum training to produce realistic trajectories and reduce red-light violations.
tldr_zh: Enactor 是一种以车辆为中心的生成模型，用于信号交叉口的闭环微观模拟，通过包含空间/时间注意力的 Transformer 和闭环课程训练生成真实轨迹并减少闯红灯行为。

title: HoloAgent-0: A Unified Embodied Agent Framework with 3D Spatial Memory
summary: LLM agents follow a practical execution loop in digital environments: they reason over structured states, invoke tools, inspect feedback, and revise actions. Extending this loop to physical robots is difficult because physical execution is continuous, embodiment-dependent, uncertain, and constrained by safety. Existing embodied-AI systems have advanced manipulation, spatial understanding, navigation, and humanoid control, but these capabilities often remain specialized modules or loosely coupled decision loops. In this work, we introduce HoloAgent-0, a unified embodied agent framework for real-world robot deployment. Embodied AgentOS converts language instructions into executable skill graphs, schedules robot resources, monitors execution, and triggers clarification or re-planning from runtime feedback. HoloAgent-0 organizes heterogeneous robot models and controllers through three coupled layers: Embodied AgentOS for closed-loop execution, 3D spatial memory for physical world grounding, and embodied skills for robot action. We deploy HoloAgent-0 on real hardware and evaluate its spatial memory, long-horizon navigation, and closed-loop execution across motion generation, object search, cross-robot coordination, and mobile manipulation.
summary_zh: 大语言模型体在数字环境中遵循实用的执行循环：对结构化状态进行推理、调用工具、检查反馈并修正动作。将该循环延展至物理机器人存在困难，因为物理执行具有连续性、具身依赖性、不确定性和安全约束。现有具身人工智能系统在操作、空间理解、导航和人形控制方面取得了进展，但这些能力往往仍是专用模块或松散耦合的决策循环。在本工作中，我们提出HoloAgent-0——一个面向真实世界机器人部署的统一具身体框架。具身体AgentOS将语言指令转换为可执行技能图，调度机器人资源，监测执行过程，并根据运行时反馈触发澄清或重新规划。HoloAgent-0通过三个耦合层组织异构机器人模型与控制器：用于闭环执行的具身AgentOS、用于物理世界锚定的3D空间记忆，以及用于机器人动作的具身技能。我们在真实硬件上部署HoloAgent-0，并对其空间记忆、长时域导航以及涵盖运动生成、目标搜索、跨机器人协同与移动操作的闭环执行能力进行了评估。
tldr: HoloAgent-0 is a unified embodied agent framework with 3D spatial memory that integrates an operating system for closed-loop execution, spatial grounding, and modular robot skills, deployed on real hardware for long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: HoloAgent-0 是一个统一具身智能体框架，结合3D空间记忆，通过闭环执行操作系统、空间基础与模块化机器人技能，在真实硬件上实现长时域任务。

title: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
summary: Accurate dynamics models are critical for informed decision-making in robotic systems, particularly for agile aerial vehicles operating under uncertainty. Neural network dynamics models are attractive for capturing complex nonlinear effects, but existing predictive approaches struggle with long-horizon forecasting because their autoregressive rollout mechanism amplifies errors over time. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling alternative by modeling dynamics in latent space, yet prior JEPA-style methods for robot navigation have been studied primarily for kinematic-level planning, with limited investigation in high-frequency control. In this work, we introduce the JEPA-style model for real-time quadrotor control. The proposed approach combines a latent dynamics model with a novel physics-inspired prober that maps frozen latents to interpretable state, enabling physically grounded long-horizon prediction. Additionally, we combine the learned model with a sampling-based optimal control solution to take advantage of its predictive capabilities for real-time control on embedded hardware. Finally, to reduce the dependence on expensive and unsafe real-world data collection, we develop a structured pipeline for automated dataset generation. Extensive open-loop and outdoor closed-loop experiments demonstrate accurate prediction, robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, and strong generalization across diverse operating conditions.
summary_zh: 准确的动力学模型对于机器人系统（尤其是不确定性环境下运行的敏捷飞行器）的智能决策至关重要。神经网络动力学模型因能捕捉复杂的非线性效应而颇具吸引力，但现有预测方法在长期预测中表现欠佳，其自回归展开机制会随时间推移放大误差。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通过在潜在空间中对动力学建模提供了一种引人注目的替代方案，然而先前用于机器人导航的JEPA类方法主要针对运动学层面的规划进行研究，在高速控制领域的探索十分有限。本文提出了一种适用于四旋翼飞行器实时控制的JEPA风格模型。该方法将潜在动力学模型与受物理学启发的新型探测器相结合，该探测器能将冻结的潜在变量映射为可解释状态，从而实现具有物理基础的长期预测。此外，我们将学习模型与基于采样的最优控制方案相结合，以利用其预测能力在嵌入式硬件上实现实时控制。最后，为减少对昂贵且不安全的真实数据采集的依赖，我们开发了一套用于自动化数据集生成的标准化流程。大量开环与户外闭环实验表明，该方法具备精准预测能力、鲁棒的零样本仿真到现实迁移性能，以及在多种运行条件下的强大泛化能力。
tldr: SkyJEPA combines a latent-space Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture with a physics-inspired prober and a sampling-based controller to achieve zero-shot sim-to-real quadrotor control with accurate long-horizon prediction.
tldr_zh: SkyJEPA 将潜在空间联合嵌入预测架构与物理启发探测器及采样控制器相结合，实现了四旋翼飞行器的零样本仿真到现实迁移控制，并具备准确的长时域预测。

title: From Pixels to Concepts: Growing Rich 3D Semantic Scene Graph Forests utilizing Foundation Models
summary: Operating in complex real-world environments requires robots to understand their surroundings on a functional semantic level. This demands a detailed multi-layer world model capturing the complex relations of its surroundings. Hierarchical 3D scene graphs address this challenge by integrating geometric, semantic, and relational data within a unified spatial framework. However, current 3D scene graph approaches often restrict themselves to rigid structures of pre-determined relationship classes, mostly neglecting important semantic connections, like causal connections or environmental contexts. This paper explores the potential of foundation models to build forests of 3D scene graphs with open semantic relationships to improve scene understanding and robotic task execution. We propose a method where instance-specific concept-nodes and relationships are first identified by a VLM and extended upon by a LLM, inferring broader, more abstract concept-nodes and relationships through reasoning. These object-nodes, concept-nodes, and relationships are then assembled into a forest of hierarchical 3D scene graphs, enhanced with concept-nodes to represent abstract concepts. Evaluations were conducted on the uHumans2 and ScanNet indoor dataset, validating the accuracy and relevance of the generated relationships. Downstream suitability of scene-graph forests for robotics applications is demonstrated in an open-vocabulary object-retrieval task utilizing both ScanNet data and a real-world indoor deployment using a Boston Dynamics Spot. This paper leverages foundation models to create more expressive, semantically deep 3D hierarchical scene graphs and demonstrates their potential to advance semantic and environmental understanding in robotics.
summary_zh: 在复杂真实环境中作业要求机器人能够在功能性语义层面上理解周围环境。这需要构建一个详尽的多层世界模型，以捕捉其环境的复杂关联。层级化三维场景图通过将几何、语义和关系数据整合在统一的空间框架中，有效应对这一挑战。然而，当前的三维场景图方法往往局限于预设关系类别的刚性结构，大多忽略了重要的语义连接，例如因果关联或环境情境。本文探索了利用基础模型构建具有开放语义关系的三维场景图森林的潜力，以提升场景理解与机器人任务执行能力。我们提出了一种方法：首先由视觉语言模型识别特定实例的概念节点及其关系，再通过大语言模型进行扩展，通过推理推断出更广泛、更抽象的概念节点与关系。随后，这些对象节点、概念节点及关系被组装成层级化三维场景图森林，并通过概念节点增强以表征抽象概念。在uHumans2与ScanNet室内数据集上进行的评估验证了所生成关系的准确性与相关性。场景图森林适用于机器人任务的后续能力通过一项开放词汇目标检索任务得到验证，该任务使用了ScanNet数据以及基于波士顿动力Spot机器人的真实室内部署。本文利用基础模型构建了更具表现力、语义更深的层级化三维场景图，并展示了其在推动机器人语义与环境理解方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper uses foundation models (VLM and LLM) to build forests of hierarchical 3D scene graphs with open semantic relationships, enhancing robotic scene understanding and demonstrating applicability in an object-retrieval task on real robot hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文利用基础模型（VLM和LLM）构建具有开放语义关系的分层3D场景图森林，提升机器人的场景理解能力，并在真实机器人硬件上的物体检索任务中验证了其适用性。

title: Causal Reward World Models: Zero-shot Reward Design for Automated Skill Generation
summary: Automated Reward Design (ARD) aims to replace manual reward engineering in reinforcement learning with language-driven reward function synthesis. However, existing approaches based on large language models (LLMs) remain inherently correlation-driven, relying on iterative environmental feedback to refine reward hypotheses for each specific task. This paradigm not only results in inefficient reasoning but also makes LLMs susceptible to semantically plausible yet causally spurious reward components, leading to ineffective optimization. To address these limitations, we propose the Causal Reward World Model (CRWM), which explicitly models the causal topological relationships between candidate reward components and task-targeted physical variables through offline pre-training on multi-task interaction data. Based on a coarse-to-fine pre-training strategy, we introduce a joint optimization module that integrates Explicit Mechanism Decoupling with Confidence-Aware Soft Fusion to refine coarse structural priors using micro-level trajectories, thereby constructing a robust and interpretable causal skeleton. During inference, LLMs leverage CRWM as a task-irrelevant causal prior to constrain the reward generation, enabling zero-shot reward function design. Our work opens up a new white-box paradigm for the ARD problem. Extensive experiments on complex continuous control benchmarks demonstrate that CRWM generates executable reward functions without feedback-driven reward refinement, significantly reducing the design latency for acquiring new robotic skills while matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance, and further exhibits strong generalization capabilities across unseen tasks and diverse robotic embodiments.
summary_zh: 自动奖励设计旨在利用语言驱动的奖励函数合成来替代强化学习中的人工奖励工程。然而，现有基于大语言模型的方法本质上仍依赖相关性驱动，需通过迭代式环境反馈为每个特定任务细化奖励假设。这种范式不仅导致推理效率低下，还使LLM易受语义合理但因果虚假的奖励成分影响，最终造成优化失效。为突破这些局限，我们提出因果奖励世界模型（CRWM），该模型通过多任务交互数据的离线预训练，显式建模候选奖励成分与任务目标物理变量间的因果拓扑关系。基于由粗到精的预训练策略，我们引入联合优化模块，该模块将显式机制解耦与置信度感知软融合相结合，利用微观轨迹数据优化粗粒度结构先验，从而构建稳健可解释的因果骨架。在推理阶段，LLM将CRWM作为任务无关的因果先验约束奖励生成过程，实现零样本奖励函数设计。本研究为ARD问题开辟了全新的白盒范式。在复杂连续控制基准上的大量实验表明，CRWM无需依赖反馈驱动的奖励优化即可生成可执行奖励函数，在匹配或超越现有最优性能的同时显著缩短了获取机器人新技能的设计延迟，并在未见任务及多样化机器人形态上展现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper presents Causal Reward World Models (CRWM), a framework that pre-trains a causal model on multi-task interaction data to enable zero-shot reward function design for new robotic skills, replacing iterative LLM-based reward engineering.
tldr_zh: 本文提出因果奖励世界模型（CRWM），通过在多任务交互数据上预训练因果模型，实现对新机器人技能的零样本奖励函数设计，取代了迭代式的大语言模型奖励工程。

title: Assistron: Bayesian Shared Autonomy with Off-the-shelf Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: We propose Assistron, a shared autonomy model that leverages Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to assist the user in daily activities. Our approach is grounded in two core principles: (1)~minimizing human cognitive and physical effort by leveraging VLA-driven autonomy for macro-movements, and (2)~prioritizing human intervention specifically at critical failure points. Driven by the user's verbal language commands, Assistron utilizes the VLA to autonomously execute macro-reaching trajectories, saving users' effort. In contact-rich interactions where VLAs tend to fail, Assistron employs a phase-aware interaction detection mechanism and solicits the user to intervene, in turn adjusting the VLA's action generation via flow matching guidance. Critically, our formulation eliminates the need for VLA fine-tuning, protecting its broad behavioral priors from catastrophic forgetting and ensuring the model does not become a narrow specialist. We validate our approach on a comprehensive multi-task scene recovery benchmark encompassing diverse daily manipulation skills. Empirical results demonstrate that Assistron significantly improves task success rates over pure autonomous baselines while significantly reducing human cognitive and physical workload compared to traditional teleoperation, offering a scalable, smooth, and effortless paradigm for assistive manipulation. The code is available in https://github.com/mousecpn/Assistron.git.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Assistron，一种共享自主模型，它利用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型协助用户完成日常活动。该方法基于两个核心原则：（1）借助VLA驱动的自主性实现宏观运动，从而最小化人类的认知与体力消耗；（2）在关键失败点优先引入人工干预。由用户的口头语言指令驱动，Assistron利用VLA自主执行宏观到达轨迹，节省用户精力。在VLA易失效的富含接触的交互中，Assistron采用相位感知交互检测机制，请求用户介入，进而通过流匹配导引调整VLA的动作生成。关键在于，我们的方案无需对VLA进行微调，从而保护其广泛的行为先验知识免遭灾难性遗忘，确保模型不会沦为狭隘的专长型工具。我们在一个涵盖多种日常操作技能的综合多任务场景恢复基准上验证了该方法。实验结果表明，与纯自主基线相比，Assistron显著提升了任务成功率；同时，与传统遥操作相比，大幅降低了用户的认知与体力负担，为辅助操作提供了一种可扩展、平滑且省力的范式。代码已开源在 https://github.com/mousecpn/Assistron.git。
tldr: Assistron proposes a Bayesian shared autonomy framework that uses off-the-shelf VLA models for macro-movements while detecting contact-rich failures to trigger human intervention, improving assistive manipulation without VLA fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: Assistron提出一种贝叶斯共享自主框架，利用现成的VLA模型执行宏观运动，并在接触丰富的交互中检测失败点以触发人工干预，从而无需微调VLA即可提升辅助操作的成功率。

title: AdaReP:Adaptive Re-Planning under Model Mismatch for Neural World-Model Predictive Control
summary: Neural world models coupled with model predictive control (MPC) replan at every environment step to bound accumulated prediction error, but this incurs substantial computational overhead. Reusing a cached plan reduces this overhead, yet its effectiveness depends on how prediction mismatch propagates through the local dynamics. We analyze this trade-off with a perturbation-based dynamic-regret framework and show that stale-plan penalties scale with the reuse tolerance, the accumulated mismatch since the last replanning step, and the local dynamics sensitivity. Based on this structure, we propose AdaReP, a training-free wrapper that adapts the replanning tolerance online using the current deviation from the cached rollout and a local sensitivity estimate, without modifying the learned world model or planner. Across image-space planning, latent-space control, and real-world robotic manipulation, AdaReP substantially reduces planner-side computation while maintaining comparable task performance, including over 80% fewer queries on a 50-trial physical robot study.
summary_zh: 结合模型预测控制（MPC）的神经世界模型在每个环境步长中重新规划，以约束累积预测误差，但这会带来巨大的计算开销。重用缓存的规划可降低此开销，但其有效性取决于预测失配如何通过局部动力学传播。我们通过基于扰动的动态遗憾框架分析了这种权衡，并表明陈旧规划的惩罚随重用容差、自上次重规划步以来的累积失配量以及局部动力学的敏感度而增大。基于这一结构，我们提出AdaReP，一种无需训练的封装模块，它利用与缓存轨迹的当前偏差及局部敏感度估计，在线自适应调整重规划容差，而无需修改已学习的世界模型或规划器。在图像空间规划、潜空间控制以及真实机器人操作任务中，AdaReP在保持相当任务性能的同时显著降低了规划端计算量，包括在一项50次试次的物理机器人研究中减少了超过80%的查询次数。
tldr: AdaReP is a training-free wrapper that adaptively adjusts the replanning tolerance in neural world-model predictive control to reduce computational overhead while maintaining task performance, validated in image-space planning, latent-space control, and real-world robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: AdaReP 是一种无需重新训练的包装方法，可自适应调整神经世界模型预测控制中的重新规划容忍度，在保持任务性能的同时大幅降低计算开销，并在图像空间规划、潜在空间控制及真实机器人操作中得到验证。

title: Can Single-View Mesh Reconstruction Generalize to Robot Camera Rotation?
summary: Single-view mesh reconstruction predicts object meshes and spatial layouts from a single observation, making it attractive for fast robot spatial reasoning and real-to-sim digital twins. However, robot-mounted cameras naturally rotate during manipulation and navigation, while learned single-view reconstruction models often rely on view-dependent priors and may generalize poorly to out-of-distribution camera rotations. Such rotations can introduce 3D inconsistencies, incorrect layouts, and violations of physical constraints, but this failure mode remains under-evaluated. We introduce an evaluation protocol with controlled axis-wise roll, pitch, and yaw sweeps to trace errors in monocular depth estimation (MDE), canonical object meshes, camera-space layout, and physical plausibility within a representative SAM3D-style pipeline. On the Aria Digital Twin dataset and a real Franka wrist-camera sequence, camera rotations induce MDE distortion, layout drift, and collision penetration, while canonical mesh predictions remain relatively stable. A two-stage SAM3D+FoundationPose pipeline is more robust than one-stage feed-forward layout prediction, and our Gravity-Aware Refinement reduces one-stage pairwise ICP-based layout-orientation error by 47.1$\%$. Our evaluation reveals that current single-view mesh reconstruction methods generalize poorly to robot camera rotation, and suggests that explicit gravity cues are important for reliable robotic single-view mesh reconstruction.
summary_zh: 单视点网格重建从单次观测中预测物体网格与空间布局，使其在快速机器人空间推理和真实到仿真数字孪生中具有吸引力。然而，机器人搭载的摄像机在操作和导航过程中会自然旋转，而现有的单视点重建模型通常依赖视角相关先验，可能难以泛化到分布外的摄像机旋转。此类旋转会引入三维不一致性、错误布局及物理约束违反，但这一失效模式尚未得到充分评估。我们提出了一种评估协议，通过控制轴向横滚、俯仰与偏航扫描，在代表性SAM3D风格流程中追溯单目深度估计（MDE）、规范物体网格、相机空间布局及物理合理性的误差。在Aria数字孪生数据集与真实Franka腕部相机序列上，摄像机旋转导致MDE畸变、布局漂移及碰撞穿透，而规范网格预测保持相对稳定。两阶段SAM3D+FoundationPose流程比单阶段前馈布局预测更具鲁棒性，且我们的重力感知优化将单阶段基于成对ICP的布局方向误差降低了47.1%。评估表明，当前单视点网格重建方法难以泛化至机器人摄像机旋转，并揭示显式重力线索对于可靠的机器人单视点网格重建至关重要。
tldr: This paper evaluates the generalization of single-view mesh reconstruction to robot camera rotations, finding significant failures in depth estimation and layout consistency, and proposes a gravity-aware refinement to improve robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了单视图网格重建对机器人相机旋转的泛化能力，发现深度估计和布局一致性存在显著失败，并提出了重力感知优化以提高鲁棒性。

title: Distilling Collaborative Dynamics into Latent Space for Implicit Coordination in Decentralized Multi-Agent Manipulation
summary: Multi-arm manipulation demands precise spatiotemporal coordination, yet many centralized approaches scale poorly as team size increases. To address this, we propose CLS-DP, a decentralized multi-agent framework that enables implicit coordination under partial observability without shared global views, explicit state information, or inter-agent communication. Under the centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm, CLS-DP distills privileged multi-agent dynamics into a latent space. At deployment, each agent infers a collaborative latent from its local RGB observation and a shared task instruction; it then conditions the diffusion denoising process on this latent. This design enables implicit coordination with a per-agent cost independent of team size. Across six RoboFactory benchmark tasks spanning two to four agents, CLS-DP achieves a 38% mean success rate, outperforming the best centralized baseline (20%) and a decentralized ablation without the collaborative latent (9%). It also maintains superior parameter efficiency across all agent configurations. Attribution maps show that an agent conditioned on the collaborative latent places high attribution on the joints and grippers of both itself and its teammates throughout execution. This suggests that the learned latent efficiently encodes collaborative dynamics from local observation, which facilitates implicit coordination in realistic settings characterized by partial observability.
summary_zh: 多臂操控需要精确的时空协调，然而许多集中式方法在团队规模扩大时扩展性较差。为解决这一问题，我们提出CLS-DP——一种去中心化多智能体框架，能够在局部可观测条件下实现隐式协调，无需共享全局视图、显式状态信息或智能体间通信。在集中式训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）范式下，CLS-DP将特权多智能体动态特征蒸馏至隐空间。部署时，每个智能体根据自身局部RGB观测和共享任务指令推断出协作隐变量，并以此隐变量调节扩散去噪过程。该设计实现了与团队规模无关的隐式协调，每个智能体的计算成本独立于团队规模。在横跨两至四个智能体的六项RoboFactory基准任务中，CLS-DP达到38%的平均成功率，优于最优集中式基线（20%）以及不含协作隐变量的去中心化消融模型（9%）。在所有智能体配置下，该方法均保持卓越的参数效率。注意力图谱显示，基于协作隐变量调节的智能体在执行过程中，对自身及队友的关节与夹爪均给予高注意力权重。这表明所学隐变量能高效地从局部观测中编码协作动态，从而在具有局部可观测性的现实场景中促进隐式协调。
tldr: Proposes a decentralized multi-agent manipulation framework (CLS-DP) that distills privileged multi-agent dynamics into a latent space to enable implicit coordination under partial observability, achieving superior success rates on multi-arm benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种去中心化多智能体操作框架（CLS-DP），将特权多智能体动态蒸馏到潜在空间，实现在部分可观测下的隐式协调，在多臂基准任务上取得了更高的成功率。

title: Humanoid-OmniOcc: Stereo-Based Full-View Occupancy Dataset for Embodied AI
summary: Occupancy prediction at voxel-level granularity is essential for safe robotic navigation and interaction in complex environments. Existing occupancy datasets, however, are predominantly designed for autonomous driving with vehicle-centric biases -- forward-facing cameras, far-field geometry, and static road priors -- limiting their applicability to embodied humanoid perception. We present Humanoid-OmniOcc, a large-scale panoramic stereo-based occupancy dataset tailored for humanoid robots. The dataset encompasses 15 diverse simulated indoor scenes and 5 real-world environments, yielding over 155K samples with broad scene and style diversity. Importantly, the dataset is designed around a Real2Sim2Real closed-loop paradigm: real sensor specifications drive physically accurate simulation, simulation produces large-scale annotated training data, and models trained in simulation are directly evaluated on real-world captures -- enabling iterative refinement of the sim-to-real pipeline. We further propose \textbf{H}umanoid \textbf{S}urround \textbf{S}tereo-guided \textbf{Occ}upancy model (Humanoid-OmniOcc) that exploits robust depth priors for accurate 2D-to-3D lifting. Extensive experiments show that Humanoid-OmniOcc consistently outperforms monocular baselines and generalizes well to both unseen simulated test scenes and real-world environments, validating the effectiveness of the Real2Sim2Real design. Code and data will be available upon acceptance at https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/humanoid-omniocc.
summary_zh: 体素级粒度的占据预测对于机器人在复杂环境中安全导航与交互至关重要。然而，现有占据数据集主要为自动驾驶设计，存在以车辆为中心的偏差——前视相机、远场几何以及静态道路先验——限制了其在具身人形感知中的适用性。我们提出Humanoid-OmniOcc，一个专为人形机器人定制的大规模全景立体占据数据集。该数据集包含15个多样化仿真室内场景和5个真实环境，提供超过15.5万样本，具有广泛的场景与风格多样性。重要的是，数据集围绕"真实-仿真-真实"闭环范式设计：真实传感器参数驱动物理精确的仿真，仿真生成大规模带标注的训练数据，在仿真中训练的模型直接对真实采集数据进行评估——从而实现仿真到真实管线的迭代优化。我们进一步提出人形机器人环绕立体引导占据模型（Humanoid-OmniOcc），利用鲁棒深度先验实现精确的2D到3D映射。大量实验表明，Humanoid-OmniOcc持续优于单目基线方法，并能良好泛化至未见过的仿真测试场景及真实环境，验证了"真实-仿真-真实"设计的有效性。代码与数据将在论文接收后于https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/humanoid-omniocc开放。
tldr: This paper introduces a large-scale stereo-based occupancy dataset for humanoid robots, covering simulated and real indoor scenes, and a surround stereo-guided occupancy model that leverages depth priors for effective sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本论文提出了一个面向人形机器人的大规模立体全景占用数据集，包含仿真和真实室内场景，并设计了一种利用深度先验的环绕立体引导占用模型，实现了有效的仿真到真实的迁移。

title: PanoVine: Whole-Body Visuomotor Control for Soft Growing Vine Robot
summary: Vine robots, a class of soft, growing robots, are suitable for navigating complex and confined environments due to their compliant bodies and self-supporting growth mechanism. However, hysteresis, tether interactions, and deformations make them difficult to predict and model, which in turn limits the effectiveness of conventional planning and control approaches. In this work, we present a data-driven, vision-based control framework for the first autonomous vine robot system. Our system integrates 19 cameras distributed along the robot's body to provide comprehensive feedback of both the robot state and the surrounding environment. Using this rich whole-body vision feedback, we train an end-to-end visuomotor policy from demonstrations for closed-loop autonomous control in complex environments. The policy efficiently aggregates information from distributed sensing while maintaining robustness to inaccurate robot states and actuation. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned policy enables robust navigation and manipulation in challenging scenarios, including steering through branched structures, climbing up slopes, traversing unsupported terrain, reaching objects precisely, and maneuvering through confined spaces and obstacles. Project website https://panovine-bot.github.io
summary_zh: 藤蔓机器人作为一种软体生长型机器人，凭借其柔性本体与自支撑生长机制，适用于在复杂受限环境中导航。然而，由于迟滞效应、牵引线交互及形变等因素，其运动预测与建模存在困难，这限制了传统规划与控制方法的有效性。本文提出一种数据驱动的视觉控制框架，实现了首个自主藤蔓机器人系统。该系统沿机器人本体分布19个摄像头，提供机器人状态及周围环境的全方位反馈。基于丰富的全身视觉反馈，我们通过示教学习端到端的视觉-运动策略，用于复杂环境中的闭环自主控制。该策略能有效整合分布式传感信息，同时保持对不准确机器人状态与驱动信号的鲁棒性。实验结果表明，该学习策略能够在具有挑战性的场景中实现鲁棒导航与操作，包括穿越分支结构、攀爬斜坡、跨越无支撑地形、精确定位物体，以及通过狭窄空间与障碍物。项目网站：https://panovine-bot.github.io
tldr: PanoVine presents an end-to-end visuomotor policy for soft growing vine robots, using 19 distributed cameras and demonstration learning to achieve robust closed-loop navigation and manipulation in complex environments.
tldr_zh: PanoVine针对软体生长藤蔓机器人提出了一种端到端的视觉运动控制策略，利用19个分布式摄像头和示范学习，在复杂环境中实现鲁棒的闭环导航与操作。

title: Improving Robotic Imitation Learning via Trajectory Standardization
summary: Imitation learning for robotic manipulation relies on large sets of human demonstration trajectories, which are often noisy and temporally irregular due to variable operator speed, intermittent pauses, and inconsistent action density. A common preprocessing strategy is time-uniform downsampling to shorten sequences, but it cannot effectively remove speed-induced non-uniformity or redundant pauses. This mismatch degrades data quality and hinders policy learning. To address this issue, we propose Information-Standardized Trajectory Resampling (ISR), an offline preprocessing method for effective imitation learning. ISR resamples each trajectory by enforcing approximately equal information distance between adjacent points. Specifically, we map trajectories onto an information-modulated Riemannian manifold and perform geodesic-equidistant parameterization. We construct an information-intensity field from velocity and acceleration norms: the velocity term removes small-motion redundancy, while the acceleration term preserves high-curvature and fine-manipulation phases. We evaluate ISR on three real-world manipulation tasks with mainstream imitation learning policies. Compared with the baseline time-uniform 3x downsampling, ISR improves task success rates by about 25%, remains robust across datasets collected from different operators, and reduces both dataset size and training cost. The code and videos are publicly available at https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/isr.page.
summary_zh: 用于机器人操作的模仿学习依赖于大量人类示教轨迹，这些轨迹常因操作员速度变化、间歇性停顿和动作密度不一致而存在噪声且时间分布不均。常见的预处理策略是时间均匀降采样以缩短序列，但该方法无法有效消除速度导致的非均匀性及冗余停顿。这种不匹配会降低数据质量并阻碍策略学习。针对该问题，我们提出信息标准化轨迹重采样（ISR）——一种用于高效模仿学习的离线预处理方法。ISR通过强制相邻轨迹点之间保持近似相等的信息距离来重采样每条轨迹。具体而言，我们将轨迹映射到信息调制的黎曼流形上，并执行测地线等距参数化。我们利用速度与加速度范数构建信息强度场：速度项消除小幅运动冗余，加速度项则保留高曲率与精细操作阶段。我们在三个真实世界操作任务中，结合主流模仿学习策略对ISR进行评估。相比基线方法——时间均匀3倍降采样，ISR将任务成功率提升约25%，对不同操作员采集的数据集保持鲁棒性，同时减少了数据集规模与训练成本。代码与视频已公开于 https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/isr.page。
tldr: Proposes Information-Standardized Trajectory Resampling (ISR), an offline preprocessing method that resamples robot demonstration trajectories on an information-modulated Riemannian manifold to remove noise and temporal irregularity, improving imitation learning success rates by ~25% on real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出信息标准化轨迹重采样（ISR），通过在信息调制的黎曼流形上重采样机器人示教轨迹，去除噪声和时间不规则性，在真实操作任务上将模仿学习成功率提升约25%。

title: Temporal Logic Guidance for Action-Only Diffusion Policies with World Models
summary: Diffusion policies enable multimodal robot behavior but offer limited ability to choose among behavior modes at inference time, even though such control is desirable in human-robot settings. Prior solutions to this lack of control have utilized Signal Temporal Logic (STL) to express human intentions and provide corresponding guidance for diffusion policy inference. However, these approaches can only guide diffusion policies that jointly generate future actions and states, increasing both complexity and runtime. We propose a novel guidance method for action-only diffusion policies that uses a separate learned world model to enable differentiable evaluation of STL robustness, with its gradient then injected into the diffusion process. This steers behavior toward constraint satisfaction without retraining, improving constraint adherence while preserving task performance. On the Can Transport task from Robomimic, our method maintains 100% task success while reducing constraint violations from over 80% for baseline methods to 4%. We also discuss extensions toward improved robustness and more complex constraints.
summary_zh: 扩散策略能够实现多模态机器人行为，但在推理阶段对行为模式的选择能力有限，尽管在人机交互场景中这种控制能力至关重要。现有针对此控制缺失的解决方案采用信号时序逻辑（STL）表达人类意图，并为扩散策略推理提供相应指导。然而，这些方法仅能引导联合生成未来动作与状态的扩散策略，既增加了复杂度也延长了运行时。我们提出一种针对纯动作扩散策略的新型引导方法，该方法利用独立学习的具身世界模型实现STL鲁棒性的可微评估，并将其梯度注入扩散过程。此举无需重新训练即可驱使行为趋向约束满足，在保持任务性能的同时提升约束遵循度。在Robomimic的物体搬运任务中，我们的方法在维持100%任务成功率的同时，将约束违反率从基线方法的80%以上降至4%。我们还讨论了向提升鲁棒性与处理更复杂约束的扩展方向。
tldr: Combines an action-only diffusion policy with a learned world model to enable differentiable Signal Temporal Logic guidance, improving constraint satisfaction without retraining.
tldr_zh: 结合仅动作扩散策略与学习的世界模型，实现可微的信号时序逻辑引导，在不重新训练的情况下提高约束满足度。

title: Compression and Retrieval: Implicit Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
summary: Video world models hold promise for simulating interactive environments, yet maintaining consistent long-term memory across complex camera trajectories remains a critical challenge. Existing methods typically rely on computationally expensive context scaling or rigid heuristic retrieval mechanisms, which lacks generalization to varying camera trajectories and environments. In this paper, we propose Compression and Retrieval (CaR), an attention-driven implicit memory retrieval mechanism to overcome these limitations. By injecting viewpoint information via positional encoding, our method performs flexible memory retrieval through attention computation. To efficiently process extended contexts with minimal computational overhead, we further introduce a lightweight context compression network. Furthermore, we construct SceneFly, a large-scale synthetic dataset featuring realistic camera trajectories and frame-level annotations to train and evaluate long-horizon video world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on established benchmarks and exhibits strong generalization to open-domain scenes.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型有望用于模拟交互式环境，但在复杂相机轨迹中保持一致的长期记忆仍是一项关键挑战。现有方法通常依赖计算成本高昂的上下文扩展或僵化的启发式检索机制，这些方法难以泛化到不同相机轨迹和环境。本文提出压缩与检索机制（CaR），一种基于注意力机制的隐式记忆检索方法以克服上述局限。该方法通过位置编码注入视点信息，并利用注意力计算实现灵活的隐式记忆检索。为高效处理扩展上下文且最小化计算开销，我们进一步引入轻量级上下文压缩网络。此外，我们构建了SceneFly大规模合成数据集，该数据集包含逼真的相机轨迹和帧级别标注，用于训练和评估长时域视频世界模型。大量实验表明，本方法在现有基准测试中达到最优性能，并在开放域场景中展现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: Proposes an attention-driven implicit memory retrieval mechanism (CaR) and a lightweight context compression network for video world models to maintain long-term memory consistency across complex camera trajectories, along with a synthetic dataset SceneFly for training and evaluation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种注意力驱动的隐式记忆检索机制（CaR）和轻量级上下文压缩网络，用于视频世界模型在复杂相机轨迹下保持长期记忆一致性，并构建了合成数据集SceneFly用于训练和评估。

title: Scalable Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Policies via Adjoint Matching
summary: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for representing complex action distributions in reinforcement learning (RL). However, their application to online RL remains limited by the challenge of scalable training in the absence of ground-truth data, where standard optimization techniques such as score matching are not directly applicable. In this work, we introduce a highly efficient algorithm for optimizing diffusion policies by leveraging recent advances in stochastic optimal control. Our approach is based on adjoint matching, which enables simulation-free training and circumvents the need for explicit likelihood estimation or costly backpropagation through the diffusion process. Furthermore, we propose several extensions that improve the robustness and stability of the method in practical settings. Empirical results demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive performance while significantly reducing computational overhead, making diffusion policies more viable for online RL scenarios.
summary_zh: 扩散策略近来已成为强化学习（RL）中表征复杂动作分布的一种强大范式。然而，其在在线RL中的应用仍受限于缺乏真实数据时的可扩展训练难题，此时诸如分数匹配等标准优化技术无法直接适用。在本工作中，我们引入了一种高效算法，通过利用随机最优控制领域的最新进展来优化扩散策略。该方法基于伴随匹配技术，能够实现免模拟训练，并规避了显式似然估计或经扩散过程的昂贵反向传播需求。此外，我们提出了若干扩展方法，以提升该方法在实际场景中的稳健性与稳定性。实验结果表明，我们的方法在显著降低计算开销的同时实现了具有竞争力的性能，从而使得扩散策略在在线RL场景中更具可行性。
tldr: This paper proposes adjoint matching, a simulation-free algorithm to train diffusion policies for online reinforcement learning, reducing computational overhead while maintaining competitive performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出伴随匹配方法，一种无模拟的扩散策略在线强化学习训练算法，在降低计算开销的同时保持竞争性能。

title: Efficient Continuous Semantic Mapping based on Spatio-Temporal Awareness
summary: Continuous semantic mapping allows autonomous robots to understand both the spatial structure and the semantic content of complex environments. However, most existing methods process the entire space, treat voxels as independent units, and do not keep the semantic labels consistent over time. This leads to high computational cost and reduced robustness in dynamic scenes. This paper proposes a semantic mapping method that brings spatial and temporal relationships into the semantic inference process. The method adjusts the inference range according to the local semantic uncertainty and fuses labels over time to improve map stability and computational efficiency. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI dataset show that the proposed method improves mapping accuracy by about 12% and reaches an mIoU of 54.92%, which is 13.18 percentage points higher than spatial-only mapping. These results show that spatiotemporal reasoning is effective for continuous semantic mapping in autonomous robotic systems.
summary_zh: 连续语义建图使自主机器人在理解复杂环境的空间结构的同时，也能理解其语义内容。然而，现有方法大多对整个空间进行处理，将体素视为独立单元，且无法保持语义标签随时间的一致性，这导致计算成本高昂，并在动态场景中降低了鲁棒性。本文提出一种将空间与时间关系引入语义推理过程的语义建图方法。该方法根据局部语义不确定性调整推理范围，并通过随时间融合标签来提高地图稳定性与计算效率。在SemanticKITTI数据集上的实验表明，所提方法将建图精度提升了约12%，并达到了54.92%的平均交并比（mIoU），比仅基于空间的建图方法高出13.18个百分点。这些结果表明，时空推理对于自主机器人系统中的连续语义建图是有效的。
tldr: This paper proposes a continuous semantic mapping method that exploits spatio-temporal awareness to reduce computational cost and improve robustness in dynamic scenes, validated on the SemanticKITTI dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种利用时空感知的连续语义建图方法，以降低计算开销并提升动态场景下的鲁棒性，在SemanticKITTI数据集上验证。

title: Autonomous Subsea Cable Search and Tracking with Graph-Optimised Priors and Visual Tracking
summary: Global communications rely on subsea cable infrastructure that remains vulnerable to damage from natural hazards and human activity. Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) offer an efficient means to inspect long sections of exposed cable, but uncertainty in cable route maps, small cable diameters and partial burial makes continuous tracking a challenge. This paper presents a novel cable search and tracking method that leverages uncertain prior cable route maps. Graph-based optimisation continuously update the cable route to remain consistent with visual observations. Route uncertainty is constrained as a function of distance from observations using physics-based catenary models that account for cable parameters (i.e., lay depth, diameter, and density), bounding the search space to physically feasible regions and improving search efficiency. Cable detection is performed using a semi-supervised classifier running in real-time on-board a camera-equipped AUV. These detections both update the graph-based optimisation and enable visual cable tracking. When tracking is lost due to misclassification, burial or imperfect control, the bounded search space enables efficient recovery. The approach was demonstrated in field trials using the University of Southampton's Smarty200 AUV. The system successfully located the cable despite deliberate errors in it initial cable route map, updating this to be consistent with observations and using visual tracking to inspect up to 59% of a 120m test cable, with successful recovered after tracking loss.
tldr: This paper presents an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) system that combines graph-based optimization with uncertain prior cable route maps and real-time visual tracking to search for and track subsea cables, demonstrated in field trials on a real AUV.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自主水下航行器（AUV）系统，结合基于图优化的不确定先验电缆路由地图与实时视觉跟踪，用于搜索和跟踪海底电缆，并在真实AUV上进行了现场试验验证。

title: Real-Time Multimodal Activity-Aware Error Detection in Robot-Assisted Surgery
summary: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery improves surgical precision but introduces complexity, making technical error detection essential for ensuring patient safety. Current executional error detection methods using video data often overlook fine-grained contextual descriptions of activities and error types within the hierarchical structure of surgical procedures. They also under-utilize complementary multimodal information. We propose a unified framework for executional error detection that leverages multimodal input, including video, kinematics, and descriptive textual prompts. Through activity prompting, we integrate descriptive language in gesture-level activities, instrument-object interactions, and error definitions. We also introduce activity-aware visual embeddings derived from vision encoders pretrained on surgical activity labels to compare the effectiveness of contrastive language-image embeddings with traditional image-based embeddings for error detection. By seamlessly integrating kinematic data with video and textual modalities, our framework significantly improves error detection performance. Achieving up to 5\% and 16.6\% F1 score improvements over state-of-the-art baselines on the JIGSAWS and SAR-RARP50 datasets, respectively, we demonstrate the value of combining curated textual prompts with multimodal data for accurate error detection.
tldr: Proposes a multimodal framework integrating video, kinematics, and descriptive text prompts for real-time error detection in robot-assisted surgery, achieving improved F1 scores on JIGSAWS and SAR-RARP50.
tldr_zh: 提出一个多模态框架，整合视频、运动学和描述性文本提示，用于机器人辅助手术中的实时错误检测，在 JIGSAWS 和 SAR-RARP50 数据集上取得 F1 分数提升。

title: BiliVLA: Scene-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model with Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Biliary Endoscopic Navigation
summary: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) demands precise endoscopic navigation and stable biliary cannulation within a narrow monocular field characterized by specular reflections, partial occlusions, and frequent tissue contact. Although recent robotic systems and vision-based assistance techniques improve operator ergonomics and provide perceptual cues, their performance degrades under pronounced anatomical variability and safety-critical visual artifacts, which hinders reliable autonomy in cannulation-grade procedures. Here, we present BiliVLA, a scene-aware Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that formulates biliary endoscopic navigation as an instruction-conditioned visuomotor learning problem. Given an endoscopic observation and a stage-specific language instruction, BiliVLA jointly predicts the target category, a grounded bounding box, and a discrete three degrees of freedom (DoF) motor command for a continuum endoscope. The proposed framework incorporates scene-aware supervision to enhance semantic target consistency and safety-aware recovery supervision to induce conservative retreat behaviors under luminal wall contact. A key component of BiliVLA is a two-stage training paradigm that combines grounding-enhanced supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which significantly improves action reliability and decision consistency during closed-loop navigation. Across three ERCP subtasks, BiliVLA achieves an average action precision of 91.96\% and an overall success rate (SR) of 84.85\% in real-world phantom experiments. These results indicate that integrating semantic grounding, scene-aware learning, and reward-guided optimization improves perception-action alignment and enables robust autonomous endoscopic navigation.
tldr: BiliVLA introduces a scene-aware Vision-Language-Action model that combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (GRPO) to achieve robust autonomous navigation in biliary endoscopy.
tldr_zh: BiliVLA提出了一种场景感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，结合监督微调与GRPO强化学习，实现了胆道内窥镜的鲁棒自主导航。

title: Flow6D: Discrete-to-Continuous Flow Matching for Efficient and Accurate Category-Level 6D Pose Estimation
summary: 6D pose estimation is a key task in computer vision and embodied AI, widely used in robotic manipulation, augmented reality, etc. Existing methods directly regress in a high-dimensional continuous space, facing two key challenges in category-level pose estimation: limited accuracy due to noise and local optima, and inefficient search over an infinite space that hinders real-time performance. This paper proposes Flow6D, a hierarchical flow matching framework with a two-stage discrete latent space localization-continuous pose regression strategy. Rotation and translation parameters are first discretized into bins, with a discrete flow matching model locking the latent space around the true pose to reduce search complexity. Then, by sampling in the latent space, a continuous flow matching model predicts local pose residuals to optimize the estimate and regress to an accurate pose. The framework also naturally extends to articulated objects, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real datasets with real-time inference at 70 FPS. Project website: https://flow6d.github.io/.
tldr: Flow6D proposes a hierarchical flow matching framework for category-level 6D pose estimation, combining discrete latent localization with continuous regression to achieve high accuracy and real-time performance (70 FPS).
tldr_zh: Flow6D 提出了一种分层流匹配框架，通过离散潜空间定位与连续回归结合，实现了类别级6D姿态估计的高精度和实时性能（70 FPS）。

title: Lessons from the Field: A Case Study of Robotic Intervention in an Industrial Emergency
summary: Incidents in chemical plants can pose a high level of risk and harsh environments for first responders. Contamination and explosion hazards can deny human access to the affected infrastructure, underscoring the need for capable robot systems. This field report documents the successful deployment of a robotic task force to neutralize an explosive gas hazard at a chemical plant after a fire incident. An Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) with a custom manipulation tool opened a critical valve under hazardous conditions, averting the threat of a large-scale explosion. We provide insights into robot deployment and use the mission results to highlight both the importance of rescue robotics and limitations of using research platforms in real emergency deployments, such as communication constraints and the need for enhanced operator-assistance functions.
tldr: This paper reports on a real-world deployment of a robotic system (UGV with custom manipulation tool) to neutralize an explosive gas hazard at a chemical plant, highlighting practical challenges and operator-assistance needs in rescue robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文报告了在化工厂爆炸性气体危险中部署机器人系统（带有定制操作工具的UGV）的真实案例，强调了救援机器人中的实际挑战和操作辅助需求。

title: ShotcreteDepth: A Bi-modal Dataset for Robust Robotic Depth Perception in Shotcrete Construction Environments
summary: We introduce ShotcreteDepth, a bi-modal dataset from the construction domain that captures both an active shotcreting process and general construction environments. The dataset comprises stereo RGB imagery and LiDAR point clouds acquired under harsh real-world conditions, including high turbidity and poor illumination. Such conditions adversely affect sensor measurements, leading to incomplete and noisy observations that pose significant challenges for perception systems in autonomous applications. Alongside the dataset, we release a lightweight annotation tool designed for time-efficient labeling of LiDAR point clouds. ShotcreteDepth consists of 11,252 temporally synchronized data samples, of which 220 are annotated for evaluation purposes. The dataset supports research in stereo matching, depth completion, and depth estimation under conditions that closely reflect the operational complexities found in industrial settings. Project repository: https://github.com/dtu-pas/shotcrete-depth
tldr: ShotcreteDepth introduces a bi-modal (stereo RGB + LiDAR) dataset for depth perception in harsh construction environments, along with a lightweight annotation tool for LiDAR point clouds.
tldr_zh: ShotcreteDepth 提出了一个在恶劣施工环境下的双模态（立体RGB+激光雷达）深度感知数据集，并附带一个轻量级激光雷达点云标注工具。

title: HERCULES: An Open-Source Simulation Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot SLAM, Collaborative Perception, and Exploration
summary: We present HERCULES, an open-source simulator and data-collection pipeline for heterogeneous multi-robot autonomy. Built upon the Unreal Engine 5 (UE5)-based simulators AirSim and Cosys-AirSim, HERCULES resolves key architectural limitations of prior frameworks to enable concurrent unmanned aerial and ground vehicle (UAV-UGV) operation in large-scale, photorealistic, dynamic environments. It introduces a new waypoint-tracking UGV controller that mirrors existing UAV control interfaces, and provides a shared navigation stack for mapping, traversability analysis, planning, and control across heterogeneous platforms. Expanding inherited sensor suites, it adds physics-based long-wave infrared (LWIR) cameras and configurable night-vision modes for degraded visual environments. HERCULES provides lightweight APIs, ROS 2 wrappers, and rigorous time synchronization across sensors and platforms, and brings state-of-the-art game-engine capabilities into robotics simulation, integrating intelligent agents such as pedestrians, traffic, and wildlife with high-fidelity dynamic phenomena, including fire, flooding, and crop disease spread. HERCULES runs in two modes: passively, replaying offline-designed trajectories to generate reproducible multi-modal datasets, and actively, running an online planner in closed loop from live observations. Our experiments in heterogeneous multi-robot SLAM, collaborative perception, and exploration, using both HERCULES-generated data and active closed-loop execution, demonstrate its utility for advancing heterogeneous multi-robot autonomy. We publicly release our source code, experiment code, documentation, and datasets, including a heterogeneous multi-robot SLAM benchmark collected with two UAVs and two UGVs across kilometer-scale desert, forest, and city environments, at https://lunarlab-gatech.github.io/HERCULES-website.
tldr: HERCULES is an open-source simulation framework for heterogeneous multi-robot autonomy, built on Unreal Engine 5, supporting UAV-UGV operation, multi-modal sensor suites, and closed-loop planning for SLAM, collaborative perception, and exploration.
tldr_zh: HERCULES是一个基于Unreal Engine 5的开源多机器人异构自主仿真框架，支持无人机-地面车辆联合操作、多模态传感器套件以及用于SLAM、协同感知和探索的闭环规划。

title: Integrated cloud-based architecture for robot-robot and human-robot collaboration using ROS 2--MQTT in Mediterranean Greenhouses
summary: The imperative to develop more sustainable agriculture demands a transition from isolated automation toward the deployment of multi-robot systems (MRS) in agrifood environments. However, Mediterranean greenhouse settings-characterized by narrow corridors, dense biomass, and structural metallic interference-pose significant challenges for robust and scalable communication between agents. Traditional robotic frameworks, such as ROS 2, frequently encounter node discovery issues and latency spikes due to dynamic obstacles, dense foliage, and other characteristic greenhouse elements, creating a critical bottleneck for real-time coordination. This paper proposes an innovative cloud-based hybrid architecture that establishes a two-way communication bridge between ROS 2, acting as an edge computing platform, and iVeg as a Decision Support System (DSS), using MQTT and the European FIWARE platform. The proposed framework enables seamless interoperability between fleets of multiple robots in environments with communication constraints, facilitating the synchronised exchange of high-level telemetry, point cloud data and farmer identification for collaboration, amongst other critical data. The architecture was validated in a high-fidelity simulation environment and subsequently tested in a real-world greenhouse scenario, demonstrating its ability to maintain persistent connectivity and data integrity under adverse network conditions. The results indicate that the integration of MQTT effectively eliminates information silos, providing a scalable and decentralised solution for managing complex robotic missions, which are executed locally via Edge Computing. This work sets a new methodological precedent for the concept of Greenhouse Models as a Service (GMaaS), bridging the gap between low-level robotic control and high-level, cloud-based IoT decision-making.
tldr: Proposes a cloud-based hybrid architecture bridging ROS 2 and MQTT/FIWARE for scalable multi-robot and human-robot collaboration in constrained Mediterranean greenhouse environments, validated in simulation and real-world tests.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于云端的混合架构，通过ROS 2与MQTT/FIWARE桥接，实现地中海温室受限环境下多机器人与人机协作的可扩展通信，并在仿真和真实场景中得到验证。

title: Each Judge Its Own Yardstick: Discovering Per-VLM Taxonomies for Physical Video Evaluation
summary: Maintaining physical consistency in video generators and world models increasingly relies on vision-language models (VLMs) as automated judges that provide reward signals, ranking decisions, and data-filtering criteria. Yet VLMs differ substantially in training data and architecture, encoding physical phenomena through distinct internal representations. A single global evaluation schema therefore gives every VLM the same axes of competence, regardless of what each can actually perceive. We propose JudgeFit, an iterative refinement procedure that discovers a per-VLM evaluation taxonomy. An initial taxonomy is constructed by prompting the target VLM to enumerate physics errors on a small set of videos and clustering the resulting descriptions. The taxonomy is then refined through a diagnostic step: we calibrate the VLM's per-dimension scores to human physical-commonsense ratings, diagnose which dimensions it scores unreliably or redundantly, and prompt an LLM to repair them, iterating until convergence. We further instantiate this procedure as a benchmark and apply it to 16 VLMs spanning eight model families. The refined taxonomy outperforms the global-schema baseline on held-out videos for every VLM tested, with a mean relative improvement of approximately 32%. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the per-VLM profiles expose model-specific blind spots that overall rankings cannot anticipate, with reliability patterns differing markedly across model families.
tldr: JudgeFit discovers a per-VLM evaluation taxonomy by iteratively refining error descriptions and calibrating scores to human ratings, improving physical consistency evaluation over a single global schema.
tldr_zh: JudgeFit 通过迭代细化错误描述并将分数校准到人类评分，为每个视觉语言模型发现专属的评估分类体系，优于单一的全局评估模式。

title: When Robots Rate Their Own Interactions: Engagement Validity and the Strangeness Failure
summary: Human-robot interaction (HRI) evaluation relies almost exclusively on human-completed questionnaires, leaving the robot's perspective unexamined. We propose an \textit{inverted evaluation}, in which LLM-powered robots complete the same standardized instruments from their own perspective, and test whether these ratings agree with human ground truth. In Study~1, five LLMs completed HRI-CUES, Godspeed, and RoSAS questionnaires for 25~interactions ($N = 1{,}522$ evaluations) from the HRI-CUES dataset. LLMs achieved moderate-to-strong agreement on engagement dimensions (satisfaction $r$ up to $.65$ and enjoyment $r$ up to $.72$) with excellent test-retest reliability (ICC $\geq .82$), but \textit{systematically inverted} the comfort/strangeness dimension ($r = -.44$ to $-.67$, all $p < .05$), conflating engagement with comfort. In Study~2, a Nao robot running Claude~Sonnet~4.5 replicated these patterns in live interactions ($N = 4$), including real-time turn-by-turn assessment. The strangeness failure persisted across five models, synthetic controls, and embodied deployment for two participants. We argue that current LLM-based robots lack access to the internal affective states needed to assess constructs like strangeness, and that inverted evaluation requires supplementary modalities (e.g., physiological signals, gaze, proxemics) to move beyond behavioral proxies. These findings establish boundary conditions for using LLMs as interaction evaluators in HRI.
tldr: This paper proposes an inverted evaluation method where LLM-powered robots complete HRI questionnaires from their own perspective, finding moderate agreement on engagement but systematic inversion on comfort/strangeness, highlighting limitations of LLMs for assessing internal affective states in HRI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种反向评估方法，让LLM驱动的机器人从自身视角完成人机交互问卷，发现其在参与度上有中等一致性，但在舒适/陌生维度上系统性反转，揭示了LLM评估HRI中内在情感状态的局限性。

title: A Vendor-Agnostic LiDAR Data Conversion System with Multi-Signal Detection and Multi-Format Output
summary: LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) sensors capture the surrounding environment as dense 3D point clouds by measuring the time-of-flight of emitted laser pulses, making them foundational across autonomous vehicles, robotics, and large-scale mapping. PCAP (Packet Capture) files from these sensors are the starting point of most 3D perception pipelines, yet internal packet structures, UDP (User Datagram Protocol) port conventions and encoding schemes differ enough across manufacturers that no single tool reads them all. Ouster, Velodyne, Hesai, and Livox each require their own SDK (Software Development Kit), their own environment setup, and their own conversion workflow. Supporting all four means maintaining four disconnected pipelines with no shared infrastructure. The pipeline described here takes a raw PCAP as input and handles vendor identification automatically, scoring six independent file characteristics through a weighted multi-signal approach to determine the source sensor. C++ SDKs handle Ouster and Velodyne, while Hesai and Livox rely on Python-based dpkt parsing where no open source SDK exists. From there, a single command writes output to any of five industry-standard formats. We tested on real outdoor captures. Ouster peaks at 2.08M points per second, Velodyne at 1.47M, both running through native C++ packet decoding. Hesai and Livox land at 110K and 150K respectively, where Python-layer parsing introduces overhead that compounds under sustained load. The 8-10x gap held consistently across runs. Tested on a consumer-grade i3 with 8GB RAM, no vendor configuration required
tldr: This paper presents a vendor-agnostic LiDAR data conversion system that automatically detects sensor type from raw PCAP files (Ouster, Velodyne, Hesai, Livox) and outputs multiple standard formats, tested on real outdoor captures with throughput measurements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种供应商无关的LiDAR数据转换系统，可从原始PCAP文件中自动检测传感器类型（Ouster、Velodyne、Hesai、Livox）并输出多种标准格式，并在真实户外捕获中进行了吞吐量测试。

title: FPAS: Frontier-Based Path Planning with Adaptive Sampling for Large-Scale Unknown Environments
summary: In this work, we propose Frontier-based Path Planning with Adaptive Sampling (FPAS), a novel framework designed for efficient goal-reaching in large-scale, unknown environments.
