tldr: OpenSPM proposes a spatial persistent memory framework combining 3D perception, Kalman-filtered key pose extraction from demonstrations, and a lightweight closed-loop flow-matching action model to achieve high-frequency, environment-transferable tabletop manipulation.
tldr_zh: OpenSPM提出了一种空间持久记忆框架，结合3D感知、从示教中提取关键姿态的卡尔曼滤波以及轻量级闭环流匹配动作模型，实现了高频、可环境迁移的桌面操作。

title: RoamFlow: Reinforcement-Aligned One-Step Action MeanFlow Policy for Image-Goal Navigation
summary: Image-goal navigation is a key challenge in embodied robotics, where an agent must reach a target specified solely by a goal image. While existing reinforcement learning approaches map perceptual observations directly to actions, they struggle to model long-horizon dependencies, often leading to suboptimal trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose RoamFlow, a generative navigation framework that leverages MeanFlow to predict the average velocity field for trajectory synthesis, enabling efficient few-step generation and reducing inference latency. We further adopt a two-stage training strategy that combines expert imitation for stable initialization with reinforcement learning for task-specific policy refinement. Extensive experiments in both Habitat simulation and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that RoamFlow achieves efficient inference while maintaining strong navigation performance under real-time constraints.
summary_zh: 图像目标导航是具身机器人领域的一项关键挑战，要求智能体仅凭目标图像指定的位置抵达终点。现有强化学习方法虽能将感知观测直接映射为动作，但在建模长程依赖关系方面存在困难，常导致次优轨迹。针对这一局限，我们提出RoamFlow生成式导航框架，利用MeanFlow预测轨迹合成所需的平均速度场，实现高效少步生成并降低推理延迟。我们进一步采用两阶段训练策略：结合专家模仿实现稳定初始化，再通过强化学习进行任务特定策略精调。在Habitat仿真环境与真实机器人平台上的大量实验表明，RoamFlow在满足实时性约束的同时，兼顾高效推理与强导航性能。
tldr: RoamFlow proposes a generative navigation framework using MeanFlow for efficient few-step trajectory prediction and reinforcement learning for policy refinement, achieving high-performance image-goal navigation in simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: RoamFlow 提出了一种生成式导航框架，利用 MeanFlow 进行高效的少步骤轨迹预测，并采用强化学习进行策略优化，在仿真和真实机器人上实现了高性能的图像目标导航。

title: Pondering the Way: Spatial-perceiving World Action Model for Embodied Navigation
summary: Existing world model-based planners for visual navigation typically follow a verification-centric paradigm, decoupling goal intent from trajectory synthesis. This approach suffers from candidate dependence, heavy computational overhead, and inconsistencies between sampled actions and predicted visuals. To address these issues, we propose SWAM (Spatial-perceiving World Action Model), a task-centric joint observation-action generation framework. Given start and goal RGB observations, SWAM performs single-pass inference to simultaneously generate intermediate RGB-D sequences and corresponding action trajectories, promoting goal-consistent trajectory generation and improved spatial feasibility. While SWAM leverages depth pseudo-labels during training to internalize spatial priors, it requires only monocular RGB input at inference time. We further introduce a visual-guided action refinement module and a trajectory-scale regularization loss to enforce fine-grained alignment between motion and visual cues while stabilizing predictions across varying distances. Extensive experiments show that SWAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art two-stage planners in success rate, trajectory accuracy, and inference efficiency, while demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen environments.
summary_zh: 现有的基于世界模型的视觉导航规划器通常遵循验证中心范式，将目标意图与轨迹生成解耦。这种方法存在候选依赖、计算开销大以及采样动作与预测视觉不一致等问题。为解决这些问题，我们提出SWAM（空间感知世界动作模型），一种以任务为中心的联合观测-动作生成框架。给定起始和目标RGB观测，SWAM通过单次推理同时生成中间RGB-D序列及对应动作轨迹，促进目标一致的轨迹生成并提升空间可行性。尽管SWAM在训练阶段利用深度伪标签内化空间先验，推理时仅需单目RGB输入。我们进一步引入视觉引导的动作优化模块和轨迹尺度正则化损失，以强化运动与视觉线索间的细粒度对齐，同时稳定不同距离下的预测。大量实验表明，SWAM在成功率、轨迹精度和推理效率上显著优于最先进的两阶段规划器，并在未见环境中展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。
tldr: SWAM is a world action model that jointly generates intermediate RGB-D sequences and action trajectories for embodied navigation from start and goal images, outperforming two-stage planners.
tldr_zh: SWAM是一种世界动作模型，可从起始和目标图像联合生成中间RGB-D序列和动作轨迹，用于具身导航，性能优于两阶段规划器。

title: Trust Your Instincts: Confidence-Driven Test-Time RL for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become indispensable for pushing Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) beyond static imitation learning. However, existing RL methods typically require external environmental feedback, relying on predefined success signals to guide policy updates. In this work, we show that VLA models possess useful internal evaluative capabilities: in discrete-action VLAs, trajectories with higher generation confidence are significantly more likely to succeed. Based on this observation, we introduce T^2VLA (Test-time VLA), an architecture-agnostic test-time RL framework that enables VLA models to achieve self-bootstrapping policy improvement. Instead of relying on external rewards, T^2VLA leverages trajectory-level similarity to high-confidence expert demonstrations as an intrinsic reward signal. In addition, we propose a Confidence-Driven Dual Expert Bootstrapping mechanism, which dynamically balances a Local Pseudo-Expert for exploration and a Global Expert Pool for training stability. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks show that T^2VLA consistently outperforms supervised baselines and approaches oracle RL performance with ground-truth rewards, achieving effective improvement without external reward feedback. Furthermore, T^2VLA adapts to distinct VLA paradigms, including both OpenVLA-OFT and the pi series.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为推动视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）超越静态模仿学习的关键技术。然而，现有RL方法通常需要外部环境反馈，依赖预定义的成功信号来指导策略更新。本研究证明VLA模型具备有用的内部评估能力：在离散动作VLA中，生成置信度更高的轨迹具有显著更高的成功概率。基于这一发现，我们提出T²VLA（测试时VLA），一种架构无关的测试时RL框架，使VLA模型能够实现自举式策略改进。T²VLA不依赖外部奖励，而是利用轨迹与高置信度专家示范的轨迹级相似度作为内在奖励信号。此外，我们提出置信度驱动双专家自举机制，通过动态平衡用于探索的局部伪专家与用于训练稳定性的全局专家池。在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上的大量实验表明，T²VLA持续优于监督式基线方法，其性能接近使用真实奖励的Oracle RL方法，即在无外部奖励反馈的情况下实现了有效改进。此外，T²VLA可适配多种VLA范式，包括OpenVLA-OFT与pi系列。
tldr: Proposes a test-time RL framework for VLA models that uses internal generation confidence as an intrinsic reward signal to improve policy without external environmental feedback.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于视觉-语言-动作模型的测试时强化学习框架，利用内在生成置信度作为内在奖励信号，在无需外部环境反馈的情况下改进策略。

title: Legible Shared Autonomy: Implicit Communication of Robot Belief through Motion
summary: Shared autonomy systems combine user input with autonomous assistance to help users with motor impairments control robot arms to perform everyday manipulation tasks, by inferring user goals and providing appropriate guidance. However, the robot's internal beliefs about user goals cannot be observed by users. Traditional shared autonomy systems provide assistance along efficient shortest paths toward inferred goals, but when multiple objects lie in similar directions, such assistive motion remains ambiguous and fails to reveal the specific goal identified by the robot. This creates two critical problems. First, when the robot correctly infers the goal, users continue controlling because they cannot perceive understanding from ambiguous assistive motion, wasting effort when autonomous completion would suffice. Second, when the robot misunderstands intent, users cannot quickly detect errors until assistive motion diverges significantly, requiring substantial corrective input. We address this by introducing legible motion into shared autonomy, where robot actions must both advance toward the goal and clearly reveal which goal has been inferred, enabling users to understand the robot's beliefs and adjust control accordingly. The robot modulates communication strength through confidence-aware adaptive authority allocation by providing assertive legible assistive actions when confident while increasing user authority when uncertain, transforming shared autonomy into transparent bidirectional collaboration. User studies including simulation and physical experiments with a six-degree-of-freedom robot arm demonstrate that legible shared autonomy significantly improves users' understanding of robot beliefs and reduces user control effort compared to standard shared autonomy.
summary_zh: 共享自主系统通过推断用户目标并提供相应引导，将用户输入与自主辅助相结合，帮助运动功能障碍者控制机械臂完成日常操作任务。然而，用户无法观察到机器人对用户目标的内部信念。传统共享自主系统会为推断目标提供沿高效最短路径的辅助，但当多个物体位于相似方向时，这种辅助运动仍存在歧义，无法揭示机器人识别的具体目标。这引发两个关键问题：其一，当机器人正确推断目标时，用户因无法从模糊的辅助运动中感知到机器人的理解而继续操控，在自主完成本可胜任的情况下徒耗精力；其二，当机器人误解意图时，用户需等到辅助运动出现显著偏差才能快速发现错误，从而需要大量修正性输入。我们通过将可解读运动引入共享自主系统来解决该问题——机器人的动作既要朝向目标推进，又要明确揭示其推断的目标，使用户能够理解机器人的信念并相应调整控制。机器人通过置信度感知的自适应权限分配来调节沟通强度：高置信度时提供明确的可解读辅助动作，不确定时则增加用户权限，从而将共享自主系统转化为透明的双向协作。包含仿真与六自由度机械臂物理实验的用户研究表明，与标准共享自主系统相比，可解读共享自主系统能显著提升用户对机器人信念的理解，并减少用户的操控负担。
tldr: This paper introduces legible motion into shared autonomy for robot arm manipulation, enabling the robot to implicitly communicate its inferred goal through its assistive movements, thereby improving user understanding and reducing control effort.
tldr_zh: 本文将可读运动引入共享自主控制，使机器臂通过辅助运动隐式传达其推断的目标，从而提高用户对机器人信念的理解并减少用户控制负担。

title: Analytic Concept-Centric Memory for Agentic Embodied Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon embodied manipulation requires agents to remember persistent objects, track changing scene states, and reuse prior interaction knowledge. However, existing agent memories are often stored as unstructured histories or embedding-based records, making it difficult to retrieve manipulation-relevant object parts, physical states, action effects, and executable skills. We propose an analytic concept-centric memory framework for agentic embodied manipulation. Our memory organizes experience around structured analytic concepts, where objects are represented by semantic parts, parametric templates, grounded poses, affordances, and manipulation states. It further connects object and scene memories with transition memory for action-induced state changes and skill memory for template-grounded and policy-grounded execution. At runtime, the agent performs structured coarse-to-fine retrieval to identify relevant objects, states, transitions, and skills, supporting state-consistent reasoning and skill reuse. Experiments on memory-dependent manipulation, articulated-object generalization, real-world memory evaluation, and ablations show that our approach improves task completion, retrieval accuracy, object re-identification, and cross-object skill generalization over unstructured and embedding-based memory baselines.
summary_zh: 长期视野下的具身操作要求智能体能够记忆持久物体、追踪动态场景状态，并复用先前的交互知识。然而，现有智能体记忆通常以非结构化历史记录或基于嵌入的存储形式存在，导致难以检索与操作相关的物体部件、物理状态、动作效果及可执行技能。为此，我们提出一种面向智能体具身操作的分析式概念中心记忆框架。该记忆系统围绕结构化分析概念组织经验，其中物体由语义部件、参数化模板、空间姿态、功能属性及操作状态共同表征。该框架进一步将物体记忆与场景记忆关联至用于记录动作引发状态变化的转换记忆，以及支持模板与策略执行基础的技能记忆。在运行时，智能体执行结构化的由粗到精检索，以识别相关物体、状态、转换及技能，从而支持状态一致性推理与技能复用。在依赖记忆的操作任务、铰接物体泛化、真实世界记忆评估及消融实验中的结果表明，相较于非结构化与基于嵌入的记忆基线方法，本方法在任务完成率、检索准确率、物体重识别及跨物体技能泛化方面均有所提升。
tldr: This paper introduces an analytic concept-centric memory framework that organizes object, scene, transition, and skill memories around structured analytic concepts to improve long-horizon embodied manipulation, achieving better task completion, retrieval, and generalization over unstructured and embedding-based baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于分析性概念中心的记忆框架，围绕结构化分析概念组织物体、场景、转换和技能记忆，以提升长周期具身操作任务的表现，在任务完成、检索准确率和泛化能力上优于非结构化与基于嵌入的记忆基线。

title: Hierarchical Policy Learning via Spectral Decomposition
summary: In this paper, we identify a semantic decomposition in robot action sequences, separating task-level motion intent from execution-level refinements. By analyzing actions in the spectral domain using the discrete cosine transform (DCT), we observe that low-frequency components capture global motion trajectories, while high-frequency components encode precise timing, alignment, and contact behaviors. Motivated by this structure, we propose Causal Spectral Policy (CSP), which models action generation as a causal coarse-to-fine process: coarse motion is predicted from observation and language, and fine corrections are generated conditionally on the realized trajectory. Across simulation and real-world evaluations, CSP consistently outperforms strong baselines on precision-sensitive manipulation tasks. Additionally, we propose human-inspired teleoperation noise injection as a data augmentation method, under which our approach demonstrates strong robustness to noisy demonstrations.
summary_zh: 本文识别了机器人动作序列中的语义分解，将任务层面的运动意图与执行层面的细化调整相分离。通过使用离散余弦变换（DCT）在频域分析动作，我们观察到低频分量捕捉全局运动轨迹，而高频分量编码精确的时序、对齐与接触行为。基于这一结构，我们提出因果频谱策略（Causal Spectral Policy, CSP），将动作生成建模为因果性的由粗到细过程：从观测和语言输入预测粗略运动，再根据已实现的轨迹有条件地生成精细修正。在仿真与真实世界的评估中，CSP在需要高精度操作的操纵任务上持续优于强基线方法。此外，我们提出受人类启发的遥操作噪声注入作为数据增强方法，该方法使我们的模型对含噪声示范展现出强鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper introduces Causal Spectral Policy (CSP), a method that decomposes robot action sequences in the spectral domain to model coarse motion intent and fine execution refinements, improving precision-sensitive manipulation and robustness to noisy demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出因果频谱策略 (CSP)，通过频谱分解将机器人动作序列中的粗粒度运动意图与细粒度执行修正分离，提升了高精度操作任务的表现和对噪声演示的鲁棒性。

title: LWDrive: Layer-Wise World-Model-Guided Vision-Language Model Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide powerful semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (E2E-AD) planning. However, trajectories directly generated by VLMs often encode only coarse driving intentions and remain insufficient for geometrically accurate, future-aware, and multi-view-grounded planning. To address these limitations, we develop the Layer-Wise World-Model-Guided Driving framework (LWDrive). LWDrive is a VLM planning framework that refines coarse trajectories through layer-wise world-model guidance. Instead of treating the VLM output as the final trajectory, LWDrive uses it as an intent-aware coarse plan, expands a diverse candidate space around it, and progressively refines the candidates through a Foresight Cascade Planner (FCP). Specifically, we introduce future-frame generation supervision to encourage the VLM to learn forward-looking scene representations, thereby injecting planning-relevant predictive dynamics into its internal hidden states. Built upon these world-model-supervised representations, FCP exploits VLM features across multiple layers and integrates historical temporal states, Action-Query representations, and current-frame multi-view Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features to refine candidate trajectories in a coarse-to-fine manner. This design enables progressive correction of spatial positions and motion trends while grounding trajectory refinement with multi-view scene cues and preserving the high-level driving intention produced by the large model. Finally, a score head evaluates the refined candidates and selects the best trajectory as the final planning output. Experiments show that LWDrive achieves a score of 92.0 on the NAVSIM benchmark and 89.6 on NAVSIM-v2. Code and models will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）为端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）规划提供了强大的语义理解与常识推理能力。然而，由VLM直接生成的轨迹往往仅编码了粗糙的驾驶意图，在几何精确性、未来感知能力以及多视图融合规划方面仍存在不足。为解决上述局限，我们提出了层级式世界模型引导的驾驶框架（LWDrive）。LWDrive是一种VLM规划框架，通过层级式世界模型引导优化粗粒度轨迹。该框架并未将VLM输出作为最终轨迹，而是将其作为包含意图的粗粒度规划，在其周围扩展多样化候选空间，并通过前瞻级联规划器（FCP）逐步优化候选轨迹。具体而言，我们引入未来帧生成监督机制，促使VLM学习前瞻性场景表征，从而将规划相关的预测动态注入其内部隐状态。基于这些由世界模型监督的表征，FCP利用VLM多个网络层的特征，融合历史时序状态、动作查询表征及当前帧多视图鸟瞰图（BEV）特征，以由粗到精的方式优化候选轨迹。该设计在利用大模型生成的高层驾驶意图的同时，能够根据多视图场景线索逐步修正空间位置与运动趋势。最终，评分头对优化后的候选轨迹进行评估，并选择最优轨迹作为最终规划输出。实验表明，LWDrive在NAVSIM基准测试中取得92.0分，在NAVSIM-v2中取得89.6分。代码与模型将公开发布。
tldr: LWDrive refines coarse VLM trajectories for autonomous driving by integrating world-model supervision and a cascade planner that uses multi-layer VLM features, BEV cues, and temporal states.
tldr_zh: LWDrive 通过引入世界模型监督和级联规划器，利用多层级 VLM 特征、BEV 线索和时间状态，逐步细化 VLM 生成的粗略轨迹，实现更准确的自动驾驶规划。

title: OWMDrive: Causality-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving via 4D Occupancy World Model
summary: Autonomous driving systems are steadily moving toward end-to-end paradigms to mitigate the limited adaptability of rule-based pipelines in complex traffic environments. However, most existing learning-based methods still make decisions from static representations of the current scene, without explicit future rollouts or modeling of the temporal causal dynamics in traffic interactions. This limitation often results in unstable or overly conservative planning under high-uncertainty conditions, such as occlusions and unexpected events. To overcome these challenges, we introduce OWMDrive, a generative end-to-end driving framework built upon an Occupancy World Model for multi-step 3D occupancy forecasting, which serves as a conditional prior to guide diffusion-based planning. Conditioned on both current observations and predicted future states, the planner iteratively refines trajectory candidates to generate a reinforced driving trajectory. By explicitly modeling scene evolution over future horizons, OWMDrive captures key spatiotemporal causal dependencies, which leads to more foresighted and robust trajectory generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OWMDrive significantly improves planning reliability and safety, especially in challenging and partially observable driving scenarios.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶系统正逐步转向端到端范式，以缓解基于规则的管道在复杂交通环境中适应性有限的问题。然而，现有大多数基于学习的方法仍从当前场景的静态表征中做出决策，未能显式地展开未来轨迹或建模交通交互中的时序因果动态。这一局限常导致高不确定性场景（如遮挡和突发事件）下出现不稳定或过度保守的规划行为。为克服这些挑战，我们提出OWMDrive——一种基于占据世界模型构建的生成式端到端驾驶框架，该模型可进行多步3D占据预测，并作为条件先验指导基于扩散的规划。在同时包含当前观测与预测未来状态的条件下，规划器通过迭代优化轨迹候选，生成强化后的驾驶轨迹。通过显式建模未来时域内的场景演化，OWMDrive捕捉了关键的时空因果依赖关系，从而实现了更具前瞻性和鲁棒性的轨迹生成。大量实验表明，OWMDrive显著提升了规划的可靠性与安全性，尤其在具有挑战性的部分可观测驾驶场景中表现突出。
tldr: OWMDrive introduces an end-to-end autonomous driving framework that uses a 4D occupancy world model to forecast future 3D occupancy, conditioning a diffusion-based planner for more robust trajectory generation under uncertainty.
tldr_zh: OWMDrive 提出了一个端到端自动驾驶框架，利用4D占据世界模型预测未来3D占据状态，从而条件化扩散规划器，在不确定性场景下生成更鲁棒的轨迹。

title: KYON: Semi-Modular Wheel-Legged Quadruped With Agile Bimanual Capability
summary: This paper presents KYON, a hybrid wheel-legged quadruped robot equipped with a bimanual upper body for loco-manipulation tasks. The platform features a semi-modular design with a reconfigurable lower legs, enabling both wheeled and legged locomotion depending on the environment. A design approach that places actuators in the base and uses transmission mechanisms reduces distal inertia, improving agility and dynamic performance. The robot integrates a whole-body control framework together with a reinforcement learning based policy to handle nonlinear dynamics and enhance robustness to disturbances for the execution of locomotion and manipulation tasks, independently. Experimental results demonstrate effective dynamic locomotion and bimanual manipulation, validating the platform's capability to operate in complex and unstructured scenarios.
summary_zh: 本文介绍KYON——一种配备双臂上身、面向移动操作任务的混合轮腿四足机器人。该平台采用半模块化设计，配备可重构小腿，可根据环境实现轮式与腿式两种运动模式。将驱动器置于基座并采用传动机构的设计方法降低了远端惯量，提升了敏捷性与动态性能。机器人集成了全身控制框架与基于强化学习的策略，以独立处理非线性动力学问题，并增强执行运动与操作任务时对抗扰动的鲁棒性。实验结果验证了该平台在动态运动与双臂操作方面的有效性，证明了其在复杂非结构化场景中的作业能力。
tldr: This paper introduces KYON, a wheel-legged quadruped robot with a bimanual upper body, featuring semi-modular design and reinforcement learning-based whole-body control for agile loco-manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍KYON，一种具有双臂上半身的轮腿混合四足机器人，采用半模块化设计和基于强化学习的全身控制，实现敏捷的移动操作。

title: Automating the Design of Embodied AgentArchitectures
summary: Embodied agents are typically built as hand-designed compositions of perception, memory, planning, and action modules. This modularity exposes a large architectural design space, but current systems still rely on researcher intuition to choose where information is stored, how observations are processed, and how model calls are connected. Agent Architecture Search (AAS) automates such design for text-domain agents, but has not been systematically evaluated on perceptual embodied agents through simulator rollouts. We study this transfer. We introduce AgentCanvas, a typed-graph runtime that hosts embodied executors as editable node-and-wire programs with simulator-aware execution and episode-level logs, and KDLoop, a coding-agent search procedure that cycles through proposal, critique, experiment, and distillation, with triggered reflection after stalls. We evaluate three AAS variants across four embodied executors spanning vision-language navigation, embodied question answering, and language-conditioned manipulation. The resulting 3x4 matrix shows that architecture-level search can produce deployable and directional success-rate gains on embodied tasks, while one apparent high-scoring candidate is rejected as leak-bearing. At the same time, the experiments expose constraints that are muted in text-domain AAS: optimization signals can be masked by rollout noise, search can become trapped in local edit basins, and episode-level credit assignment only partially emerges even when detailed logs are available. These results characterize both the promise and the current limits of automated architecture search for embodied agents.
summary_zh:
摘要：
具身智能体通常被构建为感知、记忆、规划和动作模块的手工设计组合。这种模块化设计暴露了广阔的架构设计空间，但当前系统仍依赖研究人员的直觉来选择信息存储位置、观测处理方式以及模型调用的连接方式。智能体架构搜索（AAS）实现了文本域智能体的此类设计自动化，但尚未通过模拟器展开在感知性具身智能体上进行系统评估。我们研究了这一迁移。我们引入了AgentCanvas，一个类型化图运行时，它将具身执行器承载为可编辑的节点-连线程序，具备模拟器感知执行与回合级日志功能；以及KDLoop，一个编码智能体搜索程序，通过提出、批评、实验与蒸馏的循环，并在停滞时触发反思。我们在四个具身执行器上评估了三种AAS变体，涵盖视觉语言导航、具身问答及语言条件操控。由此生成的3x4矩阵表明，架构级搜索能够在具身任务上产生可部署且具有方向性的成功率提升，同时一个看似高分的候选方案因存在信息泄露而被拒绝。与此同时，实验揭示了在文本域AAS中被弱化的约束：优化信号可能被展开噪声掩盖，搜索可能陷入局部编辑盆地，且即便有详细日志，回合级信用分配也仅能部分显现。这些结果表征了具身智能体自动化架构搜索的前景与当前局限。
tldr: This paper introduces AgentCanvas and KDLoop to automate architecture search for embodied agents, evaluating across navigation, QA, and manipulation tasks, and identifies both promise and limitations such as rollout noise and local edit traps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AgentCanvas和KDLoop来自动搜索具身智能体的架构，在导航、问答和操作任务上进行了评估，并指出了诸如随机噪声和局部编辑陷阱等局限性。

title: SIR: Structured Image Representations for Explainable Robot Learning
summary: Existing robot policies based on learned visual embeddings lack explicit structure and are sensitive to visual distractions. Thus, the representations that drive their behaviour are often opaque, making their decision-making process difficult to interpret. To address this, we introduce Structured Image Representations (SIR), a method that leverages Scene Graphs (SGs) as an intermediate representation for robot policy learning. Our approach first constructs a fully connected graph, using image-derived features as initial node representations. Then, a module learns to sparsify this graph end-to-end, creating a task-relevant sub-graph that is passed to the action generation model. This process makes our model intrinsically explainable. Evaluations on RoboCasa show that our sparse graph policies outperform image-based baselines on average with 19.5% vs 14.81% success rate. Most importantly, we show that the learned sparse graphs are a powerful tool for model analysis. By analysing when the model's sub-graph deviates from human expectation, such as by including distractor nodes or omitting key objects, we successfully uncover dataset biases, including spurious correlations and positional biases. https://github.com/intuitive-robots/SIR_Model
summary_zh: 基于学习到的视觉嵌入的现有机器人策略缺乏明确的结构，且易受视觉干扰影响。因此，驱动其行为的表征通常不透明，导致其决策过程难以解释。为解决这一问题，我们提出结构化图像表征（SIR）方法，该方法利用场景图（SG）作为机器人策略学习的中间表征。我们的方法首先构建一个全连接图，将图像衍生特征作为初始节点表征。随后，一个模块学习以端到端方式稀疏化该图，生成与任务相关的子图，并将其传递给动作生成模型。这一过程使得我们的模型具有内在可解释性。在RoboCasa上的评估显示，我们的稀疏图策略平均成功率（19.5%）优于基于图像的基线方法（14.81%）。最重要的是，我们证明学习到的稀疏图是模型分析的有力工具。通过分析模型子图何时偏离人类预期（例如包含干扰节点或遗漏关键对象），我们成功揭示了数据集中的偏差，包括伪相关和位置偏差。https://github.com/intuitive-robots/SIR_Model
tldr: Introduces Structured Image Representations (SIR) using scene graphs as intermediate representations for robot policy learning, enabling explainable action generation and dataset bias detection via sparse graph analysis.
tldr_zh: 提出结构化图像表示（SIR），将场景图作为机器人策略学习的中间表示，通过稀疏图分析实现可解释的动作生成和数据集偏差检测。

title: Seeing Touch from Motion: A Unified Modality-Aware Visuo-Tactile Policy with Tactile Motion Correlation
summary: Visuo-Tactile policies leveraging optical tactile sensors have shown great promise in contact-rich manipulation. These sensors achieve high spatial resolution and multi-dimensional force sensing by utilizing an internal camera to monitor the deformation of their elastic gel surface, thereby indirectly inferring tactile cues. Despite their advantages, extracting fine-grained contact states necessary for contact-rich manipulation remains an open challenge. Existing methods typically use either raw images or cumulative motion fields to represent tactile cues. However, both are prone to perception ambiguity. Raw tactile images mainly capture appearance changes, while cumulative motion fields only reflect the aggregate gel deformation. Consequently, distinct fine-grained contact states can exhibit highly similar patterns, making it difficult to explicitly distinguish subtle contact variations. To address this issue, we explore the dynamic priors of tactile motion and discover that the correlation between transient and cumulative motion can explicitly distinguish fine-grained contact states. Based on this insight, we propose a motion-aware tactile representation to facilitate contact-rich manipulation. Beyond tactile representation, effective fusion of tactile and visual modalities is also critical. Most existing fusion methods either directly concatenate features from each modality or train modality-specific networks separately and fuse their outputs. However, these strategies struggle to simultaneously model cross-modal interactions and preserve modality-specific characteristics. In this work, we take advantage of the Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and propose a unified modality-aware visuo-tactile policy that captures cross-modal complementarity while maintaining modality-specific properties.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于光学触觉传感器的视觉-触觉策略在富含接触的操控任务中展现出巨大潜力。这类传感器通过内置摄像头监测其弹性凝胶表面的形变，从而间接推断触觉信息，实现高空间分辨率与多维力的感知。尽管具有上述优势，提取富含接触操控所需的细粒度接触状态仍是一项开放性挑战。现有方法通常使用原始图像或累积运动场来表示触觉线索，但两者均易产生感知歧义。原始触觉图像主要捕捉外观变化，而累积运动场仅反映凝胶的整体形变。因此，不同的细粒度接触状态可能呈现高度相似的特征模式，导致难以明确区分细微的接触差异。为解决此问题，我们探索了触觉运动的动态先验，发现瞬态运动与累积运动之间的相关性能够明确区分细粒度接触状态。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种运动感知的触觉表征方法以促进富含接触的操控任务。除触觉表征外，视觉与触觉模态的有效融合同样至关重要。现有融合方法往往直接拼接各模态特征，或分别训练模态专用网络后融合其输出。然而，这些策略难以同时建模跨模态交互并保留模态特有属性。在本研究中，我们利用混合变换器架构的优势，提出了一种统一且具模态意识的视觉-触觉策略，既能捕捉跨模态互补性，又能维持模态专有特性。
tldr: This paper proposes a motion-aware tactile representation that leverages the correlation between transient and cumulative motion to distinguish fine-grained contact states, and introduces a unified modality-aware visuo-tactile policy using a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture for contact-rich manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用瞬态与累积运动相关性来区分细微接触状态的运动感知触觉表示，并采用混合Transformer架构构建了统一模态感知的视觉-触觉策略，用于高精度接触操控。

title: Flying to Image-Specified Objects: 3D Quadrotor Navigation via Cross-Graph Memory and Viewpoint Planning
summary: Instance-Specific Image-Goal Navigation (InstanceImageNav) requires a robot to navigate toward the exact object instance depicted in a query image. Extending this task to quadrotors is challenging due to continuous 3D control, limited field of view (FOV), and safety constraints, which make successful navigation highly dependent on selecting informative viewpoints. We propose a hierarchical navigation framework for quadrotor InstanceImageNav that separates high-level decision making from low-level motion execution. Instead of navigating directly to spatial locations, the system generates viewpoint-aware action nodes around frontier regions and potential target objects, enabling the robot to explore while maintaining informative viewpoints for detecting the target instance. A lightweight semantic memory maintains object-level and observation-level context, allowing semantic cues to propagate to candidate action nodes for decision making. A learning-based policy selects the most promising action node, and a trajectory planner generates dynamically feasible 3D flight paths for safe execution. Experiments in simulation demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, and real-world quadrotor flights validate the practicality and robustness of the proposed framework.
summary_zh: 实例级图像目标导航（InstanceImageNav）要求机器人导航至查询图像中描绘的特定物体实例。将该任务扩展至四旋翼飞行器时，连续三维控制、有限视场角及安全约束带来严峻挑战，使得成功导航高度依赖于信息性视点的选择。本文提出一种用于四旋翼实例级图像目标导航的分层导航框架，将高层决策与低层运动执行相分离。该系统并非直接导航至空间位置，而是在前沿区域和潜在目标物体周围生成视点感知的动作节点，使机器人在保持信息性视点以检测目标实例的同时进行探索。轻量级语义记忆维护物体级和观测级上下文信息，使语义线索能够传播至候选动作节点以辅助决策。基于学习的策略选择最有潜力的动作节点，轨迹规划器生成动力学可行的三维飞行路径以确保安全执行。仿真实验表明，该方法在强基线基础上实现了一致性提升，真实四旋翼飞行实验验证了所提框架的实用性与鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper presents a hierarchical navigation framework for quadrotors to navigate to a target object instance depicted in a query image, using cross-graph memory and viewpoint planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层导航框架，使四旋翼飞行器能够根据查询图像中的目标实例进行导航，采用了跨图记忆和视点规划方法。

title: Vision-Language Procedural Reasoning for Context-Aware Reward Modeling of Robotic Endovascular Guidewire Navigation
summary: Robotic-assisted endovascular interventions demand accurate, stable, and context-aware guidewire navigation in complex and patient-specific vascular anatomies. Despite recent advances in robotic precision and learning-based control, existing autonomous navigation methods remain limited by their reliance on static reward functions and the lack of explicit procedural reasoning regarding anatomical context and task progression. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a vision-language procedural reasoning (VL-PR) framework for autonomous guidewire navigation. The framework integrates a multimodal large language model (MLLM) as a procedural reasoning module that interprets real-time visual observations to infer high-level navigation contexts. Instead of generating low-level control commands, the inferred procedural insights enable context-aware reward adaptation by dynamically adjusting the importance of reward components across different navigation phases. This approach allows a single policy to resolve competing objectives and handle complex transitions while preserving a consistent global task goal. Experiments on a physical robotic platform across diverse vascular scenarios demonstrate enhanced task reliability and streamlined navigational efficiency, highlighting the advantages over static-reward methods and offering a scalable solution for complex and multi-task robotic endovascular procedures.
summary_zh: 机器人辅助血管介入手术要求在复杂且患者特异性的血管解剖结构中实现精确、稳定且具有情境感知能力的导丝导航。尽管近年来机器人精度和基于学习的控制方法取得了进展，现有自主导航方法仍受限于其依赖静态奖励函数，且缺乏针对解剖情境和任务进程的显式程序化推理能力。为解决上述问题，本文提出了一种面向自主导丝导航的视觉-语言程序化推理框架。该框架集成多模态大语言模型作为程序化推理模块，通过解读实时视觉观测来推断高层导航情境。所推断的程序化洞察并非直接生成底层控制指令，而是通过动态调整不同导航阶段中奖励分量的重要性，实现情境感知的奖励自适应。该方法使得单一策略能够在保持全局任务目标一致的同时，解决相互冲突的目标并处理复杂的状态转换。在物理机器人平台上针对多种血管场景开展的实验表明，该方法显著提升了任务可靠性并简化了导航效率，凸显了相较于静态奖励方法的优势，为复杂多任务的机器人血管介入手术提供了可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: Proposes a Vision-Language Procedural Reasoning framework that uses a multimodal LLM to infer navigation context and dynamically adapt reward weights for robotic endovascular guidewire navigation, improving task reliability over static-reward methods.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种视觉-语言程序推理框架，利用多模态大语言模型推断导航上下文并动态调整奖励权重，用于机器人血管内导丝导航，相比静态奖励方法提升了任务可靠性。

title: Critical Interval MSE: Toward Reliable Offline Validation for Robot Manipulation Policies
summary: Real-world evaluation is the gold standard for robot policies because it tests them against the physical conditions and deployment challenges they are ultimately designed to handle. However, real-world evaluation is also the bottleneck for iterating on robot policies: it is costly, difficult to reproduce, and often too sparse to reliably compare nearby model variants. A straightforward proxy for performance is validation loss on expert demonstrations, but this proxy is often poorly correlated with real-world performance. In this paper, we introduce Critical Interval MSE (CI-MSE), an intuitively simple yet effective offline validation metric. CI-MSE restricts error computation to task-critical segments and pairs it with simple action-alignment procedures that better match rollout-time behavior. Across simulation and real-world experiments, CI-MSE yields a stronger correlation between validation error and rollout performance than raw MSE. Across a wide range of policy checkpoints, CI-MSE achieves a Spearman's rank correlation of $-0.87$, much closer to the ideal value of $-1$ than raw MSE's $-0.61$, demonstrating a significant improvement. We show through sensitivity analysis that our metric is robust to a wide range of hyperparameters. We further study the effectiveness of CI-MSE under evaluation distribution shifts and suggest design boundaries when using this metric. In summary, this paper provides a simple and reliable offline validation tool for accelerating policy iteration. Project webpage: https://ci-mse.github.io/
summary_zh: 现实世界评估是机器人策略的黄金标准，因为它能在机器人最终需要应对的物理条件与部署挑战中进行测试。然而，现实世界评估也是机器人策略迭代的瓶颈：成本高昂、难以复现，且往往因数据稀疏而无法可靠地比较相近模型变体。一个直观的性能代理指标是专家示范数据上的验证损失，但这一指标往往与现实世界性能的关联性较差。本文提出临界区间均方误差（Critical Interval MSE, CI-MSE），这是一种直觉简单且有效的离线验证指标。CI-MSE将误差计算限制在任务关键区间，并结合简单的动作对齐流程以更好匹配实际部署时的行为。在仿真与现实世界实验中，CI-MSE在验证误差与部署性能之间呈现出比原始MSE更强的相关性。在广泛策略检查点中，CI-MSE的斯皮尔曼秩相关系数为-0.87，远优于原始MSE的-0.61，更接近理想值-1，显示出显著改进。通过敏感性分析，我们证明该指标对广泛超参数具有鲁棒性。我们进一步研究了CI-MSE在评估分布偏移下的有效性，并提出了使用该指标时的设计边界。总之，本文提供了一种简单可靠的离线验证工具，用于加速策略迭代。项目网页：https://ci-mse.github.io/
tldr: This paper proposes Critical Interval MSE (CI-MSE), a simple offline validation metric that computes error only on task-critical action segments and applies action alignment, achieving much stronger correlation with real-world robot rollout performance than raw MSE.
tldr_zh: 本文提出关键区间均方误差（CI-MSE），一种简单的离线验证指标，仅在任务关键动作片段上计算误差并进行动作对齐，与原始MSE相比，与真实机器人部署表现的关联性显著增强。

title: STEAM: Self-Supervised Temporal Ensemble Advantage Modeling for Real-World Robot Learning
summary: Real-world robot learning increasingly relies on heterogeneous data, but demonstrations and rollouts often mix useful progress with stalls, corrections, and suboptimal behavior. Effective policy learning therefore requires frame-level advantages that distinguish reliable local progress from failures and regressions. We propose Self-supervised Temporal Ensemble Advantage Modeling (STEAM), a label-free method that learns such advantages from expert demonstrations. STEAM trains an ensemble of temporal-offset predictors on frame pairs within expert trajectories, using the normalized temporal offset between two frames as a self-supervised signal. Each predictor maps a frame pair to a distribution over temporal offsets, which is converted into a scalar advantage. STEAM then takes the minimum advantage across the ensemble to score mixed-quality rollout data conservatively. Across real-world bimanual towel folding, chip checkout, cola restocking, and single-arm pick-and-place tasks, STEAM identifies stalls, failures, and recoveries. When combined with CFGRL, STEAM further improves policy success rate by 59%, 54.3%, 23% and 16.2% over baselines, respectively.
summary_zh: 真实世界机器人学习日益依赖异构数据，但演示与 rollout 中常混杂有效进展与停滞、修正及次优行为。因此，高效策略学习需要能够区分可靠局部进展与失败及倒退的帧级优势度量。我们提出自监督时序集成优势建模（STEAM），一种从专家演示中学习此类优势的无标签方法。STEAM 在专家轨迹内的帧对上训练一组时序偏移预测器，利用两帧之间的归一化时序偏移作为自监督信号。每个预测器将帧对映射为时序偏移的分布，并转换为标量优势。随后，STEAM 取集成模型的最小优势对混合质量的 rollout 数据进行保守评分。在真实世界的双臂毛巾折叠、芯片结账、可乐补货及单臂抓取放置任务中，STEAM 有效识别了停滞、失败与恢复行为。与 CFGRL 结合使用时，STEAM 在基线基础上将策略成功率分别提升了 59%、54.3%、23% 和 16.2%。
tldr: STEAM proposes a self-supervised method to learn frame-level advantages from expert demonstrations using an ensemble of temporal-offset predictors, enabling conservative scoring of mixed-quality rollout data and significantly improving real-world robot policy success rates.
tldr_zh: STEAM提出了一种自监督方法，通过集成时间偏移预测器从专家演示中学习帧级优势，实现对混合质量 rollout 数据的保守评分，并显著提高真实世界机器人策略的成功率。

title: OP3DSG: Open-Vocabulary Part-Aware 3D Scene Graph Generation for Real-World Environments
summary: 3D scene graphs (3DSGs) provide a compact and structured abstraction of 3D environments. Although advances in foundation models have enabled open-vocabulary 3DSG generation, existing approaches remain object-centric and encode limited relational information -- restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that require fine-grained understanding. We propose OP3DSG, an open-vocabulary part-aware 3DSG generation framework that constructs unified graphs that jointly model objects, interactive parts, spatial relations, functional relations, and affordances. OP3DSG integrates object-part knowledge-guided detection with part-aware 3D fusion to preserve small and interaction-relevant components, and employs a geometry-initialized prior graph with LLM-based refinement to reduce spurious relational predictions while enabling efficient graph construction. To systematically evaluate unified 3D scene graph construction, we introduce UniGraph3D, a benchmark designed for part-aware perception and multi-level relational reasoning. Experimental results show that OP3DSG achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates its effectiveness as a perception backbone in diverse real-world robotics tasks.
summary_zh: 三维场景图（3DSGs）提供了对三维环境紧凑且结构化的抽象表示。尽管基础模型的进步已实现开放词汇的3DSG生成，但现有方法仍以物体为中心且编码有限的关联信息——这限制了它们在需要细粒度理解的真实场景中的适用性。我们提出OP3DSG，一种开放词汇的部件感知三维场景图生成框架，它构建了统一图结构，联合建模物体、交互部件、空间关系、功能关系与可供性。OP3DSG集成物体-部件知识引导检测与部件感知三维融合以保留微小且与交互相关的组件，并采用几何初始化的先验图结合基于大语言模型的优化来减少虚假关系预测，同时实现高效图构建。为系统性评估统一三维场景图构建，我们引入UniGraph3D基准，专为部件感知感知与多层级关系推理设计。实验结果表明，OP3DSG取得了最先进的性能，并验证了其在多样化真实机器人任务中作为感知骨干的有效性。
tldr: OP3DSG proposes an open-vocabulary part-aware 3D scene graph generation framework that jointly models objects, interactive parts, spatial/functional relations, and affordances, with demonstrated effectiveness as a perception backbone in real-world robotics tasks.
tldr_zh: OP3DSG 提出了一个开放词汇、感知部件的 3D 场景图生成框架，可联合建模物体、交互部件、空间/功能关系与可供性，并在真实机器人任务中验证了其作为感知骨干的有效性。

title: Trajectory Optimization for Collision-Aware Redundant Robotic Multi-Axis Additive Manufacturing by Constrained Gradient Projection
summary: Redundant robotic multi-axis additive manufacturing (MAAM) enables support-free and conformal fabrication, but trajectory optimization for long-horizon paths remains challenging under strict deposition-position constraints and time-varying collision constraints. This work proposes a computational framework for collision-aware trajectory optimization in redundant robotic MAAM. We first formulate nozzle-workpiece relative kinematics using a relative Jacobian, and develop a differentiable SDF-based collision model that captures fabrication-induced geometry evolution and provides optimization gradients. The deposition position is then enforced as a hard waypoint-wise equality constraint through iterative projection onto the self-motion manifold, with the loss gradient restricted to the corresponding tangent space. Experiments on an 8-DOF robotic MAAM platform with diverse long-horizon support-free and conformal toolpaths show that our method maintains a mean nozzle-position error below 10μm, reduces maximum joint jerk by up to $77.6\%$, and eliminates all sampled collision and orientation violations. Compared with the SQP-based baseline, it achieves up to a 10.2x speedup and improved convergence. Physical fabrication experiments further verify that the resulting smooth, collision-free trajectories enable successful printing of complex geometries with fewer visible deposition artifacts.
summary_zh: 冗余机器人多轴增材制造（MAAM）可实现无支撑与共形制造，但在严格的沉积位置约束和时变碰撞约束下，针对长时域路径的轨迹优化仍具挑战性。本文提出了一种面向冗余机器人MAAM的碰撞感知轨迹优化计算框架。我们首先利用相对雅可比矩阵建立了喷嘴与工件的相对运动学模型，并开发了一种基于可微符号距离函数的碰撞模型，该模型可捕捉制造过程引起的几何演化并提供优化梯度。随后，通过将损失梯度限制在相应的切空间内，并利用迭代投影至自运动流形的方法，将沉积位置作为硬性航路点等式约束强制执行。在搭载8自由度机器人MAAM平台上的实验表明，针对多种长时域无支撑与共形刀具路径，本方法可将平均喷嘴位置误差维持在10微米以下，最大关节加加速度降低高达77.6%，并消除了所有采样碰撞及姿态违规。与基于序列二次规划的基准方法相比，本方法实现了最高10.2倍的加速比及更优的收敛性。物理制造实验进一步证实，所生成的平滑无碰撞轨迹能够成功打印复杂几何形状，同时减少可见的沉积伪影。
tldr: This paper presents a trajectory optimization framework for redundant robotic multi-axis additive manufacturing, using a differentiable SDF-based collision model and constrained gradient projection to enforce deposition accuracy and collision avoidance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于冗余机器人多轴增材制造的轨迹优化框架，利用可微SDF碰撞模型和约束梯度投影来保证沉积精度与碰撞避免。

title: Real-Time Compliance and Position Control of a Hyper-redundant Soft Robotic Arm
summary: Robots working in unstructured or partially unobservable environments must combine accurate motion with physical compliance that can passively correct contact misalignment. Soft robots provide this compliance but have struggled to precisely control their tip compliance and position. This paper presents a robot architecture designed around that control problem: a 7-link arm whose six articulated joints provide twelve independently driven revolute axes, each actuated by an antagonistic pair of pneumatic muscles, so that every axis can simultaneously change its angle and linearly adjust its stiffness. The rigid articulated backbone makes the tip compliance and position of the arm predictable enough to be commanded quantitatively in real time. The robot employs a unified iterative inverse-kinematics and inverse-compliance controller to achieve simultaneous, quantitative control of both compliance and position. The task-space compliance and kinematics models and the control law are derived and verified on both the physical arm and a matched simulation. Simulation is then used to study how the same framework extends to other arm morphologies. Finally, the arm demonstrates tasks that have been difficult for both rigid and soft arms: rejecting disturbances while writing on a moving whiteboard, and passively correcting hidden misalignment during a key-insertion and drawer-opening task. That these tasks succeed under so straightforward a controller is evidence for the advantage of this algorithm-informed structural design.
summary_zh: 在非结构化或部分不可观测环境中工作的机器人，必须将精确运动与可被动纠正接触偏差的物理柔顺性相结合。软体机器人具备这种柔顺性，但难以精确控制其末端柔顺性与位置。本文提出一种针对该控制问题设计的机器人架构：一个七连杆机械臂，其六个铰接关节提供十二个独立驱动的旋转轴，每个轴由一对拮抗的气动肌肉驱动，从而使每个轴能同时改变角度并线性调节刚度。刚性铰接骨架使机械臂的末端柔顺性与位置可预测性足够高，能够实时以数值化方式进行指令控制。该机器人采用统一的迭代逆运动学与逆柔顺性控制器，实现对柔顺性与位置的同时定量控制。推导了任务空间柔顺性及运动学模型与控制律，并在实体机械臂与匹配仿真中进行了验证。随后通过仿真研究该框架如何扩展至其他机械臂构型。最后，该机械臂展示了对于刚性及软体机械臂均具有难度的任务：在移动白板上书写时抵抗扰动，以及在钥匙插入与抽屉开启任务中被动纠正不可见偏差。这些任务能在如此简洁的控制器下成功完成，证明了这种基于算法指导的结构设计之优势。
tldr: This paper presents a hyper-redundant soft robotic arm with real-time compliance and position control using pneumatic muscles and a unified inverse kinematics/inverse-compliance controller.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种超冗余软体机械臂，通过气动肌肉和统一逆运动学/逆柔顺控制器实现实时柔顺与位置控制。

title: ViTL: Temporal Logic-Guided Zero-Shot Natural Language Navigation via Vision-Language Models
summary: Enabling robots to follow natural language commands to complete zero-shot long-horizon tasks remains challenging. It requires extracting implicit temporal and logical constraints from natural language commands and executing multiple sub-tasks accordingly. Recent zero-shot object navigation methods use vision-language models (VLMs) to guide frontier-based exploration in unknown environments, but they are limited to single-target tasks. Real-world commands such as "Clean either the chair or the couch, then turn on the tv." require navigating to multiple targets in a temporally constrained order, which no existing zero-shot system can handle. We present ViTL, a framework that addresses this gap at two levels. At the task level, we use a large language model (LLM) to compile natural language commands into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formulas, which are then converted into Deterministic Finite Automata~(DFA) that coordinate multi-channel value maps and trigger dynamic replanning when new objects are detected. At the navigation level, we introduce directional score: rather than producing a direction-agnostic value across the entire field of view, we label frontier directions on the observation image and extract per-direction scores from the VLM. Experiments on Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) show that the full framework enables zero-shot long-horizon completion of natural language navigation tasks with temporal constraints, and that directional score improves single-target navigation accuracy and efficiency over the baseline.
summary_zh: 使机器人能够遵循自然语言指令完成零样本长时任务仍具挑战性。这需要从自然语言指令中提取隐含的时间与逻辑约束，并据此执行多个子任务。近期零样本目标导航方法利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）引导未知环境下的前沿探索，但仅限于单一目标任务。诸如“先清洁椅子或沙发，然后打开电视”这类现实指令要求按时间约束顺序导航至多个目标，现有零样本系统均无法处理。我们提出ViTL框架，从两个层面解决这一空白。在任务层面，使用大语言模型（LLM）将自然语言指令编译为线性时序逻辑（LTL）公式，进而转换为确定性有限自动机（DFA），协调多通道价值图并在检测到新目标时触发动态重规划。在导航层面，引入方向评分：不在整个视场中产生方向无关的价值值，而是在观测图像上标注前沿方向，并从VLM中提取每个方向的方向评分。在Habitat-Matterport 3D（HM3D）上的实验表明，该完整框架能够零样本完成具有时间约束的长时自然语言导航任务，且方向评分相较于基线方法提升了单目标导航的准确性与效率。
tldr: ViTL uses an LLM to parse natural language commands into LTL formulas and a VLM with directional scoring to enable zero-shot long-horizon navigation with temporal constraints on the HM3D dataset.
tldr_zh: ViTL 利用大语言模型将自然语言指令解析为线性时序逻辑公式，并结合视觉语言模型的定向评分，在 HM3D 数据集上实现了零样本的、带时序约束的长程导航。

title: DSIP: A Dynamic Coordination Planner for Signal-Free Intersections using Diffusion-Model-Based Multi-Agent Motion Planning
summary: Traffic signal control at urban intersections inherently introduces stop-and-go behavior, resulting in increased delays and reduced traffic efficiency, especially under high traffic demand. With the emergence of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs), trajectory-level coordination has emerged as a high-potential strategy to augment or transcend conventional phase-based management. This paper proposes DSIP (Diffusion-model-based Signal-free Intersection Planner), a multi-agent motion planning framework driven by a generative diffusion process. DSIP shifts the intersection management paradigm from discrete temporal phasing to continuous multi-vehicle trajectory optimization. This work evaluates the theoretical upper-bound performance of this coordination strategy under idealized communication and execution conditions to isolate the core benefits of the diffusion-driven approach. Using the SUMO platform, we evaluate DSIP across diverse four-leg intersection configurations. Experimental results demonstrate that DSIP significantly reduces average delay and maintains higher average speed compared to both fixed-time signal control and state-of-the-art reinforcement-learning-based controllers, particularly in medium- to high-density traffic. These findings suggest that diffusion-based trajectory planning provides a scalable and robust foundation for future autonomous intersection management. By unlocking latent intersection capacity through software-defined coordination, this approach offers a cost-effective pathway to improve urban traffic flow efficiency without requiring physical infrastructure expansion.
summary_zh: 城市交叉口的交通信号控制本质上会引发走走停停的行为，导致延误增加、通行效率降低，尤其是在高交通需求条件下。随着网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）的出现，轨迹级协调已成为一种极具潜力的策略，用以增强或超越传统的相位式管理。本文提出DSIP（基于扩散模型的无信号交叉口规划器），这是一种由生成式扩散过程驱动的多智能体运动规划框架。DSIP将交叉口管理模式从离散的时间相位控制转变为连续的多车轨迹优化。本研究在理想化通信与执行条件下评估了该协调策略的理论上界性能，以剥离出扩散驱动方法的核心优势。基于SUMO平台，我们在多种四向交叉口配置下对DSIP进行了评估。实验结果表明，与固定时间信号控制及基于强化学习的最先进控制器相比，DSIP显著降低了平均延误，并在中高密度交通流中保持了更高的平均速度。这些发现表明，基于扩散的轨迹规划为未来的自主交叉口管理提供了可扩展且稳健的基础。通过软件定义的协调释放交叉口潜在通行能力，该方法提供了一条无需扩展物理基础设施即可提升城市交通流效率的经济有效途径。
tldr: DSIP uses diffusion-based multi-agent motion planning to coordinate CAVs at signal-free intersections, outperforming traditional signals and RL controllers in simulation.
tldr_zh: DSIP 采用基于扩散模型的多智能体运动规划方法协调网联自动驾驶车辆通过无信号路口，仿真中优于传统信号灯和强化学习方法。

title: Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization to Find Lightweight CNN Models for Autonomous Steering
summary: This research investigates the optimization of Convolutional and Dense Neural Networks (CNNs and DNNs) for autonomous steering using the (N+M) Evolution Strategy (ES) with the 1/5th success rule. The primary objective is to develop a lightweight CNN based model capable of real-time steering angle prediction, mimicking human driving behavior on predefined paths. The ES algorithm automates hyperparameter tuning, dynamically adjusting parameters such as filter sizes and layer configurations. Data collection encompasses driving scenarios recorded via the LTU ACTor autonomous driving platform, including variations in path direction and driving style. The very small dataset consists of timestamped images labeled with steering angles and pre-processed to focus on relevant visual information. Initial experiments involve training a baseline CNN model, which is then refined using ES to significantly reduce the size of the model while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy. The results highlight the viability of lightweight neural network architectures for real-time autonomous systems, striking a balance between computational efficiency and performance. This study not only advances research initiatives on the use of evolutionary algorithms for autonomous driving applications but also lays the foundation for the deployment of cost-effective and scalable solutions in self-driving technology.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于(N+M)进化策略（ES）并结合1/5成功规则的卷积神经网络与密集神经网络（CNNs和DNNs）在自主转向中的优化方法。主要目标是开发一种轻量级基于CNN的模型，能够实时预测转向角度，模拟人类在预定路径上的驾驶行为。ES算法自动化超参数调优过程，动态调整滤波器尺寸和网络层配置等参数。数据采集依托LTU ACTor自动驾驶平台记录的驾驶场景，涵盖路径方向与驾驶风格的多样性。该极小型数据集由带有时间戳的标注图像组成，其转向角度标签经过预处理以聚焦相关视觉信息。初始实验包括训练基线CNN模型，随后通过ES对其进行优化，在保持竞争性预测精度的同时显著压缩模型规模。研究结果凸显了轻量级神经网络架构在实时自主系统中的可行性，实现了计算效率与性能之间的平衡。本研究不仅推动了进化算法在自动驾驶领域应用的研究进程，也为部署经济高效且可扩展的自动驾驶解决方案奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper uses evolutionary hyperparameter optimization to design lightweight CNN models for real-time autonomous steering, balancing model size and predictive accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文采用进化超参数优化方法为自主转向设计轻量级CNN模型，在模型大小与预测精度之间取得平衡。

title: Lateral String Stability for Vehicle Platoons
summary: Connected and automated vehicle (CAV) platooning promises gains in energy efficiency and traffic throughput and, most critically, in safety. These safety benefits hinge on string stability, which determines how disturbances propagate along a platoon. While longitudinal string stability is well studied, lateral string stability, which governs the propagation of path-tracking errors that can lead to unsafe deviations from the intended path, remains underexplored. Its importance is increasing as autonomous vehicles rely more heavily on onboard sensing and map-free navigation, where sensor occlusion and dense formations amplify safety risks. This paper presents a new framework for lateral string stability that directly addresses safety-critical path-relative tracking errors and enables consistent comparison across vehicles following the same road geometry. Central to this framework is an arc-length (Eulerian) viewpoint, a departure from traditional analyses, that clarifies how tracking errors at a given point on the path propagate from one vehicle to the next. A formal definition of lateral string stability is introduced along with two control strategies: an onboard-sensing-only controller and a novel learn-from-predecessor approach utilizing vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication. We show that onboard sensing alone cannot guarantee attenuation of path-tracking errors, imposing a fundamental safety limitation, whereas V2V communication enables true error attenuation.
summary_zh: 网联自动车队（CAV）编队行驶有望提升能效与交通流量，最关键的是能增强安全性。这些安全效益取决于队列稳定性——该特性决定扰动在车队中的传播方式。虽然纵向队列稳定性已得到充分研究，但控制路径跟踪误差传播的横向队列稳定性仍探索不足——此类误差可能导致车辆危险偏离预定路径。随着自动驾驶车辆日益依赖车载感知和无地图导航（其中传感器遮挡与密集编队会放大安全风险），横向队列稳定性的重要性愈发凸显。本文提出一种新的横向队列稳定性框架，直接针对安全关键的路径相对跟踪误差，并实现沿相同道路几何行驶的车辆间一致性比较。该框架的核心是从传统分析范式转向弧长（欧拉）视角，阐明路径特定点上的跟踪误差如何在车辆间逐级传递。我们给出了横向队列稳定性的正式定义，并提出了两种控制策略：纯车载感知控制器与利用车车通信的前车学习新方法。研究表明，纯车载感知无法保证路径跟踪误差的衰减，构成根本性安全局限；而车车通信则能实现真正的误差衰减。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for lateral string stability in vehicle platoons, defining the propagation of path-tracking errors and showing that onboard sensing alone cannot guarantee safety, whereas V2V communication enables error attenuation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了车辆队列横向弦稳定性框架，定义了路径跟踪误差的传播机制，并证明仅靠车载传感无法保证安全，而V2V通信可实现误差衰减。

title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
summary: World models offer a principled way to equip long-horizon LLM agents with foresight: predictions of action consequences before execution. However, unreliable foresight can be ignored, misused, or even degrade downstream decision-making. In this paper, we introduce WorldEvolver, a self-evolving world model framework that revises its deployment-time context while keeping the downstream agent and all model parameters frozen. WorldEvolver integrates three modules: (i) Episodic Memory, which exploits real action transitions through retrieval-based simulation; (ii) Semantic Memory, which extracts persistent heuristic rules from prediction-observation mismatches; and (iii) Selective Foresight, which filters low-confidence predictions before integrating them into agent reasoning context. We evaluate WorldEvolver on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, measuring world model prediction accuracy on Word2World and downstream agent success rate on AgentBoard. Extensive experiments show that WorldEvolver achieves the highest prediction accuracy across three backbones and leads other world model baselines on downstream agent success rate, demonstrating that test-time memory revision enhances both predictive fidelity and planning performance.
summary_zh: 世界模型为长程大语言模型智能体提供了一种原则性的前瞻能力：即在执行前预测行动后果。然而，不可靠的前瞻可能被忽视、误用，甚至降低下游决策质量。本文提出WorldEvolver——一种自演进世界模型框架，该框架在保持下游智能体及所有模型参数冻结的同时，对部署时上下文进行修正。WorldEvolver集成三个模块：(i) 情景记忆，通过基于检索的模拟利用真实行动转换；(ii) 语义记忆，从预测-观测不一致中提取持久性启发式规则；(iii) 选择性前瞻，在将预测结果融入智能体推理上下文前过滤低置信度预测。我们在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上评估WorldEvolver，在Word2World上测量世界模型预测准确率，在AgentBoard上测量下游智能体成功率。大量实验表明，WorldEvolver在三个骨干模型上均实现最高预测准确率，并在下游智能体成功率上领先其他世界模型基线，证明测试时记忆修正能同时提升预测保真度与规划性能。
tldr: WorldEvolver introduces a self-evolving world model framework that improves LLM agent planning by revising deployment-time context via episodic memory, semantic memory, and selective foresight, without updating model parameters.
tldr_zh: WorldEvolver 提出了一种自演化世界模型框架，通过情景记忆、语义记忆和选择性预见在部署时修正上下文，从而提升 LLM 智能体的规划性能，且无需更新模型参数。

title: Domain Adaptation with Adaptive Imagination for Visual Reinforcement Learning under Limited Target Data
summary: Sim-to-real transfer remains a major obstacle for reinforcement learning (RL), especially for vision-based control where image observations exacerbate the state-distribution shift between simulation and the real world. Domain adaptation (DA) is a promising remedy for this challenge. Prior sim-to-real DA works have demonstrated encouraging results, yet these approaches typically assume substantially more target data, which is not available in practice. Indeed, their performance degrades significantly when the target data budget is reduced. To address this challenge, we propose AIDA (Adaptive Imagination for Domain Adaptation), a domain adaptation framework for visual reinforcement learning that addresses sim-to-real transfer under scarce target data without requiring additional interaction with the target environment. Our key idea is adaptive imagination: generating reliable and semantic imagination rollouts to augment limited target data. Specifically, AIDA employs a distribution-shift-aware discriminator that truncates rollouts when imagined transitions drift into low-confidence regions, so that only reliable transitions contribute to the augmentation. On these reliable transitions, AIDA introduces a self-consistency loss that cycles through state -> image observation -> state, penalizing discrepancies between the original and reconstructed states. This provides additional adaptation signals beyond the scarce target data. Our experiments demonstrate that adaptive imagination effectively truncates unreliable rollouts. By enforcing a self-consistency loss on the resulting reliable transitions, AIDA learns semantically meaningful state representations and outperforms baselines across five MuJoCo tasks and two Gymnasium-Robotics tasks.
summary_zh: 摘要：仿真到现实的迁移仍然是强化学习（RL）面临的主要障碍，尤其对于基于视觉的控制任务，图像观测会加剧仿真环境与真实环境之间的状态分布偏移。领域自适应（DA）是应对这一挑战的有效手段。以往的仿真到现实领域自适应工作已展现出令人鼓舞的成果，但这些方法通常需要大量目标域数据，而这在实践中难以获得。事实上，当目标数据预算减少时，它们的性能会显著下降。为解决该问题，我们提出了AIDA（面向领域自适应的自适应想象），这是一个面向视觉强化学习的领域自适应框架，能够在目标数据稀缺且无需与目标环境额外交互的情况下实现仿真到现实的迁移。我们的核心思想是自适应想象：生成可靠且具有语义信息的想象轨迹，以扩充有限的目标数据。具体而言，AIDA采用了一个具备分布偏移感知能力的判别器，当想象状态转换漂移至低置信度区域时，该判别器会截断轨迹，从而仅保留可靠的转换用于数据扩充。在这些可靠转换上，AIDA引入了一个自一致性损失，通过状态→图像观测→状态的循环过程，对原始状态与重建状态之间的差异进行惩罚。这为目标数据稀缺问题提供了额外的自适应信号。实验表明，自适应想象能有效截断不可靠的轨迹。通过对生成的可靠转换施加自一致性损失，AIDA能够学习到具有语义意义的状态表征，并在五个MuJoCo任务和两个Gymnasium-Robotics任务中优于基线方法。
tldr: AIDA proposes adaptive imagination and self-consistency loss to enable domain adaptation for visual RL under extremely limited target data, improving sim-to-real transfer on MuJoCo and Gymnasium-Robotics tasks.
tldr_zh: AIDA提出自适应想象和自一致性损失，在目标数据极少的情况下实现视觉强化学习的域适应，提升模拟到真实迁移效果。

title: Early Warning Signals for OpenVLA Failure under Visual Distribution Shift
summary: Vision Language Action models combine perception, language grounding, and control in a single policy, but their failures are hard to diagnose once visual conditions shift. We test whether OpenVLA feedforward activations contain linearly decodable information about near term task failure in LIBERO manipulation rollouts. The policy is fixed throughout. We log internal activations during execution and fit lightweight monitors after the rollouts are collected. Occlusion is the main controlled stress test. It reduces OpenVLA success from $57\%$ to $17\%$ over $100$ episodes per condition. Under this shift, a logistic probe at layer 16 reaches AUROC $0.972$ and AUPRC $0.352$ for predicting failure within a $15$ step horizon. It outperforms both a mean difference direction and an action disagreement baseline. A sparse layer sweep finds uneven decodability across depth: layer 16 is strongest among the tested layers, layer 8 remains informative, and layer 10 is weaker. To check whether the monitor is just an occlusion detector, we also evaluate color shift and camera jitter without refitting. Color shift produces no failures in this setting, so it is a benign control rather than a failure benchmark. Camera jitter does induce failures, and the occlusion trained monitor remains above random. The result is deliberately limited: OpenVLA internal states contain failure relevant structure under controlled perceptual shift, but these experiments do not establish a causal mechanism, task held out generalization, or a deployable recovery system.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型将感知、语言理解与控制集成于单一策略中，但当视觉条件发生偏移时，其故障难以诊断。我们测试了OpenVLA前馈激活在LIBERO操作任务执行过程中是否包含关于近期任务失败的线性可解码信息。策略全程固定，我们在执行过程中记录内部激活，并在任务执行完成后拟合轻量级监测器。遮挡是主要受控压力测试，它将OpenVLA的成功率从每个条件100轮次的57%降至17%。在该偏移下，第16层逻辑回归探针在预测15步时间窗口内的失败时，AUROC达到0.972，AUPRC达到0.352，表现优于均值差异方向基线及动作分歧基线。稀疏层扫描发现不同深度的可解码性存在差异：第16层在测试层中表现最强，第8层仍具有信息含量，而第10层较弱。为验证监测器是否仅为遮挡检测器，我们还测试了色移和相机抖动（未重新拟合模型）。色移在此设置中未造成失败，因此属于良性控制而非故障基准。相机抖动确实导致失败，而基于遮挡训练的监测器仍优于随机水平。本实验结果具有明确局限性：OpenVLA内部状态在受控感知偏移下包含与故障相关的结构信息，但这些实验未能建立因果机制、任务外泛化能力或可部署的恢复系统。
tldr: This paper shows that internal activations of a fixed OpenVLA policy contain linearly decodable signals predictive of task failure under visual distribution shifts (occlusion, camera jitter) in LIBERO manipulation, with a logistic probe at layer 16 achieving high AUROC.
tldr_zh: 本文展示了在LIBERO操作任务中，固定OpenVLA策略的内部激活包含在线性可解码的信号，能够预测视觉分布偏移（遮挡、相机抖动）下的任务失败，第16层的逻辑探针达到了高AUROC。

title: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview: A Low-Compute Real-Time Controllable World Model
summary: We present DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview, a preview foundational world model for real-time interactive world simulation. The system adapts the LongLive 1 autoregressive video stack, itself derived from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, with a residual action pathway inspired by the Matrix-Game family. DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview focuses on a complementary axis to frontier-scale world simulators: low-compute adaptation, consumer-GPU runtime, and broad interactive capability coverage. It supports live keyboard and mouse control, multimodal initialization, mid-stream reprompting, dual-view operation, and minute-scale interactive rollouts at native 480p resolution, reaching up to 14 to 15 FPS FPS on a single RTX 4090 with a low memory footprint. By leveraging open video backbones and applying targeted adaptation runs, we build the preview system with high cost-efficiency. DF-World 0.1 Preview is not yet a memory-complete or frontier-quality world simulator, but demonstrates a practical low-compute route toward real-time controllable world-model previews on consumer GPUs.
summary_zh: 我们推出DreamForge-World 0.1预览版，这是一个用于实时交互世界模拟的预览性基础世界模型。该系统改编自LongLive 1自回归视频框架（其本身源于Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B），并引入了受Matrix-Game家族启发的残差动作路径。DreamForge-World 0.1预览版聚焦于与前沿规模世界模拟器互补的维度：低计算量适配、消费级GPU运行以及广泛的交互能力覆盖。它支持实时键盘与鼠标控制、多模态初始化、中途重新提示、双视角操作，以及原生480p分辨率下长达分钟级的交互式推演，在单张RTX 4090上可达14至15 FPS，且内存占用较低。通过利用开放视频主干网络并执行针对性适配训练，我们以高成本效益构建了该预览系统。DF-World 0.1预览版尚不具备完整记忆能力或达到前沿品质，但展示了一条在消费级GPU上实现实时可控世界模型预览的实用低计算路径。
tldr: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview is a low-compute, real-time controllable world model based on an open video backbone, enabling interactive simulation on consumer GPUs with keyboard/mouse control and minute-scale rollouts.
tldr_zh: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview 是一个低计算量、实时可控的世界模型，基于开源视频主干，在消费级 GPU 上实现交互式模拟，支持键盘鼠标控制和分钟级交互。

title: Shell-Supervised Gaussian Splatting for Urban Real-to-Sim Reconstruction
summary: Real-to-sim reconstruction for embodied AI requires geometry that is useful for collision reasoning, navigation, and agent-environment interaction, not only photorealistic novel-view synthesis. However, close-range urban facades are difficult for video-to-3D reconstruction: glass, reflections, repeated windows, and weak texture can produce visually plausible renderings with unstable surface geometry. We introduce shell-supervised Gaussian Splatting, a reconstruction-stage framework that uses an external facade structural shell as lightweight geometric supervision for video-driven Gaussian reconstruction. The method aligns an exterior shell to the video reconstruction frame, renders per-view depth, camera-space normal, and valid-mask maps, and applies these cues through mask-gated losses during Gaussian optimization. This design preserves RGB-driven appearance while regularizing only visible shell-supported facade regions. Experiments on anonymized close-range urban facade scenes show improved facade orientation and visible-surface point-cloud consistency over photo-only, monocular-cue, and surface-oriented Gaussian baselines, while maintaining comparable held-out rendering quality.
summary_zh: 面向具身AI的真实到仿真重建不仅需要逼真的新视角合成，更需要能够支撑碰撞推理、导航及智能体-环境交互的几何结构。然而，近景城市立面的视频到三维重建面临挑战：玻璃、反射、重复窗格及弱纹理区域虽能生成视觉可接受的渲染结果，但其表面几何结构不稳定。本文提出壳监督高斯泼溅法，这是一种重建阶段框架，通过引入外部立面结构壳作为轻量级几何监督，引导基于视频的高斯重建。该方法将外部壳与视频重建帧对齐，逐视角渲染深度图、相机空间法线图及有效掩膜图，并通过高斯优化过程中的掩膜门控损失函数应用这些线索。该设计在保留RGB驱动外观的同时，仅对壳支撑的可见立面区域进行几何正则化。在匿名化的近景城市立面场景实验中，相较于纯RGB方法、单目线索方法及表面导向高斯基线方法，所提方法在立面朝向一致性和可见表面点云一致性方面均有提升，同时保持了可比的保留视角渲染质量。
tldr: Shell-supervised Gaussian Splatting improves geometric reconstruction of urban facades for embodied AI by using a facade structural shell to regularize depth, normals, and mask cues during Gaussian optimization, enhancing point-cloud consistency without sacrificing visual quality.
tldr_zh: 壳监督高斯泼溅方法通过引入外墙结构壳作为几何监督，在优化过程中约束深度、法线和掩膜，提升了面向具身AI的城市立面几何重建精度，同时保持视觉渲染质量。

title: Efficient Visual Pointing for Embodied AI:Agent-Driven Data Synthesis, Cross-Block Attention, and Iterative Correction
summary: Visual pointing maps a language instruction to pixel co ordinates, a core skill for embodied AI. We describe our PointArena 2026 solution, which achieves 77.2% overall accuracy and ranks second on the benchmark. The ap proach targets three failure modes. First, agent-driven syn thesis builds large semantic and anchor-relative candidate pools; the server inventory contains 55,372 processed out puts, 53,772 de-duplicated sample IDs, and 37,574 train able completed or accepted rows. Second, a determinis tic steerable-data pipeline creates a verified 10,000-sample main set, plus reserve samples, using masks, templates, and path verification. Third, two model-side modules address complementary errors: AttnRes adds gated cross-block at tention for steerability, while ABC correction encodes per turbed coordinates with visual features for general coordi nate grounding. Category-aware routing combines comple mentary specialists; local validation used to select experts records 93.9% Affordance, 82.6% Spatial Relation, 78.2% Reasoning, 70.4% Counting, and 63.0% Steerability.
summary_zh: 视觉指向将语言指令映射到像素坐标，是具身智能的核心技能。本文描述了PointArena 2026竞赛的解决方案，该方案实现了77.2%的总体准确率，在基准测试中排名第二。该方法针对三种失效模式。首先，智能体驱动的合成构建了大规模语义候选池和锚点相对候选池；服务器库存包含55,372个已处理输出、53,772个去重样本ID以及37,574个可训练已完成或已接受条目。其次，确定性可操控数据流水线利用掩码、模板和路径验证，创建了经过验证的10,000样本主数据集及备用样本。第三，两个模型端模块针对互补性错误：AttnRes添加了用于可操控性的门控跨块注意力机制，而ABC校正将扰动坐标与视觉特征编码以实现通用坐标定位。类别感知路由结合了互补性专家模块；用于选择专家的局部验证记录了93.9%的可供性、82.6%的空间关系、78.2%的推理、70.4%的计数和63.0%的可操控性准确率。
tldr: The paper presents a visual pointing system for embodied AI that uses agent-driven data synthesis, cross-block attention, and iterative coordinate correction to achieve high accuracy on the PointArena 2026 benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向具身AI的视觉指向系统，通过智能体驱动数据合成、跨块注意力机制和迭代坐标校正，在PointArena 2026基准测试中取得了高精度。

title: Self-supervised Geometry Reasoning for LiDAR Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
summary: LiDAR simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies on local geometric quantities such as covariances, correspondences, and surface structures. However, most existing pipelines rely on hand-crafted estimates of local geometry and use them as fixed inputs to LiDAR SLAM, which can make the estimated local geometry noisy and unstable in sparse regions of a point cloud or when using low-resolution LiDAR. To address this issue, this paper introduces a self-supervised framework that learns an explicit symbolic representation of local geometry and uses it to improve LiDAR SLAM recursively. Specifically, each point is represented as a Gaussian distribution, allowing local geometry to be described by a covariance. Without dense geometry labels or ground-truth poses, the framework learns by maximizing the likelihood of local geometry, with self-supervision derived from consistency relations over symbolic geometric representations, including predicted covariances, correspondences, and trajectory from SLAM. The learned geometry is then fed back into LiDAR SLAM, forming a reciprocal loop in which improved geometry enhances localization and mapping, and improved localization provides cleaner supervision for subsequent geometry reasoning. This framework is backend-agnostic and can be plugged into existing LiDAR SLAM pipelines without architectural changes. Experiments on KITTI under varying LiDAR resolutions show that the proposed method improves both odometry and global registration.
summary_zh: LiDAR同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）依赖局部几何量，例如协方差、对应关系和表面结构。然而，现有大多数处理流程依赖于人工设计的局部几何估计，并将其作为LiDAR SLAM的固定输入，这可能导致在点云稀疏区域或使用低分辨率LiDAR时，所估计的局部几何存在噪声且不稳定。为解决该问题，本文提出一种自监督框架，学习局部几何的显式符号化表征，并利用其递归改进LiDAR SLAM。具体而言，每个点被表示为高斯分布，从而可用协方差描述局部几何。该框架无需稠密几何标签或真实位姿，通过最大化局部几何的似然进行学习，其自监督来源于符号化几何表征（包括预测的协方差、对应关系及SLAM轨迹）的一致性约束。学习得到的几何被反馈至LiDAR SLAM，形成相互循环：改进的几何提升了定位与建图精度，而更优的定位则为后续几何推理提供了更清晰的监督信号。该框架与后端无关，可直接嵌入现有LiDAR SLAM流程而无需修改架构。在不同LiDAR分辨率下的KITTI数据集实验表明，所提方法同时改进了里程计与全局配准性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a self-supervised framework that learns an explicit symbolic representation of local geometry (covariance) from LiDAR point clouds and uses it to improve LiDAR SLAM performance, especially under low-resolution conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自监督框架，通过从激光雷达点云中学习局部几何的显式符号表示（协方差），并利用其改进激光雷达SLAM性能，尤其在低分辨率条件下。

title: TacEvo: Self-Evolving Architecture Discovery for Robotic Tactile Perception via LLM-Driven Quality-Diversity Search
summary: Vision-based tactile sensing converts contact-induced surface deformation into images, enabling robots to infer contact forces and fine surface textures that are not accessible through conventional vision alone. However, tactile images are sensor- and physics-specific, so effective architectures often require expert intuition and extensive manual iteration. Existing neural architecture search (NAS) pipelines can reduce this burden, but they are often computationally expensive and restricted to hand-designed search spaces, which limits architectural novelty and diversity. We introduce TacEvo, a self-evolving architecture discovery framework that improves network designs from downstream feedback. TacEvo uses an LLM to generate code-level mutations and crossovers, and a MAP-Elites quality-diversity loop that preserves diverse elite architectures while preferentially reusing prompts that consistently yield improvements. Exploration is guided by two behavioural descriptors, Architectural Diversity and Efficiency Ratio, which encourage coverage across structural variations and compute-size trade-offs. On ViTacTip force regression and grating classification, TacEvo achieves high autonomous generation reliability (96.0%/94.5% trainable) and improves best validation fitness over 20 generations by 56.1%/96.1%. In a 20-seed post-search high-fidelity evaluation, TacEvo matches the expert baseline on force prediction and outperforms it on fine-grained grating classification. These results suggest that LLM-driven self-evolving search constitutes a practical paradigm for AI-assisted scientific discovery in specialised robotic sensing.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的触觉传感将接触引起的表面形变转化为图像，使机器人能够推断出接触力以及仅靠传统视觉无法获取的精细表面纹理。然而，触觉图像具有传感器和物理特性的特异性，因此有效的架构往往需要专家直觉和大量的人工迭代。现有的神经架构搜索（NAS）流程可以减轻这一负担，但通常计算成本高昂且局限于人工设计的搜索空间，这限制了架构的新颖性和多样性。我们提出了TacEvo，一个自我演化的架构发现框架，能够根据下游反馈改进网络设计。TacEvo利用大语言模型（LLM）生成代码层面的变异和交叉，并采用MAP-Elites质量-多样性循环，在优先重用那些能持续带来改进的提示词的同时，保留多样化的精英架构。探索过程由两个行为描述符——架构多样性与效率比——引导，这两个描述符鼓励覆盖结构变化与计算量-性能权衡。在ViTacTip力回归和光栅分类任务上，TacEvo实现了高自主生成可靠性（可训练率分别为96.0%/94.5%），并在20代演化中使最佳验证适应度分别提升了56.1%/96.1%。在20个随机种子下的搜索后高保真评估中，TacEvo在力预测方面与专家基线持平，并在细粒度光栅分类上超越基线。这些结果表明，大语言模型驱动的自我演化搜索构成了面向专业机器人感知中AI辅助科学发现的一种实用范式。
tldr: TacEvo uses an LLM-driven quality-diversity search (MAP-Elites) to automatically evolve neural network architectures for vision-based tactile perception, achieving performance comparable to expert-designed baselines on force regression and grating classification.
tldr_zh: TacEvo利用LLM驱动的质量多样性搜索（MAP-Elites）自动演化用于视觉触觉感知的神经网络架构，在力回归和光栅分类任务上达到了与专家设计基线相当的性能。

title: FalconTrack: Photorealistic Auto-Labeled Perception and Physics-Aware Vision-Based Aerial Tracking
summary: Vision-based aerial tracking is critical in GPS-denied environments. Reliable perception for tracking depends on large-scale labeled data, yet most photorealistic datasets rely on heavy manual annotation and are time-consuming to produce. We present FalconTrack, a unified perception-and-tracking framework that (i) leverages a photorealistic editable simulator for automated label generation and (ii) combines multi-head perception with physics-aware tracking for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. FalconTrack provides an automated labeling pipeline in a Gaussian Splatting simulator that isolates target Gaussians from short object videos and composites them with randomized backgrounds to generate RGB, mask, class, and 6-DoF pose labels, producing about 10k labeled images in under 20 minutes. Using this dataset, we train a multi-head perception module with staged learning and reprojection consistency, and fuse its outputs with class-conditioned dynamics priors in an EKF for tracking. Our perception model outperforms two baselines and reaches 96-100% class accuracy in zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on three geometrically diverse objects and two environments, while maintaining consistent performance in unseen simulated and real scenes. In real hardware closed-loop visual tracking, the onboard system runs at about 25 Hz and achieves 100% success in sim-to-real F1-tenth and gate tracking in five trajectories across two environments, while a mask-centered vision baseline drops to 60% success on F1-tenth during fast out-of-view scenarios.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的空中跟踪在GPS受限环境中至关重要。跟踪任务的可靠感知依赖于大规模标注数据，然而多数逼真数据集依赖繁重的人工标注，制作耗时。我们提出FalconTrack——一个统一的感知与跟踪框架，其：(i) 利用可编辑的逼真仿真器实现自动标签生成；(ii) 将多头感知与含物理信息的跟踪相结合，实现零样本仿真到真实场景迁移。FalconTrack在高斯泼溅仿真器中构建了自动标注流水线，从短时物体视频中分离目标高斯体，并与随机化背景合成，生成RGB、掩码、类别及6自由度位姿标签，能在20分钟内生成约1万张标注图像。利用该数据集，我们采用分阶段学习与重投影一致性策略训练多头感知模块，并将其输出与基于类别的动力学先验融合于扩展卡尔曼滤波器中用于跟踪。在三个几何形状各异的物体及两种环境下的零样本仿真到真实迁移中，我们的感知模型超越两个基线，达到96-100%的类别精度，且在未见过的仿真与真实场景中保持稳定性能。在实际硬件闭环视觉跟踪中，机载系统运行频率约25Hz，在跨越两种环境的五段轨迹中实现了F1-tenth赛车与门框跟踪的100%成功率，而基于掩码中心的视觉基线在快速离视场场景下，F1-tenth跟踪成功率降至60%。
tldr: FalconTrack is a unified perception-and-tracking framework that uses a photorealistic Gaussian Splatting simulator to auto-label data, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for aerial tracking with a multi-head perception module and physics-aware EKF.
tldr_zh: FalconTrack是一个统一的感知与跟踪框架，利用光真实感高斯泼溅模拟器自动标注数据，通过多头感知模块和物理感知的扩展卡尔曼滤波器实现零样本的模拟到现实迁移的空中跟踪。

title: Analyzing Uncertainty in the Spatial Representation of the Kinematic Bicycle Model
summary:
Locating a vehicle and determining its orientation in an uncertain environment is a critical challenge in autonomous vehicle navigation and path planning. To address these challenges, a vehicle estimates its pose while depending on sensor data that offer noisy measurements. These uncertainties in pose quantities are expressed mathematically as a covariance matrix. The real-time computation of the covariance matrix is critical because of the non-linearity involved in the kinematic model. The challenge is thus to evaluate the evolution of the covariance matrix of a vehicle's discretized stochastic kinematics.
  The purpose of this study is to obtain a near-accurate evolution of the covariance matrix of the rear-wheel bicycle kinematic model under uncertainties in wheel displacement and steering angle. We used Taylor's series to linearize the nonlinear trigonometric functions and provided closed-form expectations of random variables with the required accuracy. Our analytical findings are in good agreement with those obtained from Monte-Carlo simulations. Our contribution is probably the first detailed closed-form presentation of the covariance matrix constituents of the vehicle under evaluation, which were previously reported either incorrectly or incompletely. These findings aid in identifying the potential and constraints of the discretized kinematic model as well as its stochastic analysis. The techniques presented here are useful for the simultaneous localization and odometry self-calibration of certain mobile robots and autonomous vehicles.
summary_zh:
在不确定环境中定位车辆并确定其朝向，是自动驾驶车辆导航与路径规划中的关键挑战。为应对这些挑战，车辆需依赖提供含噪声测量值的传感器数据来估计其位姿。这些位姿量的不确定性在数学上以协方差矩阵形式表达。由于运动学模型中包含非线性因素，协方差矩阵的实时计算至关重要。因此，难点在于评估车辆离散化随机运动学中协方差矩阵的演化过程。

本研究旨在获取后轮自行车运动学模型在车轮位移与转向角存在不确定性时协方差矩阵的近似精确演化。我们采用泰勒级数对非线性三角函数进行线性化处理，并以所需精度给出了随机变量的闭合形式期望值。我们的分析结果与蒙特卡洛模拟结果高度吻合。本研究的贡献在于首次详细给出了所评估车辆协方差矩阵各组成部分的闭合形式表达——此前相关报告存在错误或不完整之处。这些发现有助于识别离散化运动学模型的潜力与局限性，及其随机分析中的约束条件。本文提出的技术可用于特定移动机器人及自动驾驶车辆的同步定位与里程计自标定。
tldr: This paper presents a closed-form analytic solution for computing the covariance matrix of the kinematic bicycle model under uncertainty, validated by Monte-Carlo simulations, for use in autonomous vehicle localization and odometry calibration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了在不确定性条件下运动学自行车模型协方差矩阵的闭式解析解，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证，可用于自动驾驶车辆定位和里程计自标定。

title: VISTA-DZ: Visual Semantic Trajectory Adaptation for Personalized Dilemma Zone Prediction
summary: Driver decision making in the dilemma zone at signalized intersections is safety critical, as vehicles approaching a yellow signal must decide whether to stop or proceed within limited time and distance margins. Accurate prediction of both stop-go decisions and decision timing is important for adaptive signal control, advanced driver assistance systems, and human-centered intelligent transportation applications. However, dilemma zone behavior is strongly driver dependent. Similar approach trajectories may lead to different decisions across drivers because of differences in risk preference, braking habit, and decision threshold. Existing personalized models often rely on handcrafted scalar descriptors, which provide useful but limited summaries of individual behavior. This paper proposes VISTA-DZ, a semantic-profile-conditioned framework for personalized stop-go and decision-time prediction. Historical trajectories are converted into visual representations, interpreted by a vision-language model to generate behavioral profiles, and encoded as semantic embeddings to condition a dual-output prediction network. The final model combines a bidirectional GRU encoder, driver-conditioned multi-head cross-attention, and Feature-wise Linear Modulation for temporal evidence selection and feature adaptation. Experiments on the SDZ dataset and a newly collected FDZ dataset show that VISTA-DZ outperforms trajectory-only and handcrafted personalization baselines, achieving 93.26% in-domain simulation accuracy and 90.22% mean accuracy across 20 held-out simulation drivers. Cross-domain results further show feasible zero-shot simulation-to-real transfer and better real-world generalization when simulation data are combined with limited field data.
summary_zh: 在信号交叉口两难区内的驾驶员决策关乎行车安全，因为接近黄灯的车辆必须在有限的时间和距离范围内决定是否停车或通过。准确预测停车-通行决策及其决策时机，对于自适应信号控制、高级驾驶员辅助系统以及以人为本的智能交通应用具有重要意义。然而，两难区行为具有强烈的驾驶员依赖性。由于风险偏好、制动习惯和决策阈值的差异，相似的接近轨迹可能导致不同驾驶员做出不同决策。现有的个性化模型通常依赖人工设计的标量描述符，这些描述符虽能提供有用的个体行为概括，但信息有限。本文提出VISTA-DZ——一种基于语义画像条件的个性化停车-通行及决策时间预测框架。历史轨迹被转换为视觉表征，由视觉-语言模型解读生成行为画像，并编码为语义嵌入，以条件化双输出预测网络。最终模型结合了双向门控循环单元编码器、驾驶员条件多头交叉注意力机制以及特征级线性调制，用于时序证据选择与特征自适应。在SDZ数据集和新收集的FDZ数据集上的实验表明，VISTA-DZ优于仅依赖轨迹和手工设计特征个性化基线方法，在域内仿真中达到93.26%的准确率，并在20名保留仿真驾驶员上的平均准确率达90.22%。跨域结果进一步展示了可行的零样本仿真到现实迁移，以及将仿真数据与有限现场数据结合后更好的现实世界泛化能力。
tldr: VISTA-DZ uses vision-language models to generate behavioral profiles from historical trajectories, enabling personalized stop-go and decision-time prediction for drivers in dilemma zones at signalized intersections.
tldr_zh: VISTA-DZ 利用视觉语言模型从历史轨迹中生成行为特征，实现信号交叉口困境区域中驾驶员停车/通过决策及决策时间的个性化预测。

title: AI Training Manager: Bounded Closed-Loop Control of Adaptive Training Recipes
summary: We present the AI Training Manager, a bounded LLM-based supervisory controller for adaptive machine learning training. Standard training pipelines often rely on fixed recipes or single-axis schedulers, which can struggle with mid-run failures such as severe overfitting, loss imbalance, exploration collapse, or unsafe exploration. Rather than replacing mathematical optimizers or acting as an unconstrained coding agent, the manager operates through a schema-conditioned interface: it reads structured telemetry snapshots from an active run, audits a constrained action space, and returns validated updates to training parameters such as learning rate, regularization strength, loss-weight coefficients, and exploration settings. We evaluate this architecture across supervised language modeling and reinforcement learning. On TinyStories, the manager detects and corrects overfitting, achieving a validation loss 60% lower than the baseline while producing auditable intervention logs. In this supervised setting, we additionally show that manager inference does not need to block the training loop: training can continue while a manager response is pending, and validated updates can be applied asynchronously once available. In a robotic manipulation reinforcement-learning task, we use the same bounded decision interface in an episodic closed-loop setting, where manager updates are applied at evaluation or checkpoint boundaries. The manager mitigates both conservative and unsafe exploration regimes. These results suggest that schema-conditioned LLMs can serve as bounded supervisory managers for live training runs, complementing conventional optimizers and schedulers with interpretable, multi-axis intervention capabilities
